surabaya.name: Rawon
surabaya.description: The soup is composed of a ground mixture of garlic, shallots, star anise, ginger, candlenut, turmeric, red chili, and salt and is sautéed with oil.

surabaya.name: Tahu campur
surabaya.description: The dish is made from fried tofu with potato or cassava cakes, dressed with lettuce, noodles, and beef stew.

jakarta.name: Soto Betawi
jakarta.description: The soup is made of beef or beef offal, cooked in a cow milk or coconut milk broth, with fried potato and tomato.

jakarta.name: Nasi Uduk
jakarta.description: Steamed rice cooked in coconut milk dish

jakarta.name: Nasi kebuli
jakarta.description: The dish consists of rice cooked in goat meat broth, goat milk, and clarified butter (most often ghee).

jakarta.name: Nasi ulam
jakarta.description: The dish is steamed rice served with various herbs and Vegetable, such as Centella leaves, lemon basil, and spices, accompanied by various side dishes.

jakarta.name: Kue satu
jakarta.description: This dish is a traditional cookie made of sweet white-colored mung bean powder that crumbles when bitten.

jakarta.name: Roti buaya
jakarta.description: The dish is two piece sweetened bread in the shape of a crocodile.

jakarta.name: Sayur asem
jakarta.description: The dish consists of Vegetable in tamarind soup. The sweet and sour flavour of this dish is considered refreshing and very compatible with fried or grilled dishes, including fried fish, fried chicken, and is usually eaten with steamed rice and sambal terasi chili paste.

jakarta.name: Rujak shanghai
jakarta.description: boiled sliced gurita (octopus) as well as edible jellyfish, kangkung, and served with thick red sweet and sour sauce, mixed with pineapple juice, and toasted crushed peanuts

jakarta.name: Asinan
jakarta.description: The vegetable type uses Chinese cabbage, cabbage, bean sprouts, tofu, and lettuce served in a thin, hot, peanut sauce with vinegar, topped with peanuts and krupuk(Crackers).The Fruit type uses preserved tropical fruits, such as raw mango, water apple, papaya, ambarella, jicama, nutmeg, and pineapple served in sweet, hot, and sour vinegar and chili sauce, sprinkled with peanuts.

jakarta.name: Sekoteng
jakarta.description: a ginger-based hot drink which includes peanuts, diced bread, and tapioca pearls (known locally as pacar cina)

bandung.name: Soto Bandung
bandung.description: The soup is a clear beef soto that has pieces of meat, white radish, and fried soybeans.

bandung.name: Nasi timbel
bandung.description: The dish consisting of steamed rice wrapped inside a banana leaf.The heat of the hot-cooked rice touches the banana leaf and produces a unique aroma.

bandung.name: Kupat tahu
bandung.description: The dish is a rice cake served with peanut sauce topped with crispy crackers.

palembang.name: Pindang patin
palembang.description: This spicy and savory soup where the main ingredients of this dish are usually catfish with herbs and spices

palembang.name: Nasi Lemak
palembang.description: The dish consists of fragrant rice cooked in coconut milk and pandan leaf

palembang.name: Lakso
palembang.description: The dish is a spicy noodle dish served in savoury yellowish coconut milk-based soup, flavoured with fish, and sprinkled with fried shallots.

india.name: Chicken tikka
india.description: The dish is small pieces of boneless chicken baked using skewers on a brazier.

india.name: Palak paneer
india.description: The stew in a thick paste made from puréed spinach.

india.name: Biryani
india.description: The dish is a popular South Asian mixed rice dish made with rice, meat (such as chicken, goat, lamb, beef, prawn, or fish), and spices. Vegetarian versions use Vegetable or paneer, and sometimes eggs and potatoes are added.

india.name: Kedgeree
india.description: The dish consisting of cooked, flaked fish (traditionally smoked haddock), boiled rice, parsley, hard-boiled eggs, curry powder, lemon juice, salt, butter or cream, and occasionally sultanas. The dish can be eaten hot or cold.

india.name: Khichdi
india.description: The dish is made of rice and lentils (dal) with numerous variations. Variations include bajra and mung dal khichri.

india.name: Pilaf
india.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

india.name: Pitha
india.description: The dishes are a variety of food similar to pancakes, dumplings or fritters. This dish can be sweet or savoury, and usually made from a dough or batter, which is then steamed, fried or griddled. Very few varieties are oven-baked or boiled, and most are unleavened and cooked on a stovetop (or equivalent).

india.name: Rice and curry
india.description: The dish usually consists of a large bowl of rice, most often boiled, but frequently fried, a vegetable curry, a meat curry, dhal, papadums, and sambals.

india.name: Sevai
india.description: The dish is a type of rice vermicelli dish. While typically made from rice, varieties made from other food grains like wheat, ragi, and others can also be found.

india.name: Aloo tikki
india.description: The dish it is made of boiled potatoes, peas, and various curry spices. The dish is served hot along with a side of saunth, tamarind, and coriander-mint sauce, and sometimes dahi (yogurt) or chickpeas.

india.name: Seekh kebab
india.description: This dish is a type of kebab made with Indian spices, spiced minced or ground meat, usually lamb, beef, or chicken, formed into cylinders on skewers and grilled. It is typically cooked on a mangal or barbecue, or in a tandoor.
india.photoCredit: Jess Lander from Culver City, CA, USA

india.name: Curry puff
india.description: This dish is a small pie consisting of curry with chicken and potatoes in a fried or baked pastry shell.

india.name: Bakarkhani
india.description: A thick, spiced flat-bread that is part of the Mughlai cuisine. It is almost biscuit-like in texture, with a hard crust. The main ingredients are flour, semolina, sugar, molasses soaked in saffron, poppy or nigella seeds, salt, and clarified butter.

india.name: Teacake
india.description: In one region, it is a light yeast-based sweet bun containing dried fruit, typically served toasted and buttered. In other areas can be cookies or small cakes. In another country, they can be soft, round, flat wheat breads made with milk and a little sugar, and used to make buttered ham or cheese sandwiches. In other regions, it is more like a butter cake.

india.name: Dhebra
india.description: To create this bread, sufficient water and salt are mixed with millet flour and whole wheat flour to make a dough. The resulting dough balls are then flattened to a round shape using a rolling pin. Then, both sides are lightly fried with vegetable oil on a tava, until small brown spots appear.

india.name: Kulcha
india.description: The dish is a term for a disc-shaped loaf of leavened bread. It describes a disc-shaped loaf of bread, bun or even biscuit. It made from maida flour, water, a pinch of salt and a leavening agent (yeast, sourdough or old dough), mixed together by hand to make a soft dough. This dough is covered with a wet cloth and left to rest for an hour or so in a warm place. The result is a slight leavening of the dough but not much. The flour is kneaded again by hand and then rolled out using a rolling pin into a flat, round shape. In commercial establishments, it is baked in an earthen clay oven until done. After cooking, it is taken off the fire and optionally brushed with butter or ghee for a shiny, appetizing appearance.

india.name: Sheermal
india.description: The dish is a saffron-flavored traditional flatbread.

india.name: Manda roti
india.description: This dish is extremely thin and limp, and served folded like a handkerchief.
india.photoCredit: Lian Chang from New York City

india.name: Roti canai
india.description: The dish is a flatbread made from dough that is composed of fat (usually ghee), flour, and water; some recipes also include sweetened condensed milk.

india.name: Paratha
india.description: The dish is a kine of unleavened flatbreads made by baking or cooking whole-wheat dough on a tava, and finishing off with shallow-frying.

india.name: Naan
india.description: The dish is a leavened, oven-baked or tawa-fried flatbread, that can also be baked in a tandoor. It is characterized by a light and fluffy texture and golden-brown spots from the baking process.

india.name: Papadam
india.description: The dish is made from dough of black gram bean flour, which is either deep fried or cooked with dry heat by being flipped over an open flame until crunchy.

india.name: Roti
india.description: The dish is a round flatbread made from stoneground whole wheat flour

india.name: Goat curry
india.description: The dish is a curry dish prepared with goat meat.

india.name: Chicken curry
india.description: The dish consists of chicken stewed in an onion- and tomato-based sauce, flavoured with ginger, garlic, tomato puree, chilli peppers and a variety of spices.

india.name: Aloo paratha
india.description: The dish is a flatbread stuffed with potato filling.

india.name: Gobi paratha
india.description: The dish is a flatbread stuffed with flavoured cauliflower and other vegetable.

india.name: Korma
india.description: This dish is a stew consisting of meat or vegetables braised with yogurt, water or stock, and spices to produce a thick sauce or gravy.

india.name: Paya
india.description: This dish consists of the trotters (hooves) of a cow, goat, buffalo, or sheep, cooked with various spices. It is served at various festivals and gatherings, or made for special guests.

india.name: Fruit bun
india.description: The dish is a type of sweet roll made with fruit, fruit peel, spices and sometimes nuts. They are made with fruit and fruit peel , which are sprinkled and cooked with sugar nibs.

india.name: Samosa
india.description: The dish is a pastry with a savory filling, mostly Vegetable, spiced potatoes, onions, peas, also non-vegetarian meat, or fish. It is made into different shapes, including triangular, cone, or crescent, depending on the region.

india.name: Masala omelette
india.description: The dish is a variant of the omelette. Its main ingredients are eggs, herbs, tomatoes and spices that vary by region.

india.name: Kinema
india.description: The dish is made by boiling soybeans and then fermenting them. The fermentation process gives kinema a distinct aroma. It is typically used in various dishes, including curries, salads, and as a savoury dip or a pungent side dish to be consumed along with rice or bread.

india.name: Gundruk
india.description: The dish is obtained from the fermentation of leafy vegetables sometimes mixed with the roots as well. It is served as a side dish with the main meal and is also used as an appetizer.

india.name: Kosambari
india.description: This dish is a salad made primarily from split legumes, cucumber, and seasoned with mustard seeds. Typically including ingredients like mung beans, coriander, and optional additions such as ash gourd and green mango, it is usually served as part of a full meal or enjoyed as a snack.

india.name: Koottu
india.description: This is a vegetable stew known for its nutty flavors and semi-solid consistency. It combines lentils and various vegetables, often featuring coconut and spices, and can be served alongside rice and other dishes.

india.name: Kuzhambu
india.description: This is a tamarind-based stew, made with a variety of meats, vegetables, and sometimes dal. The dish features a broth of tamarind and spices like coriander and fenugreek, and can be served watery or thick, often enjoyed as a side for rice, with numerous regional variations adapting to local tastes.

india.name: Rajma
india.description: The dish consists of red kidney beans in a thick gravy with many Indian whole spices, and is usually served with rice.

india.name: Chhena Matar Tarkari
india.description: It is a vegetarian dish. It generally consists of peas and acid-set cheese in a tomato-based sauce, spiced with garam masala.

india.name: Chole bhature
india.description: This dish is a combination of spicy white chickpeas and deep-fried bread made from super-refined wheat flour. It is often eaten as a breakfast dish, sometimes accompanied with lassi.

india.name: Dahi
india.description: It is a traditional yogurt or fermented milk product. It is usually prepared from cows' milk, and sometimes buffalo milk or goat milk.

india.name: South Asian pickle
india.description: It is a pickled food made from a variety of vegetables, meats and fruits preserved in brine, vinegar, edible oils, and various spices.

india.name: Bagiya
india.description: It is a steamed dumpling that consists of an external covering of rice flour and an inner content of sweet substances such like vegetables and other fried items.

india.name: Marzipan
india.description: This dish consists primarily of sugar and almond meal (ground almonds), sometimes augmented with almond oil or extract.

india.name: Amba
india.description: The dish is a sauce made of a tangy mango pickle condiment.

india.name: Gajar ka halwa
india.description: The dish is a carrot-based sweet dessert pudding made by placing grated carrots in a pot containing a specific amount of water, milk, sugar, and cardamom and then cooking while stirring regularly. It is often served with a garnish of almonds and pistachios.

bangladesh.name: Chicken tikka
bangladesh.description: The dish is small pieces of boneless chicken baked using skewers on a brazier.

bangladesh.name: Biryani
bangladesh.description: The dish is a popular South Asian mixed rice dish made with rice, meat (such as chicken, goat, lamb, beef, prawn, or fish), and spices. Vegetarian versions use Vegetable or paneer, and sometimes eggs and potatoes are added.

pakistan.name: Bannu pulao
pakistan.description: The dish is made with beef, rice, spices, and stock. The beef is cooked with bones and marrow, which gives the dish a rich and flavorful taste. The rice is cooked separately with ghee, salt, and whole spices. The dish is served with a garnish of onions, green chilies, and lemon wedges.

pakistan.name: Gobi paratha
pakistan.description: The dish is a flatbread stuffed with flavoured cauliflower and other vegetable.

pakistan.name: Sajji
pakistan.description: This dish traditionally consists of lamb, marinated only in salt with a few spices. It is served with rice that is cooked inside the animal, which is then baked.

pakistan.name: Paya
pakistan.description: This dish consists of the trotters (hooves) of a cow, goat, buffalo, or sheep, cooked with various spices. It is served at various festivals and gatherings, or made for special guests.

pakistan.name: Bun kebab
pakistan.description: The dish is a sandwich. It is eaten as a regular street food. It is usually eaten as a main course or snack. It consists of a shallow-fried spicy patty, onions, and chutney. The chutney is made up from tamarind, salt, cumin powder, whole red chillies, and/or yogurt in a grilled bun. The patties are typically composed of ground beef or mutton, ground lentils, powdered cumin seeds, and an egg batter. Although they can be vegetarian. The patties are fried in ghee or oil. They can also be served with a fried egg or omelette and topped with tomatoes, cucumbers, or onions.

pakistan.name: Rajma
pakistan.description: The dish consists of red kidney beans in a thick gravy with many Indian whole spices, and is usually served with rice.

pakistan.name: Dahi
pakistan.description: It is a traditional yogurt or fermented milk product. It is usually prepared from cows' milk, and sometimes buffalo milk or goat milk.

pakistan.name: South Asian pickle
pakistan.description: It is a pickled food made from a variety of vegetables, meats and fruits preserved in brine, vinegar, edible oils, and various spices.

pakistan.description: The dish is a carrot-based sweet dessert pudding made by placing grated carrots in a pot containing a specific amount of water, milk, sugar, and cardamom and then cooking while stirring regularly. It is often served with a garnish of almonds and pistachios.

punjab.name: Saag
punjab.description: The stew is leafy vegetable dish eaten with bread. It can be made from mustard greens, collard greens, basella or finely chopped broccoli along with added spices and sometimes other ingredients, such as chhena.

punjab.name: Kulcha
punjab.description: The dish is a term for a disc-shaped loaf of leavened bread. It describes a disc-shaped loaf of bread, bun or even biscuit. It made from maida flour, water, a pinch of salt and a leavening agent (yeast, sourdough or old dough), mixed together by hand to make a soft dough. This dough is covered with a wet cloth and left to rest for an hour or so in a warm place. The result is a slight leavening of the dough but not much. The flour is kneaded again by hand and then rolled out using a rolling pin into a flat, round shape. In commercial establishments, it is baked in an earthen clay oven until done. After cooking, it is taken off the fire and optionally brushed with butter or ghee for a shiny, appetizing appearance.

gujarat.name: Dhansak
gujarat.description: The stew is made by cooking mutton or goat meat with a mixture of lentils and vegetable

gujarat.name: Bhakri
gujarat.description: The dish is a round flatbread. It is coarser than a regular wheat flatbread. It can be either soft or hard in texture.

gujarat.name: Bhel puri
gujarat.description: The dish is made of puffed rice, crumbled crunchy puri, onions, cilantro and tossed with two chutneys: a green spicy cilantro chutney and a brown tangy tamarind chutney.
gujarat.photoCredit: Barry Pousman from New York, NY

gujarat.name: Dhokla
gujarat.description: This dish is a savoury sponge dish that is made with a fermented batter that is steamed to a cake-like consistency. The batter consists of a mixture of rice with the pulse Bengal gram, but has several variants with the gram replaced by chickpeas, pigeon peas, or urad beans.

gujarat.name: Khakhra
gujarat.description: The dish is a thin cracker. It is made from mat bean, wheat flour and oil.

gujarat.name: Puran poli
gujarat.description: The dish is a flatbread made of a variant of chick pea, wheat flour, sugar, a type of clarified butter, jaggery.

delhi.name: Dal Makhani
delhi.description: The stew is a modern variation of traditional lentil dishes, it is made with black lentils and other pulses, and includes butter and cream.

sumatra.name: Nasi Lemak
sumatra.description: The dish consists of fragrant rice cooked in coconut milk and pandan leaf

sumatra.name: Asam pedas
sumatra.description: This dish is a sour and spicy fish stew dish. It is often cooked with asam (tamarind) fruit juice with chilli and spices.

sumatra.name: Telur pindang
sumatra.description: The dish is a hard-boiled egg cooked in the pindang process. The eggs are boiled slowly in water mixed with salt, soy sauce, shallot skins, teak leaf, and other spices.

sumatra.name: Perkedel
sumatra.description: mashed fried potato mixed with chopped scallion and seasoned with white pepper powder, then shaped into flat round patties and dipped in egg yolk or beaten egg, before being deep fried

indonesia.name: Nasi Lemak
indonesia.description: The dish consists of fragrant rice cooked in coconut milk and pandan leaf

indonesia.name: Nasi Campur
indonesia.description: The dish of a scoop of white rice accompanied by small portions of several other dishes, which includes meats, Vegetable, peanuts, eggs, and fried-shrimp krupuk.

indonesia.name: Nasi Goreng
indonesia.description: The rice dish with pieces of meat and Vegetable added and it can refer simply to fried pre-cooked rice, a meal including stir fried rice in a small amount of cooking oil or margarine, typically spiced with sweet soy sauce, shallot, garlic, ground shrimp paste, tamarind and chilli and accompanied by other ingredients, particularly egg, chicken and prawns.
indonesia.photoCredit: shankar s. from Dubai, united arab emirates

indonesia.name: Sinangag
indonesia.description: The dish is fried rice stir-fried with garlic, using preferably stale rice for a firmer texture. It is garnished with toasted garlic, rock salt, black pepper, and sometimes chopped scallions. The rice grains are ideally loose and not stuck together.

indonesia.name: Bubur ayam
indonesia.description: The dish is rice congee with shredded chicken, served with condiments like chopped scallion, crispy fried shallot, celery, preserved Vegetable, fried soybean, crullers, and soy sauce. It is sometimes topped with yellow chicken broth and crackers

indonesia.name: Rijsttafel
indonesia.description: The dish consists of many side dishes served in small portions, accompanied by rice prepared in several different ways. Popular side dishes include egg rolls, sambals, satay, fish, fruit, Vegetable, pickles, and nuts.

indonesia.name: Lemang
indonesia.description: This dish is made from glutinous rice, coconut milk, and salt, cooked in a hollowed bamboo tube coated with banana leaves in order to prevent the rice from sticking to the bamboo.

indonesia.name: Lemper
indonesia.description: This dish is a savoury snack made of glutinous rice filled with seasoned shredded chicken or meat floss. The meat filling is rolled inside the rice, in a fashion similar to an egg roll; this is in turn rolled and wrapped inside a banana leaf, oil paper, plastic sheet, or tinfoil to make a packet ready for serving. If banana leaf is not available, corn husk can be used.

indonesia.name: Lepet
indonesia.description: This dish is a type of sticky rice dumpling mixed with peanuts cooked with coconut milk and packed inside a young coconut leaf or palm leaf.

indonesia.name: Lontong
indonesia.description: This dish is made of compressed rice cake in the form of a cylinder wrapped inside a banana leaf. Rice is rolled inside a banana leaf and boiled, then cut into small cakes as a staple food replacement for steamed rice.
indonesia.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Diádoco assumed (based on copyright claims).

indonesia.name: Lumpia
indonesia.description: This dish is made of thin paper-like or crepe-like pastry skin enveloping savory or sweet fillings. It is often served as an appetizer or snack, and might be served deep-fried or fresh (unfried).

indonesia.name: Nasi bakar
indonesia.description: The dish is steamed rice seasoned with spices, wrapped in banana leaves, and grilled over charcoal. The banana leaf imparts a unique aroma to the rice. Variants include ingredients like fried chicken, beef, anchovy, fish, shrimp, mushrooms, tempeh, tofu, and salted duck egg.

indonesia.name: Nasi kuning
indonesia.description: The dish is an Indonesian fragrant rice dish cooked with coconut milk and turmeric

indonesia.name: Nasi padang
indonesia.description: The dish is a miniature banquet of meats, fish, Vegetable, and spicy sambals eaten with plain white rice

indonesia.name: Nasi tim
indonesia.description: The dish is made of chicken, mushroom and hard boiled egg. These are seasoned in soy sauce and garlic, and then placed at the bottom of a tin bowl. This tin bowl is then filled with rice and steamed until cooked. This dish is usually served with light chicken broth and chopped leeks.

indonesia.name: Kue lapis
indonesia.description: The dish usually consists of two alternating coloured layers, thus the name of the cake. The cake is made of rice flour, sago, coconut milk, sugar, salt, and food colouring. Popular food colouring includes green-coloured pandan and red frozen food colouring. This cake is steamed gradually, and layers are subsequently added in alternating order to avoid different colours mixing together. This method will create layered pudding-cake.

indonesia.name: Lupis
indonesia.description: The dish is a sweet cake made of glutinous rice, banana leaves, coconut, and brown sugar sauce. It is usually eaten with thick palm sugar syrup and with shredded coconut toppings.

indonesia.name: Bánh tổ
indonesia.description: The dish is made from glutinus irce flour with sticky sweet texture with brown color.

indonesia.name: Kwetiau Goreng
indonesia.description: The dish is made from noodles, which are stir-fried in cooking oil with garlic, onion or shallots, beef, chicken, fried prawn, crab or sliced bakso (meatballs), chili, Chinese cabbage, cabbages, tomatoes, egg, and other Vegetable with an ample amount of kecap manis.

indonesia.name: Mie Goreng
indonesia.description: The dish is made from thin yellow noodles stir-fried in cooking oil with garlic, onion or shallots, fried prawn, chicken, beef, or sliced bakso (meatballs), chili, Chinese cabbage, cabbages, tomatoes, egg, and other Vegetable.

indonesia.name: Mie ayam
indonesia.description: The dish consists of yellow wheat noodle boiled in water until it achieves an al dente texture and mixed in a bowl with cooking oil, soy sauce, and garlic. The oil can be chicken fat, lard, vegetable oil, or garlic oil. The chicken meat is diced and cooked in soy sauce and other seasonings including garlic.

indonesia.name: Wonton noodles
indonesia.description: The dish consists of egg noodles served in a hot broth, garnished with leafy Vegetable and wonton dumplings. Common Vegetable include broccoli or kale. The wontons typically contain prawns, chicken or pork, and spring onions, with some variations including mushrooms or black mushroom.

indonesia.name: Bakmi
indonesia.description: The dish is a type of wheat based noodles. It is typically prepared seasoned in soy sauce and topped with pork products, which is often substituted for other protein sources as halal option.

indonesia.name: Laksa
indonesia.description: The dish consists of various types of noodles, most commonly thick rice noodles, with toppings such as chicken, prawns or fish. Most variations of the dish are prepared with a rich and spicy coconut curry soup or a broth seasoned with asam (tamarind or gelugur).

indonesia.name: Bihun Goreng
indonesia.description: The fried noodles dish cooked with rice vermicelli.

indonesia.name: Kripik
indonesia.description: The dish is a bite size cracker which made from dried cassava, Vegetable, and fish with deep frying process, seasoned with salt, chili powder, and sugar.

indonesia.name: Pisang Goreng
indonesia.description: The dish is made by banana. The banana is often battered and then deep fried in ample palm oil.

indonesia.name: Mun tahu
indonesia.description: This dish is a soft tofu braised in savoury thick white sauce, mixed with minced chicken and shrimp. It is mildly flavoured with garlic, ginger and onion, seasoned with small amount of soy sauce, salt and pepper. The colour of the sauce is whitish due to minimal addition of soy sauce. This white sauce is thickened using batter of tapioca powder or maize powder; resulting in a thick, slightly runny, gelatinized white sauce.

indonesia.name: Ang ku kueh
indonesia.description: The dish is red tortoise shaped with skin made of rice flour and sweet potato, whereas the fillings are made of mung bean, peanuts and sugar.

indonesia.name: Kue mangkok
indonesia.description: The dish is a traditional steamed cupcake that requires few ingredients, typically around four to five, and is cooked by steaming.

indonesia.name: Pineapple tart
indonesia.description: The dish is a small, bite-size tart filled with pineapple jam made with butter and egg yolk.

indonesia.name: Kue putri salju
indonesia.description: The dish is dried cake shaped like crescents and covered with powdered sugar.

indonesia.name: Kue semprong
indonesia.description: The dish is a wafer snack made by clasping egg batter using an iron mold (Waffle iron) which is heated up on a charcoal stove.

indonesia.name: Curry puff
indonesia.description: This dish is a small pie consisting of curry with chicken and potatoes in a fried or baked pastry shell.

indonesia.name: Roti john
indonesia.description: The dish is an omelette sandwich. The sandwich is made with a baguette-type loaf with a fried filling of egg, minced meat (chicken, sardine or mutton), and onion, fried in a roll and served with tomato-chilli sauce. Variants may use additional or alternative ingredients such as beef, mutton and sardines.

indonesia.name: Kamir
indonesia.description: The dish is a round-shaped bread that almost similar to pancake, consists of flour, butter, and egg mixture, sometimes mixed with other fillings ingredients such as banana, tapai, strawberry, pineapple, jackfruit, cheese, and chocolate.

indonesia.name: Roti canai
indonesia.description: The dish is a flatbread made from dough that is composed of fat (usually ghee), flour, and water; some recipes also include sweetened condensed milk.

indonesia.name: Naan
indonesia.description: The dish is a leavened, oven-baked or tawa-fried flatbread, that can also be baked in a tandoor. It is characterized by a light and fluffy texture and golden-brown spots from the baking process.

indonesia.name: Roti
indonesia.description: The dish is a round flatbread made from stoneground whole wheat flour

indonesia.name: Goat curry
indonesia.description: The dish is a curry dish prepared with goat meat.

indonesia.name: Rissole
indonesia.description: This dish is a ball or flattened cake of chopped meat, fish, or Vegetable mixed with herbs or spices, then coated in breadcrumbs and fried.

indonesia.name: Spring roll
indonesia.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

indonesia.name: Popiah
indonesia.description: This dish is a fresh spring roll filled with an assortment of fresh, dried, and cooked ingredients, eaten during a festival and other celebratory occasions.

indonesia.name: Chicken feet
indonesia.description: This dish is a part of chicken which cooked and eaten in many countries. This dish has a distinct gelatinous texture different from the rest of the chicken meat.

indonesia.name: Beefsteak
indonesia.description: This dish is flat cut of beef with parallel faces, usually cut perpendicular to the muscle fibers.

indonesia.name: Hutspot
indonesia.description: The dish is boiled and mashed potatoes, carrots, and onions.

indonesia.name: Chai tow kway
indonesia.description: The dish is stir-fried cubes of radish cake.
indonesia.photoCredit: See-ming Lee from Hong Kong SAR, China

indonesia.name: Ayam buah keluak
indonesia.description: dish consisting of chicken (ayam), tamarind gravy and keluak nuts

indonesia.name: Pie tee
indonesia.description: A thin and crispy pastry tart shell often filled with a spicy, shredded Chinese turnips, sweet mixture of thinly sliced vegetables and prawns

indonesia.name: Bakwan
indonesia.description: beansprouts, shredded cabbages and carrots, battered and deep fried in cooking oil

indonesia.name: Bakso
indonesia.description: This dish is finely ground beef with a small quantity of tapioca flour and salt, and then served in a bowl of beef broth, with yellow noodles, rice vermicelli,broccoli, bean sprout, sprinkled with fried shallots and celery

indonesia.name: Guazi
indonesia.description: baked seeds of the sunflower, pumpkin, or watermelon seeds

indonesia.name: Youtiao
indonesia.description: This dish is a long golden-brown deep-fried strip of wheat flour dough

indonesia.name: Bakpia
indonesia.description: This dish has flaky version and cake-dough version. The dish itself is filled with either mung bean, pork, purple yam or azuki beans.

indonesia.name: Grass jelly
indonesia.description: The jelly is made by boiling the aged and slightly oxidized stalks and leaves of Platostoma palustre (Mesona chinensis) with potassium carbonate and a little starch for several hours, then let it cool and served with sweet beverages.

indonesia.name: Yusheng
indonesia.description: This dish consists of strips of raw fish (sometimes salmon), mixed with shredded Vegetable and a variety of sauces and condiments, among other ingredients

indonesia.name: Tee long pan
indonesia.description: a steamed rice roll serve with shrimp paste or chilli sauce or with red chilli sauce, crushed roasted peanuts, fried shallots, and dried shrimp.

singapore.name: Nasi Goreng

singapore.name: Sinangag
singapore.description: The dish is fried rice stir-fried with garlic, using preferably stale rice for a firmer texture. It is garnished with toasted garlic, rock salt, black pepper, and sometimes chopped scallions. The rice grains are ideally loose and not stuck together.

singapore.name: Hainanese chicken rice
singapore.description: The dish is poached chicken served with seasoned rice, accompanied by chili sauce and usually garnished with cucumber.

singapore.name: Char Kway Teow

singapore.name: Singapore hokkien mee
singapore.description: The dish consists of egg noodles and rice noodles stir-fried with egg, slices of pork, prawns and squid. The key to the dish is copious quantities of an aromatic broth made from prawns and pork bones, slowly simmered for many hours. Sambal chilli and calamansi limes are served on the side for the diner to blend in, giving it an extra zing and tanginess.

singapore.name: Singapore hae mee
singapore.description: The dish consists of egg noodles and rice noodles are served in richly flavoured dark soup stock with prawns, pork slices, fish cake slices, and bean sprouts topped with fried shallots and spring onion. The stock is made using dried shrimps, prawn heads, white pepper, garlic and other spices.

singapore.name: Mee goreng
singapore.description: The dish is prepared by stir-frying noodles with Vegetable, eggs, and other ingredients such as tofu and meat. Another version may include spices, tomato sauce, potatoes, cabbage, and sweet soy sauce. A slice of lime, usually of the calamansi variety, is often placed at the side of the plate as a garnish.

singapore.name: Mee siam
singapore.description: The dish consists of thin rice vermicelli of hot, sweet and sour flavours. the dish usually served along any of the followings sides: fried chicken, fried or boiled egg, speciality sambal, otak-otak, and luncheon meat.

singapore.name: Banmian
singapore.description: The dish consists of egg noodles served in a flavorful soup, often with some type of meat or fish, Vegetable and various spices. Dried anchovies, minced pork, mushrooms, and a leafy vegetable such as sweet potato leaves or sayur manis are also possible ingredients.

singapore.name: Mango pudding
singapore.description: The dish is a very popular dessert. The fresh variant is prepared by the restaurant or eatery and consists of agar or gelatin, mangoes, evaporated milk, and sugar. singapore.name: Fruit bun
singapore.description: The dish is a type of sweet roll made with fruit, fruit peel, spices and sometimes nuts. They are made with fruit and fruit peel , which are sprinkled and cooked with sugar nibs.

singapore.name: Oyster omelette
singapore.description: The dish is an omelette filled primarily with small oysters, with starch (often sweet potato starch) mixed into the egg batter for a thicker consistency. australia.description: This biscuit is made using rolled oats, flour, sugar, butter (or margarine), golden syrup, baking soda, boiling water and optionally desiccated coconut.

australia.description: The dish is confectionery composed of a shortbread biscuit base topped with caramel and milk chocolate.

australia.name: Cheesymite scroll
australia.description: The dish is a savoury baked food. It consists of a spiral of baked bread similar to a pain aux raisins with a thick, dark brown food spread and cheese in place of raisins.

australia.name: Neenish tart
australia.description: A tart made with a pastry base and a filling consisting of sweet gelatine-set cream, mock cream, icing sugar paste, or lemon and sweetened condensed milk mixture, with dried icing on the top of the tart in two colours.

australia.name: Teacake
australia.description: In one region, it is a light yeast-based sweet bun containing dried fruit, typically served toasted and buttered. In other areas can be cookies or small cakes. In another country, they can be soft, round, flat wheat breads made with milk and a little sugar, and used to make buttered ham or cheese sandwiches. In other regions, it is more like a butter cake.

australia.name: Damper
australia.description: A thick home-made bread from wheat-based dough. Flour, salt and water, with some butter if available, is lightly kneaded and baked in the coals of a campfire, either directly or within a camp oven.

australia.name: Rissole

australia.name: Prawn roll
australia.description: This dish is made using a soft white roll approximately 6 inches or 15 cm long, stuffed with a dozen or more peeled prawns, lettuce and remoulade, Thousand Island or cocktail-style sauce.

australia.name: Boston bun
australia.description: The dish is a large spiced bun with a thick layer of coconut icing. Traditionally the bun contains sieved mashed potato, and modern versions sometimes contain raisins or sultanas. It is often served sliced and buttered, to accompany a cup of tea.

australia.name: Finger bun
australia.description: The dish is a fruit bun. At one time it was a bakery and school staple but its popularity has waned.

australia.description: The dish consists of zucchini, eggs, cheese, usually bacon, and flour, baked to form a flat loaf. It is then cut into squares and served as a main dish or a side dish, often eaten for lunch.

australia.name: Pavlova
australia.description: The dish is a meringue-based dessert, taking the form of a cake-like circular block of baked meringue. It has a crisp crust and is soft, light inside usually topped with fruit and whipped cream.

australia.name: Saveloy
australia.description: This dish is a type of highly seasoned sausage, usually bright red, normally boiled and available in fish and chip shops. It is sometimes also available fried in batter.

malaysia.description: This dish is made of lard or butter, flour, and eggs, using a bamboo steamer to develop puffiness.

malaysia.name: Chicken feet
malaysia.description: This dish is a part of chicken which cooked and eaten in many countries. This dish has a distinct gelatinous texture different from the rest of the chicken meat.

malaysia.name: Mango pudding
malaysia.description: The dish is a very popular dessert. The fresh variant is prepared by the restaurant or eatery and consists of agar or gelatin, mangoes, evaporated milk, and sugar. In addition, fresh fruit such as mango, strawberries, berries and kiwifruit, are occasionally added as garnish. Served and eaten refrigerator cold, it has a rich and creamy texture.

malaysia.name: Oyster omelette
malaysia.description: The dish is an omelette filled primarily with small oysters, with starch (often sweet potato starch) mixed into the egg batter for a thicker consistency. It is often fried in pork lard, and some variations include a savory sauce poured on top. Spicy or chili sauce with lime juice is often added for extra flavor.

malaysia.name: Chai tow kway
malaysia.description: The dish is stir-fried cubes of radish cake.
malaysia.photoCredit: See-ming Lee from Hong Kong SAR, China

malaysia.name: Ayam buah keluak
malaysia.description: dish consisting of chicken (ayam), tamarind gravy and keluak nuts

malaysia.name: Pie tee
malaysia.description: A thin and crispy pastry tart shell often filled with a spicy, shredded Chinese turnips, sweet mixture of thinly sliced vegetables and prawns

malaysia.name: Guazi
malaysia.description: baked seeds of the sunflower, pumpkin, or watermelon seeds

malaysia.name: Youtiao
malaysia.description: This dish is a long golden-brown deep-fried strip of wheat flour dough

malaysia.name: Grass jelly
malaysia.description: The jelly is made by boiling the aged and slightly oxidized stalks and leaves of Platostoma palustre (Mesona chinensis) with potassium carbonate and a little starch for several hours, then let it cool and served with sweet beverages.

malaysia.name: Yusheng
malaysia.description: This dish consists of strips of raw fish (sometimes salmon), mixed with shredded Vegetable and a variety of sauces and condiments, among other ingredients

malaysia.name: Tee long pan
malaysia.description: a steamed rice roll serve with shrimp paste or chilli sauce or with red chilli sauce, crushed roasted peanuts, fried shallots, and dried shrimp.

sri lanka.name: Nasi Goreng
sri lanka.description: The rice dish with pieces of meat and Vegetable added and it can refer simply to fried pre-cooked rice, a meal including stir fried rice in a small amount of cooking oil or margarine, typically spiced with sweet soy sauce, shallot, garlic, ground shrimp paste, tamarind and chilli and accompanied by other ingredients, particularly egg, chicken and prawns.
sri lanka.photoCredit: shankar s. from Dubai, united arab emirates

sri lanka.name: Appam
sri lanka.description: The dish is made with a fermented rice batter and coconut milk. They’re cooked in a deep pan like a wok, giving them their unique shape.

sri lanka.name: Idli
sri lanka.description: The dish is a type of savoury rice cake. It is made by steaming a batter consisting of fermented de-husked black lentils and rice.

sri lanka.name: Kiribath
sri lanka.description: The dish is made form rice and coconut milk. The rice is cooked in coconut milk, sometimes with added ingredients such as sesame seeds or cashew. This dish is commonly compressed and cut into diamond or square shaped blocks before serving.

sri lanka.name: Nasi kuning
sri lanka.description: The dish is an Indonesian fragrant rice dish cooked with coconut milk and turmeric

sri lanka.name: Rice and curry
sri lanka.description: The dish usually consists of a large bowl of rice, most often boiled, but frequently fried, a vegetable curry, a meat curry, dhal, papadums, and sambals.

sri lanka.name: Bánh tổ
sri lanka.description: The dish is made from glutinus irce flour with sticky sweet texture with brown color.

sri lanka.name: Rosette
sri lanka.description: The dish is thin, cookie-like fritters made with iron molds. The batter is a blend of wheat flour, eggs, sugar and whole milk. They are formed with a rose iron. This specialized tool has a long handle and with a metal shape, commonly stars, flowers, snowflakes or Christmas trees. The metal is heated in hot oil before it is dipped in batter. Returning the iron to the oil, the batter is detached from the mold when it is partially cooked and gently flipped to finish cooking. They are usually topped with sugar or honey, or the edges of them are dipped into frosting.

sri lanka.name: Watalappam
sri lanka.description: A coconut custard pudding made of coconut milk or condensed milk, jaggery, cashew nuts, eggs, various spices, including cardamom, cloves, and nutmeg, and sometimes thick pandan juice or grated vanilla pods.

sri lanka.name: Paratha
sri lanka.description: The dish is a kine of unleavened flatbreads made by baking or cooking whole-wheat dough on a tava, and finishing off with shallow-frying.

sri lanka.name: Papadam
sri lanka.description: The dish is made from dough of black gram bean flour, which is either deep fried or cooked with dry heat by being flipped over an open flame until crunchy.

sri lanka.name: Roti
sri lanka.description: The dish is a round flatbread made from stoneground whole wheat flour

sri lanka.name: Gobi paratha
sri lanka.description: The dish is a flatbread stuffed with flavoured cauliflower and other vegetable.

sri lanka.name: Dahi
sri lanka.description: It is a traditional yogurt or fermented milk product. It is usually prepared from cows' milk, and sometimes buffalo milk or goat milk.

sri lanka.name: South Asian pickle
sri lanka.description: It is a pickled food made from a variety of vegetables, meats and fruits preserved in brine, vinegar, edible oils, and various spices.

suriname.name: Nasi Goreng
suriname.description: The rice dish with pieces of meat and Vegetable added and it can refer simply to fried pre-cooked rice, a meal including stir fried rice in a small amount of cooking oil or margarine, typically spiced with sweet soy sauce, shallot, garlic, ground shrimp paste, tamarind and chilli and accompanied by other ingredients, particularly egg, chicken and prawns.
suriname.photoCredit: shankar s. from Dubai, united arab emirates

suriname.name: Lumpia
suriname.description: This dish is made of thin paper-like or crepe-like pastry skin enveloping savory or sweet fillings. It is often served as an appetizer or snack, and might be served deep-fried or fresh (unfried).

suriname.name: Nasi kuning
suriname.description: The dish is an Indonesian fragrant rice dish cooked with coconut milk and turmeric

suriname.name: Paratha
suriname.description: The dish is a kine of unleavened flatbreads made by baking or cooking whole-wheat dough on a tava, and finishing off with shallow-frying.

suriname.name: Roti
suriname.description: The dish is a round flatbread made from stoneground whole wheat flour

suriname.name: Goat curry
suriname.description: The dish is a curry dish prepared with goat meat.

netherlands.name: Nasi Goreng
netherlands.description: The rice dish with pieces of meat and Vegetable added and it can refer simply to fried pre-cooked rice, a meal including stir fried rice in a small amount of cooking oil or margarine, typically spiced with sweet soy sauce, shallot, garlic, ground shrimp paste, tamarind and chilli and accompanied by other ingredients, particularly egg, chicken and prawns.
netherlands.photoCredit: shankar s. from Dubai, united arab emirates

netherlands.name: Rijsttafel
netherlands.description: The dish consists of many side dishes served in small portions, accompanied by rice prepared in several different ways. Popular side dishes include egg rolls, sambals, satay, fish, fruit, Vegetable, pickles, and nuts.

netherlands.name: Lumpia
netherlands.description: This dish is made of thin paper-like or crepe-like pastry skin enveloping savory or sweet fillings. It is often served as an appetizer or snack, and might be served deep-fried or fresh (unfried).

netherlands.name: Nasi kuning
netherlands.description: The dish is an Indonesian fragrant rice dish cooked with coconut milk and turmeric

netherlands.name: Rijstevlaai
netherlands.description: The dish is a pie with a filling based on rice pudding.
netherlands.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Frinck51~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

netherlands.name: Pannenkoek
netherlands.description: The dish is a style of pancake which are usually larger (up to a foot in diameter) and much thinner but not as thin as crêpes. They may incorporate slices of bacon, apples, cheese, or raisins. Plain ones are often eaten with treacle (syrup made of sugar beets), unspiced variety of apple butter or (powdered) sugar and are sometimes rolled up to be eaten by hand or with cutlery.

netherlands.name: Poffertjes
netherlands.description: The dish resembles small, fluffy pancakes, they are made with yeast and buckwheat flour. Typically, this dish is sweet treats served with powdered sugar and butter, and sometimes syrup or advocaat. A savoury variant with gouda cheese is also made.

netherlands.name: Dutch letter
netherlands.description: The dish is a type of pastry that is typically prepared using a mixture of flour, eggs and butter or puff pastry as its base and filled with almond paste (or persipan), dusted with sugar and shaped in an "S" or other letter shape.

netherlands.name: Kaasstengels
netherlands.description: The dish is a cheese snack in the shape of sticks. It tastes savoury and salty instead of sweet.

netherlands.name: Pepernoot
netherlands.description: The dish is light brown, square shaped, and made from the same ingredients as taai-taai: rye flour, sugar and anise, and sometimes also cinnamon, and clove. They are fairly chewy, though they harden gradually when exposed to the air.

netherlands.name: Speculaas
netherlands.description: The dish is a type of spiced shortcrust biscuit baked with spices. They are usually flat and are often moulded to carry certain traditional images.

netherlands.name: Moorkop
netherlands.description: This dish is a traditional pastry. It consisting of a profiterole (cream puff) filled with whipped cream. The top of the profiterole is glazed with white or dark chocolate. Often there is whipped cream on the top, with a slice of tangerine or a piece of pineapple.

netherlands.name: Roze koek
netherlands.description: The dish is a pastry. It consists of a round, flat, dense cake with a layer of pink fondant icing, similar to black and white cookies. On occasion the cakes are sold in alternative varieties, with the pink icing replaced by a different colour.

netherlands.name: Tiger bread
netherlands.description: The bread is generally made with a pattern baked onto the top made by painting rice paste onto the surface prior to baking.The rice paste that imparts the bread's characteristic flavour dries and cracks during the baking process. The bread itself has a crusty exterior, but is soft inside. Typically, it is made as a white bread bloomer loaf or bread roll, but the technique can be applied to any shape of bread.

netherlands.name: Hachée
netherlands.description: This dish is a traditional stew based on diced meat, fish or poultry, and vegetables. It is usually served with potatoes.

netherlands.name: Hasenpfeffer
netherlands.description: This dish is a traditional stew made from marinated rabbit or hare, cut into stewing-meat sized pieces and braised with onions and a marinade made from wine and vinegar.

netherlands.name: Saffron bun
netherlands.description: The dish is a rich, spiced yeast-leavened sweet bun that is flavoured with saffron and contains dried fruit including currants and raisins similar to a teacake. The main ingredients are plain flour, butter, yeast, caster sugar, currants and sultanas.

netherlands.name: Cervelat
netherlands.description: This dish is a sausage produced in Switzerland, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, and parts of Germany. The recipe and preparation of the sausage vary regionally.

netherlands.name: Hutspot
netherlands.description: The dish is boiled and mashed potatoes, carrots, and onions.

valencia.name: Paella
valencia.description: The dish is traditionally cooked over an open fire with orange tree and pine branches, which add a distinctive smoky flavor. It usually eaten directly from the pan. A cherished layer of scorched rice, called socarrat, forms at the bottom and is enjoyed if not burnt.

valencia.name: Arròs negre
valencia.description: The dish features white rice cooked with squid ink, giving it a dark color and enhancing its seafood flavor. It includes ingredients like squid or cuttlefish, garlic, green cubanelle peppers, sweet paprika, olive oil, and seafood broth. Some variations also include crab and shrimp.

valencia.name: Fideuà
valencia.description: The dish main ingredients are pasta noodles (often hollow), fish (rockfish, monkfish, cuttlefish, squid), and shellfish (Squilla mantis, shrimp, crayfish). It is seasoned mainly with lemon.

valencia.name: Panellets
valencia.description: The dish is a ball-shaped snack made from chestnuts and sweet potatoes covered in pinenuts.

catalonia.name: Arròs negre
catalonia.description: The dish features white rice cooked with squid ink, giving it a dark color and enhancing its seafood flavor. It includes ingredients like squid or cuttlefish, garlic, green cubanelle peppers, sweet paprika, olive oil, and seafood broth. Some variations also include crab and shrimp.

catalonia.name: Panellets
catalonia.description: The dish is a ball-shaped snack made from chestnuts and sweet potatoes covered in pinenuts.

catalonia.name: Coca
catalonia.description: The dish with four main varieties: sweet, savoury, closed and open. All of them use dough as the main ingredient, which is then decorated. This dough can be sweet or savoury. If it is sweet, eggs and sugar are added, and if it is savoury, yeast and salt. As regards the topping or filling, fish and Vegetable are usual at the coast whilst inland they prefer fruit, nuts, cheese and meat. It is almost any kind of bread-based product. Its size can vary from 5 cm up to 1 metre. There are various presentations: Sweet or savory, depending on the ingredients and condiments.Open or covered. The covered type with its filling on the inside. It can be both sweet and salty. The open type is the typical with its content on top. Most are like this.
catalonia.photoCredit: Enn1.jpg : Dbotany derivative work: Ilmari Karonen ( talk )

catalonia.name: Xuixo
catalonia.description: The dish is a deep-fried, sugar-coated cylindrical pastry filled with crema catalana. Commonly eaten for breakfast or tea.

catalonia.name: Escudella
catalonia.description: The dish is a traditional Catalan meat and vegetable stew, often served with a side of pasta, rice, or both

nigeria.name: Jollof Rice
nigeria.description: The dish is made with long-grain rice, tomatoes, chilies, onions, spices, and sometimes Vegetable or meat, all cooked in a single pot.

nigeria.name: Alloco
nigeria.description: It is commonly made from cut plantains in slices, fry them until they are yellow, smash them between two plates and fry them again.

nigeria.name: Amala
nigeria.description: It is made of yam, cassava flour, or unripe plantain flour.

nigeria.name: Suya
nigeria.description: This dish is generally made with skewered beef, ram, or chicken. Organ meats such as kidney, liver and tripe are also used.

nigeria.name: Draw soup
nigeria.description: This dish is made from okra, ogbono (Irvingia gabonensis), or ewedu leaves (jute). The name derives from the thick viscosity characteristic of the broth as it draws out of the bowl when eaten either with a spoon or, more characteristically, by dipping a small piece of solid sticky dough into it.

nigeria.name: Eba
nigeria.description: This dish is rich in starch and carbohydrates. It is a cooked starchy vegetable food made from dried grated cassava flour. It is often eaten with rich soups and stews, with beef, stockfish or mutton. The dish is often described as having a slightly sour, sharp taste.

nigeria.name: Echicha
nigeria.description: This dish is made by steaming the dried cocoyam and Pigeon pea until they are soft, then mixing the two thoroughly with a sauce made of palm oil, seed of the oil bean tree, onions, fresh pepper, and salt.

nigeria.name: Edikang ikong
nigeria.description: This dish is a nutritious soup and expensive to prepare, and has been described as being mostly eaten by rich people. Ingredients used in this dish include beef and dried fish, bush meat, crayfish, cow tripe, kanda, pumpkin leaves, water leaves, ugu, onion, periwinkle, palm oil, salt and pepper

nigeria.name: Egusi
nigeria.description: These protein-rich seeds are from certain cucurbitaceous plants (squash, melon, gourd), which, after being dried and ground.

nigeria.name: Ewa aganyin
nigeria.description: The dish is a beans cooked until extermely soft and then mashed, usually accompanied with peppers, onion, ginger, dried chilies, and palm oil.

nigeria.name: Ogi
nigeria.description: The dish is a maize or corn pudding soaked in water and grinded to remove husks.

nigeria.name: Peanut stew
nigeria.description: The dish is a stew made from peanut butter sauce.

nigeria.name: Peppersoup
nigeria.description: The dish is a fish or meat soup, made with chili peppers, salt, scent leave and calabash nutmeg.

nigeria.name: Okpa
nigeria.description: The dish is made from nut, flour, pepper, palm oil, and seasoning with yellow or white color.

nigeria.name: Spicy cow feet
nigeria.description: The dish is a soup made of upper cut of cow feet with palm oil, potash, nutmegs, and seasonings.

nigeria.name: Kenkey
nigeria.description: The dish is a sourdough dumplings served pepper, fried fish, soup, or stew.

nigeria.name: Kedjenou
nigeria.description: The dish is a spicy stew with a slow-cooked in a sealed pot, prepared with chicken or hen and Vegetable.

nigeria.name: Palaver sauce
nigeria.description: The dish is made using beef, fish, shrimp, pepitas, cassava, taro (cocoyam) leaves, and palm oil. It is served with boiled rice, potatoes, garri, fufu or yams.

nigeria.name: Pottage
nigeria.description: The dish is a thick soup or stew made by boiling Vegetable, grains, and, if available, meat or fish.

nigeria.name: Sopa de cacahuete
nigeria.description: The dish is a soup made from peanuts, often with various other ingredients

ghana.name: Jollof Rice
ghana.description: The dish is made with long-grain rice, tomatoes, chilies, onions, spices, and sometimes Vegetable or meat, all cooked in a single pot.

ghana.name: Egusi
ghana.description: These protein-rich seeds are from certain cucurbitaceous plants (squash, melon, gourd), which, after being dried and ground.

ghana.name: Fufu
ghana.description: The dish is a boiled cassava, plantains, and cocoyam.

ghana.name: Ogi
ghana.description: The dish is a maize or corn pudding soaked in water and grinded to remove husks.

ghana.name: Peanut stew
ghana.description: The dish is a stew made from peanut butter sauce.

ghana.name: Peppersoup
ghana.description: The dish is a fish or meat soup, made with chili peppers, salt, scent leave and calabash nutmeg.

ghana.name: Kuli-kuli
ghana.description: The dish is a crispy snack made from peanuts with a mixture of cassave flakes, sugar and water.

ghana.name: Kenkey
ghana.description: The dish is a sourdough dumplings served pepper, fried fish, soup, or stew.

ghana.name: Kelewele
ghana.description: The dish is a fried plaintains seasoned with spices, with crisp textures.

ghana.name: Kedjenou
ghana.description: The dish is a spicy stew with a slow-cooked in a sealed pot, prepared with chicken or hen and Vegetable.

ghana.name: Palaver sauce
ghana.description: The dish is made using beef, fish, shrimp, pepitas, cassava, taro (cocoyam) leaves, and palm oil. It is served with boiled rice, potatoes, garri, fufu or yams.

ghana.name: Sopa de cacahuete
ghana.description: The dish is a soup made from peanuts, often with various other ingredients

iran.name: Biryani
iran.description: The dish is a popular South Asian mixed rice dish made with rice, meat (such as chicken, goat, lamb, beef, prawn, or fish), and spices. Vegetarian versions use Vegetable or paneer, and sometimes eggs and potatoes are added.

iran.name: Baghali polo
iran.description: The dish consists of rice, fava beans and dill. It is made by cooking rice and green broad beans in boiling water. When cooked, the rice and beans are layered with dill in a pan, and everything is baked in an oven until ready. Saffron water can also be added to the rice.[1] It is typically served with meat. Like other Iranian traditional foods, the dish may be served at special occasions and family gatherings.

iran.name: Chelow
iran.description: The dish is made with rice that is carefully prepared through soaking and parboiling, at which point the water is drained and the rice is steamed. This method results in an exceptionally fluffy rice with the grains separated and not sticky; it also results in a golden rice crust at the bottom of the pot.

iran.name: Dolma
iran.description: The dish is typically made with a filling of rice, minced meat, offal, seafood, fruit, or any combination of these inside a vegetable or a leaf wrapping.

iran.name: Pilaf
iran.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

iran.name: Sholezard
iran.description: A rice pudding composed of saffron, sugar, rose water, butter, cinnamon and cardamom. It is yellow due to the presence of saffron and is topped with cinnamon, almond slices, and pistachio slices.

iran.name: Saffron rice
iran.description: The dish is made from saffron, white rice, and usually vegetable bouillon. It is similar to plain cooked rice with the addition of these ingredients.

iran.name: Tahdig
iran.description: The dish consists of crisp, caramelized rice taken from the bottom of the pot in which the rice (chelow) is cooked.

iran.name: Muhallebi
iran.description: The dish is a milk pudding commonly made with rice, sugar, milk and either rice flour, starch or semolina.

iran.name: Sorbet
iran.description: This dish is a frozen dessert made using ice combined with fruit juice, fruit purée, or other ingredients, such as wine, liqueur, or honey. Generally, this dish do not contain dairy products.

iran.name: Kabab barg
iran.description: This dish is a Persian style barbecued and marinated lamb, chicken or beef kabab dish. The main ingredients of this dish are beef tenderloin, lamb sirloin, or less commonly chicken breast, along with onions and olive oil.

iran.name: Jujeh kabab
iran.description: This dish consists of grilled chunks of chicken which are sometimes with bone and other times without bone. It is common to marinate the chunks in minced onion, lemon juice and saffron.

iran.name: Fig roll
iran.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

iran.name: Rosette
iran.description: The dish is thin, cookie-like fritters made with iron molds. The batter is a blend of wheat flour, eggs, sugar and whole milk. They are formed with a rose iron. This specialized tool has a long handle and with a metal shape, commonly stars, flowers, snowflakes or Christmas trees. The metal is heated in hot oil before it is dipped in batter. Returning the iron to the oil, the batter is detached from the mold when it is partially cooked and gently flipped to finish cooking. They are usually topped with sugar or honey, or the edges of them are dipped into frosting.

iran.name: Baklava
iran.description: The dish is a layered pastry dessert made of filo pastry, filled with chopped nuts, and sweetened with syrup or honey.

iran.name: Barbari bread
iran.description: It is one of the thickest flat breads and is commonly topped with sesame or black caraway seeds. A notable characteristic of the bread is its top skin due to the Maillard reaction that occurs during baking. Before baking it is glazed with a mixture of baking soda, flour and water.

iran.name: Taftan
iran.description: A leavened flour bread made with refined flour, milk, yoghurt, and eggs and baked in a clay oven. It is sometimes flavoured with saffron and a small amount of cardamom powder, and may be decorated with seeds such as poppy seeds.

iran.name: Lavash
iran.description: This dish is a thin flatbread that is usually leavened. Traditionally the dough is rolled out flat and slapped against the hot walls of a clay oven, but modern recipes may adapt for cooking on a wok.

iran.name: Sheermal
iran.description: The dish is a saffron-flavored traditional flatbread.

iran.name: Sangak
iran.description: The dish is is a plain, rectangular or triangular whole wheat leavened flatbread.

iran.name: Caviar
iran.description: The dish is eaten as a garnish or spread.

iran.name: Borscht
iran.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

iran.name: Ful medames
iran.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

iran.name: Kashk bademjan
iran.description: The dish is made with eggplant and dairy products served as a dip and garnished with saffron, sauteed onions, garlic, and often walnuts.

iran.name: Sajji
iran.description: This dish traditionally consists of lamb, marinated only in salt with a few spices. It is served with rice that is cooked inside the animal, which is then baked.

iran.name: Stuffed eggplant
iran.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

iran.name: Stuffed tomatoes
iran.description: This dish is a stuffed tomato filled with various ingredients, usually including rice.

iran.name: Bamia
iran.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

iran.name: Ghormeh sabzi
iran.description: This dish is herb stew where the main ingrediants are a mixture of sauteed herbs, consisting mainly of parsley, leeks, or green onions, and coriander, seasoned with the key spice of dried fenugreek leaves.

iran.name: Khoresh karafs
iran.description: This dish is a traditional stew with celerty as the main part of the dish.

iran.name: Joshpara
iran.description: made of unleavened wheat dough squares filled with ground meat and condiments.

iran.name: Khash
iran.description: This dish consists of boiled cow or sheep parts, which might include the head, feet, and stomach (tripe).

iran.name: Nargesi
iran.description: The dish is made with eggs, fried onion and spinach. It's spiced with salt, garlic, and pepper.

iran.name: Kuku
iran.description: The dish is made of whipped eggs with various ingredients folded in. It is served either hot or cold as a starter, side dish, or a main course, and is accompanied with bread and either yogurt or salad.

iran.name: Piyaz
iran.description: A bean salad that is made from any kind of boiled beans with raw onion, parsley and sumac. Optionally, a boiled egg can be added to this dish.

iran.name: Marzipan
iran.description: This dish consists primarily of sugar and almond meal (ground almonds), sometimes augmented with almond oil or extract.

iraq.name: Biryani
iraq.description: The dish is a popular South Asian mixed rice dish made with rice, meat (such as chicken, goat, lamb, beef, prawn, or fish), and spices. Vegetarian versions use Vegetable or paneer, and sometimes eggs and potatoes are added.

iraq.name: Dolma
iraq.description: The dish is typically made with a filling of rice, minced meat, offal, seafood, fruit, or any combination of these inside a vegetable or a leaf wrapping.

iraq.name: Mujaddara
iraq.description: The dish consisting of cooked lentils together with groats, generally rice, and garnished with sautéed onions.

iraq.name: Pilaf
iraq.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

iraq.name: Bappir
iraq.description: The dish is a twice-baked barley bread.

iraq.name: Fig roll
iraq.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

iraq.name: Kleicha
iraq.description: The dish comes in several traditional shapes and fillings. The most popular are the ones filled with dates. There are also sweet discs, as well as half moons filled with nuts, sugar and/or desiccated coconut. They are usually flavoured with cardamom and sometimes rose water, and glazed with egg wash, which may sometimes be scented and coloured with saffron.

iraq.name: Sfiha
iraq.description: A dish consisting of flatbread cooked with a minced meat topping, often lamb flavored with parsley, onion, tomato, pine nuts, and spices.

iraq.name: Ka'ak
iraq.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

iraq.name: Samoon
iraq.description: The dish is a type of yeast bread. It is baked in traditional stone ovens.

iraq.name: Ful medames
iraq.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

iraq.name: Baba ghanoush
iraq.description: The dish is an appetizer made of roasted eggplant, olive oil, lemon juice, and various seasonings.

iraq.name: Kibbeh
iraq.description: The dish is a spiced lean ground meat covered with pounded wheat, then toasted with nuts and spices.

iraq.name: Sheikh al-mahshi
iraq.description: This dish consists of zucchini stuffed with minced lamb meat and nuts, bathed in a yogurt sauce (the original) or tomato sauce (derivative).

iraq.name: Bamia
iraq.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

iraq.name: Khash
iraq.description: This dish consists of boiled cow or sheep parts, which might include the head, feet, and stomach (tripe).

iraq.name: Piyaz
iraq.description: A bean salad that is made from any kind of boiled beans with raw onion, parsley and sumac. Optionally, a boiled egg can be added to this dish.

iraq.name: Amba
iraq.description: The dish is a sauce made of a tangy mango pickle condiment.

iraq.name: Laffa
iraq.description: The dish is s a large, thin flatbread with that is traditionally vegan and cooked in an oven. It is most often used to wrap falafel, kebab, and shawarma to make sandwiches, to dip in hummus, matbucha and other dips, or with shakshouka, and other dishes.

myanmar.name: Biryani
myanmar.description: The dish is a popular South Asian mixed rice dish made with rice, meat (such as chicken, goat, lamb, beef, prawn, or fish), and spices. Vegetarian versions use Vegetable or paneer, and sometimes eggs and potatoes are added.

myanmar.name: Pe htaw bhut htamin
myanmar.description: The dish is a festive rice dish, typically associated with celebratory occasions like wedding receptions or almsgiving feasts. The rice dish is typically paired with a traditional chicken or mutton curry. It uses long-grained paw hsan hmwe or basmati rice, and in its most basic form, is cooked with butter, lentils, and bay leaves.Cashew nuts and raisins may be added, and the dish can be spiced with cinnamon sticks, cardamom pods or cloves, and garnished with fried golden onions to serve.

myanmar.name: Hsi htamin
myanmar.description: The dish consists of glutinous rice cooked with turmeric, salt, and onions, and served with roasted sesame seeds and fried onions, which renders a golden hue to the rice.

myanmar.name: Htamanè
myanmar.description: The dish is a glutinous rice-based savory snack, mixed with toasted sesame seeds, peanut, fried ginger, ground nut oil and fried coconut shavings.

myanmar.name: Htamin jin
myanmar.description: The dish consists of either fresh or fermented rice, kneaded with boiled fish, fresh tomato paste, mashed boiled potatoes and garlic garnish.

myanmar.name: Mont lin maya
myanmar.description: The dish consists of crisp, round savory pancakes made with a batter consisting of rice flour, quail eggs, chickpeas, and spring onions, fried in a special metal pan.

myanmar.name: Thingyan rice
myanmar.description: The dish is infused with water and commonly served with a salad of cured salted fish, which is blanched and fried with onions, along with sour mango or marian plum. The dish is then garnished with roasted chili peppers.

myanmar.name: Bánh tổ
myanmar.description: The dish is made from glutinus irce flour with sticky sweet texture with brown color.

myanmar.name: Mont di
myanmar.description: The dish consists of rice vermicelli mixed with a thin soup made of daggertooth pike conger, called thinbaw htoe, Rakhine ngapi and lemongrass. Dry roasted pike conger eel flakes, fried onion and garlic, fresh coriander, red and green chili paste are added.

myanmar.name: Ohn no khao swè
myanmar.description: The dish consists of wheat noodles in a curried chicken and coconut milk broth thickened with gram flour (chickpea flour). It features wheat noodles in a rich broth made with curried chicken and coconut milk, thickened with gram flour. Crispy fried bean fritters, hard-boiled eggs, sliced raw onions, chili peppers, and crispy noodles are added to the dish. Fish sauce and lime or lemon juice are then drizzled over everything.

myanmar.name: Kyay oh
myanmar.description: The dish is made with rice noodles (rice vermicelli or flat rice noodles) and marinated meatballs. The broth is made with pork, chicken, or fish. The pork version, the most popular, uses pork bones and intestine. It is typically served with a tomato and green pepper sauce.

myanmar.name: Kya zan hinga
myanmar.description: The dish consists of glass noodles in chicken consommé. It is made with mushrooms, bean curd skin, dried daylily buds, shrimp, garlic, pepper and sometimes fish balls. For the addition of texture and flavour, it can be garnished with coriander, sliced shallots, fish sauce, chilli powder and a squeeze of lime.

myanmar.name: Khao soi
myanmar.description: The dish is traditionally made with hand-sliced rice noodles in clear broth and topped with minced pork.

myanmar.name: Curry puff
myanmar.description: This dish is a small pie consisting of curry with chicken and potatoes in a fried or baked pastry shell.

myanmar.name: Paratha
myanmar.description: The dish is a kine of unleavened flatbreads made by baking or cooking whole-wheat dough on a tava, and finishing off with shallow-frying.

myanmar.name: Naan
myanmar.description: The dish is a leavened, oven-baked or tawa-fried flatbread, that can also be baked in a tandoor. It is characterized by a light and fluffy texture and golden-brown spots from the baking process.

myanmar.name: Goat curry
myanmar.description: The dish is a curry dish prepared with goat meat.

myanmar.name: Spring roll
myanmar.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

myanmar.name: Popiah
myanmar.description: This dish is a fresh spring roll filled with an assortment of fresh, dried, and cooked ingredients, eaten during a festival and other celebratory occasions.

myanmar.name: Burmese tofu
myanmar.description: This dish is made from water and flour ground from yellow split peas and gram flour, a version of chickpea flour The flour is mixed with water, turmeric, and a little salt and heated, stirring constantly, until it reaches a creamy consistency. It is then transferred into a tray and allowed to set.

myanmar.name: South Asian pickle
myanmar.description: It is a pickled food made from a variety of vegetables, meats and fruits preserved in brine, vinegar, edible oils, and various spices.

myanmar.name: Youtiao
myanmar.description: This dish is a long golden-brown deep-fried strip of wheat flour dough

thailand.name: Biryani
thailand.description: The dish is a popular South Asian mixed rice dish made with rice, meat (such as chicken, goat, lamb, beef, prawn, or fish), and spices. Vegetarian versions use Vegetable or paneer, and sometimes eggs and potatoes are added.

thailand.name: Khao lam
thailand.description: The dish consists of sticky rice roasted inside specially prepared bamboo sections of different diameters and lengths.

thailand.name: Khao tom
thailand.description: The dish is made of sticky rice, ripe banana, coconut milk, all wrapped and steamed-cooked in banana leaves.

thailand.name: Bánh tổ
thailand.description: The dish is made from glutinus irce flour with sticky sweet texture with brown color.

thailand.name: Khanom sot sai
thailand.description: The dish is a dessert with a sweet filling. It is made up of coconut and palm sugar, and the filling is covered with steamed rice flour mixed with coconut cream.

thailand.name: Drunken noodles
thailand.description: The dish originates from a spicy stir-fry dish that originally did not include noodles. The base ingredients of the aforementioned spicy stir-fry are garlic, shallots, fresh chilies, and shrimp paste, and holy basil (for topping). Eventually, the stir-fry was converted into a noodle dish made with broad rice noodles, soy sauce, fish sauce, oyster sauce, garlic, meat, seafood, chili, fresh black pepper pods and holy basil.

thailand.name: Pad thai
thailand.description: The dish is typically made with rice noodles, shrimp, peanuts, scrambled egg and bean sprouts. The ingredients are fried in a wok.

thailand.name: Pad see ew
thailand.description: The dish is made with light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, garlic, broad rice noodles called kuaitiao sen yai, broccoli, egg, and tofu or some form of thinly sliced meat – commonly pork, chicken, beef, shrimp, or mixed seafood. It is generally garnished with ground white pepper. The dish is prepared in a wok, which allows the black soy sauce added at the end of the cooking process to stick to the noodles for an exaggerated caramelizing and charring effect.

thailand.name: Rat na
thailand.description: The dish is made with stir-fried wide rice noodles, a meat such as chicken, beef, pork, or seafood or tofu, garlic, straw mushrooms, and gai lan. The dish is then covered in a sauce made of stock and tapioca starch, or cornstarch. It is seasoned with sweet soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, and black pepper.

thailand.name: Mi krop
thailand.description: The dish consists of crispy fried thin rice noodles mixed with fried tofu, fried shrimp, pork, or a combination, and sauced with a mixture of lemon or lime juice, fish sauce, tomato paste, kaffir lime leaves, chilis, and sugar. The dish can be garnished with scallions, bean sprouts, cilantro, chilis, and fried egg strips.

thailand.name: Wonton noodles
thailand.description: The dish consists of egg noodles served in a hot broth, garnished with leafy Vegetable and wonton dumplings. Common Vegetable include broccoli or kale. The wontons typically contain prawns, chicken or pork, and spring onions, with some variations including mushrooms or black mushroom.

thailand.name: Boat noodles
thailand.description: The dish is a noodle dish with a strong flavor. It contains both pork and beef, as well as dark soy sauce, pickled bean curd, and some other spices, and is normally served with meatballs and pig's liver. The soup is seasoned with pig or cow blood mixed with salt and spices.

thailand.name: Kluai khaek
thailand.description: The dish is made from fried, floured banana commonly topped with white sesame.

thailand.name: Curry puff
thailand.description: This dish is a small pie consisting of curry with chicken and potatoes in a fried or baked pastry shell.

thailand.name: Khanom bueang
thailand.description: The dish is an ancient snack known as crispy pancakes. It is a popular form of street food. These crepes resemble tacos. They are usually first topped or filled with meringue, followed by sweet or salty toppings such as shredded coconut, strips of fried eggs or egg yolks, or chopped scallions.

thailand.name: Roti canai
thailand.description: The dish is a flatbread made from dough that is composed of fat (usually ghee), flour, and water; some recipes also include sweetened condensed milk.

thailand.name: Paratha
thailand.description: The dish is a kine of unleavened flatbreads made by baking or cooking whole-wheat dough on a tava, and finishing off with shallow-frying.

thailand.name: Chicken curry
