thailand.description: The dish consists of chicken stewed in an onion- and tomato-based sauce, flavoured with ginger, garlic, tomato puree, chilli peppers and a variety of spices.

thailand.name: Sakhu sai mu
thailand.description: The dish is a tapioca balls made with starch with pork fillings.

thailand.name: Spring roll
thailand.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

thailand.name: Popiah
thailand.description: This dish is a fresh spring roll filled with an assortment of fresh, dried, and cooked ingredients, eaten during a festival and other celebratory occasions.

thailand.name: Malay sponge cake
thailand.description: This dish is made of lard or butter, flour, and eggs, using a bamboo steamer to develop puffiness.

thailand.name: Chicken feet
thailand.description: This dish is a part of chicken which cooked and eaten in many countries. This dish has a distinct gelatinous texture different from the rest of the chicken meat.

thailand.name: Mango pudding
thailand.description: The dish is a very popular dessert. The fresh variant is prepared by the restaurant or eatery and consists of agar or gelatin, mangoes, evaporated milk, and sugar. In addition, fresh fruit such as mango, strawberries, berries and kiwifruit, are occasionally added as garnish. Served and eaten refrigerator cold, it has a rich and creamy texture.

thailand.name: Oyster omelette
thailand.description: The dish is an omelette filled primarily with small oysters, with starch (often sweet potato starch) mixed into the egg batter for a thicker consistency. It is often fried in pork lard, and some variations include a savory sauce poured on top. Spicy or chili sauce with lime juice is often added for extra flavor.

thailand.name: Sai krok Isan
thailand.description: This dish is a fermented sausage made with pork and rice, and typically eaten as a snack served with bird's eye chilis, raw cabbage, and sliced ginger.

thailand.name: Youtiao
thailand.description: This dish is a long golden-brown deep-fried strip of wheat flour dough

thailand.name: Grass jelly
thailand.description: The jelly is made by boiling the aged and slightly oxidized stalks and leaves of Platostoma palustre (Mesona chinensis) with potassium carbonate and a little starch for several hours, then let it cool and served with sweet beverages.

china.name: Hokkien fried rice
china.description: The dish is a fried rice featuring a saucy stir-fried topping on egg fried rice. The topping may include mushrooms, meat, Vegetable, and other ingredients, cooked with water, starch, broth, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.

china.name: Yangzhou Fried Rice
china.description: The egg fried rice with mixed Vegetable and two forms of protein, typically pork and shrimp with scallions.
china.photoCredit: stu_spivack from C & Y Chinese Restaurant in Cleveland's Chinatown, Ohio

china.name: Bah-oân
china.description: The dish is a disk-shaped translucent dough 6–8 cm diameter made of sweet potato starch filled with savory stuffing and served with sweet and savory sauce.

china.name: Gaifan
china.description: The dish consists of a fish, meat, or vegetable topping served over rice. The dish can be either freshly cooked or previously cooked, such as char siu.

china.name: Jiuniang
china.description: The dish consists of a mixture of partially digested rice grains floating in a sweet saccharified liquid, with small amounts of alcohol and lactic acid. It is made by fermenting glutinous rice with a starter called jiuqu containing Rhizopus oryzae or Aspergillus oryzae and often yeast and bacteria.

china.name: Lumpia
china.description: This dish is made of thin paper-like or crepe-like pastry skin enveloping savory or sweet fillings. It is often served as an appetizer or snack, and might be served deep-fried or fresh (unfried).

china.name: Fa gao
china.description: The dish is a  steamed, cupcake-like pastry and is often characterized by a split top when cooked.

china.name: Jian dui
china.description: The dish is coated with sesame seeds on the outside and is crisp and chewy after immediately being cooked. Inside the pastry is a large hollow, caused by the expansion of the dough. The hollow of the pastry is filled with a filling usually consisting of lotus paste, or alternatively, sweet black bean paste, or red bean paste.

china.name: Osmanthus cake
china.description: The dish is made with glutinous rice flour, honey, sweet-scented osmanthus and rock sugar. It has crystal clear, sweet, and soft waxy characteristics.

china.name: Senbei
china.description: The dish is a rice cracker. They come in various shapes, sizes, and flavors, usually savory but sometimes sweet. This dish is often eaten with green tea as a casual snack and offered to visiting house guests as a courtesy refreshment.

china.name: Tangyuan
china.description: The dish is made of glutinous rice shaped into balls that are served in a hot broth or syrup. They come in varying sizes, anything between a marble to a ping pong ball, and are sometimes stuffed with filling.

china.name: Zongzi
china.description: The dish is made of glutinous rice stuffed with different fillings and wrapped in bamboo leaves. Fillings can be either sweet, such as red bean paste, or savory, such as pork belly or Chinese sausage.
china.photoCredit: The original uploader was Allentchang at English Wikipedia .

china.name: Banmian
china.description: The dish consists of egg noodles served in a flavorful soup, often with some type of meat or fish, Vegetable and various spices. Dried anchovies, minced pork, mushrooms, and a leafy vegetable such as sweet potato leaves or sayur manis are also possible ingredients.
china.photoCredit: Goh Wei Zhong ( Goh wz ); produced with the assistance of Terence Ong and Calvin Teo .

china.name: Noodles with tomato egg sauce
china.description: The dish consists of three main ingredients: noodles, tomato and egg. Except for these three main ingredients, other Vegetable or condiments can also be added into this soup, such as onions, cucumbers, carrots and ginger.

china.name: Sōmen
china.description: The dish is a very thin noodle made of wheat flour, less than 1.3 mm in diameter.

china.name: Jiaozi
china.description: The dish consists of a ground meat or vegetable filling wrapped into a thinly rolled piece of dough, which is then sealed by pressing the edges together.

china.name: Bing
china.description: The dish is a wheat flour-based bread with a flattened or disk-like shape.

china.name: Tofu skin
china.description: The dish is a food item made from soybeans. During the boiling of soy milk, in an open shallow pan, a film or skin composed primarily of a soy protein-lipid complex forms on the liquid surface.

china.name: Douhua
china.description: This dish is a sweet or savoury snack made with silken tofu. It is also referred to as tofu pudding, soybean pudding, or tofu brains.

china.name: Pidan doufu
china.description: This dish is a cold tofu dish consisting of slices of silken tofu topped with diced thousand-year-old eggs, minced garlic and spring onion, and a splash of soy sauce and Chinese vinegar.

china.name: Stinky tofu
china.description: This dish is a form of fermented tofu that has a strong odor. It is usually sold at night markets or roadside stands as a snack, or in lunch bars as a side dish, rather than in restaurants. Traditionally the dish is fermented in a brine with Vegetable and meat, sometimes for months.

china.name: Tofu skin roll
china.description: The dish's outer layer is made of tofu skin, and it is usually served in a small plate in twos or threes. It has a number of cooking styles, and is normall fried or steamed. The fillings include pork, Vegetable, fish, and beef.

china.name: Yong tau foo
china.description: The dish is a Hakka Chinese dish consisting primarily of tofu filled with ground meat mixture or fish paste, and is eaten either dry with a sauce or served as a soup dish.

china.name: Mantau
china.description: The dish is a white and soft type of steamed bread or bun. It is made with milled wheat flour, water and leavening agents.

china.name: Baozi
china.description: This dish is a type of yeast-leavened filled bun. There are many variations in fillings (meat or vegetarian) and preparations, though the buns are most often steamed.

china.name: Tangbao
china.description: This dish is a soup buns, a large, soup-filled buns made by wrapping dough which then steamed into soup.

china.name: Da bao
china.description: This dish is an extra large version of steamed bun made by fermented dough with less dense texture with pork or chicken minched meat and hard boiled egg fillings.

china.name: Lotus seed bun
china.description: This dish is a steamed yeast-leavened dough that contains lotus seed paste.

china.name: Longevity peach
china.description: This dish is a white bun with red dyed tip with a crease along the side, mimicking shape of the peach.

china.name: Mandarin roll
china.description: The dish is a steamed white-colored bun with a twisted shape.

china.name: Ang ku kueh
china.description: The dish is red tortoise shaped with skin made of rice flour and sweet potato, whereas the fillings are made of mung bean, peanuts and sugar.

china.name: Taro cake
china.description: The dish is a dense texture cake made from vegetable taro, cut into rectangular slices and pan-fried.

china.name: Turnip cake
china.description: The dish is a radish cake made from shredded radish and cut into rectangular slices before being pan-fried for serving.
china.photoCredit: See-ming Lee from Hong Kong SAR, China

china.name: Bakpia pathok
china.description: The dish usually stuffed with mung beans, but have recently come in other fillings as well, e.g. chocolate, durian and cheese.

china.name: Karakudamono
china.description: The dish is a term used to refer to various pastry desserts originating from another country.

china.name: Plăcintă
china.description: This dish is a and traditional pastry resembling a thin, small round or square-shaped cake, usually filled with apples or a soft cheese such.

china.name: Sou
china.description: The dish is a type of dried flaky pastry that can be filled pork, century egg, lotus seed paste, green beans, or peanuts.

china.name: Cong you bing
china.description: A savory, unleavened flatbread folded with oil and minced scallions (green onions). It is made from dough instead of batter. It is pan-fried, which gives it crisp edges and a chewy texture.

china.name: Guokui
china.description: The dish is a kind of flatbread made from flour. The dish is said to have been invented by a laborer who cooked flatbread in his iron helmet over a wood fire. It is round in shape, about a foot long in diameter, an inch in thickness, and weighs about 2.5 kg.

china.name: Laobing
china.description: The dish is a type of unleavened flatbread popular. It can be the size of a large pizza, about one centimeter thick, and is doughy and chewy in texture. It is made by pan frying a rolled and layered unleavened dough consisting of salt, flour, and water. Most are plain, although some have scallions or brown sugar inside the pastry. It is usually cut into slices and served as a staple food, or can be stir-fried with meat and vegetable to make stir-fried pancakes.

china.name: Shaobing
china.description: The dish is a type of baked, unleavened, layered flatbread. It is can be made with or without stuffing, and with or without sesame on top.

china.name: Naan
china.description: The dish is a leavened, oven-baked or tawa-fried flatbread, that can also be baked in a tandoor. It is characterized by a light and fluffy texture and golden-brown spots from the baking process.

china.name: Taro dumpling
china.description: The dish is made from a thick layer of taro that has been boiled and mashed. The filling is made from seasoned ground pork. The dumpling is deep fried, and the outermost layer of taro becomes crisp, light, and fluffy.

china.name: Borscht
china.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

china.name: Spring roll
china.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

china.name: Popiah
china.description: This dish is a fresh spring roll filled with an assortment of fresh, dried, and cooked ingredients, eaten during a festival and other celebratory occasions.

china.name: Hot pot
china.description: This is a dish whereby a heat source placed on the dining table keeps a pot of soup stock simmering, and accompanied with an array of foodstuffs and ingredients and food offerings provided for the diners to dip into the flavorful broth.

china.name: Red bean rice
china.description: Rice dish consisting of rice cooked with red beans.

china.name: Chicken feet
china.description: This dish is a part of chicken which cooked and eaten in many countries. This dish has a distinct gelatinous texture different from the rest of the chicken meat.

china.name: Tong sui
china.description: The dish is a collective term for any sweet soup served as a dessert typically at the end of a meal.

china.name: Egg drop soup
china.description: The dish is a soup of wispy beaten eggs in chicken broth. Condiments such as black or white pepper, and finely chopped scallions and tofu, are commonly added to the soup. The soup is made by adding a thin stream of beaten eggs to the boiling broth in the final moments of cooking, creating thin, silken strands or flakes of cooked egg that float in the soup.
china.photoCredit: Sharon Chen from Austin, United States

china.name: Oyster omelette
china.description: The dish is an omelette filled primarily with small oysters, with starch (often sweet potato starch) mixed into the egg batter for a thicker consistency. It is often fried in pork lard, and some variations include a savory sauce poured on top. Spicy or chili sauce with lime juice is often added for extra flavor.

china.name: Liangfen
china.description: This dish, generally white or off-white in color, translucent and think, is made from starch jelly, typically served cold with a savory sauce. Generally made from mung bean starch but can also be made from pea or potato starch, the translucent strips are seasoned with ingredients like soy sauce, vinegar, and chili oil.

china.name: Edamame
china.description: This dish is made from immature soybeans served in their pods, typically boiled or steamed and seasoned with salt. Rich in vitamins, dietary fiber, and isoflavones, it is popular worldwide as a side dish, appetizer, or ingredient in various sweet and savory dishes.
china.photoCredit: Tammy Green (aka Zesmerelda) from Chicago Upscale Dining + Lounge Republic Pan-Asian Restaurant [1] in Ontario & Rush Street, Chicago, Illinois 60611

china.name: Red bean cake
china.description: This is a cake with a sweet red bean paste filling.

china.name: Mooncake
china.description: The pastry is a round pastry, with a rich, thick filling usually made from lotus seed paste (other typical fillings include red bean paste or mixed nuts) surrounded by a thin and may contain yolks from salted duck eggs.

china.name: Fried ice cream
china.description: This dish is a dessert made of a scoop of ice cream that is frozen hard, then breaded or coated in a batter before being quickly deep-fried, creating a warm, crispy shell around the still-cold ice cream.

china.name: Nori
china.description: This is a dried edible seaweed. It has a strong and distinctive flavor, and is generally made into flat sheets and used to wrap rolls.

china.name: Aspic
china.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

china.name: Guazi
china.description: baked seeds of the sunflower, pumpkin, or watermelon seeds

china.name: Youtiao
china.description: This dish is a long golden-brown deep-fried strip of wheat flour dough

china.name: Grass jelly
china.description: The jelly is made by boiling the aged and slightly oxidized stalks and leaves of Platostoma palustre (Mesona chinensis) with potassium carbonate and a little starch for several hours, then let it cool and served with sweet beverages.

china.name: Yusheng
china.description: This dish consists of strips of raw fish (sometimes salmon), mixed with shredded Vegetable and a variety of sauces and condiments, among other ingredients

taiwan.name: Hokkien fried rice
taiwan.description: The dish is a fried rice featuring a saucy stir-fried topping on egg fried rice. The topping may include mushrooms, meat, Vegetable, and other ingredients, cooked with water, starch, broth, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.

taiwan.name: Bah-oân
taiwan.description: The dish is a disk-shaped translucent dough 6–8 cm diameter made of sweet potato starch filled with savory stuffing and served with sweet and savory sauce.

taiwan.name: Cifantuan
taiwan.description: The dish is made by tightly wrapping a piece of youtiao (fried dough) with glutinous rice. It is usually eaten as breakfast together with sweetened or savory soy milk.

taiwan.name: Tube rice pudding
taiwan.description: The dish consists of a stir-fried glutinous rice mixture that is seasoned and steamed in a bamboo tube. This dish is a cylindrical shape caused by the steaming process in a tube.

taiwan.name: Bánh tổ
taiwan.description: The dish is made from glutinus irce flour with sticky sweet texture with brown color.

taiwan.name: Banmian
taiwan.description: The dish consists of egg noodles served in a flavorful soup, often with some type of meat or fish, Vegetable and various spices. Dried anchovies, minced pork, mushrooms, and a leafy vegetable such as sweet potato leaves or sayur manis are also possible ingredients.
taiwan.photoCredit: Goh Wei Zhong ( Goh wz ); produced with the assistance of Terence Ong and Calvin Teo .

taiwan.name: Dan zai noodles
taiwan.description: The dish is a type of snack prepared using wheat noodle. The primary ingredients are minced pork, prawn, bean sprouts, cilantro, black vinegar, garlic, soy sauce and egg.

taiwan.name: Le̍k-tāu-phòng
taiwan.description: It is a traditional mooncake. The filling is made of sweet green gram paste stuffed with lard and shallots and baked, and sometimes a little pork is added. In recent years, due to the emphasis on health, many operators have also introduced versions that do not contain pork, lard and other ingredients, and are purely filled with mung bean puree.

taiwan.name: Pineapple cake
taiwan.description: This dish is a sweet traditional pastry and dessert containing butter, flour, egg, sugar, and pineapple jam or slices.

taiwan.name: Suncake
taiwan.description: The dish is a popular dessert. The typical fillings consist of maltose (condensed malt sugar), and they are usually sold in special gift boxes as souvenirs for visitors. They are round, and they may vary in size. They are characterized by flaky crusts. Most people eat them with tea, and some people dissolve them in hot water to make a porridge-like dessert.

taiwan.name: Taro pastry
taiwan.description: The dish is a shortbread snack with a spherical shape and made with taro as sweet filling. The main method of making it is to wrap the pastry made with flour and butter with the filling made of taro puree and place it in the oven.

taiwan.name: Scallion bread
taiwan.description: The dish is characterized by its green onion topping and use of traditional lard, featuring a soft, fluffy texture and a distinctive aroma

taiwan.name: Spring roll
taiwan.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

taiwan.name: Popiah
taiwan.description: This dish is a fresh spring roll filled with an assortment of fresh, dried, and cooked ingredients, eaten during a festival and other celebratory occasions.

taiwan.name: Hong dou tang
taiwan.description: The dish is a sweet Chinese dessert made from azuki beans served in Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, and places with Chinese diaspora.

taiwan.name: Coconut bar
taiwan.description: The dish is a refrigerated dim sum dessert. It is sweet and has a soft, gelatin-like texture but is white in color rather than translucent like gelatin. The dessert is made of coconut milk (preferably freshly made) and set with a mixture of wheat starch and corn starch, or a mixture of agar agar and gelatin. It is sweetened, and sometimes sprinkled with desiccated coconuts.

taiwan.name: Danbing
taiwan.description: The dish is an egg pancake or rolled egg crepe. The dough is made by kneading flour, potato starch, glutinous rice flour, and water into a thin dough, and an omelet is baked on top of the dough

taiwan.name: Oyster omelette
taiwan.description: The dish is an omelette filled primarily with small oysters, with starch (often sweet potato starch) mixed into the egg batter for a thicker consistency. It is often fried in pork lard, and some variations include a savory sauce poured on top. Spicy or chili sauce with lime juice is often added for extra flavor.

taiwan.name: Sopa de cacahuete
taiwan.description: The dish is a soup made from peanuts, often with various other ingredients

taiwan.name: Youtiao
taiwan.description: This dish is a long golden-brown deep-fried strip of wheat flour dough

taiwan.name: Grass jelly
taiwan.description: The jelly is made by boiling the aged and slightly oxidized stalks and leaves of Platostoma palustre (Mesona chinensis) with potassium carbonate and a little starch for several hours, then let it cool and served with sweet beverages.

hong kong.name: Yin yang fried rice
hong kong.description: This dish is a fried rice featuring bechamel sauce and tomato sauce.

hong kong.name: Cifantuan
hong kong.description: The dish is made by tightly wrapping a piece of youtiao (fried dough) with glutinous rice. It is usually eaten as breakfast together with sweetened or savory soy milk.

hong kong.name: Claypot rice
hong kong.description: The dish is made with cooked rice, finished in a claypot with other ingredients that flavor the rice. It is often served with chicken, sausage, and Vegetable.

hong kong.name: Bánh tổ
hong kong.description: The dish is made from glutinus irce flour with sticky sweet texture with brown color.

hong kong.name: Singapore-style noodles
hong kong.description: The dish are typically stir-fried cooked rice vermicelli, curry powder, Vegetable, scrambled eggs and meat, most commonly char siu pork, and/or prawn or chicken.

hong kong.name: Cart noodle
hong kong.description: The dish is typically based upon the diner choosing various ingredients they would like, including the type of noodles, various soup broths, and toppings.Examples of types of noodles and toppings, which may vary considerably from stall to stall.

hong kong.name: Wonton noodles
hong kong.description: The dish consists of egg noodles served in a hot broth, garnished with leafy Vegetable and wonton dumplings. Common Vegetable include broccoli or kale. The wontons typically contain prawns, chicken or pork, and spring onions, with some variations including mushrooms or black mushroom.

hong kong.name: Tofu skin roll
hong kong.description: The dish's outer layer is made of tofu skin, and it is usually served in a small plate in twos or threes. It has a number of cooking styles, and is normall fried or steamed. The fillings include pork, Vegetable, fish, and beef.

hong kong.name: Cha siu bao
hong kong.description: This dish is a bun filled with barbecue-flavored pork. They are usually served as dim sum.

hong kong.name: Taro cake
hong kong.description: The dish is a dense texture cake made from vegetable taro, cut into rectangular slices and pan-fried.

hong kong.name: Steamed meatball
hong kong.description: The dish is usually made of minced beef, with water chestnut to add texture and with coriander and a few slivers of chan pei or dried orange peel used as seasoning. A layer of tofu skin, or sometimes peas, are used to raise the meatballs from the bottom of the dish and prevent them from sitting in the cooking juices.

hong kong.name: Paper wrapped cake
hong kong.description: The dish is a type of cake. In essence, it is a chiffon cake baked in a paper cup. Traditionally prepared wrapped cakes are usually steamed in a wok pan. The cakes are typically prepared by separating the egg yolks and whites, and whisking them separately as well.

hong kong.name: Yau gok
hong kong.description: A dumpling which its wrap is first made of glutinous rice dough. A crescent shape is formed to hold the fried ingredients used as filling. A batch of the pastries are either baked or deep fried in a wok.

hong kong.name: Egg waffle
hong kong.description: A spherical waffle consisting of an eggy leavened batter cooked between two plates of semi-spherical cells. They are usually served hot, and often eaten plain, although they may be served with fruit and flavors such as strawberry, coconut or chocolate.

hong kong.name: Borscht
hong kong.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

hong kong.name: Beef bun
hong kong.description: This dish is a bun that has a ground beef filling, sometimes including pieces of onions.

hong kong.name: Buttered pineapple bun
hong kong.description: This dish is a sweet bun made to resemble a pineapple with a slice of butter stuffed inside.

hong kong.name: Cocktail bun
hong kong.description: This dish is a sweet bun with a filling of shredded coconut.

hong kong.name: Peanut butter bun
hong kong.description: This dish is a sweet bun that has layers of peanut butter fillings, sometimes with light sprinkles of sugar mixed with the peanut butter for extra flavor.

hong kong.name: Spring roll
hong kong.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

hong kong.name: Black sesame roll
hong kong.description: This dish is a refrigerated dessert. The dessert preparation starts by drying a thin layer of black sesame paste, which forms a refrigerated sheet. Once set, each sheet is rolled up individually into a sesame roll.

hong kong.name: Hong dou tang
hong kong.description: The dish is a sweet Chinese dessert made from azuki beans served in Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, and places with Chinese diaspora.

hong kong.name: Malay sponge cake
hong kong.description: This dish is made of lard or butter, flour, and eggs, using a bamboo steamer to develop puffiness.

hong kong.name: Shrimp toast
hong kong.description: The dish is a dim sum dish. It is made from small triangles of bread, coated with a paste made from minced shrimp and cooked by baking or deep frying.

hong kong.name: Coconut bar
hong kong.description: The dish is a refrigerated dim sum dessert. It is sweet and has a soft, gelatin-like texture but is white in color rather than translucent like gelatin. The dessert is made of coconut milk (preferably freshly made) and set with a mixture of wheat starch and corn starch, or a mixture of agar agar and gelatin. It is sweetened, and sometimes sprinkled with desiccated coconuts.

hong kong.name: Tuna bun
hong kong.description: The dish is a bun that contains tuna paste.

hong kong.name: Ham and egg bun
hong kong.description: The dish is a bun or bread that contains a sheet of egg and ham.

hong kong.name: Pineapple bun
hong kong.description: The dish is a kind of sweet bun. Despite the name, it does not traditionally contain pineapple; rather, the name refers to the look of the characteristic topping (which resembles the texture of a pineapple).

hong kong.name: Red bean ice
hong kong.description: The standard ingredients of this dish include beans, light rock sugar syrup, and evaporated milk. It is often topped with ice cream.

hong kong.name: Youtiao
hong kong.description: This dish is a long golden-brown deep-fried strip of wheat flour dough

hong kong.name: Grass jelly
hong kong.description: The jelly is made by boiling the aged and slightly oxidized stalks and leaves of Platostoma palustre (Mesona chinensis) with potassium carbonate and a little starch for several hours, then let it cool and served with sweet beverages.

osaka.name: Omurice
osaka.description: The dish consists of an omelette made with fried rice and thin, scrambled eggs, usually topped with ketchup.

osaka.name: Okonomiyaki
osaka.description: The dish is a savory pancake dish consisting of wheat flour batter and other ingredients (mixed, or as toppings) cooked on a flat griddle. Common additions include cabbage, meat, and seafood, and toppings include sauce made from Worcestershire sauce, dried seaweed flakes, bonito flakes, mayonnaise, and pickled ginger.

osaka.name: Oshizushi
osaka.description: The chef lines the bottom a block-shaped mold with the toppings(cooked fish or cured fish), covers them with sushi rice, and then presses the mold's lid to create a compact block. The block is removed from the mold and then cut into bite-sized pieces

osaka.name: Takoyaki
osaka.description: The dish is a ball-shaped snack made of a wheat flour-based batter and cooked in a special molded pan. It is typically filled with minced or diced octopus, tempura scraps, pickled ginger, and green onion. The balls are brushed with sauce similar to Worcestershire sauce and mayonnaise, and then sprinkled with green laver and shavings of dried bonito.

manila.name: Java rice
manila.description: The dish is a scoop of white rice served with small portions of various dishes, including meats, Vegetable, peanuts, eggs, and fried shrimp crackers.

japan.name: Donburi
japan.description: The rice-bowl dish consisting of fish, meat, Vegetable or other ingredients simmered together and served over rice.

japan.name: Chazuke
japan.description: The dish is made by pouring green tea, dashi, or hot water over cooked rice. This dish provides a way to use leftover rice as a quick snack because it is easy to make.

japan.name: Katsudon
japan.description: The dish is a bowl of rice topped with a deep-fried breaded pork cutlet, egg, Vegetable, and condiments.

japan.name: Moffle
japan.description: The dish consisting of mochi rice cake cooked in a waffle iron, which creates a waffle.

japan.name: Okowa
japan.description: The is a steamed rice dish made with glutinous rice mixed with meat or Vegetable.

japan.name: Onigiri
japan.description: The dish is made from white rice. It is usually formed into triangular or cylindrical shapes, and wrapped in seaweed. This dish traditionally have sour or salty fillings such as pickled Chinese plum, salted salmon, smoked and fermented bonito, kombu, tarako or pollock roe, or pickled Japanese giant red mustard greens. Because it is easily portable and eaten by hand, this dish has been used as portable food or bento from ancient times to the present day.

japan.name: Sushi
japan.description: The dish is prepared vinegared rice, rolled with seaweed, often with sugar and salt, combined with a variety of ingredients such as Vegetable and meats, most commonly seafood.

japan.name: Yakimochi
japan.description: The dish is is grilled or broiled mochi or pounded rice cake. Traditionally, it is prepared using a small charcoal grill, but in modern times a gas grill can be used. During the time of the Autumn Moon, it is traditional to eat this dish while sipping sake and enjoying the view of the full moon.

japan.name: Zosui
japan.description: The dish is a mild and thin rice soup akin to a rice-based vegetable soup. It is made from pre-cooked rice and dashi or water seasoned with either soy sauce or miso and cooked with other ingredients such as meat, seafood, mushrooms, and Vegetable.

japan.name: Senbei
japan.description: The dish is a rice cracker. They come in various shapes, sizes, and flavors, usually savory but sometimes sweet. This dish is often eaten with green tea as a casual snack and offered to visiting house guests as a courtesy refreshment.

japan.name: Dango
japan.description: The dish is made with regular rice flour and glutinous rice flour. They are usually made in round shapes, and three to five pieces are served on a skewer.

japan.name: Mochi
japan.description: The dish is a rice cake made of a short-grain glutinous rice, and sometimes other ingredients such as water, sugar, and cornstarch. The steamed rice is pounded into paste and molded into the desired shape.

japan.name: Yakisoba
japan.description: The dish is prepared by frying wheat noodles with bite-sized pork and finely chopped Vegetable like cabbage, onions, bean sprouts, and carrots.

japan.name: Shirataki noodles
japan.description: The dish is gelatinous noodles made from the corm of the konjac plant. In traditional cuisine, they are eaten in soups or stir-fried. The texture is chewy, similar to a tough jelly, and has little flavor before seasoning.

japan.name: Tensoba
japan.description: There are two varieties of the dish: one is served with a hot broth of dashi and soy sauce; the other is served with cooled soba and dipped in tsukejiru (lit. "dipping sauce"), either chilled or hot and usually strongly flavored.
japan.photoCredit: adactio from E-Kagen Sushi & Noodle Coffee Bar [1] , Brighton, England

japan.name: Toshikoshi soba
japan.description: The dish is a noodle soup dish traditionally eaten on omisoka (new year's eve).

japan.name: Abura Soba
japan.description: The dish consists of dry noodle made with a sauce of soy sauce and lard.

japan.name: Udon
japan.description: The dish is a thick noodle made from wheat flour with a mild broth from dashi, soy sauce, and mirin.

japan.name: Tempura
japan.description: The dish consists of seafood and Vegetable that have been coated in a thin batter and deep fried.

japan.name: Tonkatsu
japan.description: The dish consists of a breaded, deep-fried pork cutlet. It involves coating slices of pork with panko (bread crumbs), and then frying them in oil

japan.name: Korokke
japan.description: The dish is made by mixing cooked chopped meat, seafood, or Vegetable with mashed potato or white sauce, usually shaped like a flat patty, rolling it in wheat flour, eggs, and breadcrumbs, then deep-frying this until brown on the outside.

japan.name: Yakitori
japan.description: The dish is a Japanese type of skewered chicken. Its preparation involves attaching the bit-sized cut meat to a skewer, typically made of bamboo, after which it is grilled over a charcoal fire. During or after cooking, the meat is typically seasoned with sauce or salt.

japan.name: Agedashi dōfu
japan.description: The dish is a hot tofu dish. Soft or medium-firm silken tofu (kinugoshi) is cut into cubes, before being lightly dusted with potato starch or cornstarch and then deep fried until golden brown. It is then served in a hot broth (tentsuyu) made of dashi, mirin, and shō-yu (Japanese soy sauce), with finely-chopped negi (a type of spring onion) and grated daikon or katsuobushi (dried skipjack tuna flakes) sprinkled on top.

japan.name: Tofu skin
japan.description: The dish is a food item made from soybeans. During the boiling of soy milk, in an open shallow pan, a film or skin composed primarily of a soy protein-lipid complex forms on the liquid surface.

japan.name: Ganmodoki
japan.description: The dish is a fried tofu fritter made with Vegetable such as carrots, lotus roots, and burdock with sometimes egg.

japan.name: Hiyayakko
japan.description: The dish is a chilled tofu dressed with toppings.

japan.name: Uirō
japan.description: The dish is a steamed cake made of glutinous rice flour and sugar. It is chewy, similar to mochi, and subtly sweet. Flavors include red bean paste, green tea (matcha), yuzu, strawberry and chestnut.

japan.name: Chawanmushi
japan.description: The dish is a savory egg custard made by steaming an egg mixture flavored with soy sauce, dashi, and mirin.

japan.name: Karakudamono
japan.description: The dish is a term used to refer to various pastry desserts originating from another country.

japan.name: Bungeo-ppang
japan.description: The dish is a fish-shaped pastry stuffed with sweetened red bean paste. The snack is often sold at street stalls, grilled on an appliance similar to a waffle iron but with a fish-shaped mold. Red bean paste is the standard filling but many of these sold as street food are filled with pastry cream, sweet potato, pizza toppings, chocolate, kimchi and others.

japan.name: Taiyaki
japan.description: The dish is a fish-shaped cake, commonly sold as street food. It imitates the shape of red sea bream, which it is named after. The most common filling is red bean paste that is made from sweetened red beans. Other common fillings may be custard, chocolate, cheese, or sweet potato. Some shops even sell it with savory pancake, dumpling filling, or a sausage inside.

japan.name: Melonpan
japan.description: The dish is a sweetbun covered in a layer of crispy cookie dough.

japan.name: Japanese milk bread
japan.description: The dish is a bread made of flour, whole milk, butter, yeast, salt, sugar and often eggs.

japan.name: Naan
japan.description: The dish is a leavened, oven-baked or tawa-fried flatbread, that can also be baked in a tandoor. It is characterized by a light and fluffy texture and golden-brown spots from the baking process.

japan.name: Spring roll
japan.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

japan.name: Makizushi
japan.description: This dish is generally roll-wrapped in nori (seaweed) but is occasionally wrapped in a thin omelette, soy paper, cucumber, or shiso (perilla) leaves. This dish is often cut into six or eight pieces, constituting a single roll order.

japan.name: Nikujaga
japan.description: The dish is made of meat, potatoes, and onions stewed in dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar, sometimes with konjac and vegetable like carrots.

japan.name: Butajiru
japan.description: This dish is a soup made with pork and vegetables, flavoured with a type of fermented soybeans paste.
japan.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. 小太刀~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

japan.name: Dashi
japan.description: The dish is a family of stocks used in Japanese cuisine. It is the base for clear broth soup, noodle broth soup, and many simmering liquids to accentuate the savory flavor known as umami.

japan.name: Kenchin-jiru
japan.description: The dish is a popular Japanese vegetable soup prepared using root Vegetable and tofu prepared in various manners using myriad ingredients.

japan.name: Miso soup
japan.description: The dish is a traditional Japanese soup consisting of miso paste mixed with a dashi stock.

japan.name: Ohaw
japan.description: The dish is a savory soup of Ainu cuisine, a dish of the Ainu people of northern Japan, flavored with fish or animal bones.

japan.name: Hong dou tang
japan.description: The dish is a sweet Chinese dessert made from azuki beans served in Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, and places with Chinese diaspora.

japan.name: Zōni
japan.description: The dish is a Japanese soup containing mochi rice cakes associated with the Japanese New Year and its tradition of osechi ceremonial foods.

japan.name: Cup Noodles
japan.description: The dish is a cup instant ramen developed in 1971 and manufactured by Japanese food company Nissin Foods packaged in foam, plastic, or paper cups and are prepared by adding boiling water.

japan.name: Dojō nabe
japan.description: The dish is a Japanese nabemono dish cooked in a hot pot with pond loaches as it main ingridients
japan.photoCredit: 江戸村のとくぞう (Edomura no Tokuzo)

japan.name: Fugu chiri
japan.description: The dish is a pufferfish soup

japan.name: Harihari-nabe
japan.description: The dish is a type of nabemono made with minke whale meat and mizuna.

japan.name: Hayashi rice
japan.description: The dish is a popular dish in Japan as a Western-style dish, or yōshoku, that usually contains beef, onions, and button mushrooms in a thick demi-glace sauce, which often contains red wine and tomato sauce.

japan.name: Motsunabe
japan.description: The dish is a type of nabemono in Japanese cuisine, which is made from beef or pork tripe or other offal

japan.name: Oden
japan.description: The dish is a type of nabemono (Japanese one-pot dishes) consisting of several ingredients such as boiled eggs, daikon or konjac, and processed fishcakes stewed in a light, soy-flavored dashi broth.

japan.name: Shabu-shabu
japan.description: The dish is a Japanese nabemono hotpot dish of thinly sliced meat and Vegetable boiled in water and served with dipping sauces.

japan.name: Sukiyaki
japan.description: The dish  is a Japanese dish that is prepared and served in the nabemono (Japanese hot pot) style consists of meat (usually thinly sliced beef) which is slowly cooked or simmered at the table, alongside Vegetable and other ingredients, in a shallow iron pot in a mixture of soy sauce, sugar, and mirin.

japan.name: Green laver
japan.description: The dish is a type of edible green seaweed, including species from the genera Monostroma and Ulva (Ulva prolifera, Ulva pertusa, Ulva intestinalis)

japan.name: Hiyashi chūka
japan.description: The dish is a Chinese-style Japanese dish consisting of chilled Chinese noodles with various toppings served in the summer.

japan.name: Green tea ice cream
japan.description: The dish is ice cream flavored with matcha, or green tea.

japan.name: Hakuto jelly
japan.description: The dish is made using the juice of ripe peaches and mineral-rich spring water. The texture is very smooth and soft, similar to the texture of the fruit itself.

japan.name: Kakigōri
japan.description: The dish is a shaved ice dessert flavored with syrup and a sweetener, often condensed milk.

japan.name: Wagashi
japan.description: The dish is a traditional confection made of rice cake, red bean paste, and fruit.

japan.name: Red bean paste
japan.description: The dish is prepared by boiling the beans, then mashing or grinding them. At this stage, the paste can be sweetened or left as it is. The color of the paste is usually dark red, which comes from the husk of the beans.

japan.name: Amanattō
japan.description: The dish is a traditional confectionery made of azuki or other beans, covered with refined sugar after simmering with sugar syrup and drying.

japan.name: Raindrop cake
japan.description: The dish is a confection made of water and agar that resembles a large raindrop.
japan.photoCredit: Ty Nigh from Wichita, KS, USA

japan.name: Sakuramochi
japan.description: The dish is a confection consisting of sweet, pink-colored rice cake with red bean paste filling, wrapped in a pickled cherry blossom leaf, which may or may not be eaten depending on individual preference.

japan.name: Tokoroten
japan.description: The dish is a gelatinous dish in Japanese cuisine, made from agarophyte seaweed.

japan.name: Suama
japan.description: The dish is made of non-glutinous rice flour, hot water, and sugar characterized by its red food dye.

japan.name: Shiruko
japan.description: The dish is a sweet porridge of red beans boiled and crushed, served in a bowl with mochi.

japan.name: Namagashi
japan.description: This sweet may contain fruit jellies, other gelatines, or sweetened bean paste. It is detailed, designed with using seasonal and natural motifs such as leaves and flowers to reflect the various objects of nature in four seasons.

japan.name: Warabimochi
japan.description: This confection is made from bracken starch and covered or dipped in sweet toasted soybean flour. Sugar syrup is sometimes poured on top before serving as an added sweetener.

japan.name: Imagawayaki
japan.description: This dessert is often found at festivals. The dessert is made of batter in a special pan and filled with sweet red bean paste.

japan.name: Amezaiku
japan.description: This candy craft artistry is sculpted of multi-coloured sweetener that is clear, thick, and sticky made by converting starch to sugars.

japan.name: Anmitsu
japan.description: This dessert is made of small cubes of agar jelly, a white translucent jelly made from red algae. It is served in a bowl with sweet red bean paste, boiled peas, and a variety of fruits such as peach slices, oranges, pieces of pineapples, and/or cherries
japan.photoCredit: akira yamada from Yokohama (横浜市中区 伊勢佐木町 - Isezakicho )

japan.name: Arare
japan.description: This snack is a type of bite-sized cracker made from glutinous rice and flavored with soy sauce.

japan.name: Botamochi
japan.description: This confection is made with glutinous rice and white rice with ratio of 7:3, or only glutinous rice, plus sweet red bean paste.

japan.name: Beika
japan.description: The name refers to a dry confectionery that is made out of rice.

japan.name: Chitose ame
japan.description: This candy is given to children on the festival that celebrates the passage of their children into middle childhood. This candy is long, thin, red and white candy, and is wrapped in a thin, clear, and edible rice paper film that resembles plastic. This candy is usually given with a bag decorated with a crane and a turtle.

japan.name: Daifuku
japan.description: This confection is a small round rice cake stuffed with a sweet filling, most commonly a sweetened red bean paste. It is often served along with a green tea.
japan.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Lyzzy assumed (based on copyright claims).

japan.name: Yubeshi
japan.description: This confection is most commonly made of walnuts or yuzu citrus, and can be round or square. It has a base of sticky rice or rice flour, sugar and soy sauce.

japan.name: Yōkan
japan.description: The dish is made of red bean paste, agar, and sugar. It is usually sold in a block form, and eaten in slices.

japan.name: Monaka
japan.description: The dish consists of red bean paste sandwiched between two thin, crisp wafers made from rice cake. The wafers can be square, triangle, or complicated shapes such as cultural landmarks or symbols. The dish is a type of dessert served with tea.

japan.name: Hanabiramochi
japan.description: This dessert is usually eaten at the beginning of the year. The exact shape of the dish is strictly defined by tradition. The white rice cake covering is flat and round, folded over to form a semicircular shape, and must have a pink colour showing through in the centre of the confection, fading to a white at the edge.

japan.name: Higashi
japan.description: The dish recipe is one or more kinds of sugar, with a particular sort of flour and some other additives, while there is some variants made solely of sugar, with no flour content.

japan.name: Karintō
japan.description: This is a sweet, deep-fried snack. It is made primarily of flour, yeast, and brown sugar. It has a deep brown and pitted appearance and takes the form of a bite-sized pillow or short cylinder.

japan.name: Konpeitō
japan.description: It takes the form of a small sphere with a bumpy surface, and comes in a variety of colors and flavors.

japan.name: Kuzumochi
japan.description: A dessert that can be either mochi cake made from kudzu powder, starch derived from the root of the kudzu plant, or rice cakes made from Lactobacillales-fermented wheat starch. The usual preparation consists in combining kudzu powder with water and sugar, and cooking it over a gentle heat, stirring continuously until the mixture thickens and becomes transparent. This process also imparts an elastic texture to the kudzu. The transparent appearance of the final product contributes to a cool sensation, making it a popular choice for consumption during warmer months.

japan.name: Manjū
japan.description: A small, dense bun with a sweet filling. It has a skin made of flour, and is filled with sweet azuki bean paste. Some varieties use kudzu starch or buckwheat flour for the skin. Other types of filling include sweet potato, chestnut jam, or custard. It is usually steamed or baked, though fried variation can be found in some modern restaurants. Traditionally they are usually round, but many different shapes exist today, and some are proprietary to specific bakeries.

japan.name: Mizuame
japan.description: A clear, thick, sticky liquid, it is made by converting starch to sugars. Some are produced in a very similar fashion to corn syrup and are very similar in taste. Two methods are used to convert the starches to sugars. The traditional method is to take glutinous rice mixed with malt, and let the natural enzymatic process take place, converting the starch to syrup which consists mainly of maltose. The second and more common method is acid hydrolysis of potato starch or sweet potato starch by adding acid, such as hydrochloric, sulfuric or nitric acids, to make glucose syrup. If done by the first method, the final product is considered more flavorful than the acid version.

japan.name: Kamameshi
japan.description: A rice dish traditionally cooked in an iron pot. Many varieties exist, but most consist of rice seasoned with soy sauce or mirin, and cooked with meats and vegetables.

japan.name: Katemeshi
japan.description: Typical ingredients in the preparation of this dish included rice, barley, millet, chopped daikon radish root and leaves, and other greens. The use of daikon in the dish was very common. Other ingredients used in the dish, when available, included wheat, carrots, turnips, burdock, taro, pumpkin, soybeans, mushrooms, kidney beans, and adzuki beans, among others.

japan.name: Red bean rice
japan.description: Rice dish consisting of rice cooked with red beans.

japan.name: Takikomi gohan
japan.description: Rice dish seasoned with dashi and soy sauce and mixed with mushrooms, vegetables, meat, or fish. The ingredients are cooked together with the rice.

japan.name: Tamago kake gohan
japan.description: Cooked rice topped or mixed with raw egg and soy sauce.

japan.name: Nanakusa-no-sekku
japan.description: Seven-herb rice porridge consisting of Japanese parsley, sheperd's purse, cudweed, chickweed, nipplewort, turnip, and radish.

japan.name: Gyūdon
japan.description: Bowl of rice topped with beef and onion, simmered in a mildly sweet sauce flavored with fish and seaweed stock, soy sauce and sweet rice wine.

japan.name: Oyakodon
japan.description: Rice bowl dish, in which chicken, egg, sliced scallion (or sometimes regular onions), and other ingredients are all simmered together in a kind of soup that is made with soy sauce and stock, and then served on top of a large bowl of rice.

japan.name: Tekkadon
japan.description: Rice dish topped with thin-sliced raw tuna. The spicy version is made with what can be a mix of spicy ingredients, a spicy orange sauce, or both, usually incorporating spring onions.

japan.name: Tendon
japan.description: Fried shrimp on a bowl of rice.

japan.name: Unadon
japan.description: Typically served in a large bowl filled with steamed white rice, and topped with fillets of eel grilled. The fillets are glazed with a sweetened soy-based sauce, called tare and caramelized, preferably over charcoal fire. The fillets are not flayed, and the grayish skin side is placed faced down.

japan.name: Wappameshi
japan.description: Rice dish in special round containers seasoned with lightly-salted dashi broth, topped with steamed seasonal seafood.

japan.name: Nigirizushi
japan.description: An oblong mound of rice that a chef typically presses between the palms of the hands to form an oval-shaped ball and a topping draped over the ball. It is usually served with a bit of wasabi; toppings are typically fish such as salmon, tuna, or other seafood. Certain toppings are typically bound to the rice with a thin strip of nori, most commonly octopus, freshwater eel, sea eel, squid, and sweet egg.

japan.name: Curry bread
japan.description: Curry wrapped in a piece of dough, which is then coated in bread crumbs and deep fried. On occasion it is baked instead of deep fried, but deep frying is the most common method of cooking.

japan.name: Chirashizushi
japan.description: The dish serves the rice in a bowl and tops it with a variety of raw fish and vegetable garnishes. The dish"s name has the meaning of "scattered sushi".

japan.name: Yakisoba-pan
japan.description: This dish consists of fried wheat noodles that is sandwiched between a white bread roll bun.

japan.name: Okazu
japan.description: side dish to accompany rice, it is cooked and seasoned in such a way as to match well when eaten with rice, and are typically made from fish, meat, vegetable, or tofu

japan.name: Nanbanzuke
japan.description: This dish is made of diced fish (is lightly dusted with potato starch or cornstarch and then deep fried until golden brown. It is then served in a hot broth made of grain vinegar, stock, sweat rice wine, and Japanese soy sauce, with finely-sliced onion, finely julienne carrots, finely-shredded green peppers, and red chilli peppers

japan.name: Kushikatsu
japan.description: this dish is made with chicken, pork, seafood, and seasonal vegetables. These are skewered on bamboo; dipped in egg, flour, and panko; and deep-fried in vegetable oil

japan.name: Furai
japan.description: This is a deep fried and breaded seafood or vegetables. It is usually served with shredded cabbage and/or shredded lettuce, sauce, and lemon.

japan.name: Ebi furai
japan.description: The dish is a breaded shrimp and then deep fry.  It is usually served with shredded cabbage and/or shredded lettuce, tonkatsu sauce, and lemon.

japan.name: Kaki furai
japan.description: The dish consisting of panko-breaded deep-fried oysters

japan.name: Kakiage
japan.description: The dish is made by batter-dipping and deep-frying a batch of ingredients such as shrimp bits  It may use other seafood such as small scallops, shredded vegetables or a combination of such ingredients.

japan.name: Bento
japan.description: single-portion take-out or home-packed meal, often for lunch, typically includes rice or noodles with fish or some other meat, often with pickled and cooked vegetables in a box

japan.name: Red caviar
japan.description: It is made from the roe of salmonid fishes (various species of salmon and trout), which has an intense reddish hue

japan.name: Tamagoyaki
japan.description: The dish is a type of omelette made by rolling together several layers of fried beaten eggs. It is often prepared in a rectangular pan.

japan.name: Onsen tamago
japan.description: This dish is essentially an egg boiled at low temperatures in hot spring water. It has a unique texture, with the white resembling a delicate, milky custard and the yolk firm but creamy, due to the different solidifying temperatures of the yolk and white. The egg is poached in its shell and served without the shell, typically in a small cup with a broth and soy sauce.
japan.photoCredit: Blue Lotus from Jigokudani Onsen, Nagano

japan.name: Edamame
japan.description: This dish is made from immature soybeans served in their pods, typically boiled or steamed and seasoned with salt. Rich in vitamins, dietary fiber, and isoflavones, it is popular worldwide as a side dish, appetizer, or ingredient in various sweet and savory dishes.
japan.photoCredit: Tammy Green (aka Zesmerelda) from Chicago Upscale Dining + Lounge Republic Pan-Asian Restaurant [1] in Ontario & Rush Street, Chicago, Illinois 60611

japan.name: Fried ice cream
japan.description: This dish is a dessert made of a scoop of ice cream that is frozen hard, then breaded or coated in a batter before being quickly deep-fried, creating a warm, crispy shell around the still-cold ice cream.

japan.name: Nori
japan.description: This is a dried edible seaweed. It has a strong and distinctive flavor, and is generally made into flat sheets and used to wrap rolls.

japan.name: Katsuobushi
japan.description: The dish is a simmered, smoked, and fermented skipjack tuna.

japan.name: Kinpira
japan.description: The food is usually made of root vegetables that have been sautéed and simmered. The most common variety is braised burdock root. Other vegetables include carrots and lotus root, skins of squash such as pumpkin, mushrooms or broccoli, and seaweeds. Other foods include tofu, capsicum, wheat gluten, chicken thigh, pork, and beef.

chittagong.name: Akhni
chittagong.description: The mixed rice and meat dish, a variant of pilaf.

sylhet.name: Akhni
sylhet.description: The mixed rice and meat dish, a variant of pilaf.

tamil nadu.name: Appam
tamil nadu.description: The dish is made with a fermented rice batter and coconut milk. They’re cooked in a deep pan like a wok, giving them their unique shape.

tamil nadu.name: Curd rice
tamil nadu.description: The dish combining steamed white rice and yogurt.

tamil nadu.name: Puttu
tamil nadu.description: The dish is made of steamed cylinders of ground rice layered with coconut shavings, sometimes with a sweet or savory filling on the inside. It is usually a breakfast dish served hot with either sweet side dishes such as palm sugar or banana, or savoury with chana masala, chutney, rasam, or meat curries.

tamil nadu.name: Kozhukkatta
tamil nadu.description: The dish is made from rice flour, with a filling of grated coconut, jaggery, or jackfruit jam. Although usually sweet, can sometimes be stuffed with a savory filling.

tamil nadu.name: Dosa
tamil nadu.description: The dish is a thin, savoury crepe made from a fermented batter of ground black gram and rice. They are served hot, often with chutney and sambar (a lentil-based vegetable stew).

tamil nadu.name: Uttapam
tamil nadu.description: The dish is a type of savory crepe or pancake, but instead of being crisp and crepe-like, it is thicker and topped with various ingredients.

tamil nadu.name: Patrode
tamil nadu.description: The dish is made from colocasia leaves stuffed with gram or rice flour and flavourings such as spices, tamarind, and jaggery (raw sugar).

tamil nadu.name: Puran poli
tamil nadu.description: The dish is a flatbread made of a variant of chick pea, wheat flour, sugar, a type of clarified butter, jaggery.

tamil nadu.name: Kuzhambu
tamil nadu.description: This is a tamarind-based stew, made with a variety of meats, vegetables, and sometimes dal. The dish features a broth of tamarind and spices like coriander and fenugreek, and can be served watery or thick, often enjoyed as a side for rice, with numerous regional variations adapting to local tastes.

tamil nadu.name: Murukku
tamil nadu.description: This is a savoury, crunchy snack typically made from rice and black gram flour. The flours are mixed with water, salt, chili powder, asafoetida and either sesame seeds or cumin seeds. The mix is kneaded into a dough, which is shaped into spiral or coil shapes either by hand or extruded using a mould. The spirals are then deep-fried in vegetable oil.

kerala.name: Appam
kerala.description: The dish is made with a fermented rice batter and coconut milk. They’re cooked in a deep pan like a wok, giving them their unique shape.

kerala.name: Curd rice
kerala.description: The dish combining steamed white rice and yogurt.

kerala.name: Puttu
kerala.description: The dish is made of steamed cylinders of ground rice layered with coconut shavings, sometimes with a sweet or savory filling on the inside. It is usually a breakfast dish served hot with either sweet side dishes such as palm sugar or banana, or savoury with chana masala, chutney, rasam, or meat curries.

kerala.name: Thalassery biryani
kerala.description: The dish is a rice-based dish blended with spices and chicken.

kerala.name: Kozhukkatta
kerala.description: The dish is made from rice flour, with a filling of grated coconut, jaggery, or jackfruit jam. Although usually sweet, can sometimes be stuffed with a savory filling.

kerala.name: Dosa
kerala.description: The dish is a thin, savoury crepe made from a fermented batter of ground black gram and rice. They are served hot, often with chutney and sambar (a lentil-based vegetable stew).

kerala.name: Uttapam
kerala.description: The dish is a type of savory crepe or pancake, but instead of being crisp and crepe-like, it is thicker and topped with various ingredients.

kerala.name: Ada
kerala.description: The dish consisting of rice parcels encased in a dough made of rice flour, with sweet fillings, steamed in banana leaf and served as an evening snack or as part of breakfast. Grated coconut and rice flour are the two main ingredients.

kerala.name: Patrode
kerala.description: The dish is made from colocasia leaves stuffed with gram or rice flour and flavourings such as spices, tamarind, and jaggery (raw sugar).

kerala.name: Chatti pathiri
kerala.description: The dish uses pastry sheets or pancakes made with flour, egg, oil and water. The filling can be sweet, made with sweetened seasoned beaten eggs, nuts and raisins, or savoury, with the traditional meat filling used in samosas or savoury puffs. The flour is kneaded into soft dough and rolled into thin pancakes which are softened in milk and arranged in layers with filling between them and baked. It is considered an essential part of any festival, pre- and post-wedding events.

kerala.name: Parotta
kerala.description: The dish is a flaky and layered flatbread, and is prepared by kneading maida/wheat flour, egg (in some recipes), oil or ghee and water.

kerala.name: Puran poli
kerala.description: The dish is a flatbread made of a variant of chick pea, wheat flour, sugar, a type of clarified butter, jaggery.

kerala.name: Murukku
kerala.description: This is a savoury, crunchy snack typically made from rice and black gram flour. The flours are mixed with water, salt, chili powder, asafoetida and either sesame seeds or cumin seeds. The mix is kneaded into a dough, which is shaped into spiral or coil shapes either by hand or extruded using a mould. The spirals are then deep-fried in vegetable oil.

spain.name: Arroz caldoso
spain.description: The dish consists of rice cooked in broth, with various seasonings and ingredients. The recipe varies by region, ranging from a risotto-like consistency to a rice soup or a dish resembling paella.

spain.name: Arroz con pollo
spain.description: The dish consists of chicken cooked with rice, onions, saffron, and a potential plethora of other grains or Vegetable.

spain.name: Horchata
spain.description: The dish is a beverage, generally plant-based but sometimes containing milk. It is made with soaked, ground, and sweetened tiger nuts. In some regions, the base is jicaro, melon or sesame seeds, or white rice, along with other spices.

spain.name: Sopa de fideo
spain.description: The dish is made with thin noodles (typically vermicelli and angel hair pasta) which are typically broken or cut and then browned separately prior to being stewed in stock with the other soup ingredients. Additional soup ingredients include bell pepper, onion and garlic, tomatoes, tomato sauce, chicken, chili peppers, vegetable oil, salt and pepper.

spain.name: Alfajor
spain.description: The dish is a traditional confection typically made of flour, honey, and nuts.

spain.name: Barquillo
spain.description: The dish is made from the basic cookie ingredients of flour, sugar, egg whites and butter rolled out thinly and then shaped into a hollow cylinder or a cone.

spain.name: Bizcocho
spain.description: The dish is the name given range of pastries, cakes or cookies.

spain.name: Empanada
spain.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

spain.name: Ensaïmada
spain.description: The dish is a pastry product made with flour, water, sugar, eggs, dough, and a reduced pork lard.

spain.name: Fazuelos
spain.description: The dish is a thin rolled pastry made of fried dough comprising flour, eggs, sugar, and oil. The dough is rolled thinly, cut into strips, and briefly fried. A syrup of water, orange blossom, and sugar is then prepared for additional flavor.

spain.name: Milhojas
spain.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

spain.name: Nun's puffs
spain.description: This dish is a dessert pastry. The dessert is made from butter, milk, flour, sugar, eggs, and sometimes honey. Recipes call for pan frying (traditionally in lard), re-frying and then baking, or baking straight away. The best-established recipes suggest cooking the butter, milk, and flour in a pan then adding the eggs (whites last) and sprinkling sugar on the mixture before baking.
spain.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Žiga assumed (based on copyright claims).

spain.name: Pionono
spain.description: This dish is a dough made of flour, eggs, and sugar, which is baked in a thin sheet then rolled around a filling of dulce de leche sometimes with walnuts, or fruits like strawberries with chantilly cream. This dish can also be made savoury with cured ham, cheese, tomato and mayonnaise, or a savory salad, such as ham salad with asparagus and lettuce, chicken salad or even tuna.

spain.name: Roscón
spain.description: The dish is a sweet bread-based ring-shaped dessert.

spain.name: Tarta capuchina
spain.description: A cake made mainly with egg yolk and syryp using water bath. The cake is usually presented in a cylindrical or rectangle shape, depending on the mold. It is commonly served at room temperature.

spain.name: Tarta de Santiago
spain.description: The ingredients mainly consist of ground almonds (almond flour), eggs, and sugar, with additional flavouring of lemon zest, sweet wine, brandy, or grape marc, depending on the recipe used.

spain.name: Escabeche
spain.description: The dish is made of marinated fish, meat or Vegetable, cooked or pickled in an acidic sauce (usually with vinegar), and flavored with paprika, citrus, and other spices.

spain.name: Stuffed squid
spain.description: This dish is made of made of olive oil, onion, garlic, rice, tomatoes, salt, black pepper, mint leaves, parsley, and tomato juice, with squid as the main ingredient.

spain.name: Stuffed eggplant
spain.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

spain.name: Hamin
spain.description: This dish is a Sabbath stew made from whole grains, cubes of meat, chickpeas or beans, onion and cumin.

spain.name: Puchero
spain.description: The dish is made of meat (beef, veal, pork or chicken), bacon, cured bones (such as those of the jamón serrano), and Vegetable (potatoes, celery, chard, leek, carrots, and turnips).

spain.name: Olla podrida
spain.description: The dish is usually made with chickpeas or beans, assorted meats like pork, beef, bacon, partridge, chicken, ham, and sausage, and Vegetable such as carrots, leeks, cabbage, potatoes, and onions.
spain.photoCredit: Santaorosia Photographic Colectivity from norte del sur europeo

spain.name: Pottage
spain.description: The dish is a thick soup or stew made by boiling Vegetable, grains, and, if available, meat or fish.

spain.name: Haminados
spain.description: The dish consists of eggs that are cooked for a long time, resulting in red-brown whites and darkened yolks.

spain.name: Huevos estrellados
spain.description: The dish is any of a number of dishes involving eggs fried in a large amount of olive oil or any other oil. The dish can be accompanied by french fries and some kind of meat (typically ham, bacon, or a sausage).

spain.name: Spanish omelette
spain.description: The dish is an omelette made with eggs and potatoes, usually including onion. It is often served at room temperature as a snack.

spain.name: Callos
spain.description: This dish contains beef tripe and chickpeas, blood sausage and peppers. A simple recipe of this is boiling the tripe until tender, slicing it into strips and cooking it in pork and beans with peppers. It is common to add cheese to it to enhance the flavour.

spain.name: Chorizo
spain.description: This dish is a type of pork sausage with varieties that are quite different from each other depending on the countries and the continent. The most common version is a fermented, cured, smoked sausage which gets its smokiness and deep red color from dried, smoked, red peppers.

spain.name: Longaniza
spain.description: This sausage is similar to salchichón, though thinner; both differ from chorizo in that black pepper is used for them instead of paprika and may have different spices in them like nutmeg.
spain.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Ardo Beltz assumed (based on copyright claims).

spain.name: Salchichón
spain.description: This dish is a summer sausage that is made by smoking, drying, cooking, or some combination. It is made with pork, although some recipes use other meats including ox, veal, or horse.

spain.name: Menudo
spain.description: This is a soup, made with cow's stomach (tripe) in broth with a red chili pepper base.

spain.name: Migas
spain.description: This dish is made from stale bread and other ingredients.

spain.name: Beefsteak
spain.description: This dish is flat cut of beef with parallel faces, usually cut perpendicular to the muscle fibers.

spain.name: Capirotada
spain.description: This dish consists of toasted savory bread and soaked in a mulled syrup made of whole cane sugar, clove, and cinnamon sticks.

spain.name: Churro
spain.description: This dish is a type of fried dough, made with choux pastry dough piped into hot oil with a piping bag and large closed star tip or similar shape.

spain.name: Rosca de reyes
spain.description: This dish is a cake consists of a sweet brioche dough aromatised with orange blossom water and decorated with slices of candied or crystallized fruit of various colors. It can be filled with whipped cream, cream, almond paste or others.

peru.name: Arroz chaufa
peru.description: The dish is a fried rice mix with Vegetable, typically including scallions, eggs, and chicken. It’s cooked quickly at high heat, often in a wok, with soy sauce and oil.
peru.photoCredit: Arnold Gatilao from Oakland, CA, USA

peru.name: Tallarín saltado
peru.description: To make this dish, some cooked noodles, Vegetable and portions of meat are sautéed to taste. The seasoning or dressing comes from Chinese spices and sesame oil.

peru.name: Baked potato
peru.description: The dish is a preparation of potato with baking method. It may be served with fillings, toppings or condiments such as butter, cheese, sour cream, gravy, baked beans, and tuna, among others.

peru.name: Milhojas
peru.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

peru.name: Sopaipilla
peru.description: A fried pastry and a type of quick bread, traditionally made from leavened wheat dough (or a mixture of wheat flour and masa harina) to which some shortening such as butter is added. After being allowed to rise, the dough is rolled into a sheet that is then cut into circular, square or triangular shapes, 8–10 cm in size for the longest dimension (if intended for a dessert) or 15–20 cm (if intended to be stuffed for a main course). These pieces are then deep-fried in oil, sometimes after being allowed to rise further before frying: the frying causes them to puff up, ideally forming a hollow pocket in the center.

peru.name: Marraqueta
peru.description: The dish is a bread roll made with wheat flour, salt, water and yeast and has a crusty exterior.

peru.name: Papa rellena
peru.description: This dish is a potato-based dough into which a filling made of chopped beef and onions, whole olives, hard-boiled eggs, cumin and other spices is stuffed.

peru.name: Ají de gallina
peru.description: This dish is composed of a sauce base made by sauteing red onion, garlic, and chili pepper together, and adding shredded poached poultry and stock.

peru.name: Seco
peru.description: The dish is a stew of beef, kid or another animal, macerated in vinegar, which is served accompanied by rice and a sauce of ají, huacatay and cilantro.

peru.name: Pollo a la brasa
peru.description: This dish is a variety of rotisserie chicken. It originally consists of a chicken (cooked on a spit over charcoal and seasoned only with salt) served with large french fries, though today additional spices are used to prepare it. It is almost always served with creamy (mayonnaise-based) sauces.

peru.name: Sopa de cacahuete
peru.description: The dish is a soup made from peanuts, often with various other ingredients

cuba.name: Arroz con maiz
cuba.description: The dish is made with rice and corn cooked in one pot.

cuba.name: Empanada
cuba.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

cuba.name: Papa rellena
cuba.description: This dish is a potato-based dough into which a filling made of chopped beef and onions, whole olives, hard-boiled eggs, cumin and other spices is stuffed.

cuba.name: Cuban pastry
cuba.description: This dish is a baked puff pastry filled with either sweet or savory fillings. Traditional options include cream cheese, guava with cheese, pineapple, and coconut.

cuba.name: Boliche
cuba.description: This dish is a pot roast dish consisting of eye round beef roast stuffed with ham.

cuba.name: Moros y Cristianos
cuba.description: Rice and beans dish where onions, garlic, and bell pepper are commonly used. Then, white rice and pre-boiled black beans are added, as well as the water that the beans were boiled in. Other seasonings such as oregano and bay leaf are often added to the dish to give additional flavor.

cuba.name: Frijoles negros
cuba.description: This dish is a black beans that is typically seasoned with salt, ham hocks, onions and garlic, tomatoes, powdered cumin seeds, oregano and vinegar.

cuba.name: Moronga
cuba.description: This dish is a kind of blood sausage. Spices, herbs (such as ruta, oregano, and mint), onions, and chili peppers are added and then boiled in the pig's large intestines for casing for several hours. It is served in a sauce.
cuba.photoCredit: Jeremy Keith from Brighton & Hove, United Kingdom

cuba.name: Picadillo
cuba.description: It is made with ground meat (most commonly beef), tomatoes (tomato sauce may be used as a substitute), and also raisins, olives, and other ingredients that vary by region.

dominican republic.name: Arroz con maiz
dominican republic.description: The dish is made with rice and corn cooked in one pot.

dominican republic.name: Papa rellena
dominican republic.description: This dish is a potato-based dough into which a filling made of chopped beef and onions, whole olives, hard-boiled eggs, cumin and other spices is stuffed.

dominican republic.name: Moro de guandules
dominican republic.description: This is a one pot dish made with long-grain rice, pigeon peas, celery, cubanelle pepper, red onion, garlic, lippia, cilantro, tomato paste, and occasionally olives and capers.

dominican republic.name: Longaniza
dominican republic.description: This sausage is similar to salchichón, though thinner; both differ from chorizo in that black pepper is used for them instead of paprika and may have different spices in them like nutmeg.
dominican republic.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Ardo Beltz assumed (based on copyright claims).

dominican republic.name: Cocada
dominican republic.description: This dish is a traditional coconut confectionery made with with eggs and shredded coconut.

venezuela.name: Arroz con maiz
venezuela.description: The dish is made with rice and corn cooked in one pot.

venezuela.name: Pabellón criollo
venezuela.description: It is a plate of rice, shredded beef in stew and stewed black beans.

venezuela.name: Cachapa
venezuela.description: The dish is made from maize flour. It can be made like pancakes of fresh corn dough, or wrapped in dry corn leaves and boiled. It is traditionally eaten with a handmade cheese, a soft, mozzarella-like cheese, and occasionally with fried pork on the side.

venezuela.name: Empanada
venezuela.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

venezuela.name: Milhojas
venezuela.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

venezuela.name: Arepa
venezuela.description: A type of flatbread made of ground maize dough stuffed with a filling. It is commonly eaten in those countries and can be served with accompaniments, such as cheese, various types of meat, avocado, or deviled ham spread.
venezuela.photoCredit: Steven Depolo from Grand Rapids, MI, USA

venezuela.name: Pan de jamón
venezuela.description: The dish is a bread, filled with ham, raisins and green olives. Many variations have been created, some filling the bread with other ingredients like turkey or cream cheese and others using puff pastry as the dough.

venezuela.name: Perico
venezuela.description: The dish is prepared with scrambled eggs, butter, sautéed diced onions, bell pepper, and tomatoes. Scallions are a frequent substitution or addition to the onions.

venezuela.name: Frijoles negros
venezuela.description: This dish is a black beans that is typically seasoned with salt, ham hocks, onions and garlic, tomatoes, powdered cumin seeds, oregano and vinegar.

venezuela.name: Cocada
venezuela.description: This dish is a traditional coconut confectionery made with with eggs and shredded coconut.

puerto rico.name: Arroz con maiz
puerto rico.description: The dish is made with rice and corn cooked in one pot.

puerto rico.name: Quesito
puerto rico.description: The dish is a cream cheese-filled pastry twist. Cream cheese is whipped with vanilla and sugar, guava paste or jam can be added.

puerto rico.name: Pasteles
puerto rico.description: The dish is a pastel filled with beans, fruit, chilies, corn, nuts, meat, fish, and wrapped in corn husk.

puerto rico.name: Sorullos
puerto rico.description: The dish is a fried cornmeal-based with stuffed cheese.

puerto rico.name: Papa rellena
puerto rico.description: This dish is a potato-based dough into which a filling made of chopped beef and onions, whole olives, hard-boiled eggs, cumin and other spices is stuffed.

puerto rico.name: Frijoles negros
puerto rico.description: This dish is a black beans that is typically seasoned with salt, ham hocks, onions and garlic, tomatoes, powdered cumin seeds, oregano and vinegar.

puerto rico.name: Longaniza
