puerto rico.description: This sausage is similar to salchichón, though thinner; both differ from chorizo in that black pepper is used for them instead of paprika and may have different spices in them like nutmeg.
puerto rico.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Ardo Beltz assumed (based on copyright claims).

puerto rico.name: Salchichón
puerto rico.description: This dish is a summer sausage that is made by smoking, drying, cooking, or some combination. It is made with pork, although some recipes use other meats including ox, veal, or horse.

puerto rico.name: Moronga
puerto rico.description: This dish is a kind of blood sausage. Spices, herbs (such as ruta, oregano, and mint), onions, and chili peppers are added and then boiled in the pig's large intestines for casing for several hours. It is served in a sauce.
puerto rico.photoCredit: Jeremy Keith from Brighton & Hove, United Kingdom

colombia.name: Arroz de lisa
colombia.description: The dish is made with mullet, typically including Vegetable, and spices. It is usually served in a leaf with minced chives, accompanied by bollo, avocado salad, and guarapo.

colombia.name: Empanada
colombia.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

colombia.name: Milhojas
colombia.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

colombia.name: Arepa
colombia.description: A type of flatbread made of ground maize dough stuffed with a filling. It is commonly eaten in those countries and can be served with accompaniments, such as cheese, various types of meat, avocado, or deviled ham spread.
colombia.photoCredit: Steven Depolo from Grand Rapids, MI, USA

colombia.name: Carimañola
colombia.description: The dish is a torpedo-shaped fritter stuffed with cheese, seasoned ground meat or shredded chicken and fried.

colombia.name: Papa rellena
colombia.description: This dish is a potato-based dough into which a filling made of chopped beef and onions, whole olives, hard-boiled eggs, cumin and other spices is stuffed.

colombia.name: Perico
colombia.description: The dish is prepared with scrambled eggs, butter, sautéed diced onions, bell pepper, and tomatoes. Scallions are a frequent substitution or addition to the onions.

colombia.name: Bandeja paisa
colombia.description: This dish is characterized by a generous variety of foods, including red beans cooked with pork, white rice, ground meat, chicharrón, a fried egg, ripe plantain, chorizo, arepa, hogao sauce, black pudding, avocado, and lemon. It is typically served on a platter or tray.

colombia.name: Butifarra Soledeñas
colombia.description: This dish is made from ground beef and pork with seasoning and spices. The meat is cut into pieces and boiled. The mixture is encased in intestine and tied off with string into sections.

colombia.name: Moronga
colombia.description: This dish is a kind of blood sausage. Spices, herbs (such as ruta, oregano, and mint), onions, and chili peppers are added and then boiled in the pig's large intestines for casing for several hours. It is served in a sauce.
colombia.photoCredit: Jeremy Keith from Brighton & Hove, United Kingdom

colombia.name: Cocada
colombia.description: This dish is a traditional coconut confectionery made with with eggs and shredded coconut.

saudi arabia.name: Bannu pulao
saudi arabia.description: The dish is made with beef, rice, spices, and stock. The beef is cooked with bones and marrow, which gives the dish a rich and flavorful taste. The rice is cooked separately with ghee, salt, and whole spices. The dish is served with a garnish of onions, green chilies, and lemon wedges.

saudi arabia.name: Pilaf
saudi arabia.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

saudi arabia.name: Fig roll
saudi arabia.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

saudi arabia.name: Ka'ak
saudi arabia.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

saudi arabia.name: Lahoh
saudi arabia.description: The dish is a spongy, flat pancake-like bread. It is a type of flat bread. It is traditionally and typically prepared from a thick batter of sorghum flour, White cornmeal/cornflour, warm water, yeast, and a pinch of salt. The mixture is beaten by hand until soft and creamy. The batter is then left to ferment overnight to cook and then eat for breakfast. There is a sweet-tasting variety of the dish, one made with eggs.  It is traditionally baked on a metallic circular stove. Lacking that, it can also be baked in an ordinary pan.

saudi arabia.name: Ful medames
saudi arabia.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

vietnam.name: Bánh chưng
vietnam.description: The dish is made from glutinous rice, mung beans, pork and other ingredients.

vietnam.name: Chao
vietnam.description: The dish is a form of savoury rice porridge made by boiling rice in a large amount of water until the rice softens. It is is sometimes cooked with pandan leaves or Asian mung bean. It is a simple breakfast food eaten with pickled Vegetable or fermented tofu.

vietnam.name: Pho
vietnam.description: The dish is a soup consisting of broth, rice noodles, herbs, and meat, typically beef or sometimes chicken.

vietnam.name: Xôi
vietnam.description: The dish is a savory glutinous rice covered with eggs and Vegetable.

vietnam.name: Bánh tét
vietnam.description: The dish is a savoury but sometimes sweetened cake made primarily from glutinous rice, which is rolled in a banana leaf into a thick, log-like cylindrical shape, with a mung bean and pork filling, then boiled. After cooking, the banana leaf is removed, and the cake is sliced into wheel-shaped servings.

vietnam.name: Bánh tổ
vietnam.description: The dish is made from glutinus irce flour with sticky sweet texture with brown color.

vietnam.name: Chè
vietnam.description: The dish is any sweet beverage, dessert soup or stew, or pudding. It includes a wide variety of distinct soups or puddings.

vietnam.name: Bánh canh
vietnam.description: The dish contains noodles that can be made from tapioca flour or a mixture of rice and tapioca flour.

vietnam.name: Bánh mì
vietnam.description: The dish is a short bread with thin, crisp crust and a soft texture with meats and vegetable filling, coriander, cucumber, pickled carrots, combined with other condiments.

vietnam.name: Bánh xèo
vietnam.description: The dish is a savoury fried pancake made of rice flour, water, and turmeric powder. Some common stuffings include pork, prawns, diced green onion, mung bean, and bean sprouts.

vietnam.name: chuối chiên
vietnam.description: The dish after deep frying, banana fritters are drizzled with rum or rice wine and ignited to further crisp them.

vietnam.name: Bánh bột lọc
vietnam.description: The dish is a small, clear-looking, chewy tapioca dumplings that can be eaten as appetizers or small snacks.They are usually filled with shrimp and pork belly, often being topped with fried shallots and served with sweet chili fish sauce.

vietnam.name: Bánh chuối
vietnam.description: The dish is a sweet banana cake or bread pudding. Although its exact ingredients may vary, it is usually made with ripe bananas or starchy banana, rice flour, coconut milk, sugar, white bread, shredded young coconut, condensed milk, butter, egg, and vanilla extract. In the finished dish, the cooked banana often appears purplish-red in color.

vietnam.name: Bánh khoai mì
vietnam.description: The dish is a cake made from grated cassava, sugar, coconut milk, and a small amount of salt.

vietnam.name: Bánh bao
vietnam.description: The dish is a ball-shaped bun containing pork or chicken meat, onions, eggs, mushrooms and vegetable.

vietnam.name: Ang ku kueh
vietnam.description: The dish is red tortoise shaped with skin made of rice flour and sweet potato, whereas the fillings are made of mung bean, peanuts and sugar.

vietnam.name: Goat curry
vietnam.description: The dish is a curry dish prepared with goat meat.

vietnam.name: Chả giò
vietnam.description: The dish is a fried egg roll with ground meat, usually pork.

vietnam.name: Bánh lá
vietnam.description: The dish is a leaf cake, consisting of parcel of a variety of rice stuffed with some fillings and wrapped in a leaf or leaves.

vietnam.name: Bò nướng lá lốt
vietnam.description: The dish is a grilled beef served on a leaf which has a spicy smell but medicinal taste.. It is commonly served in a barbecue technique.

vietnam.name: Spring roll
vietnam.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

vietnam.name: Gỏi cuốn
vietnam.description: This dish consists of pork, prawn, Vegetable, rice vermicelli, and other ingredients wrapped in rice paper.

vietnam.name: Popiah
vietnam.description: This dish is a fresh spring roll filled with an assortment of fresh, dried, and cooked ingredients, eaten during a festival and other celebratory occasions.

vietnam.name: Nem chua
vietnam.description: This dish is a fermented pork dish. It is mainly composed of a mixture of lean pork and thin strips of cooked rind, garnished with garlic and chilli.

vietnam.name: Nem nướng
vietnam.description: This dish is a grilled pork sausage or grilled meatballs, that is made of ground pork with between a third and a half pork fat. The meat is typically flavoured with chopped shallots, crushed garlic, fish sauce, sugar and black pepper.

vietnam.name: Chả lụa
vietnam.description: This dish is made of lean pork, potato starch, garlic, ground black pepper, and fish sauce.

vietnam.name: Aspic
vietnam.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

vietnam.name: Youtiao
vietnam.description: This dish is a long golden-brown deep-fried strip of wheat flour dough

vietnam.name: Grass jelly
vietnam.description: The jelly is made by boiling the aged and slightly oxidized stalks and leaves of Platostoma palustre (Mesona chinensis) with potassium carbonate and a little starch for several hours, then let it cool and served with sweet beverages.

vietnam.name: Bánh bò
vietnam.description: The dish is a chewy cake made of rice flour, water, sugar, and yeast with honeycomb-like appearance on the inside due to air bubbles. They also have colorful variants.

maharashtra.name: Bhakri
maharashtra.description: The dish is a round flatbread. It is coarser than a regular wheat flatbread. It can be either soft or hard in texture.

maharashtra.name: Bhel puri
maharashtra.description: The dish is made of puffed rice, crumbled crunchy puri, onions, cilantro and tossed with two chutneys: a green spicy cilantro chutney and a brown tangy tamarind chutney.
maharashtra.photoCredit: Barry Pousman from New York, NY

maharashtra.name: Patrode
maharashtra.description: The dish is made from colocasia leaves stuffed with gram or rice flour and flavourings such as spices, tamarind, and jaggery (raw sugar).

maharashtra.name: Puran poli
maharashtra.description: The dish is a flatbread made of a variant of chick pea, wheat flour, sugar, a type of clarified butter, jaggery.

maharashtra.name: Tomato omelette
maharashtra.description: This is a vegan breakfast dish, made primarily from chickpea flour or batter with added tomatoes, onions, and green chillies. The batter is cooked on a skillet until golden and is typically served hot with condiments.

maharashtra.name: Ragda pattice
maharashtra.description: The dish is made of mashed potato patties and pea sauce.

rajasthan.name: Bhakri
rajasthan.description: The dish is a round flatbread. It is coarser than a regular wheat flatbread. It can be either soft or hard in texture.

rajasthan.name: Kachori
rajasthan.description: The dish is a deep-fried, spicy, stuffed pastry made with baked mixture of mungbean and onions, besan, coriander, red chili powder, salt, and other spices.

rajasthan.name: Mirchi Bada
rajasthan.description: This dish is made by stuffing a green chili with spices, mashed potato, and flour, then it is wrapped in batter and fried until golden brown.

rajasthan.name: Kadhi
rajasthan.description: This dish is a yogurt-based dish made by simmering yogurt with besan (gram flour) and spices until it forms a thick, tangy gravy.

rajasthan.name: Dal bati
rajasthan.description: The sauce is made from pulses such as pigeon peas, split chickpeas, green gram, dew beans, or black gram. The lentils are soaked, boiled, and then cooked with a seasoning of mustard and cumin seeds, along with green chillies, garlic, and spices like red chilli, turmeric, coriander, and ginger. Some versions may include sweet and sour elements. The bread is a hard, round bread made from wheat flour, mixed with yogurt, salt, and water. The dough is shaped into balls and cooked in a traditional oven or stove until golden brown, then greased with clarified butter. It is typically served with daal, along with sides like semolina-based dessert, rice, mint chutney, raw mango chutney, garlic chutney, onion salad, and buttermilk.

mindanao.name: Bibingka
mindanao.description: The dish is a type of baked rice cake that is traditionally cooked in a terracotta oven lined with banana leaves and is usually eaten for breakfast or as mid-afternoon snack especially during the Christmas season.

mindanao.name: Binignit
mindanao.description: The dish is traditionally made with glutinous rice cooked in coconut milk with various slices of bananas, taro, ube, and sweet potato, among other ingredients.

mindanao.name: Kuning
mindanao.description: The is a rice dish cooked with turmeric, lemongrass, salt, bay leaves, and other spices to taste.

mindanao.name: Panyalam
mindanao.description: The dish is fried rice pancake made with ground glutinous rice, brown sugar, and coconut milk mixed into a batter that is deep-fried.

mindanao.name: Balbacua
mindanao.description: This dish is a beef stew made from beef, collagen-rich beef parts (oxtail, skin, and joints), and various spices cooked for several hours until very tender.

nepal.name: Bhel puri
nepal.description: The dish is made of puffed rice, crumbled crunchy puri, onions, cilantro and tossed with two chutneys: a green spicy cilantro chutney and a brown tangy tamarind chutney.
nepal.photoCredit: Barry Pousman from New York, NY

nepal.name: Sel roti
nepal.description: The dish is a ring-shaped sweet fried dough made from rice flour.

nepal.name: Thenthuk
nepal.description: The noodle dish is made of wheat flour dough, mixed Vegetable and some pieces of mutton or yak meat.

nepal.name: Momo
nepal.description: The dumplings are prepared with ground/minced meat, potatoes, and leek filling.

nepal.name: Paratha
nepal.description: The dish is a kine of unleavened flatbreads made by baking or cooking whole-wheat dough on a tava, and finishing off with shallow-frying.

nepal.name: Papadam
nepal.description: The dish is made from dough of black gram bean flour, which is either deep fried or cooked with dry heat by being flipped over an open flame until crunchy.

nepal.name: Gobi paratha
nepal.description: The dish is a flatbread stuffed with flavoured cauliflower and other vegetable.

nepal.name: Sinki
nepal.description: This dish is a preserved fermented vegetable made from radish tap roots. To prepare the dish, aged radish slivers are pressed into a hole lined with bamboo and straw, covered with vegetation, rocks, wood, and mud, and then allowed to cure for about a month. After curing, the preserved radish is sun-dried and can be stored for several years.

nepal.name: Kinema
nepal.description: The dish is made by boiling soybeans and then fermenting them. The fermentation process gives kinema a distinct aroma. It is typically used in various dishes, including curries, salads, and as a savoury dip or a pungent side dish to be consumed along with rice or bread.

nepal.name: Gundruk
nepal.description: The dish is obtained from the fermentation of leafy vegetables sometimes mixed with the roots as well. It is served as a side dish with the main meal and is also used as an appetizer.

nepal.name: Dhindo
nepal.description: This dish is made by gradually adding flour to boiling water while stirring, typically using buckwheat or millet flour. It is served with various accompaniments, such as lentils, curries, and condiments, and is eaten by forming small balls and dipping them into soups or liquids.

nepal.name: Kwati
nepal.description: The dish made with nine varieties of beans. The most commonly used ingredients are black gram, green gram, chickpea, field bean, soybean, field pea, garden pea, cowpea and rice bean.

nepal.name: Rajma
nepal.description: The dish consists of red kidney beans in a thick gravy with many Indian whole spices, and is usually served with rice.

nepal.name: Dahi
nepal.description: It is a traditional yogurt or fermented milk product. It is usually prepared from cows' milk, and sometimes buffalo milk or goat milk.

nepal.name: South Asian pickle
nepal.description: It is a pickled food made from a variety of vegetables, meats and fruits preserved in brine, vinegar, edible oils, and various spices.

nepal.name: Bagiya
nepal.description: It is a steamed dumpling that consists of an external covering of rice flour and an inner content of sweet substances such like vegetables and other fried items.

nepal.name: Aspic
nepal.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

nepal.name: Gajar ka halwa
nepal.description: The dish is a carrot-based sweet dessert pudding made by placing grated carrots in a pot containing a specific amount of water, milk, sugar, and cardamom and then cooking while stirring regularly. It is often served with a garnish of almonds and pistachios.

korea.name: Bokkeum-bap
korea.description: The dish is made by stir-frying cooked rice with other ingredients in oil. It is a popular end-of-meal add-on.after eating main dishes cooked on a tabletop stove,then cooked rice along with seaweed flakes and sesame oil will be added directly into the remains of the main dish, stir-fried and scorched.

korea.name: Gimbap
korea.description: The dish is made from cooked rice, Vegetable, fish, and meat rolled in gim—dried sheets of seaweed—and served in bite-sized slices.

korea.name: Juk
korea.description: The dish is made by boiling rice or other grains or legumes, such as beans, sesame, nuts, and pumpkin. It is often eaten warm, especially as a morning meal, but is now eaten at any time of the day.

korea.name: Kongbap
korea.description: The dish consists of white or brown rice cooked together with one or more varieties of soybeans. It may be made from scratch by combining and cooking together dried rice and soybeans—usually black soybeans.

korea.name: Nurungji
korea.description: The dish is made of scorched rice. After boiling and serving rice, a thin crust of scorched rice will usually be left in the bottom of the cooking pot.

korea.name: Siru-tteok
korea.description: The dish is a steamed rice cake made with red bean and rice.

korea.name: Injeolmi
korea.description: The dish is made by steaming glutinous rice flour, which is shaped into small pieces and covered with dried beans or black sesame.

korea.name: Songpyeon
korea.description: The dish is made of rice powder with shape resembles a half moon and contains sweet fillings such as soybeans, cowpeas, chestnuts, red beans, or honey.

korea.name: Hwajeon
korea.description: The dish is a pan-fried rice cake covered with edible petals.
korea.photoCredit: Korea.net / Korean Culture and Information Service (Jeon Han)

korea.name: Tteokguk
korea.description: The dish is a soup with thinly sliced rice cake usually garnished with cooked eggs, marinated meat, gim, and sesame oil.

korea.name: Tteok
korea.description: This dish is made with steamed flour of various grains, especially glutinous and non-glutinous rice. Steamed flour can also be pounded, shaped, or pan-fried to make this dish. In some cases, this dish is pounded from cooked grains.

korea.name: Buldak Ramen
korea.description: The dish is a type of 'stir-fried' dry noodle: after boiling, the noodles are drained, and mixed with a spicy sauce and a topping.

korea.name: Jajangmyeon
korea.description: The dish is a noodle dish topped with a thick sauce made of chunjang, diced pork, and Vegetable. Variants of the dish may include seafood or other meats. The sauce is darker and sweeter compared to similar dishes.

korea.name: Bibim guksu
korea.description: The dish is a cold spicy noodle dish made with very thin wheat flour noodles called somyeon with added flavorings.

korea.name: Ulmyeon
korea.description: The dish consists of noodles, Vegetable (including shiitake mushrooms, white button mushrooms, and carrots), egg, and seafood (including sea cucumber, shrimp, and squid or cuttlefish) in a chowder-like broth that is thickened with cornstarch.

korea.name: Janchi guksu
korea.description: The dish consists of wheat flour noodles in a light broth made from anchovy and sometimes also dasima (kelp). Beef broth may be substituted for the anchovy broth. It is served with a sauce made from sesame oil, ganjang and small amounts of chili pepper powder and scallions. Thinly sliced jidan (fried egg), gim (laver) and zucchini are added on top of the dish as garnishes, though various other Vegetable or kimchi can also be used.

korea.name: Kal-guksu
korea.description: The dish consists of handmade, knife-cut wheat flour noodles served in a large bowl with broth and other ingredients. It is traditionally considered a seasonal food, consumed most often in summer.

korea.name: Kong-guksu
korea.description: The dish consists of noodles made with wheat flour and soup made from ground soybeans.

korea.name: Jjamppong
korea.description: The dish is a noodle soup with red, spicy seafood- or pork-based broth flavored with gochugaru (chili powder). Common ingredients include onions, garlic, zucchini, carrots, cabbages, squid, mussels, and pork.

korea.name: Buchimgae
korea.description: The dish made by pan-frying a thick batter mixed with egg and other ingredients until a thin flat pancake-shaped fritter is formed.

korea.name: Jeon
korea.description: The dish is a fritter made by seasoning whole, sliced, or minced fish, meat, Vegetable, etc., and coating them with wheat flour and egg wash before frying them in oil.

korea.name: Hotteok
korea.description: The dough is made from wheat flour, water, milk, sugar, and yeast. Handful-sized balls of this stiff dough are filled with a sweet mixture, which may contain brown sugar, honey, chopped peanuts, and cinnamon. The filled dough is then placed on a greased griddle, and pressed flat into a large circle, this is done with a stainless steel circle and wooden handle as it cooks.
korea.photoCredit: Korea.net / Korean Culture and Information Service

korea.name: Tofu skin
korea.description: The dish is a food item made from soybeans. During the boiling of soy milk, in an open shallow pan, a film or skin composed primarily of a soy protein-lipid complex forms on the liquid surface.

korea.name: Doenjang jjigae
korea.description: This dish is made from the primary ingredient of soybean paste, and additional optional ingredients Vegetable, seafood, and meat.

korea.name: Dubu-kimchi
korea.description: This dish consists of tofu (dubu) and stir-fried kimchi. Soft, warm, blanched tofu is served with well-fermented, tangy baechu-kimchi (napa cabbage kimchi) stir-fried with pork.

korea.name: Sundubu-jjigae
korea.description: The dish is made with freshly curdled extra soft tofu (sundubu) which has not been strained and pressed, Vegetable, sometimes mushrooms, onion, optional seafood (commonly oysters, mussels, clams and shrimp), optional meat (commonly beef or pork), and gochujang or gochugaru.

korea.name: Jjim
korea.description: This is a cuisine term from a region that refers to dishes made by steaming or boiling meat, chicken, fish, or shellfish which have been marinated in a sauce or soup. The cooking method for most of this dishes nowadays has changed to boiling the ingredients in broth and reducing the liquid.

korea.name: Gyeran-jjim
korea.description: This dish is a custardy, casserole-like side dish, often seasoned with salted shrimp or salted pollock roe and topped with scallions and toasted sesame seeds. This dish ideally light and fluffy.

korea.name: Seon
korea.description: The dish is made from steamed Vegetable such as zucchini, cucumber, eggplant or Napa cabbage and stuffed with meat.

korea.name: Eo-mandu
korea.description: The dish is a half-moon-shaped dumpling prepared with filleted whitefish, most typically brown croakers, instead of flour dough as the wrapping.

korea.name: Jeungpyeon
korea.description: The dish is made by steaming rice flour dough prepared with makgeolli (rice wine).

korea.name: Mujigae-tteok
korea.description: The dish is a layered tteok (rice cake) of different colors resembling a rainbow.

korea.name: Bungeo-ppang
korea.description: The dish is a fish-shaped pastry stuffed with sweetened red bean paste. The snack is often sold at street stalls, grilled on an appliance similar to a waffle iron but with a fish-shaped mold. Red bean paste is the standard filling but many of these sold as street food are filled with pastry cream, sweet potato, pizza toppings, chocolate, kimchi and others.

korea.name: Taiyaki
korea.description: The dish is a fish-shaped cake, commonly sold as street food. It imitates the shape of red sea bream, which it is named after. The most common filling is red bean paste that is made from sweetened red beans. Other common fillings may be custard, chocolate, cheese, or sweet potato. Some shops even sell it with savory pancake, dumpling filling, or a sausage inside.

korea.name: Samgye-tang
korea.description: The dish is a chicken soup filled with garlic, rice, jujube, and ginseng.

korea.name: Red bean rice
korea.description: Rice dish consisting of rice cooked with red beans.

korea.name: Chicken feet
korea.description: This dish is a part of chicken which cooked and eaten in many countries. This dish has a distinct gelatinous texture different from the rest of the chicken meat.

korea.name: Tteokbokki
korea.description: The dish is a simmered rice cake made from small-sized long, white, cylinder-shaped rice cakes. Fish cakes, boiled eggs, and scallions are some common ingredients paired with this dish. It can be seasoned with either spicy chili paste or non-spicy soy sauce-based sauce; the former is the most common form.

korea.name: Gyeran-ppang
korea.description: The dish is a fluffy oblong-shaped loaf of bread is sweet and savory with a whole egg inside the pancake dough.
korea.photoCredit: travel oriented from Seoul, South Korea

korea.name: Bap
korea.description: This dish is a term for cooked rice made by boiling rice or other grains, such as black rice, barley, sorghum, millets, and beans, until the water is absorbed. Various ingredients like vegetables, seafood, and meat can be added to create different variants of this dish.

korea.name: Nokdu-muk
korea.description: This dish is a jelly made from bean starch, known for its clear white color and sometimes colored yellow with gardenia. Typically served cold as a side dish, it is often seasoned with soy sauce and vinegar and is commonly featured at special occasions like weddings; it can also be used in dishes that combines it with vegetables and beef.

korea.name: Sundae sausage
korea.description: The sausage dish is generally made by steaming cow or pig's intestines stuffed with various ingredients.

korea.name: Nori
korea.description: This is a dried edible seaweed. It has a strong and distinctive flavor, and is generally made into flat sheets and used to wrap rolls.

korea.name: Aspic
korea.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

france.name: Boudin
france.description: The dish is essentially pig’s guts filled with blood and other ingredients, such as onions, spinach, etc.

france.name: Croquette
france.description: The dish is a deep-fried roll, consisting of a thick binder combined with a filling, which is then breaded.

france.name: Crouton
france.description: The dish is a piece of toasted or fried bread, normally cubed and seasoned. The dish is used to add texture and flavor to salads—notably the Caesar salad— as an accompaniment to soups and stews, or eaten as a snack food.

france.name: Cat tongue
france.description: The dish is a small, long, and flat biscuit resembling a cat's tongue.
france.photoCredit: File:Kue_Lidah_Kucing_1.jpg : Gunawan Kartapranata File:Katzenzungen 7441.jpg : Ashley Pomeroy

france.name: Macaroon
france.description: The dish is small biscuit made from almond, egg whites, sugar, coconuts, and other nuts. Sometimes with jam or chocolate toppings.

france.name: Macaron
france.description: The dish is a sweet meringue-based confection made with egg white, icing sugar, granulated sugar, almond meal, and often food colouring.

france.name: Speculaas
france.description: The dish is a type of spiced shortcrust biscuit baked with spices. They are usually flat and are often moulded to carry certain traditional images.

france.name: Bichon au citron
france.description: The dish is a pastry that it is made of puff pastry. A major distinguishing feature is that it is filled with lemon curd. The outer layer of sugar is sometimes partially caramelized.

france.name: Chouquette
france.description: The dish are small pieces of pastry consisting of small spheres of choux pastry, sugared and baked. The dish was known in the 16th century, and was originally applied to small savoury spheres. Since the late 17th century it have been sweet.
france.photoCredit: The original uploader was Aerith at French Wikipedia .

france.name: Choux pastry
france.description: The dish is a delicate pastry dough used in many pastries. The essential ingredients are butter, water, flour and eggs. Instead of a raising agent, it employs its high moisture content to create steam, as the water in the dough evaporates when baked, puffing the pastry.

france.name: Conversation tart
france.description: The dish is a type of tart made with puff pastry that is filled with sweet almond custard cream and topped with royal icing.

france.name: Crêpes Suzette
france.description: The dish is a dessert consisting of crepes with a sauce of caramelized sugar and butter, tangerine or orange juice, zest, and orange liqueur on top.

france.name: Croissant
france.description: The dish is a pastry made from puff pastry in a crescent shape. It is a buttery, flaky pastry using the yeast-leavened laminated dough. They are named for their historical crescent shape. The dough is layered with butter, rolled and folded several times in succession, then rolled into a thin sheet, in a technique called laminating. The process results in a layered, flaky texture, similar to a puff pastry.

france.name: Cronut
france.description: The dish is a doughnut-like pastry made from croissant-like dough filled with flavored cream and fried in grapeseed oil.

france.name: Croquembouche
france.description: The dish is a dessert consisting of choux pastry puffs piled into a cone and bound with threads of caramel. It may also be decorated with other confectionery, such as sugared almonds, chocolate, and edible flowers.

france.name: Éclair
france.description: The dish is a pastry made with choux dough filled with a cream and topped with a flavored icing. It is typically piped into an oblong shape with a pastry bag and baked until it is crisp and hollow inside. Once cool, the pastry is filled with custard , whipped cream or chiboust cream, then iced with fondant icing. The icing is sometimes caramel.

france.name: Flaugnarde
france.description: The dish is a baked dessert with fruit arranged in a buttered dish and covered with a thick flan-like batter. It is made with apples, peaches, pears, plums, prunes or other fruits. Resembling a sweet batter pudding or large pancake, the dish is dusted with confectioner's sugar and can be served either warm or cold.

france.name: Kouign-amann
france.description: The dish is a sweet, round laminated dough pastry, originally made with bread dough, containing layers of butter and incorporated sugar, similar in fashion to puff pastry albeit with fewer layers. It is slowly baked until the sugar caramelizes and the butter (in fact the steam from the water in the butter) expands the dough, resulting in its layered structure.

france.name: Milhojas
france.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

france.name: Mille-feuille
france.description: The dish is a dessert made of puff pastry layered with pastry cream. Traditionally, it is made up of three layers of puff pastry, alternating with two layers of pastry cream. The top pastry layer is finished in various ways: sometimes it is topped with whipped cream, or it may be dusted with icing sugar, cocoa, pastry crumbs, or sliced almonds. It may also be glazed with icing or fondant alone, or in alternating white (icing) and brown (chocolate) or other colored icing stripes, and combed to create a marbled effect.

france.name: Pain au chocolat
france.description: The dish consisting of a cuboid-shaped piece of yeast-leavened laminated dough, similar in texture to a puff pastry, with one or two pieces of dark chocolate in the center. The chocolate usually has a slight bite to the texture.

france.name: Pain aux raisins
france.description: The dish is a spiral pastry often eaten for breakfast. It is typically made with a leavened butter pastry with raisins added and shaped in a spiral with custard filling.

france.name: Palmier
france.description: The dish is a pastry in a palm leaf shape or a butterfly shape. It is made from puff pastry, a laminated dough similar to the dough used for croissant, but without yeast. The puff pastry is rolled out, coated with sugar, and then the two sides are rolled up together so that they meet in the middle, making a roll that is then cut into about 1⁄4 in (6 mm) slices and baked. Usually it is rolled in sugar before baking.

france.name: Paris–Brest
france.description: This dish is a dessert made of choux pastry and a praline flavoured cream, covered with flaked almonds.

france.name: Profiterole
france.description: The dish is a filled choux pastry ball with a typically sweet and moist filling of whipped cream, custard, pastry cream, or ice cream. The puffs may be embellished or left plain or garnished with chocolate sauce, caramel, or a dusting of powdered sugar. Savory are also made, filled with pureed meats, cheese, and so on. These were formerly common garnishes for soups.

france.name: Vol-au-vent
france.description: The dish is a small hollow case of puff pastry. It is typically made by cutting two circles in rolled out puff pastry, cutting a hole in one of them, then stacking the ring-shaped piece on top of the disc-shaped piece.  The pastry is cooked, then filled with any of a variety of savory or sweet fillings. It it is usually served as an appetizer or a small snack, filled with chicken or fish.

france.name: Viennoiserie
france.description: The dish is baked goods made from a yeast-leavened dough in a manner similar to bread, or from puff pastry, but with added ingredients (particularly eggs, butter, milk, cream and sugar), which give them a richer, sweeter character that approaches that of pastry. The dough is often laminated.

france.name: Custard tart
france.description: A baked pastry consisting of an outer pastry crust filled with egg custard.

france.name: Lemon meringue pie
france.description: A dessert pie consisting of a shortened pastry base filled with lemon curd and topped with meringue.

france.name: Quiche
france.description: A tart consisting of a pastry crust filled with savoury custard and pieces of cheese, meat, seafood or vegetables. A well-known variant includes lardons or bacon. This dish may be served hot, warm or cold.

france.name: Shepherd's pie
france.description: A savoury dish of cooked minced meat topped with mashed potato and baked. The meat used may be either previously cooked or freshly minced. The usual meats are beef or lamb.

france.name: Baguette
france.description: A long, thin type of bread that is commonly made from basic lean dough. It is distinguishable by its length and crisp crust.

france.name: Brioche
france.description: A pastry whose high egg and butter content gives it a rich and tender crumb. It has a dark, golden, and flaky crust, frequently accentuated by an egg wash applied after proofing. It is made in the same basic way as bread but has the richer aspect of a pastry because of the addition of eggs, butter, liquid (milk, water, cream, and, sometimes, brandy) and occasionally sugar. It is often baked with additions of fruit or chocolate chips and served on its own or as the basis of a dessert, with many regional variations in added ingredients, fillings, or toppings.

france.name: Pain de campagne
france.description: The dish is a bread made with a combination of white flour with whole wheat flour and/or rye flour, water, leavening and salt.

france.name: Pain de mie
france.description: The dish is a white or brown bread with a thin, soft crust.

france.name: Pretzel
france.description: The dish is a type of baked pastry made from dough that is commonly shaped into a knot.

france.name: Escabeche
france.description: The dish is made of marinated fish, meat or Vegetable, cooked or pickled in an acidic sauce (usually with vinegar), and flavored with paprika, citrus, and other spices.

france.name: Veal Orloff
france.description: The dish consists of thinly sliced braised loin of veal, with duxelles and soubise layered between the slices, topped with Mornay sauce, and browned in the oven.

france.name: Angel wings
france.description: A traditional sweet crisp pastry made out of dough that has been shaped into thin twisted ribbons, deep-fried and sprinkled with powdered sugar.

france.name: Charlotte
france.description: Baked pudding made of bread, sponge cake, crumbs or biscuits/cookies that are mold and then filled with a fruit puree or custard. It can be served hot or cold

france.name: Galantine
france.description: The dish of boned, stuffed meat, most commonly poultry or fish, usually poached and served cold coated with meat jelly.

france.name: Rissole
france.description: This dish is a ball or flattened cake of chopped meat, fish, or Vegetable mixed with herbs or spices, then coated in breadcrumbs and fried.

france.name: Roulade
france.description: This dish is a filled rolled meat. It typically consists of a slice of steak rolled around a filling such as cheese, Vegetable, or other meats.

france.name: Lobster Thermidor
france.description: This dish is made with lobster meat cooked in a rich wine sauce, then stuffed back into a lobster shell and browned.

france.name: Ballotine
france.description: This dish is traditionally a de-boned thigh and/or leg part of the chicken, duck or other poultry stuffed with forcemeat and other ingredients. It is tied to hold its shape and sometimes stitched up with a trussing needle.

france.name: Tripoux
france.description: This dish is made with small bundles of sheep tripe, usually stuffed with sheep's feet, sweetbreads and various herbs and garden Vegetable. There are a number of variations on this dish, but they generally all involve savoury ingredients held together with sheep tripe and braised over low heat.

france.name: Stuffed tomatoes
france.description: This dish is a stuffed tomato filled with various ingredients, usually including rice.

france.name: Calf's liver and bacon
france.description: This dish is made with slices of bacon that are fried, and slices of veal liver (often covered in flour) are sauteed in the rendered fat. The bacon and slices of liver are placed in a dish and covered with a gravy made with the fond.

france.name: Pariser schnitzel
france.description: This dish is prepared from a thin slice of veal, salted, which is dredged in flour and then dipped in beaten egg. It is then fried in a pan in clarified butter or lard until the outside of the dish turns golden brown. This dish does not incorporate bread crumbs.

france.name: Paupiette
france.description: The dish is a piece of meat, beaten thin, and rolled with a stuffing of vegetables, fruits, or sweetmeats

france.name: Pot-au-feu
france.description: The dish is comprised of slowly boiled meat and Vegetable with broth.

france.name: Navarin
france.description: The dish is a ragoût (stew) of lamb or mutton.

france.name: Pottage
france.description: The dish is a thick soup or stew made by boiling Vegetable, grains, and, if available, meat or fish.

france.name: Croque monsieur
france.description: The dish is traditionally made with baked or boiled ham and sliced cheese between slices of bread, topped with grated cheese and lightly salted and peppered, and then baked in an oven or fried in a frying pan. The bread may optionally be browned by grilling after being dipped in beaten egg.

france.name: Jambon-beurre
france.description: The dish is a ham sandwich made of a fresh baguette sliced open, spread with butter (salted or unsalted) and filled with slices of ham.

france.name: French toast
france.description: The dish consists of sliced bread soaked in beaten eggs and often milk or cream, then pan-fried. When it is served as a sweet dish, sugar, vanilla, or cinnamon are also commonly added before pan-frying, and then it may be topped with sugar (often powdered sugar), butter, fruit, or syrup. When it is a savory dish, it is generally fried with a pinch of salt or pepper, and it can then be served with a sauce such as ketchup or mayonnaise.

france.name: Floating island
france.description: The dish is a dessert consisting of meringue floating on a vanilla custard. The meringue used is baked in a bain-marie. It may be served at room temperature or chilled.

france.name: Soufflé
france.description: The dish is a baked egg dish. Combined with various other ingredients, it can be served as a savoury main dish or sweetened as a dessert.

france.name: Oeuf mayonnaise
france.description: The dish is a starter food, features a large chicken egg, cooked until almost hard-boiled but with a slightly creamy yolk. After being chilled, peeled, and halved lengthwise, the egg halves are placed face down on a plate. They are then covered with a sauce made of mayonnaise and Dijon mustard, thinned with water or lemon juice for easy pouring.

france.name: Meringue
france.description: The dish is a light, airy dessert or candy made from whipped egg whites and sugar, sometimes with an acidic ingredient like lemon, vinegar, or cream of tartar. A binding agent such as salt, flour, or gelatin may be added. Egg whites are whipped until stiff peaks form by denaturing the protein ovalbumin through mechanical mixing.

france.name: Cholent
france.description: The dish is a slow-simmering stew, placing their individual pots of into the town baker's ovens that always stayed hot and slow-cooked the food overnight.

france.name: Chipolata
france.description: This sausage is typically made from coarse-ground pork seasoned with salt and pepper together with herbs and spices, such as sage, thyme, pimento, or nutmeg.

france.name: Cervelat
france.description: This dish is a sausage produced in Switzerland, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, and parts of Germany. The recipe and preparation of the sausage vary regionally.

france.name: Andouille
france.description: This is a smoked sausage made using pork. It is primarily pig chitterlings, tripe, onions, wine, and seasoning. It is generally grey and has a distinctive odor.

france.name: Beefsteak
france.description: This dish is flat cut of beef with parallel faces, usually cut perpendicular to the muscle fibers.

france.name: Crème caramel
france.description: This dish is a custard dessert with a layer of clear caramel sauce.

luxembourg.name: Boudin
luxembourg.description: The dish is essentially pig’s guts filled with blood and other ingredients, such as onions, spinach, etc.

luxembourg.name: Judd mat Gaardebounen
luxembourg.description: This is a dish featuring cured or smoked pork collar cooked with leeks, carrots, celery, and cloves, often enhanced with herbs and a glass of wine. The dish is served with beans in a sauce made from onion, butter, and meat stock, and typically includes sliced pork arranged on a plate, accompanied by boiled potatoes and either wine or beer.

luxembourg.name: Bouneschlupp
luxembourg.description: This dish a green bean soup with potatoes, bacon, and onions.

switzerland.name: Boudin
switzerland.description: The dish is essentially pig’s guts filled with blood and other ingredients, such as onions, spinach, etc.

switzerland.name: Riz Casimir
switzerland.description: The dish is made from rice, sliced veal, curry sauce, and fruits, usually bananas, pineapples and peaches or cherries. It is also garnished with roasted almond slivers. Long-grain rice is normally used for this dish. Veal is often replaced with pork or chicken.

switzerland.name: Springerle
switzerland.description: The dish is a type of biscuit or cookie with an embossed design made by pressing a mold onto rolled dough and allowing the impression to dry before baking. This preserves the detail of the surface pattern.

switzerland.name: Birnbrot
switzerland.description: The dish is a bread with a filling of dried pears. Besides dried pears the filling also contains raisins, walnuts and other dried fruit such as apples or figs. The filling is additionally flavored with candied fruit, coriander, cinnamon, star anise, anise, clove and some sort of alcohol.

switzerland.name: Wähe
switzerland.description: This dish consists of a casing (typically made of shortcrust pastry, but sometimes yeast dough or puff pastry) and a topping of a custard enveloping either fruit, Vegetable or cheese.

switzerland.name: Zopf
switzerland.description: A type of bread made from white flour, milk, eggs, butter and yeast. It is typically brushed with egg yolk, egg wash, or milk before baking, lending it its golden crust. It is baked in the form of a plait and traditionally eaten on Sunday mornings.

switzerland.name: Lye roll
switzerland.description: The dish is typically covered with salt, preferably pretzel salt.

switzerland.name: Pretzel
switzerland.description: The dish is a type of baked pastry made from dough that is commonly shaped into a knot.

switzerland.name: Salo
switzerland.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

switzerland.name: Cordon bleu
switzerland.description: The dish is a meat wrapped around cheese then breaded and pan-fried or deep-fried.

switzerland.name: Cervelat
switzerland.description: This dish is a sausage produced in Switzerland, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, and parts of Germany. The recipe and preparation of the sausage vary regionally.

johor.name: Burasa
johor.description: The dish is an Indonesian rice dumpling, cooked with coconut milk packed inside a banana leaf pouch.

johor.name: Mee Bandung Muar
johor.description: The dish is a cuisine that was originally cooked with yellow noodles coupled with egg in addition to a thick broth-gravy made of a combination of dried shrimps, onion, spices, shrimp paste and chilies. Then the dish was upgraded by adding prawn, meat, fish cakes and Vegetable.

shanghai.name: Cifantuan
shanghai.description: The dish is made by tightly wrapping a piece of youtiao (fried dough) with glutinous rice. It is usually eaten as breakfast together with sweetened or savory soy milk.

shanghai.name: Song gao
shanghai.description: The dish composed of rice flour, sugar, and water, with beans embedded throughout the cake. Giant pink-colored beans with a diameter of about 1 inch (25 mm) are embedded on top of the cake; conventional sized beans are embedded inside the cake. The dish also has a red bean paste filling. This dish is steamed, as a large round cake and is then partitioned into sections for eating.

shanghai.name: Shanghai fried noodles
shanghai.description: The dish are typically stir-fried with beef cutlets, bok choy, and onion, or with pork and Chinese yellow chives.
shanghai.photoCredit: Raysonho @ Open Grid Scheduler / Grid Engine

shanghai.name: Shengjian mantou
shanghai.description: This dish is a small, pan-fried bun with pork filling.

telangana.name: Curd rice
telangana.description: The dish combining steamed white rice and yogurt.

telangana.name: Dosa
telangana.description: The dish is a thin, savoury crepe made from a fermented batter of ground black gram and rice. They are served hot, often with chutney and sambar (a lentil-based vegetable stew).

telangana.name: Uttapam
telangana.description: The dish is a type of savory crepe or pancake, but instead of being crisp and crepe-like, it is thicker and topped with various ingredients.

telangana.name: Puran poli
telangana.description: The dish is a flatbread made of a variant of chick pea, wheat flour, sugar, a type of clarified butter, jaggery.

telangana.name: Poornalu
telangana.description: The dish is a sweet and dumpling made from rice flour stuffed with jagger paste and dry fruits.

telangana.name: Dalcha
telangana.description: Primary ingredients are lentils, can be chick pea or sometimes pigeon pea. Vegetables or meats, both chicken or mutton, may also be added to the stew.

andhra pradesh.name: Curd rice
andhra pradesh.description: The dish combining steamed white rice and yogurt.

andhra pradesh.name: Dosa
andhra pradesh.description: The dish is a thin, savoury crepe made from a fermented batter of ground black gram and rice. They are served hot, often with chutney and sambar (a lentil-based vegetable stew).

andhra pradesh.name: Uttapam
andhra pradesh.description: The dish is a type of savory crepe or pancake, but instead of being crisp and crepe-like, it is thicker and topped with various ingredients.

andhra pradesh.name: Puran poli
andhra pradesh.description: The dish is a flatbread made of a variant of chick pea, wheat flour, sugar, a type of clarified butter, jaggery.

andhra pradesh.name: Poornalu
andhra pradesh.description: The dish is a sweet and dumpling made from rice flour stuffed with jagger paste and dry fruits.

andhra pradesh.name: Murukku
andhra pradesh.description: This is a savoury, crunchy snack typically made from rice and black gram flour. The flours are mixed with water, salt, chili powder, asafoetida and either sesame seeds or cumin seeds. The mix is kneaded into a dough, which is shaped into spiral or coil shapes either by hand or extruded using a mould. The spirals are then deep-fried in vegetable oil.

turkey.name: Dolma
turkey.description: The dish is typically made with a filling of rice, minced meat, offal, seafood, fruit, or any combination of these inside a vegetable or a leaf wrapping.

turkey.name: Pilaf
turkey.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

turkey.name: Sarma
turkey.description: The dish is made of vegetable leaves rolled around a filling of minced meat, grains such as rice, or both.

turkey.name: Kesme
turkey.description: The dish is made from flour, egg, water, salt and milk. The dish may be boiled immediately in a broth often containing ingredients such as potatoes, meat, carrots, peppers, and tomatoes, or left to harden and stored.

turkey.name: Manti
turkey.description: The dumplings typically consist of a spiced meat mixture, usually lamb or ground beef, wrapped in a thin dough sheet which is then boiled or steamed.

turkey.name: Acıbadem kurabiyesi
turkey.description: The dish is a biscuit made of almonds, sugar and egg whites. The traditional recipes include a small amount of bitter almonds

turkey.name: Fig roll
turkey.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

turkey.name: Flour kurabiye
turkey.description: The dish is a kind of cookie that is made from butter, sunflower oil (or another mild flavored oil), baking powder, and the namesake ingredient flour. Generally, vanilla powder is also added.

turkey.name: Rosette
turkey.description: The dish is thin, cookie-like fritters made with iron molds. The batter is a blend of wheat flour, eggs, sugar and whole milk. They are formed with a rose iron. This specialized tool has a long handle and with a metal shape, commonly stars, flowers, snowflakes or Christmas trees. The metal is heated in hot oil before it is dipped in batter. Returning the iron to the oil, the batter is detached from the mold when it is partially cooked and gently flipped to finish cooking. They are usually topped with sugar or honey, or the edges of them are dipped into frosting.

turkey.name: Baklava
turkey.description: The dish is a layered pastry dessert made of filo pastry, filled with chopped nuts, and sweetened with syrup or honey.

turkey.name: Simit
turkey.description: The dish is a circular bread encrusted with sesame seeds or poppy, flax, or sunflower seeds.

turkey.name: Gözleme
turkey.description: The dish is a stuffed faltbread. The dough is usually unleavened, and made only with flour, salt and water, but it can be made from yeast dough as well. The dough is rolled thin, then filled with various toppings, sealed, and cooked over a griddle. Fillings are numerous and vary by region and personal preference, and include a variety of meats , Vegetable, mushrooms, tubers, cheeses, as well as eggs, seasonal herbs, and spices.

turkey.name: Lady's navel
turkey.description: The dish is a type of sweet pastry. They are made from balls of choux pastry which are given a dimple, deep-fried and then soaked in syrup.

turkey.name: Savory spinach pie
turkey.description: The dish is a pastry. The filling is made of chopped spinach (sometimes chard) and usually feta or white cheese, and egg.

turkey.name: Torpedo dessert
turkey.description: The dish is a buttery, flaky bread roll, filled with pastry cream, named for its well-known torpedo shape. It is made of a layered yeast-leavened dough. The dough is layered with butter, rolled and folded several times in succession, then rolled into a sheet, in a technique called laminating. The process results in a layered, flaky texture, similar to a puff pastry.

turkey.name: Börek
turkey.description: A thin flaky dough such as filo with a variety of fillings, such as meat, cheese, spinach, or potatoes. This dish may be prepared in a large pan and cut into portions after baking, or as individual pastries. They are usually baked but some varieties can be fried. It is sometimes sprinkled with sesame or nigella seeds, and it can be served hot or cold.

turkey.name: Bazlama
turkey.description: This dish is a leavened, circular flatbreadmade from wheat flour and has an average thickness of 2 cm and diameters ranging from 10 to 25 cm. After mixing and fermenting for two to three hours, a 200-250 gram piece of dough is made into balls, then rolled out flat and baked on a hot stove. During baking, the bread is turned over and fried on both sides. After baking, it is generally consumed fresh.

turkey.name: Chickpea bread
turkey.description: Bread made from yeast found on chickpeas; this yeast is mixed with flour and water and left out overnight in a warm place.

turkey.name: Lavash
turkey.description: This dish is a thin flatbread that is usually leavened. Traditionally the dough is rolled out flat and slapped against the hot walls of a clay oven, but modern recipes may adapt for cooking on a wok.

turkey.name: Baba ghanoush
turkey.description: The dish is an appetizer made of roasted eggplant, olive oil, lemon juice, and various seasonings.

turkey.name: Kibbeh
turkey.description: The dish is a spiced lean ground meat covered with pounded wheat, then toasted with nuts and spices.

turkey.name: Paçanga böreği
turkey.description: The dish is a fried pastry filled with cheese, tomato, parsley and pepper.

turkey.name: Walnut stuffed figs
turkey.description: The dish is a figs, warm water to soak the figs, walnuts, milk, water, sugar, butter.

turkey.name: Stuffed apples
turkey.description: The dish is an apple sutffed with lamb meat and rice.

turkey.name: Stuffed quinces
turkey.description: The dish is made from quinces stuffed with meat lamb and rice.

turkey.name: Chebureki
turkey.description: The dish is a fried turnovers with a filling of ground or minced meat and onions.

turkey.name: İmam bayıldı
turkey.description: The dish is an eggplant stuffed with onion, garlic, and tomatoes, simmered in olive oil.

turkey.name: Karnıyarık
turkey.description: The dish is a eggplant stuffed with a mix of sauteed chopped oninons, garlic, blackpepper, tomatoes.

turkey.name: Stuffed squash
turkey.description: This dish consists of various kinds of squash or zucchini stuffed with rice and sometimes meat and cooked on the stovetop or in the oven.

turkey.name: Mücver
turkey.description: This dish is made from grated zucchini. They are typically pan-fried in oil and their batter often includes a mixture of eggs, onion, dill, parsley, flour, and sometimes potatoes and cheese.

turkey.name: Şöbiyet
turkey.description: This dish is a dessert made with phyllo dough stuffed with clotted cream and nuts (walnut or pistachio).

turkey.name: Stuffed mussels
turkey.description: This dish is made with plump orange mussels that contain herbed and spiced rice.

turkey.name: Stuffed squid
turkey.description: This dish is made of made of olive oil, onion, garlic, rice, tomatoes, salt, black pepper, mint leaves, parsley, and tomato juice, with squid as the main ingredient.

turkey.name: Stuffed eggplant
turkey.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

turkey.name: Stuffed tomatoes
turkey.description: This dish is a stuffed tomato filled with various ingredients, usually including rice.

turkey.name: Türlü
turkey.description: This dish is made of stewed Vegetable and may also include stewed meat. The basic ingredients of this dish vary greatly. It usually includes potatoes, eggplants and okra. Meat versions are made with beef or lamb, or also with pork in some regions.

turkey.name: Bamia
turkey.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

turkey.name: Patlıcanlı kebap
turkey.description: This dish consists of pieces of eggplant layered alternately with fine-chopped (not minced) meat such as beef and lamb. It may be assembled on a skewer and cooked over a fire.

turkey.name: Kuru fasulye
turkey.description: This dish is premarily made with white beans and olive oil, and onion and tomato paste or tomato sauce are almost invariably used.

turkey.name: Khash
turkey.description: This dish consists of boiled cow or sheep parts, which might include the head, feet, and stomach (tripe).

turkey.name: Çılbır
turkey.description: The dish consists of poached eggs with yogurt (often with garlic mixed in).
turkey.photoCredit: Premshree Pillai from Brooklyn, NY, US

turkey.name: Piyaz
turkey.description: A bean salad that is made from any kind of boiled beans with raw onion, parsley and sumac. Optionally, a boiled egg can be added to this dish.

turkey.name: Mercimek köftesi
turkey.description: Lentil balls are prepared from split red lentils along with tomato paste, fine bulgur, parsley, onion, and other spices.

algeria.name: Dolma
algeria.description: The dish is typically made with a filling of rice, minced meat, offal, seafood, fruit, or any combination of these inside a vegetable or a leaf wrapping.

algeria.name: Ka'ak
algeria.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

algeria.name: Msemmen
algeria.description: The dish is a flatbread folded into square pancakes with multiple internal layers and cooked on a griddle, usually served with honey or a cup of aromatic morning mint tea or coffee.

algeria.name: Tajine
algeria.description: This dish consists of meat, fruit, Vegetable, and spices that are cooked together very slowly.

algeria.name: Chermoula
algeria.description: It is traditionally used to flavor fish or seafood, but it can be used on other meats or Vegetable. Common ingredients include garlic, cumin, coriander, oil, lemon juice, and salt. Regional variations may also include preserved lemons, onion, ground chili peppers, black pepper, saffron, and other herbs.

algeria.name: Ful medames
algeria.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

algeria.name: Shakshouka
algeria.description: The dish is a poached egg in a sauce of tomatoes, olive oils, peppers, onion, and garlic, commonly with other spices also.

algeria.name: Mulukhiyah
algeria.description: The dish is a soup made of jute leaves resulting in thick liquid or broth, chopped with garlic, cilantro, and dressed with oil.

algeria.name: Mesfouf
algeria.description: The dish is made of peas and beans with sweet taste accompanied by butter and olive oil.

algeria.name: Merguez
algeria.description: The dish is a lamb or beef based fresh sausage.

algeria.name: Matbucha
algeria.description: The dish is a condiment or cooked salad consisting of cooked tomatoes with roasted bell peppers seasoned with garlic and chili pepper.

algeria.name: Harira
algeria.description: The dish is a soup made with lemon juic and egg to brighten the color and spice up the flavor.

algeria.name: Brik
algeria.description: The dish is a stuffed pastry, deep fried with triangular pastry shape. It is made by slapping a sticky lump of dough onto a hot non-stick surface in overlapping circles to produce the desired size and cooked for a short amount of time. Typical fillings include tuna, ground meat, raw egg, chicken, or anchovies garnished with harissa, capers, or cheese.

algeria.name: Freekeh
algeria.description: The dish is a roasted and rubbed macarroni wheat.

algeria.name: Falafel
algeria.description: The dish is a deep-fried ball or patty-shaped fritter made from broad beans, ground chickpease, or both.

algeria.name: Stuffed dates
algeria.description: The dish is a heated dates filled with meat, mint, and parsley with different stuffing including butters and goat cheese.

egypt.name: Dolma
egypt.description: The dish is typically made with a filling of rice, minced meat, offal, seafood, fruit, or any combination of these inside a vegetable or a leaf wrapping.

egypt.name: Koshary
egypt.description: The dish is made by mixing pasta,  fried rice, vermicelli and brown lentils, and topped with chickpeas, a garlicky tomato sauce, garlic vinegar, and crispy fried onions. Sprinklings of garlic vinegar and hot sauce are optional.

egypt.name: Pilaf
egypt.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

egypt.name: Kahk
egypt.description: The dish is a small circular biscuit. It is covered with powdered sugar and can be stuffed with ʿagameyya (a mixture of honey, nuts, and ghee), lokum, walnuts, pistachios, or dates, or simply served plain.

egypt.name: Pastafrola
egypt.description: A type of sweet tart, covered, jam-filled shortcrust pastry dish principally made from flour, sugar and egg. Common fillings include quince cheese, sweet potato jam, dulce de leche, guava, or strawberry jam.

egypt.name: Sfiha
egypt.description: A dish consisting of flatbread cooked with a minced meat topping, often lamb flavored with parsley, onion, tomato, pine nuts, and spices.

egypt.name: Eish merahrah
egypt.description: A flatbread, made with ground fenugreek seeds and maize. A soft dough is made with the maize flour and left to ferment overnight with a sourdough starter, shaped into round loaves, and then allowed to rise or "proof" for 30 minutes before being flattened into round disks and baked.

egypt.name: Ka'ak
egypt.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

egypt.name: Tajine
egypt.description: This dish consists of meat, fruit, Vegetable, and spices that are cooked together very slowly.

egypt.name: Duqqa
egypt.description: This dish consists of a mixture of herbs, nuts (usually hazelnut), and spices. It is typically used as a dip with bread or fresh Vegetable for a starter.

egypt.name: Fesikh
egypt.description: The dish is a salted pickled fermented and dried gray mullet or whitefish.

egypt.name: Ful medames
egypt.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

egypt.name: Kamounia
egypt.description: The dish is a beef and liver stew prepared with cumin.

egypt.name: Qatayef
egypt.description: The dish is a sweet dumpling filled with cream or nuts, or a folded pancake.

egypt.name: Mulukhiyah
egypt.description: The dish is a soup made of jute leaves resulting in thick liquid or broth, chopped with garlic, cilantro, and dressed with oil.

egypt.name: Matbucha
egypt.description: The dish is a condiment or cooked salad consisting of cooked tomatoes with roasted bell peppers seasoned with garlic and chili pepper.

egypt.name: Hawawshi
egypt.description: The dish is a pita stuffed with minced meat and spiced with onions, pepper, parsley, and sometimes chilies.

egypt.name: Baba ghanoush
egypt.description: The dish is an appetizer made of roasted eggplant, olive oil, lemon juice, and various seasonings.

egypt.name: Kibbeh
egypt.description: The dish is a spiced lean ground meat covered with pounded wheat, then toasted with nuts and spices.

egypt.name: Hummus
egypt.description: The dish is a dip. spread, or savory sides made from cooked, mashed chickpeas blended with sesame, lemon juice, and garlic.

egypt.name: Freekeh
egypt.description: The dish is a roasted and rubbed macarroni wheat.

egypt.name: Falafel
egypt.description: The dish is a deep-fried ball or patty-shaped fritter made from broad beans, ground chickpease, or both.

egypt.name: Eggah
egypt.description: The dish is an egg dish spiced with pepper, cinnamon, cumin, coriander seeds, turmeric, nutmeg, and fresh herbs.

egypt.name: Stuffed dates
egypt.description: The dish is a heated dates filled with meat, mint, and parsley with different stuffing including butters and goat cheese.

egypt.name: Stuffed squash
egypt.description: This dish consists of various kinds of squash or zucchini stuffed with rice and sometimes meat and cooked on the stovetop or in the oven.

egypt.name: Sheikh al-mahshi
egypt.description: This dish consists of zucchini stuffed with minced lamb meat and nuts, bathed in a yogurt sauce (the original) or tomato sauce (derivative).

egypt.name: Bamia
egypt.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

egypt.name: Bissara
egypt.description: The dish contains beans, onions, garlic, fresh aromatic herbs and spices. All ingredients are slowly cooked and then blended together to yield a creamy and fragrant dip or side dish.

libya.name: Dolma
libya.description: The dish is typically made with a filling of rice, minced meat, offal, seafood, fruit, or any combination of these inside a vegetable or a leaf wrapping.

libya.name: Couscous
libya.description: This dish is small steamed granules of rolled semolina that is often served with a stew spooned on top. Pearl millet, sorghum, bulgur, and other cereals are sometimes cooked in a similar way in other regions.

libya.name: Bazin
libya.description: An unleavened bread prepared with barley, water and salt. It is prepared by boiling barley flour in water and then beating it to create a dough using a unique stick designed for this purpose. The dough may then be placed in a pan and allowed time to harden, after which it is baked or steamed. The salt contributes to the hardness of this dish. It may have a paste-like and hardened texture. It may also be prepared using whole wheat flour, olive oil and pepper as ingredients. This bread is typically served with a tomato sauce, eggs, potatoes and mutton. This preparation method involves shaping the dough into the shape of a pyramid or dome, after which it may be served with a tomato-based soup or meat-and-potato stew poured atop or around it and garnished with hard-boiled eggs.

libya.name: Ka'ak
libya.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

libya.name: Usban
libya.description: This dish is a traditional kind of sausage stuffed with a mixture of rice, herbs, lamb, chopped liver and heart. This dish is usually served alongside the main meal of rice or couscous, often on special occasions.

libya.name: Tajine
libya.description: This dish consists of meat, fruit, Vegetable, and spices that are cooked together very slowly.
