libya.name: Stuffed dates
libya.description: The dish is a heated dates filled with meat, mint, and parsley with different stuffing including butters and goat cheese.

arabian peninsula.name: Kabsa
arabian peninsula.description: The dish usually made with rice (usually basmati), meat, Vegetable, and a mixture of spices.

arabian peninsula.name: Markook
arabian peninsula.description: The dish is a type of thin bread. The dough is unleavened and usually made with only flour, water, and salt, and after being rested and divided into round portions, flattened and spread across a round cushion until it is thin then flipped onto the saj.

laos.name: Khao lam
laos.description: The dish consists of sticky rice roasted inside specially prepared bamboo sections of different diameters and lengths.

laos.name: Khao tom
laos.description: The dish is made of sticky rice, ripe banana, coconut milk, all wrapped and steamed-cooked in banana leaves.

laos.name: Khao poon
laos.description: The dish is a rice vermicelli soup that is often made with pounded chicken, fish, or pork in coconut milk broth (or without coconut milk) and seasoned with common ingredients such as fish sauce, padaek, lime leaves, galangal, garlic, shallots, chillies, and fish mint.

laos.name: Lard na
laos.description: The dish is made with stir-fried wide rice noodles and either chicken, beef, pork, or tofu. The most common version includes Vegetable such as Chinese kailan and straw mushrooms. However, broccoli is also commonly used if kailan is unavailable. Common seasonings include sweet soy sauce, fish sauce ("nam pa"), sugar, garlic, and black pepper.

laos.name: Khao piak sen
laos.description: The noodles in this dish are thick and chewy, the fresh noodles add a lot of starch to the overall dish. The broth for the dish is usually made from pork, chicken or both. The broth is simmered with galangal, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves. In addition, some also simmer the broth with garlic cooked in oil.

laos.name: Spring roll
laos.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

laos.name: Malay sponge cake
laos.description: This dish is made of lard or butter, flour, and eggs, using a bamboo steamer to develop puffiness.

laos.name: Ant egg soup
laos.description: The dish is a soup made from the eggs of the weaver ant species. Recipes for the dish may include ingredients such as chicken stock, lemongrass, fish sauce, chilies, tamarind, shallot and spring onion.

laos.name: Naem
laos.description: This dish is a pork sausage. It is a fermented food with a sour flavour. It has a short shelf life and is often eaten in raw form after fermentation. It is used as an ingredient in various dishes and is also served as a side dish.

laos.name: Sai ua
laos.description: This is minced pork meat, herbs, spices, and red curry paste.

georgia.name: Kharcho
georgia.description: The dish is a soup consists of beef, rice, cherry plum purée, and chopped walnuts (Juglans regia), but they are not compulsory. The soup is seasoned with Khmeli Suneli and coriander. The characteristic ingredients of the soup are meat (usually fatty cuts of beef), cherry plum purée made from tklapi or tkemali, rice, chopped walnuts, and a spice mix that varies between different regions.

georgia.name: Pilaf
georgia.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

georgia.name: Tonis puri
georgia.description: A chewy yet pillowy-soft made from flour, water, yeast, and salt. The bread is usually filled with feta and fresh herbs like cilantro, basil, or tarragon.

georgia.name: Shotis puri
georgia.description: The dish is a bread made of white flour and shaped like a canoe.

georgia.name: Naan
georgia.description: The dish is a leavened, oven-baked or tawa-fried flatbread, that can also be baked in a tandoor. It is characterized by a light and fluffy texture and golden-brown spots from the baking process.

georgia.name: Kholodets
georgia.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients.These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

georgia.name: Borscht
georgia.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

georgia.name: Solyanka
georgia.description: A thick sour soup with cabbage, salted cucumbers, meat, poultry, fish, or mushrooms

georgia.name: Kulich
georgia.description: This bread is round and tall, and dough decorations were made on top of it.

georgia.name: Badrijani
georgia.description: The dish is a fried eggplant stuffed with spiced walnut and garlic paste, topped with pomegrenate seeds.

georgia.name: Lobio
georgia.description: The dish is composed of various kinds of prepared beans (cooked or stewed), containing coriander, walnuts, garlic and onion.

georgia.name: Piti
georgia.description: It is made with mutton and vegetables (tomatoes, potatoes, chickpeas), infused with saffron water to add flavour and colour, all covered by a lump of fat, and cooked in a sealed crock

georgia.name: Khash
georgia.description: This dish consists of boiled cow or sheep parts, which might include the head, feet, and stomach (tripe).

georgia.name: Aspic
georgia.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

hawaii.name: Loco moco
hawaii.description: The dish consists of white rice, topped with a hamburger patty and brown gravy, and finally a sunny-side up fried egg. These ingredients must exist in the dish. No other egg variations are considered traditional and the stacking of the dish must be in the aforementioned order to be considered traditional.

hawaii.name: Saimin
hawaii.description: The dish is made of soft wheat egg noodles served in a hot dashi garnished with diced green onions and a thin slice of kamaboko. It may also include additional toppings such as char siu, sliced Spam, sliced egg, bok choy, mushrooms, or shredded nori.

hadhramaut.name: Mandi
hadhramaut.description: The dish consists mainly of meat and rice with a blend of spices, and is cooked in a pit.

jordan.name: Mansaf
jordan.description: The dish is made of lamb cooked in a sauce of fermented dried yogurt and served with rice or bulgur.

jordan.name: Pilaf
jordan.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

jordan.name: Fig roll
jordan.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

jordan.name: Sfiha
jordan.description: A dish consisting of flatbread cooked with a minced meat topping, often lamb flavored with parsley, onion, tomato, pine nuts, and spices.

jordan.name: Ka'ak
jordan.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

jordan.name: Ful medames
jordan.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

jordan.name: Mulukhiyah
jordan.description: The dish is a soup made of jute leaves resulting in thick liquid or broth, chopped with garlic, cilantro, and dressed with oil.

jordan.name: Baba ghanoush
jordan.description: The dish is an appetizer made of roasted eggplant, olive oil, lemon juice, and various seasonings.

jordan.name: Kibbeh
jordan.description: The dish is a spiced lean ground meat covered with pounded wheat, then toasted with nuts and spices.

jordan.name: Freekeh
jordan.description: The dish is a roasted and rubbed macarroni wheat.

jordan.name: Falafel
jordan.description: The dish is a deep-fried ball or patty-shaped fritter made from broad beans, ground chickpease, or both.

jordan.name: Stuffed dates
jordan.description: The dish is a heated dates filled with meat, mint, and parsley with different stuffing including butters and goat cheese.

jordan.name: Sheikh al-mahshi
jordan.description: This dish consists of zucchini stuffed with minced lamb meat and nuts, bathed in a yogurt sauce (the original) or tomato sauce (derivative).

mesopotamia.name: Maqluba
mesopotamia.description: The dish consists of meat, rice, and fried Vegetable placed in a pot which is flipped upside down when served.

mesopotamia.name: Lokma
mesopotamia.description: The dish is a dessert made of leavened and deep fried dough balls, soaked in syrup or honey, sometimes coated with cinnamon or other ingredients.

united states.name: Mochi ice cream
united states.description: The dish is made from pounded sticky rice with an ice cream filling.

united states.name: Kraft Dinner
united states.description: The dish is a nonperishable, packaged macaroni and cheese product.

united states.name: Hash browns
united states.description: The dish consists of finely julienned potatoes that have been fried until golden brown.

united states.name: Treacle sponge pudding
united states.description: The dish is a steamed sponge cake with treacle cooked on top of it.

united states.name: Oatmeal raisin cookie
united states.description: The dish is made from an oatmeal dough with raisins. Its ingredients also typically include flour, sugar, eggs, salt, and spices.

united states.name: Peanut butter cookie
united states.description: The dish is a type of cookie that is distinguished for having peanut butter as a principal ingredient.

united states.name: Russian tea cake
united states.description: The dish is a kind of pastry, often eaten around Christmas. It is have a relatively simple recipe, generally consisting entirely of flour, water, butter, and ground nuts, the nut variety depending upon the cookie type. After baking, they are rolled in powdered sugar while still hot, then coated again once the cookie has cooled.

united states.name: Bear claw
united states.description: The dish is a sweet, yeast-raised pastry. It include the basic ingredients such as eggs, yeast, flour, milk, sugar, and butter. It is also made with "sweet dough" which is "bread dough with more shortening than usual". It is usually filled with almond paste, and sometimes raisins, and often shaped in a semicircle with slices along the curved edge, or rectangular with partial slices along one side.

united states.name: Bierock
united states.description: The dish is a yeast dough pastry pocket sandwich with savory filling. The soft yeast rolls contain some sugar, butter and eggs, and either warm water, milk, or a mix of both. The filling is a basic mix of onion, ground beef and cabbage which can be made more complicated by the addition of different cheese blends, condiments and seasonings like caraway seeds.

united states.name: Bizcocho
united states.description: The dish is the name given range of pastries, cakes or cookies.

united states.name: Knish
united states.description: The dish is a traditional snack food consisting of a filling covered with dough that is typically baked or sometimes deep fried. In most traditional versions, the filling is made entirely of mashed potato, buckwheat groats, or cheese. Other varieties of fillings include beef, chicken, sweet potatoes, black beans, or spinach.

united states.name: New York roll
united states.description: This dish is a pastry made from circular croissant dough, and filled with pastry cream and topped with a chocolate ganache. It can be enhanced with many different flavors such as chocolate, pistachio, and caramel.

united states.name: Nun's puffs
united states.description: This dish is a dessert pastry. The dessert is made from butter, milk, flour, sugar, eggs, and sometimes honey. Recipes call for pan frying (traditionally in lard), re-frying and then baking, or baking straight away. The best-established recipes suggest cooking the butter, milk, and flour in a pan then adding the eggs (whites last) and sprinkling sugar on the mixture before baking.
united states.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Žiga assumed (based on copyright claims).

united states.name: Apple crisp
united states.description: The dish is a dessert made with a streusel topping. Ingredients usually include cooked apples, butter, sugar, flour, and cinnamon.

united states.name: Banana cream pie
united states.description: The dish is a variation of a cream pie which includes sliced bananas. Typically ingredients include a pastry crust which has been blind-baked or a graham cracker crust, which is then filled with bananas and custard or pastry cream (a cooked mixture of milk, sugar, vanilla, eggs, butter) and topped with cream.

united states.name: Bean pie
united states.description: The dish is a sweet custard pie whose filling consists of mashed beans, usually navy bean, sugar, eggs, milk, butter and spices. Common spices and flavorings include vanilla, cinnamon and nutmeg. Variations can include cloves, ginger, pumpkin pie spice and lemon extract.

united states.name: Blackberry pie
united states.description: A pie composed of blackberry filling, usually in the form of either blackberry jam, actual blackberries themselves, or some combination thereof.

united states.name: Black bottom pie
united states.description: A type of pie that features a layer of chocolate pastry cream or pudding, the "black bottom", topped with whipped cream or meringue. The single crust is pre-baked and of variable composition, but a graham cracker crust is common.

united states.name: Blueberry pie
united states.description: A pie with a blueberry filling and is readily made because it does not require pitting or peeling of fruit. It usually has a top and bottom crust. The top crust can be circular, but the pie can also have a crumble crust or no top crust.

united states.name: Cashew pie
united states.description: A pie prepared with cashews as a primary ingredient. Whole or chopped cashews may be used, or both. It may be prepared with a sweet filling base prepared with corn syrup, sugar and eggs.

united states.name: Cherry pie
united states.description: A pie baked with a cherry filling. Traditionally, it is made with sour cherries rather than sweet cherries. Morello cherries are one of the most common kinds of cherry used, but other varieties such as the black cherry may also be used.

united states.name: Chiffon pie
united states.description: A type of pie that consists of a special type of airy filling in a crust. The filling is typically produced by folding meringue into a mixture resembling fruit curd (most commonly lemon) that has been thickened with unflavored gelatin to provide a light, airy texture. This filling is then put into a pre-baked pie shell of variable composition and chilled.
united states.photoCredit: Arnold Gatilao from Oakland, CA, USA

united states.name: Cobbler
united states.description: A dessert consisting of a fruit filling poured into a large baking dish and covered with a batter, biscuit, or dumpling before being baked.

united states.name: Cream pie
united states.description: A type of pie filled with a rich custard or pudding that is made from milk, cream, sugar, wheat flour, and eggs and typically topped with whipped cream.

united states.name: Cookie cake
united states.description: A dessert that consists of a large cookie, which is baked similarly to a batch of regular-sized cookies and usually decorated with frosting. THey are made with cookie dough.
united states.photoCredit: U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. Fifth Fleet

united states.name: Pumpkin pie
united states.description: A dessert pie with a spiced, pumpkin-based custard filling. The pie's filling ranges in color from orange to brown and is baked in a single pie shell, usually without a top crust. The pie is generally flavored with pumpkin spice, a blend that includes cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and cloves or allspice. The pie is usually prepared with canned pumpkin, but fresh-cooked pumpkin can be used.

united states.name: Sugar cream pie
united states.description: A custard pie made with a simple filling of cream, sugar and cornstarch or flour.

united states.name: Whole wheat bread
united states.description: A type of bread made using flour that is partly or entirely milled from whole or almost-whole wheat grains. It is one kind of brown bread. Some varieties of whole-wheat bread are traditionally coated with whole or cracked grains of wheat, though this is mostly decorative compared to the nutritional value of the loaf itself.

united states.name: Teacake
united states.description: In one region, it is a light yeast-based sweet bun containing dried fruit, typically served toasted and buttered. In other areas can be cookies or small cakes. In another country, they can be soft, round, flat wheat breads made with milk and a little sugar, and used to make buttered ham or cheese sandwiches. In other regions, it is more like a butter cake.

united states.name: Sopaipilla
united states.description: A fried pastry and a type of quick bread, traditionally made from leavened wheat dough (or a mixture of wheat flour and masa harina) to which some shortening such as butter is added. After being allowed to rise, the dough is rolled into a sheet that is then cut into circular, square or triangular shapes, 8–10 cm in size for the longest dimension (if intended for a dessert) or 15–20 cm (if intended to be stuffed for a main course). These pieces are then deep-fried in oil, sometimes after being allowed to rise further before frying: the frying causes them to puff up, ideally forming a hollow pocket in the center.

united states.name: Cuban bread
united states.description: A fairly simple white bread, but has a slightly different baking method and ingredient list (in particular, it generally includes a small amount of fat in the form of lard or vegetable shortening); it is usually made in long loaves.

united states.name: Graham bread
united states.description: The bread include Graham flour, milk, molasses, yeast, and salt.

united states.name: Hot and spicy cheese bread
united states.description: The dish is a popular cheese bread. The bread is sold at farmer's markets across the city and at local bakeries. Today, the bread is made with a brioche-like yeasted dough, mixed with cheese, and topped with crushed hot red peppers. It also contains chives and parsley. The bread is often eaten as a snack bread, pulled apart and eaten while walking around the farmers market.

united states.name: Potato bread
united states.description: The dish is a form of bread in which potato flour or potato replaces a portion of the regular wheat flour.

united states.name: Pretzel
united states.description: The dish is a type of baked pastry made from dough that is commonly shaped into a knot.

united states.name: Pumpkin bread
united states.description: The dish is a type of moist quick bread made with pumpkin.

united states.name: Angel wings
united states.description: A traditional sweet crisp pastry made out of dough that has been shaped into thin twisted ribbons, deep-fried and sprinkled with powdered sugar.

united states.name: Stuffed crust pizza
united states.description: The dish is a pizza with other ingredients added into the outer edge of the crust.

united states.name: Pizza snack rolls
united states.description: The dish is a rolled pizza consisting of bite-sized breaded pizza pockets with a fillings of tomato sauce, imitation cheese, and various pizza toppings.

united states.name: Manicotti
united states.description: The dish is a large pata tubes, cooked stuffed and baked with cheese mixed with chopped parsley, ground meat such as veal.

united states.name: Egg roll
united states.description: The dish is a cylindrical, savory roll with shredded cabbage, chopped meat, or other fillings inside a thick wrapping wheat flour skin, fried in hot oil.

united states.name: Jalapeño popper
united states.description: The dish are jalapeno peppers that have been hollowed out, stuffed with a mixture of cheese, spices, ground meat, and breaded and deep-fried.

united states.name: Hot Pockets
united states.description: This dish is a brand of microwaveable turnovers generally containing one or more types of cheese, meat, or Vegetable.

united states.name: Sausage bread
united states.description: This dish is typically made from pizza dough and includes sausage, mozzarella cheese (or a similar substitute cheese) and other ingredients such as mushrooms, onions, other vegetable, and various herbs, spices and sauces depending on the recipe.
united states.photoCredit: Mo Riza from New York, USA

united states.name: Turducken
united states.description: This dish consists of a deboned chicken stuffed into a deboned duck, further stuffed into a deboned turkey.

united states.name: California roll
united states.description: This dish is an inside-out rice roll containing imitation crab (or rarely real crab), avocado, and cucumber.

united states.name: Tootsie Roll
united states.description: A candy made of sugar, corn syrup, partially hydrogenated soybean oil, condensed skim milk, cocoa, whey, soy lecithin, and artificial and natural flavors

united states.name: Salted Nut Roll
united states.description: A candy bar surrounded in a layer of caramel and then covered with salted Virginia peanuts

united states.name: Nut roll
united states.description: A sweet yeast dough is rolled flat, and filled with spread usually walnuts spread or poppy seed. The filled dough is rolled up, forming a log or loaf shape, then baked.

united states.name: Fruit Roll-Ups
united states.description: This dish is a brand of snack. It is a flat, corn syrup-based, fruit-flavored snack rolled into a tube, spread on a backing sheet of cellophane to prevent the product from sticking to itself.

united states.name: Calf's liver and bacon
united states.description: This dish is made with slices of bacon that are fried, and slices of veal liver (often covered in flour) are sauteed in the rendered fat. The bacon and slices of liver are placed in a dish and covered with a gravy made with the fond.

united states.name: Oyster stew
united states.description: This dish is a stew made with oysters made with milk and cream.

united states.name: Apple dumpling
united states.description: The dish is a baked or boiled pastry-wrapped apple. To prepare it, apples are peeled, cored and sometimes quartered and placed on a portion of dough. The hole from the core may be filled with cinnamon, butter and sugar and sometimes dried fruit such as raisins, sultanas, or currants. The dough is folded over the apples and sealed. Sometimes a spiced sauce is poured over the dumplings which are then baked until tender; the sugar and butter create a sweet sauce. It can be served hot, cold, or room temperature for breakfast, dessert, or as a main dish.
united states.photoCredit: tracy ducasse from Massachusetts, United States

united states.name: Hamburger
united states.description: The dish is a dish consisting of fillings—usually a patty of ground meat, typically beef—placed inside a sliced bun or bread roll. The patties are often served with cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, bacon or chilis with condiments such as ketchup, mustard, mayonnaise, relish or a "special sauce", and are frequently placed on sesame seed buns.

united states.name: Pigs in a blanket
united states.description: The dish is a small hot dogs or other sausages individually wrapped in pastry, commonly served as an appetizer.

united states.name: Hot dog bun
united states.description: The dish is a type of soft bun shaped specifically to contain a hot dog or another type of sausage.

united states.name: Ham and eggs
united states.description: The dish is a dish combining various preparations of ham and egg.

united states.name: Senate bean soup
united states.description: The dish is a soup made with navy beans, ham hocks, and onion.

united states.name: Custard pie
united states.description: The dish is any type of uncooked custard mixture placed in an uncooked or partially cooked crust and baked together.The dish commonly refers to a plain mixture of milk, eggs, sugar, salt, vanilla extract and sometimes nutmeg combined with a pie crust.

united states.name: Divinity
united states.description: The dish is a nougat-like confection made with whipped egg white, corn syrup, and sugar. Optional ingredients such as flavors, chopped dried fruit and chopped nuts are frequently added.

united states.name: Frozen custard
united states.description: The dish is a frozen dessert that is a type of ice cream that is made with egg yolks in addition to cream and sweetener, either sugar or an alternative, and an additional flavoring such as cocoa, vanilla, or fruit such as strawberries or peaches.

united states.name: Matzah brei
united states.description: The basic ingredients are matzah, eggs, and a "softening" liquid for the matzah, such as hot water or milk. Typically the dry matzah is broken into pieces, briefly softened in water or milk, mixed with beaten eggs, and fried in a skillet. The frying is done with oil or butter. The matzah and egg mixture may be scrambled, set to cook like a pancake, or fried like a tortilla.

united states.name: Steak and eggs
united states.description: The dish is a dish of beefsteak and fried eggs. It is most typically served as a breakfast or brunch food.

united states.name: Strata
united states.description: The dish is a family of layered casserole dishes. The most common modern variant is a brunch dish, made from a mixture which mainly consists of bread, eggs and cheese. It may also include meat or vegetable. The usual preparation requires the bread to be layered with the filling in order to produce layers.

united states.name: Pickled egg
united states.description: This dish consists of hard-boiled eggs cured in vinegar or brine, originally created for preservation. They are a popular snack or appetizer, especially in pubs and bars. After boiling, the eggs are shelled and submerged in a solution of vinegar, salt, spices, and seasonings, with variations that can add sweet or spicy flavors.

united states.name: Baked beans
united states.description: This dish consists of the vegetable parboiled and then baked in sauce at a low temperature for a long period of time. It may be cooked through a steaming process as well.

united states.name: Bean chip
united states.description: This dish consists of chips made primarily from various beans, offering higher fiber and protein than corn or potato chips. They can be deep-fried or baked, often seasoned, and are made by blending soaked beans into a dough, steaming it, and then frying the slices, typically served with dips.

united states.name: Vegetarian chili
united states.description: The dish is made by omitting meat in the stew or replacing it with alternatives like textured vegetable protein, tofu, or starchy vegetables, and typically includes beans, with possible additions of corn, squash, mushrooms, or beets.

united states.name: Succotash
united states.description: This is a vegetable dish mainly made of sweet corn and lima beans or other shell beans. It can include additional ingredients like onions, tomatoes, and okra, offering a nutritious combination of grains and legumes.
united states.photoCredit: Ralph Daily from Birmingham, United States

united states.name: Green bean casserole
united states.description: This is a baked dish consisting primarily of green beans, cream of mushroom soup, and french fried onions. The recipe calls for green beans, mushroom soup, milk, soy sauce, ground black pepper, and french fried onions. The beans, soup, milk, and seasonings are mixed together with a portion of the onions and baked, then topped with more onions and baked for another few minutes.
united states.photoCredit: Rick Kimpel from Spring, TX, USA

united states.name: Doubles
united states.description: It consists of curried chickpeas served on two fried flatbreads. It is normally eaten during breakfast, but is also eaten occasionally during lunch or as a late night snack and popular hangover food.

united states.name: Breakfast sausage
united states.description: It is a type of fresh sausage typically made from pork. It can be in the form of smoked or fresh patties, links or loose sausage.

united states.name: Italian sausage
united states.description: This pork sausage is often noted for being seasoned with fennel or anise as the primary seasoning.

united states.name: Beefsteak
united states.description: This dish is flat cut of beef with parallel faces, usually cut perpendicular to the muscle fibers.

united states.name: Churro
united states.description: This dish is a type of fried dough, made with choux pastry dough piped into hot oil with a piping bag and large closed star tip or similar shape.

united states.name: Cochinito de piloncillo
united states.description: This dish is a sweet bread made with a type of sweetener made from sugar cane.

united states.name: Rosca de reyes
united states.description: This dish is a cake consists of a sweet brioche dough aromatised with orange blossom water and decorated with slices of candied or crystallized fruit of various colors. It can be filled with whipped cream, cream, almond paste or others.

united states.name: Fudge
united states.description: This dish is a type of confection that is made by mixing sugar, butter and milk. It has a variety of flavors, with fruit, nut, chocolate, and caramel being the most popular.

united states.name: Lemon ice box pie
united states.description: An icebox pie consisting of lemon juice, eggs, and condensed milk in a pie crust,[1][2] frequently made of graham crackers and butter.

aceh.name: Nasi gurih
aceh.description: The dish is made by cooking mixture of rice and sticky rice soaked in coconut milk instead of water, along with salt, lemongrass, Indian bay leaf, and pandan leaves to add aroma.

bali.name: Nasi jinggo
bali.description: The dish consists of rice packaged in small portions of banana leaves.

bali.name: Serabi
bali.description: The dish is similar to a pancake, made of a rice flour-based batter with coconut milk or coconut cream and shredded coconut as an emulsifier. Mostly it tastes sweet, as these pancake-like desserts are usually eaten with a golden-brown coconut sugar syrup.

bali.name: Urap
bali.description: The dish is a salad dish of steamed Vegetable mixed with seasoned and spiced grated coconut for dressing.

bali.name: Plecing Kangkung
bali.description: The dish is made from blanched water spinach leaves and served cold with sambal made from ground red chili pepper, shallot, garlic, bird's eye chili, candlenut, kaffir lime, shrimp paste, salt, and sugar.

bali.name: Milk pie
bali.description: Custard tart pastry consisting of a shortcrust pastry filled with egg custard and condensed milk.

yogyakarta.name: Nasi kucing
yogyakarta.description: The dish consists of a small portion of rice with toppings, usually sambal, dried fish, and tempeh, wrapped in banana leaves.

yogyakarta.name: Urap
yogyakarta.description: The dish is a salad dish of steamed Vegetable mixed with seasoned and spiced grated coconut for dressing.

yogyakarta.name: Bakpia pathok
yogyakarta.description: The dish usually stuffed with mung beans, but have recently come in other fillings as well, e.g. chocolate, durian and cheese.

ogun state.name: Ofada rice
ogun state.description: The dish is a type of rice. It is used in making a variety of dishes.

jerusalem.name: Orez Shu'it
jerusalem.description: The dish consisting of white beans cooked in a tomato paste, served on white rice.

assam.name: Panta bhat
assam.description: The dish is a rice-based dish prepared by soaking rice, generally leftover, in water overnight. Traditionally served in the morning with salt, onion, chili and mashed potatoes or "Alu Makha" (simple boiled potatoes mashed and salted without adding any cream or cheese).

afghanistan.name: Pilaf
afghanistan.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

afghanistan.name: Bolani
afghanistan.description: A stuffed flat-bread, fried with a filling. It has a thin crust and can be stuffed with a variety of ingredients, such as potatoes or leeks but also grated pumpkin, chives, red lentils or with minced meat.

afghanistan.name: Sheermal
afghanistan.description: The dish is a saffron-flavored traditional flatbread.

afghanistan.name: Bichak
afghanistan.description: This dish is a stuffed baked or fried pastry that comes in different forms (round, triangle, quadrangle) appetizer.

afghanistan.name: Bamia
afghanistan.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

afghanistan.name: Khash
afghanistan.description: This dish consists of boiled cow or sheep parts, which might include the head, feet, and stomach (tripe).

uzbekistan.name: Pilaf
uzbekistan.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

uzbekistan.name: Smetana
uzbekistan.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

uzbekistan.name: Bichak
uzbekistan.description: This dish is a stuffed baked or fried pastry that comes in different forms (round, triangle, quadrangle) appetizer.

uzbekistan.name: Joshpara
uzbekistan.description: made of unleavened wheat dough squares filled with ground meat and condiments.

uzbekistan.name: Qazı
uzbekistan.description: This is a traditional sausage-like food made from horse meat. It is a common element on a festive meal table. A reviewer described the dish as smoky and earthy. It is often eaten cold, sometimes sliced, and served as an appetiser.

uzbekistan.name: Qarta
uzbekistan.description: The dishes are boiled and pan-fried horse rectum, taken from the final few inches of the digestive tract before the muscular part of the anus. It is served without sauce or spices. It is prepared in various ways to clean it thoroughly and remove any unpleasant taste due to the provenance of the tissue.

armenia.name: Pilaf
armenia.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

armenia.name: Manti
armenia.description: The dumplings typically consist of a spiced meat mixture, usually lamb or ground beef, wrapped in a thin dough sheet which is then boiled or steamed.

armenia.name: Simit
armenia.description: The dish is a circular bread encrusted with sesame seeds or poppy, flax, or sunflower seeds.

armenia.name: Nazook
armenia.description: This dish is a rolled pastry made from flour, butter, sugar, sour cream, yeast, vanilla extract and eggs, with a filling often made with nuts, and especially walnuts. There is also a variation where lemon juice and cranberries are used.

armenia.name: Börek
armenia.description: A thin flaky dough such as filo with a variety of fillings, such as meat, cheese, spinach, or potatoes. This dish may be prepared in a large pan and cut into portions after baking, or as individual pastries. They are usually baked but some varieties can be fried. It is sometimes sprinkled with sesame or nigella seeds, and it can be served hot or cold.

armenia.name: Tsoureki
armenia.description: A sweet holiday bread made with flour, milk, butter, eggs, and sugar and commonly seasoned with orange zest, mastic resin, or mahlab.

armenia.name: Lavash
armenia.description: This dish is a thin flatbread that is usually leavened. Traditionally the dough is rolled out flat and slapped against the hot walls of a clay oven, but modern recipes may adapt for cooking on a wok.

armenia.name: Borscht
armenia.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

armenia.name: Sorrel soup
armenia.description: A soup made from water or broth, sorrel leaves, and salt. Usually includes further ingredients such as egg yolks or whole eggs (hard-boiled or scrambled), potatoes, carrots, parsley root, and rice.

armenia.name: Kulich
armenia.description: This bread is round and tall, and dough decorations were made on top of it.

armenia.name: Baba ghanoush
armenia.description: The dish is an appetizer made of roasted eggplant, olive oil, lemon juice, and various seasonings.

armenia.name: Ghapama
armenia.description: The dish is a stuffed pumpkin stew prepared by removing the guts of the pumpkin and stuffed with boiled rice and dried fruits.

armenia.name: İmam bayıldı
armenia.description: The dish is an eggplant stuffed with onion, garlic, and tomatoes, simmered in olive oil.

armenia.name: Stuffed mussels
armenia.description: This dish is made with plump orange mussels that contain herbed and spiced rice.

armenia.name: Stuffed eggplant
armenia.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

armenia.name: Stuffed tomatoes
armenia.description: This dish is a stuffed tomato filled with various ingredients, usually including rice.

armenia.name: Bamia
armenia.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

armenia.name: Piti
armenia.description: It is made with mutton and vegetables (tomatoes, potatoes, chickpeas), infused with saffron water to add flavour and colour, all covered by a lump of fat, and cooked in a sealed crock

armenia.name: Khash
armenia.description: This dish consists of boiled cow or sheep parts, which might include the head, feet, and stomach (tripe).

azerbaijan.name: Pilaf
azerbaijan.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

azerbaijan.name: Shorgoghal
azerbaijan.description: The dish is a traditional pastry in a round shape filled with anise or fennel seed, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric, salt and pepper.

azerbaijan.name: Lavash
azerbaijan.description: This dish is a thin flatbread that is usually leavened. Traditionally the dough is rolled out flat and slapped against the hot walls of a clay oven, but modern recipes may adapt for cooking on a wok.

azerbaijan.name: Borscht
azerbaijan.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

azerbaijan.name: Stuffed apples
azerbaijan.description: The dish is an apple sutffed with lamb meat and rice.

azerbaijan.name: Stuffed quinces
azerbaijan.description: The dish is made from quinces stuffed with meat lamb and rice.

azerbaijan.name: Stuffed eggplant
azerbaijan.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

azerbaijan.name: Stuffed tomatoes
azerbaijan.description: This dish is a stuffed tomato filled with various ingredients, usually including rice.

azerbaijan.name: Bamia
azerbaijan.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

azerbaijan.name: Dovga
azerbaijan.description: soup made from plain yoghurt and herbs. The soup ingredients can vary seasonally and regionally, the soup usually includes coriander, dill, mint, and spinach.

azerbaijan.name: Joshpara
azerbaijan.description: made of unleavened wheat dough squares filled with ground meat and condiments.

azerbaijan.name: Piti
azerbaijan.description: It is made with mutton and vegetables (tomatoes, potatoes, chickpeas), infused with saffron water to add flavour and colour, all covered by a lump of fat, and cooked in a sealed crock

russia.name: Pilaf
russia.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

russia.name: Oladyi
russia.description: The dish is a small thick pancakes or fritters. The batter is made from wheat or (nowadays more rarely) buckwheat flour, eggs, milk, salt, and sugar with yeast or baking soda. The batter may also contain kefir, soured milk or yoghurt. The dish may also include various additions, such as apple or raisins.

russia.name: Russian tea cake
russia.description: The dish is a kind of pastry, often eaten around Christmas. It is have a relatively simple recipe, generally consisting entirely of flour, water, butter, and ground nuts, the nut variety depending upon the cookie type. After baking, they are rolled in powdered sugar while still hot, then coated again once the cookie has cooled.

russia.name: Alexandertorte
russia.description: The dish is a cake that consists of pastry strips filled with raspberry preserves or raspberry jam. It is traditionally eaten as a dessert after lunch or dinner, but it can also be served at tea time. It should be made a day or so before it is planned to serve, because the icing must be hard before the cake is cut.

russia.name: Bierock
russia.description: The dish is a yeast dough pastry pocket sandwich with savory filling. The soft yeast rolls contain some sugar, butter and eggs, and either warm water, milk, or a mix of both. The filling is a basic mix of onion, ground beef and cabbage which can be made more complicated by the addition of different cheese blends, condiments and seasonings like caraway seeds.

russia.name: Poppy seed roll
russia.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

russia.name: Coulibiac
russia.description: A pie usually filled with salmon or sturgeon, rice or buckwheat, hard-boiled eggs, mushrooms, onions, and dill. The pie is baked in a pastry shell, usually of brioche or puff pastry.

russia.name: Kurnik
russia.description: A dome-shaped savoury usually filled with chicken or turkey, eggs, onions, kasha or rice, and other optional components. Sometimes filled with boiled rooster combs.

russia.name: Borodinsky bread
russia.description: Bread made with a mixture of no less than 80% by weight of a whole-grain rye flour with about 15% of a second-grade wheat flour and about 5% of rye, or rarely, barley malt, often leavened by a separately prepared starter culture made like a choux pastry, by diluting the flour by a near-boiling (95-96 °C) water, and adding the yeast after cooling the mix to 65-67 °C, but then mostly inoculated by the previous batches of dough instead of the dry yeast. It is then sweetened and colored with beet sugar molasses, and flavored with salt and spices, of which the coriander seed is required, and caraway is optional, but still quite popular. Modern recipes are often 100% whole rye.

russia.name: Caviar
russia.description: The dish is eaten as a garnish or spread.

russia.name: Kholodets
russia.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients.These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

russia.name: Salo
russia.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

russia.name: Okroshka
russia.description: The dish is a mix of mostly raw vegetables (like cucumbers, radishes and spring onions), boiled potatoes, eggs, cooked meat such as beef, veal, sausages or ham and kvass.

russia.name: Rassolnik
russia.description: The dish is a kind of soup made from pickled cucumbers, pearl barley, and pork or beef kidneys.

russia.name: Shchi
russia.description: The dish is a kind of cabbage soup.

russia.name: Borscht
russia.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

russia.name: Solyanka
russia.description: A thick sour soup with cabbage, salted cucumbers, meat, poultry, fish, or mushrooms

russia.name: Sorrel soup
russia.description: A soup made from water or broth, sorrel leaves, and salt. Usually includes further ingredients such as egg yolks or whole eggs (hard-boiled or scrambled), potatoes, carrots, parsley root, and rice.

russia.name: Ukha
russia.description: A clear soup, made from various types of fish such as bream, wels catfish, northern pike, or even ruffe

russia.name: Dressed herring
russia.description: A layered salad composed of diced spekesild covered with layers of grated boiled eggs, Vegetable (potatoes, carrots, beetroots), chopped onions, and mayonnaise

russia.name: Mimosa salad
russia.description: Salad with main ingredients are cheese, eggs, canned fish, onion, and mayonnaise

russia.name: Olivier salad
russia.description: Salad dish consisted of diced boiled potatoes, carrots and brined dill pickles (or cucumber), together with vegetable or fruit, meat, mixed with with salt, pepper and mustard, and dressed with mayonnaise

russia.name: Vinegret
russia.description: Salad dish consisted of diced cooked Vegetable (red beets, potatoes, carrots), chopped onions, as well as sauerkraut and/or brined pickles.

russia.name: Syrniki
russia.description: Pancake made of creamy fermented milk, mixed with flour, eggs and sugar, sometimes adding vanilla extract, mix well and then pan-fried or shallow-fried.
russia.photoCredit: Tatyana Morozyuk, color processing by Off-shell

russia.name: Chicken Kiev
russia.description: A dish made of chicken fillet pounded and rolled around cold butter, then coated with egg and bread crumbs, and either fried or baked.

russia.name: Beef Stroganoff
russia.description: A dish of sautéed pieces of beef in a sauce of mustard and smetana (sour cream).

russia.name: Makarony po-flotski
russia.description: The dish made of cooked pasta (typically macaroni, penne or fusilli) mixed with stuffing made of stewed ground meat (usually beef or pork) and fried onions, and seasoned with salt and black pepper

russia.name: Pozharsky cutlet
russia.description: A breaded ground chicken or veal patty

russia.name: Shashlik
russia.description: A dish of skewered and grilled cubes of meat (lamb or sometimes made of pork, beef, chicken or venison) which was marinated overnight in a high-acidity marinade like vinegar, dry wine or sour fruit/vegetable juice with the addition of onions, herbs and spices.

russia.name: Korovai
russia.description: A large round braided bread, traditionally baked from wheat flour and decorated with symbolic flags and figurines, such as suns, moons, birds, animals, and pine cones

russia.name: Zefir
russia.description: The dish is made by whipping fruit and berry purée (mostly apple puree) with sugar and egg whites with subsequent addition of a gelling agent like pectin, carrageenan, agar, or gelatine

russia.name: Varenye
russia.description: Whole fruit preservation made by cooking berries, other fruits, or more rarely nuts, Vegetable, or flowers, in sugar syrup (sometimes honey)

russia.name: Pyshka
russia.description: This dish is similar to doughnut, either ring-shaped or without a hole.

russia.name: Chrain
russia.description: This dish has white and red type. The white consists of grated horseradish and vinegar, and sometimes sugar and salt, while red type includes the addition of beetroot

russia.name: Khrenovina sauce
russia.description: This sauce is prepared by blending fresh tomatoes, horseradish, garlic and salt

russia.name: Smetana
russia.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

russia.name: Sushki
russia.description: It is a small, crunchy, mildly sweet bread rings eaten for dessert, usually with tea or coffee. Typical ingredients are flour, eggs, water, and salt, which are combined into a firm dough. This is then cut and rolled into thin strips of about half a centimetre thickness which are formed into rings, briefly cooked in boiling sugar water, then baked in an oven.

russia.name: Kulich
russia.description: This bread is round and tall, and dough decorations were made on top of it.

russia.name: Kutia
russia.description: This dish is a ceremonial grain dish with sweet gravy traditionally served during the Christmas – Feast of Jordan holiday season or as part of a funeral feast. The main ingredients are wheatberries, poppy seeds, honey or sugar, various nuts and sometimes raisins.

russia.name: Guryev porridge
russia.description: This dish is a sweet porridge prepared from semolina and milk with the addition of candied nuts (hazelnut, walnuts, almonds), honey and dried fruits (or fruit preserves).

russia.name: Kasha
russia.description: This dish can be baked but most often is boiled, either in water or milk. The main ingredients are cereal (buckwheat, wheat, barley, oats, millet or rye).

russia.name: Paskha
russia.description: It is a molded dessert that is made of cheese (such as cottage cheese), cream, and usually raisins, candied fruit, and almonds and that is traditionally served at Easter.

russia.name: Curd snack
russia.description: The main part this snack is made from cheese, which is mixed with sugar, sweeteners or other ingredients and milled into a homogenous paste that is pressed into the desired shape and filled with jam or other fillings. The formed bars then pass through the so-called "glaze waterfall" that coats them in chocolate or another type of glaze. Finally, the snacks are cooled in a cooling tunnel and packed.

russia.name: Pastila
russia.description: It is a small squares of pressed fruit paste or a light, airy puffs with a delicate apple flavor.

russia.name: Pryanik
russia.description: These sweets refer to a range of traditional sweet-baked goods and are made from flour and honey.

russia.name: Chebureki
russia.description: The dish is a fried turnovers with a filling of ground or minced meat and onions.

russia.name: Helzel
russia.description: The dish is a sausage made from poultry neck skin stuffed with flour, bread crumbs, and fried onions, sewn up with a thread.
russia.photoCredit: Wizard85 (original file) ; Off-shell (cropped and reprocessed version)

russia.name: Holishkes
russia.description: This dish is prepared from blanched cabbage leaves wrapped in a parcel-like manner around minced meat and then simmered in tomato sauce. Sometimes rice is added to the meat filling.

russia.name: Red caviar
russia.description: It is made from the roe of salmonid fishes (various species of salmon and trout), which has an intense reddish hue

russia.name: Pirozhki
russia.description: The dish is a baked or fried yeast-leavened boat-shaped buns with a variety of fillings. They come in sweet or savory varieties. Common savory fillings include ground meat, mashed potato, mushrooms, boiled egg with scallions, or cabbage. Typical sweet fillings are fruit (apple, cherry, apricot, lemon), jam, or tvorog

russia.name: Kishka
russia.description: The dish refers to various types of sausage or stuffed intestine with a filling made from a combination of meat and meal, often grain or potato.

russia.name: Doctor's sausage
russia.description: This sausage dish is a emulsified boiled sausage with pale pink color and low fat content.

russia.name: Aspic
russia.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

kazakhstan.name: Pilaf
kazakhstan.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

kazakhstan.name: Smetana
kazakhstan.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

kazakhstan.name: Kasha
kazakhstan.description: This dish can be baked but most often is boiled, either in water or milk. The main ingredients are cereal (buckwheat, wheat, barley, oats, millet or rye).

kazakhstan.name: Chebureki
kazakhstan.description: The dish is a fried turnovers with a filling of ground or minced meat and onions.

kazakhstan.name: Kuurdak
kazakhstan.description: This dish is usually described as stewed brown meat.

kazakhstan.name: Qazı
kazakhstan.description: This is a traditional sausage-like food made from horse meat. It is a common element on a festive meal table. A reviewer described the dish as smoky and earthy. It is often eaten cold, sometimes sliced, and served as an appetiser.

kazakhstan.name: Qarta
kazakhstan.description: The dishes are boiled and pan-fried horse rectum, taken from the final few inches of the digestive tract before the muscular part of the anus. It is served without sauce or spices. It is prepared in various ways to clean it thoroughly and remove any unpleasant taste due to the provenance of the tissue.

syria.name: Pilaf
syria.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

syria.name: Fig roll
syria.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

syria.name: Sfiha
syria.description: A dish consisting of flatbread cooked with a minced meat topping, often lamb flavored with parsley, onion, tomato, pine nuts, and spices.

syria.name: Ka'ak
syria.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

syria.name: Samoon
syria.description: The dish is a type of yeast bread. It is baked in traditional stone ovens.

syria.name: Ful medames
syria.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

syria.name: Mulukhiyah
syria.description: The dish is a soup made of jute leaves resulting in thick liquid or broth, chopped with garlic, cilantro, and dressed with oil.

syria.name: Baba ghanoush
syria.description: The dish is an appetizer made of roasted eggplant, olive oil, lemon juice, and various seasonings.

syria.name: Kibbeh nayyeh
syria.description: The dish is a minced raw lamb or beef mixed with fine spices.

syria.name: Kibbeh
syria.description: The dish is a spiced lean ground meat covered with pounded wheat, then toasted with nuts and spices.

syria.name: Freekeh
syria.description: The dish is a roasted and rubbed macarroni wheat.

syria.name: Falafel
syria.description: The dish is a deep-fried ball or patty-shaped fritter made from broad beans, ground chickpease, or both.

syria.name: Stuffed dates
syria.description: The dish is a heated dates filled with meat, mint, and parsley with different stuffing including butters and goat cheese.

syria.name: Sheikh al-mahshi
syria.description: This dish consists of zucchini stuffed with minced lamb meat and nuts, bathed in a yogurt sauce (the original) or tomato sauce (derivative).

syria.name: Stuffed eggplant
syria.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

syria.name: Bamia
syria.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

syria.name: Marzipan
syria.description: This dish consists primarily of sugar and almond meal (ground almonds), sometimes augmented with almond oil or extract.

greece.name: Pilaf
greece.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

greece.name: Sarma
greece.description: The dish is made of vegetable leaves rolled around a filling of minced meat, grains such as rice, or both.

greece.name: Souvlaki
greece.description: This dish is a fast food consisting of small pieces of meat and sometimes Vegetable grilled on a skewer. It is usually eaten straight off the skewer while still hot. It can be served with or inside a rolled pita, typically with lemon, sauces, Vegetable such as sliced tomato and onion, and fried potatoes as a side.

greece.name: Gyros
greece.description: This dish is meat cooked on a vertical rotisserie, then sliced and served wrapped or stuffed in pita bread, along with other ingredients such as tomato, onion, fried potatoes, and tzatziki.

greece.name: Paximathia
greece.description: The dish is a hard bread that is prepared with whole wheat, chick pea or barley flour.

greece.name: Baklava
greece.description: The dish is a layered pastry dessert made of filo pastry, filled with chopped nuts, and sweetened with syrup or honey.

greece.name: Cream horn
greece.description: The dish is a pastry made with flaky pastry and whipped cream. The shape is made by winding overlapping pastry strips around a conical thin sheet metallic mold. After baking, a spoonful of jam or fruit is added and the pastry is then filled with whipped cream. The pastry can also be moistened and sprinkled with sugar before baking for a sweeter, crisp finish.

greece.name: Kok
greece.description: The dish is a profiterole consisting of pastry cream, chocolate glaze and syrup. It is sometimes additionally topped with nuts or flakes of various kinds.

greece.name: Savory spinach pie
greece.description: The dish is a pastry. The filling is made of chopped spinach (sometimes chard) and usually feta or white cheese, and egg.

greece.name: Pastafrola
greece.description: A type of sweet tart, covered, jam-filled shortcrust pastry dish principally made from flour, sugar and egg. Common fillings include quince cheese, sweet potato jam, dulce de leche, guava, or strawberry jam.

greece.name: Tiropita
greece.description: A pastry made with layers of buttered phyllo and filled with a cheese-egg mixture. It is served either in an individual-size free-form wrapped shape, or as a larger pie that is portioned.

greece.name: Tsoureki
greece.description: A sweet holiday bread made with flour, milk, butter, eggs, and sugar and commonly seasoned with orange zest, mastic resin, or mahlab.

greece.name: Lagana
greece.description: The dish is a flatbread. Traditionally, it was prepared unleavened (without the yeast), but leavened is nowadays more common. It is typically flat, oval-shaped, with surface decorated by impressing fingertips.

greece.name: Salo
greece.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

greece.name: Smetana
greece.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

greece.name: Chebureki
greece.description: The dish is a fried turnovers with a filling of ground or minced meat and onions.

greece.name: İmam bayıldı
greece.description: The dish is an eggplant stuffed with onion, garlic, and tomatoes, simmered in olive oil.

greece.name: Stuffed squid
greece.description: This dish is made of made of olive oil, onion, garlic, rice, tomatoes, salt, black pepper, mint leaves, parsley, and tomato juice, with squid as the main ingredient.

greece.name: Stuffed eggplant
greece.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

greece.name: Stuffed tomatoes
greece.description: This dish is a stuffed tomato filled with various ingredients, usually including rice.

greece.name: Türlü
greece.description: This dish is made of stewed Vegetable and may also include stewed meat. The basic ingredients of this dish vary greatly. It usually includes potatoes, eggplants and okra. Meat versions are made with beef or lamb, or also with pork in some regions.

greece.name: Bamia
greece.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

greece.name: Avgolemono
greece.description: The dish is a family of sauces and soups made with egg yolk and lemon juice mixed with broth, heated until they thicken. As a soup, this dish usually starts with chicken broth, though meat (usually lamb), fish, or vegetable broths are also used.

greece.name: Gigantes plaki
greece.description: This is a dish of large white beans baked in a tomato sauce. The dish is made with dried giant runner beans, tomatoes, onions, olive oil, parsley, and carrots. Other vegetables such as garlic and celery are sometimes used.

greece.name: Fasolada
greece.description: The dish is made by simmering beans with tomatoes and other vegetables such as carrots, onion, parsley, thyme, celery, and bay leaf. Recipes vary considerably, often including meat and olive oil.

bulgaria.name: Pilaf
bulgaria.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

bulgaria.name: Banitsa
bulgaria.description: The dish is prepared by layering a mixture of whisked eggs, plain yogurt, and pieces of white brined cheese between filo pastry and then baking it in an oven.

bulgaria.name: Torpedo dessert
bulgaria.description: The dish is a buttery, flaky bread roll, filled with pastry cream, named for its well-known torpedo shape. It is made of a layered yeast-leavened dough. The dough is layered with butter, rolled and folded several times in succession, then rolled into a sheet, in a technique called laminating. The process results in a layered, flaky texture, similar to a puff pastry.

bulgaria.name: Zelnik
bulgaria.description: A pastry composed of layers of thinly-rolled leavened wheat flour dough, or possibly phyllo pastry, filled with various combinations of sirene (a white cheese), feta cheese, eggs, sorrel, browned meat, leeks, spring onions and/or rice.

bulgaria.name: Börek
bulgaria.description: A thin flaky dough such as filo with a variety of fillings, such as meat, cheese, spinach, or potatoes. This dish may be prepared in a large pan and cut into portions after baking, or as individual pastries. They are usually baked but some varieties can be fried. It is sometimes sprinkled with sesame or nigella seeds, and it can be served hot or cold.

bulgaria.name: Cozonac
bulgaria.description: A sweet yeast dough that can be used to make different traditional holiday breads and cakes. The main ingredients are wheat flour, butter, milk, eggs, sugar, yeast, raisins, citrus peel, and flavorings like vanilla or rum.

bulgaria.name: Angel wings
bulgaria.description: A traditional sweet crisp pastry made out of dough that has been shaped into thin twisted ribbons, deep-fried and sprinkled with powdered sugar.

bulgaria.name: Smetana
bulgaria.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

bulgaria.name: Tufahije
bulgaria.description: The dish is a walnut-stuffed apples poached in sugar water.

bulgaria.name: Chebureki
bulgaria.description: The dish is a fried turnovers with a filling of ground or minced meat and onions.

bulgaria.name: İmam bayıldı
bulgaria.description: The dish is an eggplant stuffed with onion, garlic, and tomatoes, simmered in olive oil.

bulgaria.name: Türlü
bulgaria.description: This dish is made of stewed Vegetable and may also include stewed meat. The basic ingredients of this dish vary greatly. It usually includes potatoes, eggplants and okra. Meat versions are made with beef or lamb, or also with pork in some regions.

bulgaria.name: Mish-mash
bulgaria.description: The dish is made with fresh vegetables, typically tomatoes, peppers, and onions, combined with eggs and sirene, and brined cheese. It is often garnished with parsley, and variations may include ingredients like garlic, scallions, eggplant, okra, or carrots. Some versions are made without sirene or onions.

bulgaria.name: Bob chorba
bulgaria.description: This dish is made from dry beans, onions, tomatoes, spearmint and carrots.

bulgaria.name: Lukanka
bulgaria.description: This dish is semi-dried, has a flattened cylindrical shape, and brownish-red interior in a skin that is normally covered with a white fungus. The mix of small pieces of meat and fat give the interior a grainy structure.

bulgaria.name: Apio
bulgaria.description: The dish is an appetizer which is made from celeriac and carrot and served cold.

romania.name: Cornulețe

romania.name: Kürtőskalács
romania.description: The dish is a spit cake. It is made from sweet, yeast dough (raised dough), of which a strip is spun and then wrapped around a truncated cone–shaped baking spit, and rolled in granulated sugar. It is roasted over charcoal while basted with melted butter, until its surface cooks to a golden-brown color. During the baking process the sugar stuck on the caramelises and forms a crisp, shiny crust. The surface of the cake can then be topped with additional ingredients such as ground walnut or powdered cinnamon.

romania.name: Papanași
romania.description: The dish is doughnut-shaped with the doughnut hole on top. The dough is made with a soft cheese. The dough can be fried, as a "doughnut", or boiled, as a dumpling. Ingredients: semolina or wheat flour, cheese, rum or lemon zest or orange zest, preserves or cherries, sour cream or crème fraîche, vanilla, eggs, sugar, salt, butter, baking soda.

romania.name: Plăcintă
romania.description: This dish is a and traditional pastry resembling a thin, small round or square-shaped cake, usually filled with apples or a soft cheese such.

romania.name: Sfințișori

romania.description: This dish is a stew that primarily made from chicken mixed with a thick tomato sauce. Additionally, garlic or spring onions can be added to the dish. romania.name: Sibiu Salami
romania.description: The dish is a salami made with pork meat, pork fat, salt and condiments, fermented and air-dried.

north macedonia.description: This dish is made with fresh beans, often served baked in an unglazed earthenware pot.

serbia.name: Pilaf
serbia.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

serbia.name: Bundevara
serbia.description: The dish is a sweet pie made of rolled phyllo, filled with sweetened grated pumpkin pulp and baked in an oven. Occasionally nutmeg, cinnamon or similar spices may be added, or raisins or grated lemon rinds. It is usually dusted with icing sugar and/or vanilla sugar, and is served hot or cold. The pumpkins (or squashes) with more intense coloured pulp (richer in carotene) are more appreciated.

serbia.name: Poppy seed roll
serbia.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

serbia.name: Savory spinach pie
serbia.description: The dish is a pastry. The filling is made of chopped spinach (sometimes chard) and usually feta or white cheese, and egg.

serbia.name: Börek
serbia.description: A thin flaky dough such as filo with a variety of fillings, such as meat, cheese, spinach, or potatoes. This dish may be prepared in a large pan and cut into portions after baking, or as individual pastries. They are usually baked but some varieties can be fried. It is sometimes sprinkled with sesame or nigella seeds, and it can be served hot or cold.

serbia.name: Česnica
serbia.description: Bread made with wheat flour and water. A coin is often put into the dough during the kneading; other small objects may also be inserted.

serbia.name: Cozonac
serbia.description: A sweet yeast dough that can be used to make different traditional holiday breads and cakes. The main ingredients are wheat flour, butter, milk, eggs, sugar, yeast, raisins, citrus peel, and flavorings like vanilla or rum.

serbia.name: Salo
serbia.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

serbia.name: Syrniki
serbia.description: Pancake made of creamy fermented milk, mixed with flour, eggs and sugar, sometimes adding vanilla extract, mix well and then pan-fried or shallow-fried.
serbia.photoCredit: Tatyana Morozyuk, color processing by Off-shell

serbia.name: Smetana
serbia.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

serbia.name: Kulich
serbia.description: This bread is round and tall, and dough decorations were made on top of it.

serbia.name: Tufahije
serbia.description: The dish is a walnut-stuffed apples poached in sugar water.

serbia.name: İmam bayıldı
serbia.description: The dish is an eggplant stuffed with onion, garlic, and tomatoes, simmered in olive oil.

serbia.name: Karađorđeva šnicla
serbia.description: The dish is a breaded cutlet dish with rolled veal, pork, or chicken steak, stuffed with dairy then breaded and fried.

serbia.name: Meringue
serbia.description: The dish is a light, airy dessert or candy made from whipped egg whites and sugar, sometimes with an acidic ingredient like lemon, vinegar, or cream of tartar. A binding agent such as salt, flour, or gelatin may be added. Egg whites are whipped until stiff peaks form by denaturing the protein ovalbumin through mechanical mixing.

ethiopia.name: Pilaf
ethiopia.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

ethiopia.name: Injera
ethiopia.description: The dish is a sour fermented pancake-like flatbread with a slightly spongy texture, traditionally made of teff flour.

ethiopia.name: Himbasha
ethiopia.description: The dish is a celebration bread that is slightly sweet. It often served at special occasions. The dough is given a decorative touch before baking. The design varies in detail, but in general, is given the shape of a wheel with indentations to create several spokes. Common additions to the recipe include candied orange, ginger, or ground cardamom seeds, although plain varieties are not unheard of.

ethiopia.name: Lahoh
ethiopia.description: The dish is a spongy, flat pancake-like bread. It is a type of flat bread. It is traditionally and typically prepared from a thick batter of sorghum flour, White cornmeal/cornflour, warm water, yeast, and a pinch of salt. The mixture is beaten by hand until soft and creamy. The batter is then left to ferment overnight to cook and then eat for breakfast. There is a sweet-tasting variety of the dish, one made with eggs.  It is traditionally baked on a metallic circular stove. Lacking that, it can also be baked in an ordinary pan.

ethiopia.name: Wat
ethiopia.description: This dish is a stew that may be prepared with chicken, beef, lamb, a variety of Vegetable, spice mixtures.

ethiopia.name: Dabo kolo
ethiopia.description: This dish is a finger food consisting of small pieces of spiced fried dough. It is prepared by frying small pieces of dough cut from rolls.

ethiopia.name: Fit-fit
ethiopia.description: The dish is a shredded flat bread with spiced butter and jalapeno peppers.

ethiopia.name: Mandazi
ethiopia.description: The dish is a fried bread also known as bofrot or puff puff made from water, sugar, yeast, and coconut milk.
ethiopia.photoCredit: The original uploader was ChildofMidnight at English Wikipedia .

ethiopia.name: Gored gored
ethiopia.description: The dish is a raw beef dish with cube shape.

ethiopia.name: Shahan ful
ethiopia.description: The dish is a slow-cooked fava beans in water, cruhed into a coarse paste.

ethiopia.name: Kitfo
ethiopia.description: The dish is a minced raw beef, marinated in chili powder and clarified butter.

eritrea.name: Kitcha
eritrea.description: The dish is a relatively thin unleavened bread. It is generally made with wheat flour, water, and salt. It is cooked in a hot pan free-form until one side is cooked. It is then picked up and cooked on the other side. Slight burning on each side is often seen. It will take the shape of the pan in which it is cooked (much like a pancake, though it bears no relation).

eritrea.name: Wat
eritrea.description: This dish is a stew that may be prepared with chicken, beef, lamb, a variety of Vegetable, spice mixtures.

eritrea.name: Dabo kolo
eritrea.description: This dish is a finger food consisting of small pieces of spiced fried dough. It is prepared by frying small pieces of dough cut from rolls.

eritrea.name: Fit-fit
eritrea.description: The dish is a shredded flat bread with spiced butter and jalapeno peppers.

eritrea.name: Genfo
eritrea.description: The dish is a stiff porridge served with dipping sauce and mixture of butter and red peppers.

tanzania.description: The dish is a shredded flat bread with spiced butter and jalapeno peppers.

tanzania.name: Mandazi

tanzania.photoCredit: The original uploader was ChildofMidnight at English Wikipedia .

tanzania.name: Kachumbari
tanzania.description: The dish is a fresh tomato and onion salad dish with chopped tomatoes, onions, and chili peppers.

tanzania.name: Bamia
tanzania.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

tanzania.name: Ugali
tanzania.description: The dish is a type of corn meal made from maize or corn flour. It is cooked in boiling water or milk until it reaches a stiff or firm dough-like consistency.

kenya.name: Pilaf
kenya.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

kenya.description: The dish is a fresh tomato and onion salad dish with chopped tomatoes, onions, and chili peppers.

kenya.name: Ugali
kenya.description: The dish is a type of corn meal made from maize or corn flour. It is cooked in boiling water or milk until it reaches a stiff or firm dough-like consistency.

kenya.name: Githeri
kenya.description: This is a meal consisting of maize and legumes (primarily beans) mixed and boiled together. The maize and beans are mixed in a type of pot, with water added, and the mixture is boiled until fully cooked.

palestine.name: Pilaf
palestine.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

palestine.name: Taboon bread
palestine.description: A flatbread baked in a clay oven. It is used as a base or wrap in many cuisines, and eaten with different accompaniments.

palestine.name: Ka'ak
palestine.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

palestine.name: Ful medames
palestine.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

palestine.name: Mulukhiyah
palestine.description: The dish is a soup made of jute leaves resulting in thick liquid or broth, chopped with garlic, cilantro, and dressed with oil.

palestine.name: Kibbeh
palestine.description: The dish is a spiced lean ground meat covered with pounded wheat, then toasted with nuts and spices.

palestine.name: Freekeh
palestine.description: The dish is a roasted and rubbed macarroni wheat.

palestine.name: Falafel
palestine.description: The dish is a deep-fried ball or patty-shaped fritter made from broad beans, ground chickpease, or both.

palestine.name: Stuffed dates
palestine.description: The dish is a heated dates filled with meat, mint, and parsley with different stuffing including butters and goat cheese.

palestine.name: Sheikh al-mahshi
palestine.description: This dish consists of zucchini stuffed with minced lamb meat and nuts, bathed in a yogurt sauce (the original) or tomato sauce (derivative).

palestine.name: Stuffed eggplant
palestine.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

palestine.name: Bamia
palestine.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

yemen.name: Pilaf
