yemen.description: It is a rice dish, usually sautéed, or in some regions, a wheat dish, whose recipe usually involves cooking in stock or broth, adding spices, and other ingredients such as Vegetable or meat, and employing some technique for achieving cooked grains that do not adhere to each other.

yemen.name: Murtabak
yemen.description: The dish is often described as spicy folded omelette pancake with bits of vegetable. The most common form of this dish is made from pan fried crepes usually stuffed with beaten eggs, chopped leeks, chives, or green onion (scallions) and minced meat, which is then folded and cut to squares.

yemen.name: Fig roll
yemen.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

yemen.name: Jachnun
yemen.description: The dish is a pastry traditionally eaten in the morning with a local condiment, boiled eggs and a local spicy sauce. It is prepared from dough which is rolled out thinly and brushed with clarified butter spiced and aged in a smoked vessel, traditionally using smoke from the wood of a specific tree, though regular clarified butter or shortening can be used. A little honey is sometimes added in addition, whereupon the dough is rolled up before cooking.

yemen.name: Ka'ak
yemen.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

yemen.name: Lahoh
yemen.description: The dish is a spongy, flat pancake-like bread. It is a type of flat bread. It is traditionally and typically prepared from a thick batter of sorghum flour, White cornmeal/cornflour, warm water, yeast, and a pinch of salt. The mixture is beaten by hand until soft and creamy. The batter is then left to ferment overnight to cook and then eat for breakfast. There is a sweet-tasting variety of the dish, one made with eggs.  It is traditionally baked on a metallic circular stove. Lacking that, it can also be baked in an ordinary pan.

yemen.name: Maluj
yemen.description: The dish is typically made with flour, cooking oil, yeast, fenugreek, and salt.

yemen.name: Ful medames
yemen.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

yemen.name: Saltah
yemen.description: The dish is based off a brown meat stew called maraq, a dollop of fenugreek froth, and sahawiq (a mixture of chillies, tomatoes, garlic, and herbs ground into a salsa).

shiraz.name: Shirin polo
shiraz.description: The dish is typically served at celebrations such as weddings, birthdays, and holidays. It is steamed rice topped with nuts and dried fruits such as barberries, apricots, and dates.

mexico.name: Spanish rice
mexico.description: The dish is a side dish made from white rice, tomato, garlic, onion, and perhaps other ingredients. It is almost always eaten as a complement to other dishes such as mole, refried beans, rotisserie chicken, carne asada, picadillo, tacos, fried fish, fried chicken, chiles rellenos, or vegetable soup.

mexico.name: Sopa de fideo
mexico.description: The dish is made with thin noodles (typically vermicelli and angel hair pasta) which are typically broken or cut and then browned separately prior to being stewed in stock with the other soup ingredients. Additional soup ingredients include bell pepper, onion and garlic, tomatoes, tomato sauce, chicken, chili peppers, vegetable oil, salt and pepper.

mexico.name: Taco
mexico.description: The dish is small hand-sized corn- or wheat-based tortilla topped with a filling.

mexico.name: Burrito
mexico.description: The dish is a thin flatbread filled with savory ingredients, most often a meat such as beef, chicken, or pork, and often include other ingredients, such as rice, cooked beans (either whole or refried), Vegetable, such as lettuce and tomatoes, cheese, and condiments such as mixed avocado-based dip and a green sauce.

mexico.name: Tamale
mexico.description: The dish made of masa, a dough made from nixtamalized corn, which is steamed in a corn husk or banana leaves.

mexico.name: Piñata cookie
mexico.description: The dish is a sugar cookie that is shaped and colored like a rainbow colored horse and filled with various small candies which spill out when the cookie is broken.

mexico.name: Empanada
mexico.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

mexico.name: Milhojas
mexico.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

mexico.name: Pan dulce
mexico.description: The dish is the general name for a variety of some areas pastries. They are inexpensive treats and are consumed at breakfast or dinner.

mexico.name: Bolillo
mexico.description: A type of savory bread, often baked in a stone oven. It is roughly 15 centimeters (5.9 in) long, in the shape of an ovoid, with a crunchy crust and a soft inside. It has a slash on top made with a slashing tool or bread lame, which permits the exhaust of steam and the expansion of bread without stressing its skin.

mexico.name: Gordita
mexico.description: The dish is a dough stuffed with cheese, meat, or other fillings. The dough is most commonly made of nixtamalized corn flour, but can also be of wheat flour. In the deep-fried version, it is separated in small portions, then each one is filled with meat, and shaped like an oblong disc. The pastry is immersed in boiling oil until golden and crispy on the outside. After cooking, it is allowed to stand to drain excess oil, then a small slit is cut into one side to allow vapor and excessive heat to release, and lime juice and salsa are poured inside, which gives this pastry its characteristic flavor. The baked version is prepared almost identically to the preparation of a certain flatbread, except it is thicker.
mexico.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. JEDIKNIGHT1970 assumed (based on copyright claims).

mexico.name: Taquito
mexico.description: The dish is a small rolled-up flatbread then shallow or deep fried, topped with condiments such as sour cream, avocado-based dipping, and vegetable.

mexico.name: Papa rellena
mexico.description: This dish is a potato-based dough into which a filling made of chopped beef and onions, whole olives, hard-boiled eggs, cumin and other spices is stuffed.

mexico.name: Enchilada
mexico.description: This dish consists of a corn tortilla rolled around a filling (meats, cheese, beans, potatoes, vegetables, or combinations) and covered with a savory sauce.

mexico.name: Chimichanga
mexico.description: The dish is typically prepared by filling a flour tortilla with various ingredients, most commonly rice, cheese, beans, and a meat, such as chopped or shredded meat, marinated meat, dried beef, or shredded chicken, and folding it into a rectangular package

mexico.name: Puchero
mexico.description: The dish is made of meat (beef, veal, pork or chicken), bacon, cured bones (such as those of the jamón serrano), and Vegetable (potatoes, celery, chard, leek, carrots, and turnips).

mexico.name: Chicken feet
mexico.description: This dish is a part of chicken which cooked and eaten in many countries. This dish has a distinct gelatinous texture different from the rest of the chicken meat.

mexico.name: Pan de muerto
mexico.description: The dish is a type of sweet bread. It is a sweetened soft bread shaped like a bun, often decorated with bone-shaped phalanx pieces. Some traditions state that the rounded or domed top of the bread represents a grave. It usually has skulls or crossbones added in extra dough.

mexico.name: Huevos rancheros
mexico.description: The basic dish consists of fried eggs served on lightly fried or charred corn or flour tortillas topped with a spicy salsa made of tomatoes, chili peppers, and onion. Common accompaniments include refried beans, rice, and guacamole or slices of avocado, with cilantro as a garnish.

mexico.name: Refried beans
mexico.description: This is a dish of leftover cooked and mashed beans that is fried.

mexico.name: Frijoles negros
mexico.description: This dish is a black beans that is typically seasoned with salt, ham hocks, onions and garlic, tomatoes, powdered cumin seeds, oregano and vinegar.

mexico.name: Frijoles charros
mexico.description: The dish is characterised by common ground beans stewed with onion, garlic, and bacon. Other common ingredients include chili peppers, tomatoes, cilantro, ham, sausage, pork and pork sausage. It is served warm and is usually of a soupy consistency.

mexico.name: Borracho beans
mexico.description: This dish is made of pinto beans cooked in beer and flavored with cilantro, onion, garlic, bacon, bacon fat, cumin, and chili powder or whole chili peppers. This dish can be served wrapped in tortillas with some form of grilled beef, eaten from a bowl much like chili, or used as a bean dip and eaten with tortilla chips.

mexico.name: Longaniza
mexico.description: This sausage is similar to salchichón, though thinner; both differ from chorizo in that black pepper is used for them instead of paprika and may have different spices in them like nutmeg.
mexico.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Ardo Beltz assumed (based on copyright claims).

mexico.name: Queso flameado
mexico.description: The food is a hot melted cheese and spicy pork sausage that is often served in hot pan with burst of flames.

mexico.name: Elote
mexico.description: This dish is an ear of corn, on or off the plant. They are splashed with salt water and grilled in the coals until the husks start to burn and the kernels reach a crunchy texture.

mexico.name: Entomatada
mexico.description: The dish is made of a folded corn tortilla that has been fried in oil and then bathed in a tomato sauce made from tomatoes, garlic, onion, oregano, chilli peppers, and salt. The recipes for the tomato sauce vary by cook. The tortilla can be filled with a number of different ingredients. However, the most common are chicken, beef, cheese, or beans.

mexico.name: Japanese-style peanuts
mexico.description: This type of snack food is made from peanuts coated in a wheat flour dough and then fried or deep-fried. It comes in a variety of different flavours. The original version's recipe for the extra-crunchy shell has ingredients such as wheat flour, soy sauce, water, sugar, monosodium glutamate, and citric acid.

mexico.name: Manchamanteles
mexico.description: This dish is a type of stew made from assorted meat, chili peppers, vegetables, and fruits. A typical recipe contains chicken and/or pork, sausage, pineapple, apple, banana, chili peppers, almonds, cinnamon, lard, and tomatoes.

mexico.name: Menudo
mexico.description: This is a soup, made with cow's stomach (tripe) in broth with a red chili pepper base.

mexico.name: Mole de olla
mexico.description: A traditional soup made of a kind of edible cactus, squash, zucchini, green beans, corn, potato, chambarete and aguja meat, submerged into a broth, seasoned with garlic, onion, and wormseed.

mexico.name: Molote
mexico.description: A filled, plantain or corn-based pastry usually served as an appetizer or snack. It consists of a dough made from plantain or corn masa, sometimes blended with mashed potatoes, that is filled with various ingredients, rolled into cigar shapes or ovals or half moons.

mexico.name: Nachos
mexico.description: This is a culinary dish consisting of chips covered with cheese or cheese sauce, as well as a variety of other toppings and garnishes, often including meats (such as ground beef or grilled chicken), vegetables (such as chili peppers, lettuce, tomatoes, and olives), and condiments such as sour cream.

mexico.name: Picadillo
mexico.description: It is made with ground meat (most commonly beef), tomatoes (tomato sauce may be used as a substitute), and also raisins, olives, and other ingredients that vary by region.

mexico.name: Quesadilla
mexico.description: This is a dish consisting of a flatbread that is filled primarily with cheese, and sometimes meats, spices, and other fillings, and then cooked on a griddle or stove.

mexico.name: Rajas con crema
mexico.description: It is one of the dishes most commonly served during parties. Preparation of the dish involves roasting, peeling and slicing the peppers, sauteing them together with sliced onions, and simmering the mixture with cream. Sometimes chicken broth is added for flavor.

mexico.name: Salsa
mexico.description: This food usually serves as condiments , stirred into soups and stews. They may be raw or cooked, and are generally served at room temperature. They can be made with fruit, corn, or black beans.

mexico.name: Sincronizada
mexico.description: This food is made by placing ham, vegetables (like tomatoes, onion, etc.) and a portion of cheese between two flour tortillas.

mexico.name: Tripas
mexico.description: They are the small intestines of farm animals that have been cleaned, boiled and grilled.
mexico.photoCredit: The original uploader was Puercozon at English Wikipedia .

mexico.name: Totopo
mexico.description: The food is a flat, round, or triangular corn item similar to a tortilla, that has been toasted, fried or baked.

mexico.name: Tlacoyo
mexico.description: They are stuffed with cheese, fava beans, cooked ground beans, chicharron, and other ingredients before being fried or toasted.

mexico.name: Al pastor
mexico.description: This food is a preparation of spit-grilled slices of pork.

mexico.name: Tlayuda
mexico.description: This food consists of a large, thin, crunchy, partially fried or toasted tortilla covered with a spread of refried beans, unrefined pork lard, lettuce or cabbage, avocado, meat, cheese, and sauces.
mexico.photoCredit: The original uploader was Bobak at English Wikipedia .

mexico.name: Tostada
mexico.description: This food consists of corn and vegetables. It is a flat or bowl-shaped bread that is deep-fried or toasted.

mexico.name: Sope
mexico.description: This dish consists of a fried dough base with savory toppings. The dough base is fried with pinched sides and topped with refried beans, crumbled cheese, lettuce, onions, red or green sauce and sour cream.

mexico.name: Tostilocos
mexico.description: The food consists of white corn, pickled pork rinds, cucumber, lime juice, mango pieces, hot sauce, chamoy, chili powder, salt, mayonnaise, and cracker peanuts and a variety of savory sauces and condiments.

mexico.name: Caldo de queso
mexico.description: This is made with boiled water, diced potatoes, onions, tomato, green chiles and oregano. The cheese is usually added only at the end, once the other are ingredients are boiled.

mexico.name: Migas
mexico.description: This dish is made from stale bread and other ingredients.

mexico.name: Beefsteak
mexico.description: This dish is flat cut of beef with parallel faces, usually cut perpendicular to the muscle fibers.

mexico.name: Carne asada
mexico.description: This dish is grilled and sliced beef, usually skirt steak, flap steak, or flank steak though chuck steak can also be used.
mexico.photoCredit: Daniel R. Blume from Toledo, Ohio, USA

mexico.name: Carne a la tampiqueña
mexico.description: This dish consists of strip of roasted meat, corn tortilla, white cheese and  avocado-based dip.

mexico.name: Cabrito
mexico.description: This food is roast whole goat over a charcoal fire.

mexico.name: Puntas
mexico.description: This dish consists of small cuts of meat cooked in various sauces, either of dried chili or fresh chilis sauces. Initially, the tips were made with strips of leftover beef cut. Then, different types of meat have been used.

mexico.name: Chamoy
mexico.description: This is a variety of savory sauces and condiments made from pickled fruit. This sauce may range from a liquid to a paste consistency, and typically its flavor is salty, sweet, sour, and spiced with chilies.

mexico.name: Guacamole
mexico.description: This is an avocado-based dip, spread, or salad that traditionally made by mashing peeled, ripe avocados and salt with a mortar and pestle.

mexico.name: Mole verde
mexico.description: This is a traditional sauce and marinade variety with pumpkin seed and green chile (to bring color) as the main ingredients. Other ingredients varies depending on the region.

mexico.name: Chipotle
mexico.description: This ingredient is a smoke-dried ripe type of chili pepper used for seasoning.

mexico.name: Salsa verde
mexico.description: This is a type of spicy green sauce based on husk tomato and green chili peppers.

mexico.name: Arroz a la tumbada
mexico.description: This is a traditional dish prepared with white rice and seafood. It is made with chopped tomato, onion, garlic and red pepper. Rice and fish broth or water is added, then seafood which may include shrimp, clams, crab, calamari and whitefish.

mexico.name: Arroz poblano
mexico.description: This dish is made with rice and gets its green color from a type of pepper that is processed into a liquid.

mexico.name: Morisqueta
mexico.description: This dish consists of cooked rice, combined with beans, and served with a sauce of tomato, onion and garlic.

mexico.name: Fried ice cream
mexico.description: This dish is a dessert made of a scoop of ice cream that is frozen hard, then breaded or coated in a batter before being quickly deep-fried, creating a warm, crispy shell around the still-cold ice cream.

mexico.name: Capirotada
mexico.description: This dish consists of toasted savory bread and soaked in a mulled syrup made of whole cane sugar, clove, and cinnamon sticks.

mexico.name: Caldo de siete mares
mexico.description: This dish is a fish soup typically made with tomato, fish, or seafood broth with local fresh seafood ingredients and cooked quickly in a thin broth.
mexico.photoCredit: Kent Wang from Austin, TX, USA

mexico.name: Calavera
mexico.description: This dish is an edible decorative skulls made from sugar.

mexico.name: Cocada
mexico.description: This dish is a traditional coconut confectionery made with with eggs and shredded coconut.

mexico.name: Cochinito de piloncillo
mexico.description: This dish is a sweet bread made with a type of sweetener made from sugar cane.

mexico.name: Concha
mexico.description: This dish is a traditional sweet bread roll that gets its name from its round shape and its striped, seashell-like appearance.

mexico.name: Pico de gallo
mexico.description: This dish is a type of salsa traditionally made from chopped tomato, onion, and peppers, with salt, lime juice, and cilantro.

mexico.name: Nopalito
mexico.description: This dish is made with diced nopales, the naturally flat stems, called pads, of prickly pear cactus. It has a light, slightly tart flavor, and a crisp, mucilaginous texture.

okinawa.name: Taco rice
okinawa.description: The dish consists of taco-flavored ground beef served on a bed of rice, frequently served with shredded cheese, shredded lettuce, tomato and salsa.

okinawa.name: Okinawa soba
okinawa.description: The dish uses soba noodle that are made from wheat flour, and do not contain any buckwheat. It is served in a broth flavored with konbu (edible seaweed), katsuobushi flakes and pork. Standard toppings are kamaboko (fish cake), sliced scallion and a thick slice of stewed san-mai niku (三枚肉, pork belly; lit. "three-layer meat") or soki (boneless pork ribs) and usually garnished with beni shōga (pickled ginger).

okinawa.name: Chanpurū
okinawa.description: The dish consists of tofu combined with some kind of vegetable, meat, or fish.

okinawa.name: Chinsukō
okinawa.description: The dish is a traditional sweet often sold as a souvenir. It is a small biscuit made of mostly lard and flour, with a mild and sweet flavor similar to shortbread.

okinawa.name: Coffee jelly
okinawa.description: The dish is a jelly dessert flavored with coffee and sugar.

okinawa.name: Sata andagi
okinawa.description: The dish is a sweet deep fried bun of dough similar to a doughnut. It is typically prepared so that the outside is crispy and browned while the inside is light and cake-like.

normandy.name: Teurgoule
normandy.description: The dish consists of rice cooked in milk, sweetened with sugar, and is flavoured with cinnamon and sometimes nutmeg. It is baked in an earthenware terrine for several hours. Long cooking creates a thick, brown caramelised crust over the dish.

normandy.name: Galette
normandy.description: The dish is a term to designate various types of flat round or freeform crusty cakes or a pancake made with buckwheat flour usually with a savoury filling. A common form of the dish resembles a type of single crust, free-form pie with a fruit filling and the crust folded partway over the top of the filling.

normandy.name: Blanquette de veau
normandy.description: This dish is a veal stew. In the classic version, the meat is simmered in a white stock and served in a sauce enriched with cream and egg.

chongqing.name: Ciba cake
chongqing.description: The dish is made of glutinous rice pounded into paste and is often fried or steamed before being served. It is often molded into shapes of balls or cuboids.

chongqing.name: Chongqing noodles
chongqing.description: The dish typically prepared using wheat noodle. There are two main types of this dishes: noodles with soup and noodles without soup. The dishes are typically spicy and prepared using a variety of spices, seasonings and sauces. Sichuan pepper is often used in the dish's preparation. Myriad meats and Vegetable are also used in its preparation. Various garnishes and condiments are also used, such as spring onions and chili oil.

xi'an.name: Jian dui
xi'an.description: The dish is coated with sesame seeds on the outside and is crisp and chewy after immediately being cooked. Inside the pastry is a large hollow, caused by the expansion of the dough. The hollow of the pastry is filled with a filling usually consisting of lotus paste, or alternatively, sweet black bean paste, or red bean paste.

xi'an.name: Paomo
xi'an.description: This dish is a hot stew of chopped-up steamed leavened flat bread cooked in lamb broth and served with lamb meat, sometimes substituted with beef.

jiangsu.name: Funing big cake
jiangsu.description: The dish traditionally use sticky rice, white sugar, and refined lard as  raw materials. Sometimes the dish also contains pine nuts, walnuts, or other ingredients as garnishes.

jiangsu.name: Xiao Long Bao
jiangsu.description: The dish is a steamed dumpling filled with soup and meat.

beijing.name: Lüdagun
beijing.description: The dish is made with sticky rice and red bean paste, with yellow soybean flour sprinkled on top.

beijing.name: Wotou
beijing.description: The dish is a type of steamed bread made from cornmeal.

beijing.name: Wonton
beijing.description: This dish is a type of dumpling. The are several common regional variations of shape, but the most versatile shape is a simple right triangle, made by folding the square wrapper in half by pulling together two diagonally opposite corners. The most common filling is ground pork or chicken and shrimp with a small amount of flour added as a binder.

beijing.name: Wandouhuang
beijing.description: This is a light and refreshing paste-like cake made from yellow peas or yellow pea flour, water, and sugar, with a slightly sweet taste. Traditionally associated with spring.

beijing.name: Douzhi
beijing.description: It is similar to soy milk, but made from mung beans. It is generally slightly sour, with an rotten egg-like smell.

foshan.name: White sugar sponge cake
foshan.description: The dish is white in color, with a spongy and soft consistency. The taste is sweet, and sometimes has a slightly sour taste due to fermentation of the batter prior to cooking.

huế.name: Bánh bèo
huế.description: The dish is made of rice flour and tapioca flour with rice cake, dried shrimps, crispy pork skin, scallion oil, and dipping sauce.

macau.name: Bánh tổ
macau.description: The dish is made from glutinus irce flour with sticky sweet texture with brown color.

macau.name: Cart noodle
macau.description: The dish is typically based upon the diner choosing various ingredients they would like, including the type of noodles, various soup broths, and toppings.Examples of types of noodles and toppings, which may vary considerably from stall to stall.

macau.name: Cha siu bao
macau.description: This dish is a bun filled with barbecue-flavored pork. They are usually served as dim sum.

macau.name: Egg waffle
macau.description: A spherical waffle consisting of an eggy leavened batter cooked between two plates of semi-spherical cells. They are usually served hot, and often eaten plain, although they may be served with fruit and flavors such as strawberry, coconut or chocolate.

macau.name: Spring roll
macau.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

macau.name: Hong dou tang
macau.description: The dish is a sweet Chinese dessert made from azuki beans served in Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, and places with Chinese diaspora.

macau.name: Pork chop bun
macau.description: The dish consists of a bun which is extremely crisp outside and very soft inside. A fried pork chop is filled into the bun horizontally.
macau.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Chensiyuan assumed (based on copyright claims).

macau.name: Grass jelly
macau.description: The jelly is made by boiling the aged and slightly oxidized stalks and leaves of Platostoma palustre (Mesona chinensis) with potassium carbonate and a little starch for several hours, then let it cool and served with sweet beverages.

cambodia.name: Bánh tổ
cambodia.description: The dish is made from glutinus irce flour with sticky sweet texture with brown color.

cambodia.name: Roti
cambodia.description: The dish is a round flatbread made from stoneground whole wheat flour

cambodia.name: Chicken curry
cambodia.description: The dish consists of chicken stewed in an onion- and tomato-based sauce, flavoured with ginger, garlic, tomato puree, chilli peppers and a variety of spices.

cambodia.name: Spring roll
cambodia.description: This dish is a rolled appetizer or dim sum. The kind of wrapper, fillings, and cooking technique used, as well as the name, vary considerably depending on the region's culture, though they are generally filled with Vegetable.

cambodia.name: Popiah
cambodia.description: This dish is a fresh spring roll filled with an assortment of fresh, dried, and cooked ingredients, eaten during a festival and other celebratory occasions.

cambodia.name: Malay sponge cake
cambodia.description: This dish is made of lard or butter, flour, and eggs, using a bamboo steamer to develop puffiness.

cambodia.name: Youtiao
cambodia.description: This dish is a long golden-brown deep-fried strip of wheat flour dough

germany.name: Rijstevlaai
germany.description: The dish is a pie with a filling based on rice pudding.
germany.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Frinck51~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

germany.name: Krapfen
germany.description: The dish is a doughnut with no central hole, made from sweet yeast dough fried in lard or cooking oil, with a jam filling, and usually covered in powdered sugar.

germany.name: Dampfnudel
germany.description: The dish is a dumpling made from flour, yeast, butter or margarine, and eggs with sugar.

germany.name: Aachener Printen
germany.description: This pastry is originally sweetened with honey, but are now generally sweetened with a syrup made from sugar beets.

germany.name: Speculaas
germany.description: The dish is a type of spiced shortcrust biscuit baked with spices. They are usually flat and are often moulded to carry certain traditional images.

germany.name: Spritzgebäck
germany.description: The dish is a type biscuit or cookie made of a rich shortcrust pastry. When made correctly, the cookies are crisp, fragile, somewhat dry, and buttery.

germany.name: Teiglach
germany.description: The dish is small, knotted pastries boiled in a honeyed syrup.

germany.name: Bethmännchen
germany.description: The dish is a pastry made from marzipan with almond, powdered sugar, rosewater, flour and egg.

germany.name: Bierock
germany.description: The dish is a yeast dough pastry pocket sandwich with savory filling. The soft yeast rolls contain some sugar, butter and eggs, and either warm water, milk, or a mix of both. The filling is a basic mix of onion, ground beef and cabbage which can be made more complicated by the addition of different cheese blends, condiments and seasonings like caraway seeds.

germany.name: Moorkop
germany.description: This dish is a traditional pastry. It consisting of a profiterole (cream puff) filled with whipped cream. The top of the profiterole is glazed with white or dark chocolate. Often there is whipped cream on the top, with a slice of tangerine or a piece of pineapple.

germany.name: Poppy seed roll
germany.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

germany.name: Schnecken
germany.description: The dish are a type of sweet bun or roll. They typically contain raisins.

germany.name: Schneeball
germany.description: The dish is a deep-fried pastry made from shortcrust pastry. Its name derives from its round, ball-like shape, its diameter of about eight to ten centimeters, and its traditional decoration with white confectioner's sugar.

germany.name: Strudel
germany.description: The dish is a type of layered pastry with a filling that is usually sweet, but savoury fillings are also common.

germany.name: Stutenkerl
germany.description: The dish is a pastry made of sweet leavened dough, in the form of a man. The pastry often features raisins in the place of eyes and a clay pipe.

germany.name: Kuchen
germany.description: Cake with eggs, flour and sugar as common ingredients while also, but not always, including some fat.
germany.photoCredit: Fotographen: Thomas Högner Maximilian Högner ( User:Leberwurscht )

germany.name: Wähe
germany.description: This dish consists of a casing (typically made of shortcrust pastry, but sometimes yeast dough or puff pastry) and a topping of a custard enveloping either fruit, Vegetable or cheese.

germany.name: Zopf
germany.description: A type of bread made from white flour, milk, eggs, butter and yeast. It is typically brushed with egg yolk, egg wash, or milk before baking, lending it its golden crust. It is baked in the form of a plait and traditionally eaten on Sunday mornings.

germany.name: Spelt bread
germany.description: Bread made from unripe spelt flour.

germany.name: Potato bread
germany.description: The dish is a form of bread in which potato flour or potato replaces a portion of the regular wheat flour.

germany.name: Pretzel
germany.description: The dish is a type of baked pastry made from dough that is commonly shaped into a knot.

germany.name: Salo
germany.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

germany.name: Chrain
germany.description: This dish has white and red type. The white consists of grated horseradish and vinegar, and sometimes sugar and salt, while red type includes the addition of beetroot

germany.name: Smetana
germany.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

germany.name: Helzel
germany.description: The dish is a sausage made from poultry neck skin stuffed with flour, bread crumbs, and fried onions, sewn up with a thread.
germany.photoCredit: Wizard85 (original file) ; Off-shell (cropped and reprocessed version)

germany.name: Jelly doughnut
germany.description: This dish is a doughnut with a fruit preserve filling.

germany.name: Nut roll
germany.description: A sweet yeast dough is rolled flat, and filled with spread usually walnuts spread or poppy seed. The filled dough is rolled up, forming a log or loaf shape, then baked.

germany.name: Bockwurst
germany.description: This dish is traditionally made from ground pork or veal. It is flavored with salt, white pepper and paprika. Other herbs, such as marjoram, chives and parsley, are also often added. It is often smoked as well.
germany.photoCredit: Tinoelf at German Wikipedia ( Original text: tinoelf )

germany.name: Bratwurst
germany.description: This dish is a type of sausage made from pork or, less commonly, beef or veal.

germany.name: Hasenpfeffer
germany.description: This dish is a traditional stew made from marinated rabbit or hare, cut into stewing-meat sized pieces and braised with onions and a marinade made from wine and vinegar.

germany.name: Pichelsteiner
germany.description: This dish is a stew containing several kinds of meat and vegetables. It uses beef, pork, and mutton, and usually includes potatoes, diced carrots, parsley roots, chopped cabbage, and leeks.
germany.photoCredit: Josef Türk Jun. from Reit im Winkl, Deutschland

germany.name: Apple dumpling
germany.description: The dish is a baked or boiled pastry-wrapped apple. To prepare it, apples are peeled, cored and sometimes quartered and placed on a portion of dough. The hole from the core may be filled with cinnamon, butter and sugar and sometimes dried fruit such as raisins, sultanas, or currants. The dough is folded over the apples and sealed. Sometimes a spiced sauce is poured over the dumplings which are then baked until tender; the sugar and butter create a sweet sauce. It can be served hot, cold, or room temperature for breakfast, dessert, or as a main dish.
germany.photoCredit: tracy ducasse from Massachusetts, United States

germany.name: Hamburger
germany.description: The dish is a dish consisting of fillings—usually a patty of ground meat, typically beef—placed inside a sliced bun or bread roll. The patties are often served with cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, bacon or chilis with condiments such as ketchup, mustard, mayonnaise, relish or a "special sauce", and are frequently placed on sesame seed buns.

germany.name: Heißwecke
germany.description: The dish is a sweet bread roll made with milk and wheat flour that is eaten hot.

germany.name: Toast Hawaii
germany.description: The dish is an open sandwich consisting of a slice of toast with ham and cheese, and a maraschino cherry in the middle of a pineapple slice, baked so that the cheese starts to melt.

germany.name: Schweinshaxe
germany.description: The dish is a roasted ham hock (or pork knuckle). The ham hock is the end of the pig's leg, just above the ankle and below the meaty ham portion.

germany.name: Eisbein
germany.description: The dish consists of corned ham hock, usually cured and slightly boiled.

germany.name: Cervelat
germany.description: This dish is a sausage produced in Switzerland, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, and parts of Germany. The recipe and preparation of the sausage vary regionally.

germany.name: Liverwurst
germany.description: This is a sausage made from liver. Many varieties are spread. It usually contains pigs" or calves" liver. Other ingredients are meat (notably veal), fat, and spices

fukuoka.name: Yaki udon
fukuoka.description: The dish is prepared by stir-frying dish consisting of thick, smooth, white udon noodles mixed with a soy-based sauce, meat (usually pork), and Vegetable.

fukuoka.name: Tonkotsu ramen
fukuoka.description: The noodle dish is prepared by boiling the bones in water for a significant amount of time, up to eighteen hours, and the broth is typically cloudy in appearance. Additional broth ingredients can include onion, garlic, spring onions, ginger, pork back fat, pig's trotters, oil and chicken carcasses. The dish is traditionally topped with chāshū (sliced pork belly), and additional ingredients can include kombu, kikurage, shōyu, chili bean paste, sesame seeds and others.
fukuoka.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Schellack assumed (based on copyright claims).

penang.name: Penang hokkien mee
penang.description: The dish primarily consists of rice vermicelli and thicker yellow egg noodles, while the broth is made with prawn heads and shells, and pork ribs. Sliced prawns or shrimps are also added into the dish, along with pork slices, hard boiled eggs, and kangkung.

penang.name: Mee siam
penang.description: The dish consists of thin rice vermicelli of hot, sweet and sour flavours. the dish usually served along any of the followings sides: fried chicken, fried or boiled egg, speciality sambal, otak-otak, and luncheon meat.

kuala lumpur.name: Hokkien char mee
kuala lumpur.description: The dish consists of thick yellow noodles braised in thick dark soy sauce with pork, squid, fish cake and cabbage as the main ingredients and cubes of pork fat fried until crispy (sometimes pork liver is included).

makassar.name: Mie kering
makassar.description: The dish is a type of dried noodle served with thick gravy and sliced chicken, shrimp, mushrooms, liver, and squid.

makassar.name: Konro
makassar.description: This soup is made with ribs, such as spareribs or beef as main ingredient. The soup is brown-black in color and eaten either with rice cake cut into bite-size pieces or rice. The spicy and strong-tasting soup is made from a mixture of rich spices, which includes coriander, a fruit that gives it its blackish color, also small amount of nutmeg, turmeric, galangal, cinnamon, tamarind, lemongrass, clove, and  bayleaf.

tibet.name: Laping
tibet.description: The dish is a spicy cold plain flour noodle dish basically garnished with tsulazi (chilli oil), soy sauce, vinegar, etc,. It is made of mungbean starch.

tibet.name: Thenthuk
tibet.description: The noodle dish is made of wheat flour dough, mixed Vegetable and some pieces of mutton or yak meat.

tibet.name: Thukpa bhatuk
tibet.description: The dish is made of noodle. Meat is usually a main ingredient in this soup, commonly mutton, beef or yak; however, this soup can also be made vegetarian with a vegetable bouillon.

tibet.name: Momo
tibet.description: The dumplings are prepared with ground/minced meat, potatoes, and leek filling.

tibet.name: Tingmo
tibet.description: The dish is a steamed bun with shape similar to flower rolls with soft and fluffy texture.

tibet.name: Khapse
tibet.description: The dish is a deep-fried biscuit. The dough is usually made with flour, eggs, butter and sugar and is then shaped into different shapes and sizes. Some are sprinkled with powdered sugar, while other shapes, such as the donkey ear-shaped, are decorative.

tibet.name: Balep korkun
tibet.description: A type of bread that is round, flat and relatively easy to make. The ingredients are barley flour, water and baking powder. It is cooked in a frying pan.

tibet.name: Sha phaley
tibet.description: The dish consists of bread stuffed with seasoned meat and cabbage, which is then fashioned into semi-circular or circular shapes and which according to regional variations is either deep fried or pan fried like pot stickers.

xinjiang.name: Laghman
xinjiang.description: The dish is prepared with meat (mainly lamb or beef), Vegetable and pulled long noodles. The Vegetable usually include bell peppers, eggplants, radish, potatoes, onions, garlic, and spices.

mandalay.name: Nan gyi thohk
mandalay.description: The dish is made with thick round rice noodles mixed with specially prepared chicken curry and chili oil. The dish is garnished with toasted chickpea flour, sliced onions, chilis, crispy noodles, slices of hard-boiled egg, fish cakes, and zested with lime or lemon.

mandalay.name: Nan gyi thoke
mandalay.description: The dish is made with thick round rice noodles mixed with specially prepared chicken curry and chili oil.

sichuan.name: Dandan noodles
sichuan.description: The dish consists of a spicy sauce usually containing preserved Vegetable (often including zha cai, lower enlarged mustard stems, or ya cai, upper mustard stems), chili oil, Sichuan pepper, minced pork, and scallions served over noodles. The dish can either be served dry or as a noodle soup.

sichuan.name: Hot and sour noodles
sichuan.description: The noodles are made from starch derived from peas, potato, sweet potato, or rice. Its unique flavor combines the sourness from Chinese rice vinegar with the spiciness from chili pepper oil. Ground toasted peanuts and soybeans on top of the noodles add crispness. Besides rice vinegar, chili oil and peanuts/soybeans, other ingredients include sugar, salt, soy sauce, scallion pieces, and smashed garlic.

sichuan.name: Thenthuk
sichuan.description: The noodle dish is made of wheat flour dough, mixed Vegetable and some pieces of mutton or yak meat.

sichuan.name: Wonton
sichuan.description: This dish is a type of dumpling. The are several common regional variations of shape, but the most versatile shape is a simple right triangle, made by folding the square wrapper in half by pulling together two diagonally opposite corners. The most common filling is ground pork or chicken and shrimp with a small amount of flour added as a binder.

wuhan.name: Hot dry noodles
wuhan.description: The dish contains soy sauce, sesame paste, pickled Vegetable (carrots and beans), chopped garlic chives and chili oil.

lanzhou.name: Lanzhou beef noodle soup
lanzhou.description: The dish consist of hand-pulled lamian noodles, and clear consommé broth made from stewed beef. It often uses qingzhen (halal) meat and contains no soy sauce, resulting in a lighter taste that may be flavored by salt and herbs.

guangxi.name: Luosifen
guangxi.description: The dish consists of rice noodles boiled and served in a soup. The stock that forms the soup is made by stewing river snails and pork bones for several hours with black cardamom, fennel seed, dried tangerine peel, cassia bark, cloves, white pepper, bay leaf, licorice root, sand ginger, and star anise. It is served with pickled bamboo shoot, pickled green beans, shredded wood ear, fu zhu, fresh green Vegetable, peanuts, and chili oil added to the soup.

suzhou.name: Su-style noodles
suzhou.description: The dish is a combination of soup, noodles, and toppings. There are two types of soup for this dish: red soup and white soup. Both types of soup start with a slowly cooked base soup. The recipe depends on the noodle restaurant. It can be eel bone, green shell snail, pork bone, chicken, pork, or ham.

suzhou.name: Shengjian mantou
suzhou.description: This dish is a small, pan-fried bun with pork filling.

gyeonggi.name: Jat-guksu
gyeonggi.description: The dish consists of wheat flour or buckwheat noodles in a bowl of cold broth made from ground pine nuts.

massachusetts.name: Chow mein sandwich
massachusetts.description: The dish consists of a brown gravy-based chow mein mixture placed between halves of a hamburger-style bun.

massachusetts.name: Black and white cookie
massachusetts.description: The dish is round cookies iced or frosted in two colors, with one half vanilla and the other chocolate. It is slightly dome-shaped (convex), has frosting on a fluffy angel cake base
massachusetts.photoCredit: The original uploader was Punkitra at English Wikipedia .

massachusetts.name: Chocolate chip cookie
massachusetts.description: The dish is a drop cookie that features chocolate chips or chocolate morsels as its distinguishing ingredient.

massachusetts.name: Snickerdoodle
massachusetts.description: The dish is a type of cookie made with flour, fat, sugar, and salt, and rolled in cinnamon sugar. Eggs may also sometimes be used as an ingredient, with cream of tartar and baking soda added to leaven the dough. They are characterized by a cracked surface and can be either crisp or soft depending on the ingredients used.
massachusetts.photoCredit: jim Winstead from los angeles, usa

new york.name: Chicken riggies
new york.description: The dish is a pasta-based dish typically consisting of chicken, rigatoni, and hot or sweet peppers in a spicy cream and tomato sauce.

new york.name: New York-style cheesecake
new york.description: The dish is a baked cream cheese that is firm on the outside with a soft and creamy texture on the inside. These dishes are often made in a greased cake pan and are relatively fluffy in texture. The crust used with this style is most commonly made from shortbread that is crushed and mixed with sugar and butter.

new york.name: Black and white cookie
new york.description: The dish is round cookies iced or frosted in two colors, with one half vanilla and the other chocolate. It is slightly dome-shaped (convex), has frosting on a fluffy angel cake base
new york.photoCredit: The original uploader was Punkitra at English Wikipedia .

new york.name: Snickerdoodle
new york.description: The dish is a type of cookie made with flour, fat, sugar, and salt, and rolled in cinnamon sugar. Eggs may also sometimes be used as an ingredient, with cream of tartar and baking soda added to leaven the dough. They are characterized by a cracked surface and can be either crisp or soft depending on the ingredients used.
new york.photoCredit: jim Winstead from los angeles, usa

new york.name: Eggs Benedict
new york.description: The dish consists of two halves of an english muffin, each topped with bacon, a poached egg, and hollandaise sauce.

hanoi.name: Bún ốc
hanoi.description: The dish contains broth, snails, and tofu as its basic characteristics but it can also contain green bananas, some fresh Vegetable or chopped water spinach, bean sprouts, water dropwort, tomatoes, and other ingredients.

hanoi.name: Pâté chaud
hanoi.description: The dish is a savory puff pastry. The pastry is made of a light layered and flaky exterior with a meat filling. Traditionally, the filling consists of ground pork, but chicken and beef are also now commonly used.

tokyo.name: Tsukemen
tokyo.description: The dish consists of noodles that are eaten after being dipped in a separate bowl of soup or broth.

tokyo.name: Hello Panda
tokyo.description: The dish is a type of filling biscuits, each biscuit consists of a small hollow shortbread layer, filled with crème of various flavors. On some biscuits are printed cartoon style depictions of giant pandas doing various activities, such as fencing and archery, and also in the United States, other activities such as hockey and baseball.

tokyo.name: Anpan
tokyo.description: Sweet roll most commonly filled with red bean paste. It can also be prepared with other fillings, including white beans, green beans, sesame, and chestnuts.

tokyo.name: Tokyo Banana
tokyo.description: The dish is banana-shaped sponge cake with cream filling.

tokyo.name: Katsu-sando
tokyo.description: This dish is a sandwich which made of deep-fried pork cutlet between slices of bread.
tokyo.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Fg2 assumed (based on copyright claims).

milan.name: Cotoletta alla milanese
milan.description: The dish consists of veal rib chop or sirloin bone-in and made into a breaded cutlet, fried in butter.

milan.name: Panettone
milan.description: The dish is characterized by its cupola shape, which extends from a cylindrical base and is usually about 12–15 cm (4.7–5.9 in) high for a dish weighing 1 kg (2.2 lb).
milan.photoCredit: N i c o l a from Fiumicino (Rome), Italy

mtskheta-mtianeti.name: Khinkali
mtskheta-mtianeti.description: The dish is made of twisted knobs of dough, stuffed with meat, fish or Vegetable and spices.

poland.name: Pierogi
poland.description: The filled dumplings made by wrapping unleavened dough around a filling and cooked in boiling water.

poland.name: Racuchy
poland.description: The dish is made from flour, milk, eggs, sugar and a pinch of salt. It is made with yeast or, in other versions, baking powder or baking soda. The dish pan fried in oil.

poland.name: Poppy seed roll
poland.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

poland.name: Rugelach
poland.description: The dish is a filled baked confection. Traditional are made in the form of a crescent by rolling a triangle of dough around a filling. An alternative form is constructed much like a strudel or nut roll, but unlike those, the rolled dough and filling are cut into slices before baking.

poland.name: Torpedo dessert
poland.description: The dish is a buttery, flaky bread roll, filled with pastry cream, named for its well-known torpedo shape. It is made of a layered yeast-leavened dough. The dough is layered with butter, rolled and folded several times in succession, then rolled into a sheet, in a technique called laminating. The process results in a layered, flaky texture, similar to a puff pastry.

poland.name: Babka
poland.description: A sweet braided bread prepared with a yeast-leavened dough that is rolled out and spread with a filling such as chocolate, cinnamon, fruit, or cheese, then rolled up and braided before baking.

poland.name: Bagel
poland.description: Traditionally made from yeasted wheat dough that is shaped by hand into a torus or ring, briefly boiled in water, and then baked. The result is a dense, chewy, doughy interior with a browned and sometimes crisp exterior. They are often topped with seeds baked on the outer crust—traditional choices include poppy and sesame seeds—or with salt grains.

poland.name: Bialy
poland.description: A chewy yeast roll bearing similarity to the bagel, it has a diameter of up to 15 centimetres (6 in). It is simply baked with a depression in the middle. It is also usually covered with onion flakes. Before baking, the depression is sometimes filled with diced onion and other ingredients, such as garlic, poppy seeds, or bread crumbs.

poland.name: Christmas wafer
poland.description: This dish is baked from pure wheat flour and water, are usually rectangular in shape and very thin; they are identical in composition to the altar bread.
poland.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Julo assumed (based on copyright claims).

poland.name: Potato bread
poland.description: The dish is a form of bread in which potato flour or potato replaces a portion of the regular wheat flour.

poland.name: Salo
poland.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

poland.name: Borscht
poland.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

poland.name: Sorrel soup
poland.description: A soup made from water or broth, sorrel leaves, and salt. Usually includes further ingredients such as egg yolks or whole eggs (hard-boiled or scrambled), potatoes, carrots, parsley root, and rice.

poland.name: Dressed herring
poland.description: A layered salad composed of diced spekesild covered with layers of grated boiled eggs, Vegetable (potatoes, carrots, beetroots), chopped onions, and mayonnaise

poland.name: Syrniki
poland.description: Pancake made of creamy fermented milk, mixed with flour, eggs and sugar, sometimes adding vanilla extract, mix well and then pan-fried or shallow-fried.
poland.photoCredit: Tatyana Morozyuk, color processing by Off-shell

poland.name: Angel wings
poland.description: A traditional sweet crisp pastry made out of dough that has been shaped into thin twisted ribbons, deep-fried and sprinkled with powdered sugar.

poland.name: Chrain
poland.description: This dish has white and red type. The white consists of grated horseradish and vinegar, and sometimes sugar and salt, while red type includes the addition of beetroot

poland.name: Smetana
poland.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

poland.name: Kutia
poland.description: This dish is a ceremonial grain dish with sweet gravy traditionally served during the Christmas – Feast of Jordan holiday season or as part of a funeral feast. The main ingredients are wheatberries, poppy seeds, honey or sugar, various nuts and sometimes raisins.

poland.name: Kasha
poland.description: This dish can be baked but most often is boiled, either in water or milk. The main ingredients are cereal (buckwheat, wheat, barley, oats, millet or rye).

poland.name: Curd snack
poland.description: The main part this snack is made from cheese, which is mixed with sugar, sweeteners or other ingredients and milled into a homogenous paste that is pressed into the desired shape and filled with jam or other fillings. The formed bars then pass through the so-called "glaze waterfall" that coats them in chocolate or another type of glaze. Finally, the snacks are cooled in a cooling tunnel and packed.

poland.name: Pryanik
poland.description: These sweets refer to a range of traditional sweet-baked goods and are made from flour and honey.

poland.name: Gołąbki
poland.description: The dish is a cabbage leaves wrapped around a filling of minced pork or beef, chopped onions, and rice.

poland.name: Zrazy
poland.description: The dish is a meat roulade with a rolled shape and made from thin slices of beef, flavored with salt and pepper and stuffed with Vegetable, mushrooms, eggs, and potatoes.

poland.name: Helzel
poland.description: The dish is a sausage made from poultry neck skin stuffed with flour, bread crumbs, and fried onions, sewn up with a thread.
poland.photoCredit: Wizard85 (original file) ; Off-shell (cropped and reprocessed version)

poland.name: Rissole
poland.description: This dish is a ball or flattened cake of chopped meat, fish, or Vegetable mixed with herbs or spices, then coated in breadcrumbs and fried.

poland.name: Stuffed racuchy
poland.description: This dish is a type of pancake stuffed with slices of apple and served with sugar. In more modern versions, other druit can be used like bananas. There is also a savoury sweet version of this dish, filled with potatoes.

poland.name: Holishkes
poland.description: This dish is prepared from blanched cabbage leaves wrapped in a parcel-like manner around minced meat and then simmered in tomato sauce. Sometimes rice is added to the meat filling.

poland.name: Nut roll
poland.description: A sweet yeast dough is rolled flat, and filled with spread usually walnuts spread or poppy seed. The filled dough is rolled up, forming a log or loaf shape, then baked.

poland.name: Flaki
poland.description: This dish is a soup usually made with thin, cleaned strips of beef tripe.

poland.name: Kogel mogel
poland.description: The dish is made from egg yolks, sugar, and flavourings such as honey, vanilla, cocoa or rum. In its classic form it is served slightly chilled or at room temperature. Served warm or hot, it is considered a home remedy for sore throats.

poland.name: Meringue
poland.description: The dish is a light, airy dessert or candy made from whipped egg whites and sugar, sometimes with an acidic ingredient like lemon, vinegar, or cream of tartar. A binding agent such as salt, flour, or gelatin may be added. Egg whites are whipped until stiff peaks form by denaturing the protein ovalbumin through mechanical mixing.

poland.name: Kishka
poland.description: The dish refers to various types of sausage or stuffed intestine with a filling made from a combination of meat and meal, often grain or potato.

poland.name: Aspic
poland.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

ukraine.name: Varenyky
ukraine.description: The filled dumplings made by wrapping unleavened dough around a filling and cooked in boiling water.

ukraine.name: Oladyi
ukraine.description: The dish is a small thick pancakes or fritters. The batter is made from wheat or (nowadays more rarely) buckwheat flour, eggs, milk, salt, and sugar with yeast or baking soda. The batter may also contain kefir, soured milk or yoghurt. The dish may also include various additions, such as apple or raisins.

ukraine.name: Plăcintă
ukraine.description: This dish is a and traditional pastry resembling a thin, small round or square-shaped cake, usually filled with apples or a soft cheese such.

ukraine.name: Poppy seed roll
ukraine.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

ukraine.name: Babka
ukraine.description: A sweet braided bread prepared with a yeast-leavened dough that is rolled out and spread with a filling such as chocolate, cinnamon, fruit, or cheese, then rolled up and braided before baking.

ukraine.name: Bublik
ukraine.description: A ring of yeast-leavened wheat dough from flour, milk, sugar, butter, salt, egg whites, that has been boiled in water for a short time before baking.
ukraine.photoCredit: Original image: Ural-66 ; reprocessed version by Off-shell

ukraine.name: Kholodets
ukraine.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients.These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

ukraine.name: Salo
ukraine.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

ukraine.name: Rassolnik
ukraine.description: The dish is a kind of soup made from pickled cucumbers, pearl barley, and pork or beef kidneys.

ukraine.name: Borscht
ukraine.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

ukraine.name: Solyanka
ukraine.description: A thick sour soup with cabbage, salted cucumbers, meat, poultry, fish, or mushrooms

ukraine.name: Sorrel soup
ukraine.description: A soup made from water or broth, sorrel leaves, and salt. Usually includes further ingredients such as egg yolks or whole eggs (hard-boiled or scrambled), potatoes, carrots, parsley root, and rice.

ukraine.name: Dressed herring
ukraine.description: A layered salad composed of diced spekesild covered with layers of grated boiled eggs, Vegetable (potatoes, carrots, beetroots), chopped onions, and mayonnaise

ukraine.name: Syrniki
ukraine.description: Pancake made of creamy fermented milk, mixed with flour, eggs and sugar, sometimes adding vanilla extract, mix well and then pan-fried or shallow-fried.
ukraine.photoCredit: Tatyana Morozyuk, color processing by Off-shell

ukraine.name: Chicken Kiev
ukraine.description: A dish made of chicken fillet pounded and rolled around cold butter, then coated with egg and bread crumbs, and either fried or baked.

ukraine.name: Korovai
ukraine.description: A large round braided bread, traditionally baked from wheat flour and decorated with symbolic flags and figurines, such as suns, moons, birds, animals, and pine cones

ukraine.name: Varenye
ukraine.description: Whole fruit preservation made by cooking berries, other fruits, or more rarely nuts, Vegetable, or flowers, in sugar syrup (sometimes honey)

ukraine.name: Angel wings
ukraine.description: A traditional sweet crisp pastry made out of dough that has been shaped into thin twisted ribbons, deep-fried and sprinkled with powdered sugar.

ukraine.name: Chrain
ukraine.description: This dish has white and red type. The white consists of grated horseradish and vinegar, and sometimes sugar and salt, while red type includes the addition of beetroot

ukraine.name: Smetana
ukraine.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

ukraine.name: Sushki
ukraine.description: It is a small, crunchy, mildly sweet bread rings eaten for dessert, usually with tea or coffee. Typical ingredients are flour, eggs, water, and salt, which are combined into a firm dough. This is then cut and rolled into thin strips of about half a centimetre thickness which are formed into rings, briefly cooked in boiling sugar water, then baked in an oven.

ukraine.name: Kulich
ukraine.description: This bread is round and tall, and dough decorations were made on top of it.

ukraine.name: Kutia
ukraine.description: This dish is a ceremonial grain dish with sweet gravy traditionally served during the Christmas – Feast of Jordan holiday season or as part of a funeral feast. The main ingredients are wheatberries, poppy seeds, honey or sugar, various nuts and sometimes raisins.

ukraine.name: Kasha
ukraine.description: This dish can be baked but most often is boiled, either in water or milk. The main ingredients are cereal (buckwheat, wheat, barley, oats, millet or rye).

ukraine.name: Paskha
ukraine.description: It is a molded dessert that is made of cheese (such as cottage cheese), cream, and usually raisins, candied fruit, and almonds and that is traditionally served at Easter.

ukraine.name: Curd snack
ukraine.description: The main part this snack is made from cheese, which is mixed with sugar, sweeteners or other ingredients and milled into a homogenous paste that is pressed into the desired shape and filled with jam or other fillings. The formed bars then pass through the so-called "glaze waterfall" that coats them in chocolate or another type of glaze. Finally, the snacks are cooled in a cooling tunnel and packed.

ukraine.name: Pryanik
ukraine.description: These sweets refer to a range of traditional sweet-baked goods and are made from flour and honey.

ukraine.name: Chebureki
ukraine.description: The dish is a fried turnovers with a filling of ground or minced meat and onions.

ukraine.name: Helzel
ukraine.description: The dish is a sausage made from poultry neck skin stuffed with flour, bread crumbs, and fried onions, sewn up with a thread.
ukraine.photoCredit: Wizard85 (original file) ; Off-shell (cropped and reprocessed version)

ukraine.name: Pampushka
ukraine.description: This dish is a small savoury or sweet yeast-raised bun or doughnut. Traditionally they are baked, but may also be fried. The savoury version have no filling, while the sweet version may be filled with fruits, berries, or poppy seeds, and topped with powdered sugar.

ukraine.name: Holishkes
ukraine.description: This dish is prepared from blanched cabbage leaves wrapped in a parcel-like manner around minced meat and then simmered in tomato sauce. Sometimes rice is added to the meat filling.

ukraine.name: Kishka
ukraine.description: The dish refers to various types of sausage or stuffed intestine with a filling made from a combination of meat and meal, often grain or potato.

ukraine.name: Aspic
ukraine.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

ulaanbaatar.name: Buuz
ulaanbaatar.description: The dish is steamed dumpling filled with meat.

guangzhou.name: Shumai
guangzhou.description: The dish is a type of dumpling made of ground pork.

guangzhou.name: Egg tart
guangzhou.description: The dish consists of an outer pastry crust filled with egg custard.

hohhot.name: Shumai
hohhot.description: The dish is a type of dumpling made of ground pork.

inner mongolia.name: Shumai
inner mongolia.description: The dish is a type of dumpling made of ground pork.

hiroshima.name: Okonomiyaki
hiroshima.description: The dish is a savory pancake dish consisting of wheat flour batter and other ingredients (mixed, or as toppings) cooked on a flat griddle. Common additions include cabbage, meat, and seafood, and toppings include sauce made from Worcestershire sauce, dried seaweed flakes, bonito flakes, mayonnaise, and pickled ginger.

kathmandu valley.name: Chataamari
kathmandu valley.description: The dish is made of rice crepe with meat and egg topping.

kathmandu valley.name: Sapu Mhicha
kathmandu valley.description: This dish is made up of buffalo leaf tripe stuffed with bone marrow.

bavaria.name: Kaiserschmarrn
bavaria.description: The dish is a light, caramelized pancake made from a sweet batter using flour, eggs, sugar, salt, and milk, fried in butter.

bavaria.name: Germknödel
bavaria.description: The dish is a fluffy yeast dough dumpling filled with spiced plum jam and served with melted butter and a mix of poppy seeds and sugar on top.

bavaria.name: Springerle
bavaria.description: The dish is a type of biscuit or cookie with an embossed design made by pressing a mold onto rolled dough and allowing the impression to dry before baking. This preserves the detail of the surface pattern.

bavaria.name: Schuxen
bavaria.description: The dish is an elongate fried dough pastry made from rye flour and yeast. Nowadays they are rare, and few bakers produce them.
bavaria.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Mm de assumed (based on copyright claims).

bavaria.name: Lye roll
bavaria.description: The dish is typically covered with salt, preferably pretzel salt.

bavaria.name: Weisswurst
bavaria.description: It is a mild, pale sausage made from finely ground veal and pork, typically boiled and served with mustard and pretzels.

wales.name: Crempog
wales.description: The dish is made with flour, buttermilk, eggs, vinegar and salted butter. Traditionally made on bakestones or griddles.

wales.name: Bara brith
wales.description: The bread is made by mixing flour (either white or self-raising), yeast (if not using self-raising flour), butter, mixed dried fruit (such as raisins, currants and sultanas), mixed spices and an egg. Some recipes favour soaking the dried fruit in tea overnight before the baking. This mixture is then proved to allow fermentation to take place. After an initial period, the air is knocked out of the mixture and it is allowed to prove once more. This period of preparation can take up to two hours, including the resting time for the bread mixture. It is then baked in an oven. It is traditionally served at tea time, alongside tea. It is normally served in slices with butter spread on one side.

wales.name: Tatws Pum Munud
wales.description: The dish is a traditional stew, made with smoked bacon, stock, potatoes and other Vegetable.

wales.name: Pottage
wales.description: The dish is a thick soup or stew made by boiling Vegetable, grains, and, if available, meat or fish.

wales.name: Saveloy
wales.description: This dish is a type of highly seasoned sausage, usually bright red, normally boiled and available in fish and chip shops. It is sometimes also available fried in batter.

wales.name: Nori
wales.description: This is a dried edible seaweed. It has a strong and distinctive flavor, and is generally made into flat sheets and used to wrap rolls.

scotland.name: Bannock
scotland.description: The dish is a flatbread or quick bread made with baking powder or baking soda as a leavening agent, giving them a light and airy texture.

scotland.name: Lucky tattie
scotland.description: The dish is made of a white fondant solid core flavoured with cassia, and steamed and covered with cinnamon powder.

scotland.name: Caramel shortbread
scotland.description: The dish is confectionery composed of a shortbread biscuit base topped with caramel and milk chocolate.

scotland.name: Empire biscuit
scotland.description: The dish is a type of sweet biscuit that has a layer of jam in between two biscuits, typically shortbread. The top is covered with white water icing, usually decorated with a glace cherry in the centre, but Dew Drops are common too.

scotland.name: Shortbread
scotland.description: The dish is made from one part white sugar, two parts butter and three to four parts plain wheat flour. It does not contain any leavening, such as baking powder or baking soda. It is widely associated with Christmas and Daft days festivities.

scotland.name: Black bun
scotland.description: A type of fruit cake completely covered with pastry. The cake mixture typically contains raisins, currants, almonds, citrus peel, allspice, ginger, cinnamon and black pepper.

scotland.name: Scotch pie
scotland.description: A small, double-crust meat pie, traditionally filled with minced mutton but now generally beef, sometimes lamb.

scotland.name: Potato bread
scotland.description: The dish is a form of bread in which potato flour or potato replaces a portion of the regular wheat flour.

scotland.name: Haggis
scotland.description: The dish is a savoury pudding containing sheep's pluck, minced with chopped onion, oatmeal, suet, spices, and salt.

scotland.name: Calf's liver and bacon
scotland.description: This dish is made with slices of bacon that are fried, and slices of veal liver (often covered in flour) are sauteed in the rendered fat. The bacon and slices of liver are placed in a dish and covered with a gravy made with the fond.

scotland.name: Maconochie
scotland.description: The dish is a canned stew of sliced turnips, carrots, potatoes, onions, haricot beans, and beef in a thin broth.

scotland.name: Black pudding
scotland.description: This dish is made from pork or occasionally beef blood, with pork fat or beef suet, and a cereal, usually oatmeal, oat groats, or barley groats. It has a high proportion of cereal, along with the use of certain herbs such as pennyroyal.

scotland.name: Stornoway black pudding
scotland.description: This is a type of black pudding. Black pudding is a distinct type of blood sausage. It is made from pork or occasionally beef blood, with pork fat or beef suet, and a cereal, usually oatmeal, oat groats, or barley groats. The high proportion of cereal, along with the use of certain herbs such as pennyroyal, distinguishes black pudding from blood sausages eaten in other parts of the world.

scotland.name: Lorne sausage
scotland.description: This sausage dish is a traditional food item made from minced meat, rusk and spices.

rhode island.name: Johnnycake
rhode island.description: The dish is an unleavened cornbread made of cornmeal, salt, and water. Early cooks set thick corn dough on a wooden board or barrel stave, which they leaned on a piece of wood or a rock in front of an open fire to bake.

rhode island.name: Black and white cookie
rhode island.description: The dish is round cookies iced or frosted in two colors, with one half vanilla and the other chocolate. It is slightly dome-shaped (convex), has frosting on a fluffy angel cake base
rhode island.photoCredit: The original uploader was Punkitra at English Wikipedia .

rhode island.name: Snickerdoodle
rhode island.description: The dish is a type of cookie made with flour, fat, sugar, and salt, and rolled in cinnamon sugar. Eggs may also sometimes be used as an ingredient, with cream of tartar and baking soda added to leaven the dough. They are characterized by a cracked surface and can be either crisp or soft depending on the ingredients used.
rhode island.photoCredit: jim Winstead from los angeles, usa

liguria.name: Farinata
liguria.description: The dish is a type of thin, unleavened pancake or crêpe made from chickpea flour.

liguria.name: Pinolate
liguria.description: The dish is a type of cookie light golden color and studded with golden pine nuts (pinoli in Italian). Made with almond paste and egg whites, they are moist, soft and chewy.

provence.name: Farinata
provence.description: The dish is a type of thin, unleavened pancake or crêpe made from chickpea flour.

provence.name: Fougasse
provence.description: It is used to make a regional version of a calzone, commonly filled with cheese and small strips of bacon inside the pocket made by folding the bread over. Other variations include dried fruit, a type of blue cheese and nuts, or olives and goat cheese.

tehran.name: Chelow kabab
tehran.description: This dish consists of steamed rice (čelow) and one of the many varieties of kebab. This dish is served with accompaniments such as butter, sumac powder, basil, onions, and grilled tomatoes.

tehran.name: Kabab koobideh
tehran.description: This dish is a type of kofta kabab made from ground lamb or beef, often mixed with ground pepper and chopped onions.

chengdu.name: Mapo tofu
chengdu.description: This dish consists of tofu set in a spicy sauce, typically a thin, oily, and bright red suspension, based on douban (fermented broad bean and chili paste), and douchi (fermented black beans), along with minced meat, traditionally beef

lagos.name: Akara
lagos.description: The dish is a fritter made from cowpeas or beans, sometimes seasoned with salt, pepper, and chopped onions molded into the shape of large scone.

lagos.name: Moin moin
lagos.description: The dish is a steamed or boiled bean pudding made from a mixture of washed and peeled beans and onions, fresh red peppers, spices, and often fish, eggs,chicken and/or crayfish.

tunisia.name: Couscous
tunisia.description: This dish is small steamed granules of rolled semolina that is often served with a stew spooned on top. Pearl millet, sorghum, bulgur, and other cereals are sometimes cooked in a similar way in other regions.

tunisia.name: Empanada
tunisia.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

tunisia.name: Ka'ak
tunisia.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

tunisia.name: Msemmen
tunisia.description: The dish is a flatbread folded into square pancakes with multiple internal layers and cooked on a griddle, usually served with honey or a cup of aromatic morning mint tea or coffee.

tunisia.name: Usban
tunisia.description: This dish is a traditional kind of sausage stuffed with a mixture of rice, herbs, lamb, chopped liver and heart. This dish is usually served alongside the main meal of rice or couscous, often on special occasions.

tunisia.name: Tajine
tunisia.description: This dish consists of meat, fruit, Vegetable, and spices that are cooked together very slowly.

tunisia.name: Chermoula
tunisia.description: It is traditionally used to flavor fish or seafood, but it can be used on other meats or Vegetable. Common ingredients include garlic, cumin, coriander, oil, lemon juice, and salt. Regional variations may also include preserved lemons, onion, ground chili peppers, black pepper, saffron, and other herbs.

tunisia.name: Ful medames
tunisia.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

tunisia.name: Shakshouka
tunisia.description: The dish is a poached egg in a sauce of tomatoes, olive oils, peppers, onion, and garlic, commonly with other spices also.

tunisia.name: Lablabi
tunisia.description: The dish is a chickpeas in a thin garlic and cumin broth with crusty bread.

tunisia.name: Kamounia
tunisia.description: The dish is a beef and liver stew prepared with cumin.

tunisia.name: Mulukhiyah
tunisia.description: The dish is a soup made of jute leaves resulting in thick liquid or broth, chopped with garlic, cilantro, and dressed with oil.

tunisia.name: Mesfouf
tunisia.description: The dish is made of peas and beans with sweet taste accompanied by butter and olive oil.

tunisia.name: Merguez
tunisia.description: The dish is a lamb or beef based fresh sausage.

tunisia.name: Matbucha
tunisia.description: The dish is a condiment or cooked salad consisting of cooked tomatoes with roasted bell peppers seasoned with garlic and chili pepper.

tunisia.name: Baba ghanoush
tunisia.description: The dish is an appetizer made of roasted eggplant, olive oil, lemon juice, and various seasonings.

tunisia.name: Brik
tunisia.description: The dish is a stuffed pastry, deep fried with triangular pastry shape. It is made by slapping a sticky lump of dough onto a hot non-stick surface in overlapping circles to produce the desired size and cooked for a short amount of time. Typical fillings include tuna, ground meat, raw egg, chicken, or anchovies garnished with harissa, capers, or cheese.

tunisia.name: Freekeh
tunisia.description: The dish is a roasted and rubbed macarroni wheat.

tunisia.name: Falafel
tunisia.description: The dish is a deep-fried ball or patty-shaped fritter made from broad beans, ground chickpease, or both.

tunisia.name: Stuffed dates
tunisia.description: The dish is a heated dates filled with meat, mint, and parsley with different stuffing including butters and goat cheese.

tunisia.name: Stuffed squid
tunisia.description: This dish is made of made of olive oil, onion, garlic, rice, tomatoes, salt, black pepper, mint leaves, parsley, and tomato juice, with squid as the main ingredient.

tunisia.name: Assidat Zgougou
tunisia.description: The dish is pine nut porridge/cream. It was originally made out of pine, Flour, milk, cream and, nuts.

tunisia.name: Bambalouni
tunisia.description: It is prepared with a flour dough fried in oil. The dish is eaten sprinkled with sugar or soaked in honey.

tunisia.name: Mechouia salad
tunisia.description: This dish is a grilled vegetable, tomatoes, peppers, onions and garlic salad, that may also contain eggplant.

tunisia.name: Fricasse
tunisia.description: This dish is a savory fried pastry often filled with tuna, hard-boiled egg, olives, harissa, preserved lemons, capers and mashed potato, with turmeric as a condiment.

daegu.name: Galbi-jjim
daegu.description: This dish is a stew made with short rib, generally beef or pork.

guatemala.name: Tamale
guatemala.description: The dish made of masa, a dough made from nixtamalized corn, which is steamed in a corn husk or banana leaves.

guatemala.name: Milhojas
guatemala.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

guatemala.name: Rellenitos de plátano
guatemala.description: This is a dish of sweet mashed plantains stuffed with a mixture of refried beans, chocolate, and cinnamon.

guatemala.name: Garnacha
guatemala.description: This is a traditional dish composed of fried corn flatbread topped with refried beans, shredded cabbage, cheese, and other garnishes.

guatemala.name: Frijoles negros
guatemala.description: This dish is a black beans that is typically seasoned with salt, ham hocks, onions and garlic, tomatoes, powdered cumin seeds, oregano and vinegar.

guatemala.name: Longaniza
guatemala.description: This sausage is similar to salchichón, though thinner; both differ from chorizo in that black pepper is used for them instead of paprika and may have different spices in them like nutmeg.
guatemala.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Ardo Beltz assumed (based on copyright claims).

guatemala.name: Tostada
guatemala.description: This food consists of corn and vegetables. It is a flat or bowl-shaped bread that is deep-fried or toasted.

changsha.name: Cha siu bao
changsha.description: This dish is a bun filled with barbecue-flavored pork. They are usually served as dim sum.

kunming.name: Cha siu bao
kunming.description: This dish is a bun filled with barbecue-flavored pork. They are usually served as dim sum.

xiamen.name: Cha siu bao
xiamen.description: This dish is a bun filled with barbecue-flavored pork. They are usually served as dim sum.

tianjin.name: Gaobuli
tianjin.description: This dish is a bun with wrinkles on the outside.

henan.name: Tangbao
henan.description: This dish is a soup buns, a large, soup-filled buns made by wrapping dough which then steamed into soup.

south korea.name: Hoppang
