south korea.description: This dish is a convenience food version of steamed bread and is typically filled with smooth, sweetened red bean paste.

south korea.name: Gyeran-mari
south korea.description: The dish is made with beaten eggs mixed with several finely diced ingredients, fried and rolled.

south korea.name: Morkovcha
south korea.description: It is a spicy marinated carrot salad. It is made of finely julienned carrots, garlic, onion,[4] ground red pepper, ground coriander seeds, vinegar, vegetable oil (or olive oil), salt and pepper. It may also include sesame seeds.

thai.name: Ang ku kueh
thai.description: The dish is red tortoise shaped with skin made of rice flour and sweet potato, whereas the fillings are made of mung bean, peanuts and sugar.

connecticut.name: Steamed cheeseburger
connecticut.description: This dish is a type of hamburger topped with cheese that is cooked via steaming.
connecticut.photoCredit: Connie Ma from United States of America

connecticut.name: Black and white cookie
connecticut.description: The dish is round cookies iced or frosted in two colors, with one half vanilla and the other chocolate. It is slightly dome-shaped (convex), has frosting on a fluffy angel cake base
connecticut.photoCredit: The original uploader was Punkitra at English Wikipedia .

connecticut.name: Snickerdoodle
connecticut.description: The dish is a type of cookie made with flour, fat, sugar, and salt, and rolled in cinnamon sugar. Eggs may also sometimes be used as an ingredient, with cream of tartar and baking soda added to leaven the dough. They are characterized by a cracked surface and can be either crisp or soft depending on the ingredients used.
connecticut.photoCredit: jim Winstead from los angeles, usa

england.name: Steak and kidney pudding
england.description: The dish is a main course in which beef steak and beef, veal, pork or lamb kidney are enclosed in suet pastry and slow-steamed on a stovetop.
england.photoCredit: Kolforn ( Kolforn ) I'd appreciate if you could mail me (Kolforn@gmail.com) if you want to use this picture out of the Wikimedia project scope. england.name: Bread pudding
england.description: The dish is a bread-based dessert. It is made with stale bread and milk or cream, generally containing eggs, a form of fat such as oil, butter or suet and, depending on whether the pudding is sweet or savory, a variety of other ingredients. Sweet version of the dish may use sugar, syrup, honey, dried fruit, nuts, as well as spices such as cinnamon, nutmeg, mace, or vanilla. The bread is soaked in the liquids, mixed with the other ingredients, and baked.

england.name: Animal cracker
england.description: The dish is a particular type of cracker, baked in the shape of an animal, usually an animal either at a zoo or a circus, such as a lion, a tiger, a bear, or an elephant. The most common variety is light-colored and slightly sweet, but darker chocolate-flavored and colorful frosted varieties are also sold.
england.photoCredit: Baseball Bugs Uploaded by Baseball Bugs at en.wikipedia

england.name: Charcoal biscuit
england.description: The dish is a biscuit based on a powdered willow charcoal or activated carbon mixed with ordinary flour, and made into dough with butter, sugar and eggs.

england.name: Gingerbread man
england.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie made from gingerbread, usually in the shape of a stylized human being following seasonal themes.

england.name: Hot cross bun
england.description: The dish is a spiced bun, usually containing small pieces of fruit and marked with a cross on the top.

england.name: Nun's puffs
england.description: This dish is a dessert pastry. The dessert is made from butter, milk, flour, sugar, eggs, and sometimes honey. Recipes call for pan frying (traditionally in lard), re-frying and then baking, or baking straight away. The best-established recipes suggest cooking the butter, milk, and flour in a pan then adding the eggs (whites last) and sprinkling sugar on the mixture before baking.
england.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Žiga assumed (based on copyright claims).

england.name: Pot pie
england.description: The dish is a type of meat pie with a top pie crust that is commonly used throughout the continent, consisting of flaky pastry. It may be made with a variety of fillings including poultry, beef, seafood or plant-based meat substitute fillings, and may also differ in the types of crust.

england.name: Apple pie
england.description: The dish is a pie in which the principal filling is apples. It is often served with whipped cream, ice cream, custard or cheddar cheese. It is generally double-crusted, with pastry both above and below the filling; the upper crust may be solid or latticed (woven of crosswise strips). The bottom crust may be baked separately ("blind") to prevent it from getting soggy. Deep-dish often has a top crust only.

england.name: Bacon and egg pie
england.description: The dish is a savoury pie consisting of a crust containing bacon, egg and sometimes onion, mushrooms, bell peppers, peas, tomato, fresh herbs and cheese. It may be served with ketchup, which can be combined with Worcestershire sauce and drizzled over the filling before the pie is baked[and some versions have a rising agent such as baking powder mixed into the egg to make a fluffier filling.

england.name: Banoffee pie
england.description: The dish is a dessert pie made from bananas, whipped cream, and a thick caramel sauce (made from boiled condensed milk, or milk jam), combined either on a buttery biscuit base or one made from crumbled biscuits and butter. Some versions of the recipe include chocolate, coffee, or both.

england.name: Chess pie
england.description: A dessert with a filling composed mainly of flour, butter, sugar, eggs, and sometimes milk.

england.name: Chicken and mushroom pie
england.description: The outside is usually a full top and bottom crust, with the filling made up of small pieces of chicken and sliced mushrooms in a creamy sauce. The top crust is typically puff pastry. Variations on the theme can use nutmeg or spring onion as part of the creamy filling.

england.name: Cobbler
england.description: A dessert consisting of a fruit filling poured into a large baking dish and covered with a batter, biscuit, or dumpling before being baked.

england.name: Corned beef pie
england.description: Made from corned beef, onion and often thinly sliced, cubed or mashed potato. It can be eaten hot or cold, making it a suitable common picnic food and also a "winter warmer".

england.name: Curry pie
england.description: It is made from curry gravy, usually containing an assortment of fillings and enclosed in a pastry shell.

england.name: Custard tart
england.description: A baked pastry consisting of an outer pastry crust filled with egg custard.

england.name: Fish pie
england.description: The pie is usually made with fresh and smoked fish (for example, cod, haddock, salmon or halibut) or seafood in a white sauce or cheddar cheese sauce made using the milk the fish was poached in.

england.name: Homity pie
england.description: Open vegetable pie which case contains a filling of potatoes and an onion and leek mixture, which is then covered with cheese.

england.name: Mince pie
england.description: A sweet pie filled with mincemeat, being a mixture of fruit, spices and suet.

england.name: Pumpkin pie
england.description: A dessert pie with a spiced, pumpkin-based custard filling. The pie's filling ranges in color from orange to brown and is baked in a single pie shell, usually without a top crust. The pie is generally flavored with pumpkin spice, a blend that includes cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and cloves or allspice. The pie is usually prepared with canned pumpkin, but fresh-cooked pumpkin can be used.

england.name: Rhubarb pie
england.description: A pie with a rhubarb filling.

england.name: Sausage roll
england.description: The basic composition is sheets of puff pastry formed into tubes around sausage meat and glazed with egg or milk before being baked. They can be served either hot or cold.

england.name: Shepherd's pie
england.description: A savoury dish of cooked minced meat topped with mashed potato and baked. The meat used may be either previously cooked or freshly minced. The usual meats are beef or lamb.

england.name: Steak pie
england.description: It is made from stewing steak and beef gravy, enclosed in a pastry shell. Sometimes mixed vegetables are included in the filling.

england.name: Treacle tart
england.description: Tart that is prepared using shortcrust pastry, with a thick filling made of golden syrup (also known as light treacle), breadcrumbs, and lemon juice or zest. The tart is normally served hot or warm with a scoop of clotted cream, ordinary cream, ice cream, or custard. Some modern recipes add cream, eggs, or both in order to create a softer filling.

england.name: Whole wheat bread
england.description: A type of bread made using flour that is partly or entirely milled from whole or almost-whole wheat grains. It is one kind of brown bread. Some varieties of whole-wheat bread are traditionally coated with whole or cracked grains of wheat, though this is mostly decorative compared to the nutritional value of the loaf itself.

england.name: Teacake
england.description: In one region, it is a light yeast-based sweet bun containing dried fruit, typically served toasted and buttered. In other areas can be cookies or small cakes. In another country, they can be soft, round, flat wheat breads made with milk and a little sugar, and used to make buttered ham or cheese sandwiches. In other regions, it is more like a butter cake.

england.name: Soda bread
england.description: A variety of quick bread made in many cuisines in which sodium bicarbonate is used as a leavening agent instead of yeast. The basic ingredients are flour, baking soda, salt, and buttermilk. The buttermilk contains lactic acid, which reacts with the baking soda to form bubbles of carbon dioxide. Other ingredients can be added, such as butter, egg, raisins, or nuts. Quick breads can be prepared quickly and reliably, without requiring the time and labor needed for kneaded yeast breads.

england.name: Cottage loaf
england.description: The bread is characterised by its shape, which is essentially that of two round loaves, one on top of the other, with the upper one being smaller

england.name: English muffin
england.description: Small, round and flat yeast-leavened (sometimes sourdough) bread which is commonly 4 in (10 cm) round and 1.5 in (4 cm) tall made from wheat flour, butter, milk, sugar, salt, egg, and yeast. It is generally split horizontally and served toasted. It is frequently eaten with sweet or savoury toppings such as butter, fruit jam, honey, eggs, sausage, bacon, or cheese.

england.name: Calf's liver and bacon
england.description: This dish is made with slices of bacon that are fried, and slices of veal liver (often covered in flour) are sauteed in the rendered fat. The bacon and slices of liver are placed in a dish and covered with a gravy made with the fond.

england.name: Lancashire hotpot
england.description: This dish consists of lamb or mutton and onion, topped with sliced potatoes and slowly baked in a pot at a low heat.
england.photoCredit: alexcwood Camera location 51° 23′ 55.2″ N, 0° 18′ 02.4″ W View this and other nearby images on: OpenStreetMap 51.398667; -0.300667

england.name: Scouse
england.description: The dish is a type of stew typically made from chunks of meat (usually beef or lamb) with potatoes, carrots, and onion.

england.name: Pottage
england.description: The dish is a thick soup or stew made by boiling Vegetable, grains, and, if available, meat or fish.

england.name: Bath bun
england.description: The dish is a sweet roll made from a milk-based yeast dough with crushed sugar sprinkled on top after baking. Variations in ingredients include enclosing a lump of sugar in the bun or adding candied fruit peel, currants, raisins or sultanas.

england.name: Sally Lunn bun
england.description: The dish is a large bun or teacake, a type of batter bread, made with a yeast dough including cream and eggs. Sometimes served warm and sliced, with butter.

england.name: Pie and peas
england.description: This dish consists of an individual meat pie served with mushy peas, mint sauce, pickled onions or gravy.

england.name: Mushy peas
england.description: These are dried marrowfat peas which are first soaked overnight in water with baking soda, and then rinsed in fresh water, after which the peas are gathered in a saucepan, covered with water, and brought to a boil, and then simmered until the peas are softened. The mush is seasoned with salt and pepper.

england.name: Saveloy
england.description: This dish is a type of highly seasoned sausage, usually bright red, normally boiled and available in fish and chip shops. It is sometimes also available fried in batter.

england.name: Black pudding
england.description: This dish is made from pork or occasionally beef blood, with pork fat or beef suet, and a cereal, usually oatmeal, oat groats, or barley groats. It has a high proportion of cereal, along with the use of certain herbs such as pennyroyal.

england.name: Battered sausage
england.description: They are made up of a pork sausage dipped in batter and usually served with chips.

cheshire.name: Sticky toffee pudding
cheshire.description: The dish is a dessert consisting of a moist sponge cake made with finely chopped dates (optional), covered in a toffee sauce and often served with a vanilla custard or vanilla ice-cream.

cheshire.name: Meat and potato pie
cheshire.description: A pastry casing containing: potato, either lamb or beef, and sometimes carrot and/or onion.

northumberland.name: Sticky toffee pudding
northumberland.description: The dish is a dessert consisting of a moist sponge cake made with finely chopped dates (optional), covered in a toffee sauce and often served with a vanilla custard or vanilla ice-cream.

yorkshire.name: Sticky toffee pudding
yorkshire.description: The dish is a dessert consisting of a moist sponge cake made with finely chopped dates (optional), covered in a toffee sauce and often served with a vanilla custard or vanilla ice-cream.

yorkshire.name: Fat rascal
yorkshire.description: The dish baked as a buttery, flat cake baked in a covered pan among the ashes of a peat fire.

yorkshire.name: Rich tea
yorkshire.description: The dish is a type of sweet biscuit; the ingredients generally include wheat flour, sugar, vegetable oil and malt extract.

yorkshire.name: Meat and potato pie
yorkshire.description: A pastry casing containing: potato, either lamb or beef, and sometimes carrot and/or onion.

ireland.name: Christmas pudding
ireland.description: The dish is sweet, dried-fruit pudding traditionally served as part of Christmas dinner.

ireland.name: Lincoln biscuit
ireland.description: The dish is a circular shortcake biscuit, most commonly decorated on one side with a pattern of raised dots.
ireland.photoCredit: The original uploader was Dark-Fire at English Wikipedia . (original Author: Mark Hogan )

ireland.name: Jambon
ireland.description: The dish is a square pastry filled with cheese and chunks of ham.

ireland.name: Barmbrack
ireland.description: A yeast bread with added sultanas and raisins. An item (often a ring) is placed inside the bread, with the person receiving it considered to be fortunate. It is often served toasted with butter along with a cup of tea.

ireland.name: Farl
ireland.description: Any of various quadrant-shaped flatbreads and cakes, traditionally made by cutting a round into four pieces, made especially with oatmeal or wheat flour.

ireland.name: Scone
ireland.description: The dish is usually made of either wheat flour or oatmeal, with baking powder as a leavening agent, and baked on sheet pans.

ireland.name: Potato bread
ireland.description: The dish is a form of bread in which potato flour or potato replaces a portion of the regular wheat flour.

ireland.name: Rock cake
ireland.description: The dish is a small cake with a rough surface resembling a rock.

ireland.name: Rissole
ireland.description: This dish is a ball or flattened cake of chopped meat, fish, or Vegetable mixed with herbs or spices, then coated in breadcrumbs and fried.

ireland.name: Pigs in blankets
ireland.description: This dish consists of small sausages wrapped in bacon.

ireland.name: Chicken fillet roll
ireland.description: This dish is a baguette filled with a fillet of processed chicken.

ireland.name: Breakfast roll
ireland.description: A bread roll filled with elements of a traditional fried breakfast, like sausages, bacon, pudding, mushrooms, and sauces, commonly served at convenience stores, supermarkets, and casual eateries.

ireland.name: Irish stew
ireland.description: This dish is a stew that is traditionally made with root vegetables and lamb or mutton, but also commonly with beef.
ireland.photoCredit: A Healthier Michigan from Detroit, United States

ireland.name: Skirts and kidneys
ireland.description: The dish is a stew made from pork and pork kidneys.

ireland.name: Black pudding
ireland.description: This dish is made from pork or occasionally beef blood, with pork fat or beef suet, and a cereal, usually oatmeal, oat groats, or barley groats. It has a high proportion of cereal, along with the use of certain herbs such as pennyroyal.

ireland.name: Battered sausage
ireland.description: They are made up of a pork sausage dipped in batter and usually served with chips.

ireland.name: Nori
ireland.description: This is a dried edible seaweed. It has a strong and distinctive flavor, and is generally made into flat sheets and used to wrap rolls.

ireland.name: Kipper
ireland.description: This dish is a whole herring, a small, oily fish, that has been split in a butterfly fashion from tail to head along the dorsal ridge, gutted, salted or pickled, and cold-smoked over smouldering wood chips
ireland.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Gaius Cornelius assumed (based on copyright claims).

new zealand.name: Christmas pudding
new zealand.description: The dish is sweet, dried-fruit pudding traditionally served as part of Christmas dinner.

new zealand.name: Afghan
new zealand.description: The dish is a biscuit made from flour, butter, cornflakes, sugar and cocoa powder, topped with chocolate icing and a half walnut. The recipe has a high proportion of butter, and relatively low sugar, and no leavening (rising agent), giving it a soft, dense and rich texture, with crunchiness from the cornflakes, rather than from a high sugar content. The high butter content gives a soft melt-in-the-mouth texture, and the sweetness of the icing offsets the low sugar and the cocoa bitterness.

new zealand.name: Anzac biscuit
new zealand.description: This biscuit is made using rolled oats, flour, sugar, butter (or margarine), golden syrup, baking soda, boiling water and optionally desiccated coconut.

new zealand.name: Caramel shortbread
new zealand.description: The dish is confectionery composed of a shortbread biscuit base topped with caramel and milk chocolate.

new zealand.name: Ginger snap
new zealand.description: The dish is a biscuit flavoured with ginger. The dish is flavoured with powdered ginger and a variety of other spices, most commonly cinnamon, molasses and clove.

new zealand.name: Rissole
new zealand.description: This dish is a ball or flattened cake of chopped meat, fish, or Vegetable mixed with herbs or spices, then coated in breadcrumbs and fried.

new zealand.name: Boston bun
new zealand.description: The dish is a large spiced bun with a thick layer of coconut icing. Traditionally the bun contains sieved mashed potato, and modern versions sometimes contain raisins or sultanas. It is often served sliced and buttered, to accompany a cup of tea.

new zealand.name: Finger bun
new zealand.description: The dish is a fruit bun. At one time it was a bakery and school staple but its popularity has waned.

new zealand.name: Zucchini slice
new zealand.description: The dish consists of zucchini, eggs, cheese, usually bacon, and flour, baked to form a flat loaf. It is then cut into squares and served as a main dish or a side dish, often eaten for lunch.

new zealand.name: Pavlova
new zealand.description: The dish is a meringue-based dessert, taking the form of a cake-like circular block of baked meringue. It has a crisp crust and is soft, light inside usually topped with fruit and whipped cream.

new zealand.name: Saveloy
new zealand.description: This dish is a type of highly seasoned sausage, usually bright red, normally boiled and available in fish and chip shops. It is sometimes also available fried in batter.

new zealand.name: Battered sausage
new zealand.description: They are made up of a pork sausage dipped in batter and usually served with chips.

south africa.name: Christmas pudding
south africa.description: The dish is sweet, dried-fruit pudding traditionally served as part of Christmas dinner.

south africa.name: Melktert
south africa.description: A sweet pastry crust containing a custard filling made from milk, flour, sugar and eggs.

south africa.name: Potbrood
south africa.description: The dish is a bread traditionally baked in a cast-iron pot in a pit made in the ground and lined with hot coals.

south africa.name: Boerewors
south africa.description: This dish is made from coarsely minced beef, minced pork, lamb and or goat. It also contains spices (usually toasted coriander seed, black pepper, nutmeg, cloves and allspice).

south africa.name: Biltong
south africa.description: This dish is a form of dried, cured meat. Various types of meat are used to produce it, ranging from beef to game meats such as ostrich or kudu. The cut may also vary being either fillets of meat cut into strips following the grain of the muscle, or flat pieces sliced across the grain.

south africa.name: Tomato bredie
south africa.description: This dish is cooked for a very long time, and its seasonings include cinnamon, cardamom, ginger and cloves as well as chilli.

south africa.name: Sosatie
south africa.description: This dish is a traditional dish of meat (usually lamb or mutton) cooked on skewers. The ingredients can include cubes of lamb, beef, chicken, dried apricots, red onions and mixed peppers.

south africa.name: Chakalaka
south africa.description: This dish is usually spicy, that is traditionally served with bread, pap, samp, stews, or curries.
south africa.photoCredit: philipp from cape town, south africa

south africa.name: Delele
south africa.description: This dish is prepared with baking soda and well known for its slimy texture. It can be dried before cooking, but more frequently it is cooked fresh.

south africa.name: Droëwors
south africa.description: This snack is based on the traditional, coriander-seed spiced sausage. It is usually made as a thin sausage rather than thick sausage, as the thinner sausage dries quicker and is thus, less likely to spoil before it can be preserved.

south africa.name: Frikkadel
south africa.description: The dish is a baked or deep-fried meatballs prepared with onion, bread, eggs, vinegar, and spices.

south africa.name: Mala Mogodu
south africa.description: The dish is a combination of chopped tripe and intestines served with dumpling.

south africa.name: Hertzoggie
south africa.description: The dish is a jam-fileed tartlet or cookie commonly served on a cup pastry base.

south africa.name: Mealie bread
south africa.description: The dish is a bread baked with creamed corn with butter.

south africa.name: Malva pudding
south africa.description: The dish is a spongy caramelised texture pudding, made with apricot jam, served with custard and/or ice cream.

south africa.name: Koeksister
south africa.description: The dish is a confectionery made of fried dough infused in syrup or honey.

south africa.name: Chicken feet
south africa.description: This dish is a part of chicken which cooked and eaten in many countries. This dish has a distinct gelatinous texture different from the rest of the chicken meat.

south africa.name: Bobotie
south africa.description: The dish consists of spiced minced meat baked with an egg-based topping.

south africa.name: Potjiekos
south africa.description: The dish is made by first adding cooking oil to a potjie, and placed on a fire until hot. Meat is added, typically lamb or pork. The meat is spiced and often a form of alcohol is added for flavor - mostly beer or a dessert wine.

south africa.name: Vetkoek
south africa.description: The dish is a fried dough similar in shape to a doughnut without a hole, and is made with a yeast dough. The dish is also often made alongside a curry mince, which is stuffed inside.

south africa.name: South Asian pickle
south africa.description: It is a pickled food made from a variety of vegetables, meats and fruits preserved in brine, vinegar, edible oils, and various spices.

canada.name: Christmas pudding
canada.description: The dish is sweet, dried-fruit pudding traditionally served as part of Christmas dinner.

canada.name: Maple leaf cream cookie
canada.description: The dish is a sandwich cookies. The cream filling is maple-flavoured, and may contain real maple syrup.

canada.name: Blueberry pie
canada.description: A pie with a blueberry filling and is readily made because it does not require pitting or peeling of fruit. It usually has a top and bottom crust. The top crust can be circular, but the pie can also have a crumble crust or no top crust.

canada.name: Bumbleberry pie
canada.description: A mixed berry pie. It is made of at least three kinds of berries. This pie often also contains apple and/or rhubarb. Berries commonly used in this pie may include blueberries, raspberries, strawberries, and blackberries.

canada.name: Butter tart
canada.description: A type of small pastry tart consists of a filling of butter, sugar, syrup, and egg, baked in a pastry shell until the filling is semi-solid with a crunchy top.

canada.name: Cherry pie
canada.description: A pie baked with a cherry filling. Traditionally, it is made with sour cherries rather than sweet cherries. Morello cherries are one of the most common kinds of cherry used, but other varieties such as the black cherry may also be used.

canada.name: Flapper pie
canada.description: A vanilla custard pie topped with meringue (or sometimes whipped cream) within a graham cracker crust.

canada.name: Pumpkin pie
canada.description: A dessert pie with a spiced, pumpkin-based custard filling. The pie's filling ranges in color from orange to brown and is baked in a single pie shell, usually without a top crust. The pie is generally flavored with pumpkin spice, a blend that includes cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and cloves or allspice. The pie is usually prepared with canned pumpkin, but fresh-cooked pumpkin can be used.

canada.name: Whole wheat bread
canada.description: A type of bread made using flour that is partly or entirely milled from whole or almost-whole wheat grains. It is one kind of brown bread. Some varieties of whole-wheat bread are traditionally coated with whole or cracked grains of wheat, though this is mostly decorative compared to the nutritional value of the loaf itself.

canada.name: Turducken
canada.description: This dish consists of a deboned chicken stuffed into a deboned duck, further stuffed into a deboned turkey.

canada.name: California roll
canada.description: This dish is an inside-out rice roll containing imitation crab (or rarely real crab), avocado, and cucumber.

canada.name: Hawaiian pizza
canada.description: The dish is a pizza traditionally topped with pineapple, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, and either ham or bacon.
canada.photoCredit: Janine from Mililani, Hawaii, United States

canada.name: Peabutter
canada.description: This is a savory spread used as an alternative to peanut butter.

canada.name: Doubles
canada.description: It consists of curried chickpeas served on two fried flatbreads. It is normally eaten during breakfast, but is also eaten occasionally during lunch or as a late night snack and popular hangover food.

kent.name: Sussex pond pudding
kent.description: The dish is made of a suet pastry, filled with butter and sugar, and is boiled or steamed for several hours. Modern versions of the recipe often include a whole lemon enclosed in the pastry.

konkan.name: Sanna
konkan.description: The dish is a spongy, steamed, and savoury unfilled dumpling originally made of red rice, black lentil and coconut.

detroit.name: Detroit-style pizza
detroit.description: The dish is a rectangular pan pizza with a thick, crisp, chewy crust. It is traditionally topped to the edges with mozzarella or brick cheese, which caramelizes against the high-sided heavyweight rectangular pan.

michigan.name: Detroit-style pizza
michigan.description: The dish is a rectangular pan pizza with a thick, crisp, chewy crust. It is traditionally topped to the edges with mozzarella or brick cheese, which caramelizes against the high-sided heavyweight rectangular pan.

piedmont.name: Baci di dama
piedmont.description: The dish is a type of sandwich biscuit consisting of two hazelnut biscuits joined together by a chocolate filling.The most common variations are made with almonds, pistachios, and cocoa in place of hazelnuts.

piedmont.name: Breadstick
piedmont.description: A pencil-sized sticks of crisp, dry baked bread that is made from flour, water, and yeast.

piedmont.name: Agnolotti
piedmont.description: The dish is a stuffed pasta made with small pieces of flattened dough folded over a filling of roasted meat or Vegetable.
piedmont.photoCredit: Photo by Gahlord Dewald/Thoughtfaucet (who uploaded it and that is the attribution credit to apply if you use it elsewhere)

piedmont.name: Zabaione
piedmont.description: The dish is a type of dessert, or sometimes a beverage, made with egg yolks, sugar, and a sweet wine. Some versions of the recipe incorporate spirits such as cognac. The dessert version is a light custard, whipped to incorporate a large amount of air.

piedmont.name: Pasta e fagioli
piedmont.description: It is often called pasta fasul or pasta fazool. pasta soup of which there are several regional variants.

basel.name: Basler Läckerli
basel.description: The dish is made by baking a thin layer of dough, which is then topped with a sugar glaze while still hot and cut into rectangular pieces.

baltimore.name: Berger Cookies
baltimore.description: The dish is frosted on its flat bottom, giving the final cookie an overall rounded shape. Each weighs 1.25 ounces, with the cake-like under-cookie weighing a quarter of an ounce, and the chocolate/fudge frosting weighing an ounce.
baltimore.photoCredit: danielle_blue from Baltimore, Maryland, United States

bern.name: Berner Haselnusslebkuchen
bern.description: The dish is made of a clay-like mass of roasted and ground hazelnuts and about one eighth ground almonds, as well as a little sugar, honey, cinnamon, candied lemon and orange peel, held together by egg white.

new mexico.name: Bizcochito
new mexico.description: The dish is a kind of crisp butter cookie made with lard, flavored with sugar, cinnamon, and anise. The dough is rolled thin and cut into the shape of the Christian cross, a star, or a circle, symbolizing the moon.

new mexico.name: Machaca
new mexico.description: This is traditionally dried meat, usually spiced beef or pork, rehydrated and pounded to make it tender.
new mexico.photoCredit: Dale Cruse from San Francisco, CA, USA

maine.name: Black and white cookie
maine.description: The dish is round cookies iced or frosted in two colors, with one half vanilla and the other chocolate. It is slightly dome-shaped (convex), has frosting on a fluffy angel cake base
maine.photoCredit: The original uploader was Punkitra at English Wikipedia .

maine.name: Snickerdoodle
maine.description: The dish is a type of cookie made with flour, fat, sugar, and salt, and rolled in cinnamon sugar. Eggs may also sometimes be used as an ingredient, with cream of tartar and baking soda added to leaven the dough. They are characterized by a cracked surface and can be either crisp or soft depending on the ingredients used.
maine.photoCredit: jim Winstead from los angeles, usa

maine.name: Lobster stew
maine.description: The dish is composed of a lobster, a sofrito, onions, tomatoes, garlic and parsley, boiled then eaten with thin slices of bread.
maine.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Slastic assumed (based on copyright claims).

pennsylvania.name: Black and white cookie
pennsylvania.description: The dish is round cookies iced or frosted in two colors, with one half vanilla and the other chocolate. It is slightly dome-shaped (convex), has frosting on a fluffy angel cake base
pennsylvania.photoCredit: The original uploader was Punkitra at English Wikipedia .

pennsylvania.name: Snickerdoodle
pennsylvania.description: The dish is a type of cookie made with flour, fat, sugar, and salt, and rolled in cinnamon sugar. Eggs may also sometimes be used as an ingredient, with cream of tartar and baking soda added to leaven the dough. They are characterized by a cracked surface and can be either crisp or soft depending on the ingredients used.
pennsylvania.photoCredit: jim Winstead from los angeles, usa

pennsylvania.name: Sugar cookie
pennsylvania.description: The dish is a cookie with the main ingredients being sugar, flour, butter, eggs, vanilla, and either baking powder or baking soda.They may be formed by hand, dropped, or rolled and cut into shapes. They may be decorated with additional sugar, icing, sprinkles, or a combination of these. Decorative shapes and figures can be cut into the rolled-out dough using a cookie cutter.

pennsylvania.name: Shoofly pie
pennsylvania.description: This dish can be described as a crumb cake baked in a pie crust. The primary ingredients of the filling are molasses, brown sugar, and water. It comes in two different versions: wet-bottom and dry-bottom. The dry-bottom version is baked until fully set and results in a more cake-like consistency throughout. The wet-bottom version is set like cake at the top where it was mixed in with the crumbs, but the very bottom is a stickier, gooier custard-like consistency.

pennsylvania.name: Stromboli
pennsylvania.description: This dish is a type of baked turnover filled with various cheeses and usually cold cuts (typically meats) or vegetable, served hot.

pennsylvania.name: Schnitz un knepp
pennsylvania.description: The dish consists of ham or pork shoulder with dried apples and dumplings.

pennsylvania.name: Hog maw
pennsylvania.description: The dish is the stomach of a pig prepared as food. More specifically, the exterior muscular wall of the stomach organ (with interior lining mucosa removed) contains no fat if cleaned properly.

florida.name: Black and white cookie
florida.description: The dish is round cookies iced or frosted in two colors, with one half vanilla and the other chocolate. It is slightly dome-shaped (convex), has frosting on a fluffy angel cake base
florida.photoCredit: The original uploader was Punkitra at English Wikipedia .

florida.name: Key lime pie
florida.description: This dish is made of Key lime juice, egg yolks, and sweetened condensed milk. It may be served with no topping, with a meringue topping made from egg whites, or with whipped cream.

london.name: Bourbon biscuit
london.description: The dish is a sandwich biscuit consisting of two thin rectangular dark chocolate-flavoured biscuits with a chocolate buttercream filling.

london.name: Woolton pie
london.description: A pastry dish of Vegetable. The recipe involved dicing and cooking potatoes (or parsnips), cauliflower, carrots and possibly turnip. Other Vegetable were added where available.

moselle.name: Bredele
moselle.description: The dish can include cake with egg white and aniseed,  orange and cinnamon, small pain and spice cakes that are made with sugar rather than honey.

moselle.name: Spritzgebäck
moselle.description: The dish is a type biscuit or cookie made of a rich shortcrust pastry. When made correctly, the cookies are crisp, fragile, somewhat dry, and buttery.

denmark.name: Butter cookie
denmark.description: The dish hes a variety of shapes such as circles, squares, ovals, rings, and pretzel-like forms, and with a variety of appearances, including marbled, checkered or plain.

denmark.name: Chocolate-coated marshmallow treats
denmark.description: The dish is a confection consisting of a biscuit base topped with marshmallow-like filling and then coated in a hard shell of chocolate.

denmark.name: Finskepinner
denmark.description: The dish is a shortbread cookie characterized by its long shape, crispy texture, and its frequent consumption during Christmas.

denmark.name: Danish pastry
denmark.description: This dish is a multilayered sweet pastry made with yeast dough of what flour, milk, eggs, sugar, and large amount of butter or margarine. Rolled out thinly and covered with a thin slices of butter between each layers.

denmark.name: Kringlea
denmark.description: The dish is a pastry, a variety of pretzel. It denotes the pretzel-like knotted shape rather than the pretzel pastry type. It may be made from puff pastry (like Danish pastry) or yeast dough, filled with remonce or marzipan and raisins, sprinkled with coarse sugar, nut flakes or icing.

denmark.name: Semla
denmark.description: The dish is a traditional sweet roll made in various forms. It consists of a cardamom-spiced wheat bun which has its top cut off, and is then filled with a mix of milk and almond paste, topped with whipped cream. The cut-off top serves as a lid and is dusted with powdered sugar. Today it is often eaten on its own, with coffee or tea. Some prefer to eat it in a bowl of hot milk.

denmark.name: Rugbrød
denmark.description: The dish is made with rye flour as the basic ingredient, which produces a plain or "old-fashioned" bread with a uniform, somewhat heavy structure.
denmark.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Sten assumed (based on copyright claims).

denmark.name: Rullepølse
denmark.description: The dish consists of a piece of pork belly, or beef flank or lamb and it is flattened out and is spread with herbs and seasoning (salt, pepper, allspice), chopped onions, and in some variants, parsley. It is then rolled up and placed in a brine for a number of days, before being placed in a special press, cooled, and sliced thinly.

denmark.name: Kaszanka
denmark.description: This dish is a sausage made of a mixture of pig's blood, pork offal (commonly liver), and buckwheat or barley stuffed in a pig intestine. It is usually flavored with onion, black pepper, and marjoram.

denmark.name: Rød pølse
denmark.description: This dish is a type of brightly red, boiled pork sausage.

denmark.name: Aspic
denmark.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

bohol.name: Caycay
bohol.description: The dish is a crunchy layered cookie coated in syrup (latik) or honey and rolled in coarsely ground toasted peanuts.

texas.name: Cowboy cookies
texas.description: The dish is a type of drop cookie made with oatmeal, chocolate chips, pecans, and coconut.

texas.name: Klobásník
texas.description: The dish is a sausage that is wrapped in sweet, spun dough. Other ingredients such as ham, eggs, cheese and peppers are used alongside or instead of sausage.

texas.name: Texas toast
texas.description: A toasted bread that is typically made from sliced bread that has been sliced at double the usual thickness of packaged bread. It is prepared by spreading butter on both sides of the bread and broiling or grilling it until it is a light golden brown. Commonly, garlic is added to the butter, yielding a form of garlic bread. The toast may include cheese on one or both sides, similar to an open-faced grilled cheese sandwich.

texas.name: Texas caviar
texas.description: The dish is a bean salad consisting of black eyed peas that are lightly pickled in vinaigrette-style dressing, commonly served as a dip with tortilla chips.

texas.name: Borracho beans
texas.description: This dish is made of pinto beans cooked in beer and flavored with cilantro, onion, garlic, bacon, bacon fat, cumin, and chili powder or whole chili peppers. This dish can be served wrapped in tortillas with some form of grilled beef, eaten from a bowl much like chili, or used as a bean dip and eaten with tortilla chips.

texas.name: Hot link sausage
texas.description: The dish is a type of sausage prepared using pork, beef, or a combination of both. It is sometimes used as an ingredient in other dishes.

texas.name: Fajita
texas.description: It usually refers to any stripped grilled meat, optionally served with stripped peppers and onions.

texas.name: Machaca
texas.description: This is traditionally dried meat, usually spiced beef or pork, rehydrated and pounded to make it tender.
texas.photoCredit: Dale Cruse from San Francisco, CA, USA

chile.name: Cuchuflí
chile.description: The dish is a tubular-shaped desserts made from sugar, egg whites, flour, butter, and vanilla that are often filled with dulce de leche or other sweet fillings.

chile.name: Bizcocho
chile.description: The dish is the name given range of pastries, cakes or cookies.

chile.name: Conejito
chile.description: The dish is a pastry filled with custard, and not fried. The dough is made with flour, eggs, sugar, milk, leavening, and butter. The filling is made with corn starch, egg yolks, milk, sugar, and vanilla.

chile.name: Empanada
chile.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

chile.name: Milhojas
chile.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

chile.name: Sopaipilla
chile.description: A fried pastry and a type of quick bread, traditionally made from leavened wheat dough (or a mixture of wheat flour and masa harina) to which some shortening such as butter is added. After being allowed to rise, the dough is rolled into a sheet that is then cut into circular, square or triangular shapes, 8–10 cm in size for the longest dimension (if intended for a dessert) or 15–20 cm (if intended to be stuffed for a main course). These pieces are then deep-fried in oil, sometimes after being allowed to rise further before frying: the frying causes them to puff up, ideally forming a hollow pocket in the center.

chile.name: Hallulla
chile.description: The dish is a popular bread. It is a flat round bread baked with vegetable (but sometimes also animal) shortening and is used for several traditional sandwiches. The traditional recipe includes wheat flour, yeast, sugar, salt, vegetable shortening, milk and water.

chile.name: Marraqueta
chile.description: The dish is a bread roll made with wheat flour, salt, water and yeast and has a crusty exterior.

chile.name: Potato bread
chile.description: The dish is a form of bread in which potato flour or potato replaces a portion of the regular wheat flour.

chile.name: Papa rellena
chile.description: This dish is a potato-based dough into which a filling made of chopped beef and onions, whole olives, hard-boiled eggs, cumin and other spices is stuffed.

chile.name: Paila marina
chile.description: This dish is a seafood soup usually served in a earthenware bowl. It usually contains a shellfish stock base cooked with different kinds of shellfish and fish.

chile.name: Porotos con riendas
chile.description: This is a dish made of boiled beans with spaghetti, pork sausage, diced pumpkin, chili, and onions.

chile.name: Longaniza
chile.description: This sausage is similar to salchichón, though thinner; both differ from chorizo in that black pepper is used for them instead of paprika and may have different spices in them like nutmeg.
chile.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Ardo Beltz assumed (based on copyright claims).

chile.name: Cocada
chile.description: This dish is a traditional coconut confectionery made with with eggs and shredded coconut.

argentina.name: Cuchuflí
argentina.description: The dish is a tubular-shaped desserts made from sugar, egg whites, flour, butter, and vanilla that are often filled with dulce de leche or other sweet fillings.

argentina.name: Bierock
argentina.description: The dish is a yeast dough pastry pocket sandwich with savory filling. The soft yeast rolls contain some sugar, butter and eggs, and either warm water, milk, or a mix of both. The filling is a basic mix of onion, ground beef and cabbage which can be made more complicated by the addition of different cheese blends, condiments and seasonings like caraway seeds.

argentina.name: Empanada
argentina.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

argentina.name: Milhojas
argentina.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

argentina.name: Tortita negra
argentina.description: The dish is a pastry which is flat at its base and round on the sides. Traditionally they have dark brown sugar on the top.They are usually the perfect accompaniment to mate in the morning or in the afternoon during "tea time". They are a popular food at children's parties

argentina.name: Pastafrola
argentina.description: A type of sweet tart, covered, jam-filled shortcrust pastry dish principally made from flour, sugar and egg. Common fillings include quince cheese, sweet potato jam, dulce de leche, guava, or strawberry jam.

argentina.name: Sopaipilla
argentina.description: A fried pastry and a type of quick bread, traditionally made from leavened wheat dough (or a mixture of wheat flour and masa harina) to which some shortening such as butter is added. After being allowed to rise, the dough is rolled into a sheet that is then cut into circular, square or triangular shapes, 8–10 cm in size for the longest dimension (if intended for a dessert) or 15–20 cm (if intended to be stuffed for a main course). These pieces are then deep-fried in oil, sometimes after being allowed to rise further before frying: the frying causes them to puff up, ideally forming a hollow pocket in the center.

argentina.name: Stuffed tomatoes
argentina.description: This dish is a stuffed tomato filled with various ingredients, usually including rice.

argentina.name: Puchero
argentina.description: The dish is made of meat (beef, veal, pork or chicken), bacon, cured bones (such as those of the jamón serrano), and Vegetable (potatoes, celery, chard, leek, carrots, and turnips).

argentina.name: Bondiola sandwich
argentina.description: This dish is a sandwich made with thick slices of pork shoulder. The meat consists of slices of roasted or cured pork shoulder and it is usually served on crispy brioche bread. It can be topped with a variety of condiments and vegetables.

argentina.name: Longaniza
argentina.description: This sausage is similar to salchichón, though thinner; both differ from chorizo in that black pepper is used for them instead of paprika and may have different spices in them like nutmeg.
argentina.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Ardo Beltz assumed (based on copyright claims).

argentina.name: Moronga
argentina.description: This dish is a kind of blood sausage. Spices, herbs (such as ruta, oregano, and mint), onions, and chili peppers are added and then boiled in the pig's large intestines for casing for several hours. It is served in a sauce.
argentina.photoCredit: Jeremy Keith from Brighton & Hove, United Kingdom

argentina.name: Cabrito
argentina.description: This food is roast whole goat over a charcoal fire.

argentina.name: Cocada
argentina.description: This dish is a traditional coconut confectionery made with with eggs and shredded coconut.

argentina.name: Bife a cavalo
argentina.description: The dish consists of grilled or pan-fried steak with rice, beans, and salad.

argentina.name: Sopa de cacahuete
argentina.description: The dish is a soup made from peanuts, often with various other ingredients

dublin.name: Cream cracker
dublin.description: The dish is made of wheat flour, vegetable oil, and yeast and commonly served with cheese as form of biscuit.

northern ireland.name: Empire biscuit
northern ireland.description: The dish is a type of sweet biscuit that has a layer of jam in between two biscuits, typically shortbread. The top is covered with white water icing, usually decorated with a glace cherry in the centre, but Dew Drops are common too.

bahrain.name: Fig roll
bahrain.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

bahrain.name: Ka'ak
bahrain.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

bahrain.name: Ful medames
bahrain.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

cyprus.name: Fig roll
cyprus.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

cyprus.name: Mulukhiyah
cyprus.description: The dish is a soup made of jute leaves resulting in thick liquid or broth, chopped with garlic, cilantro, and dressed with oil.

cyprus.name: Freekeh
cyprus.description: The dish is a roasted and rubbed macarroni wheat.

cyprus.name: Falafel
cyprus.description: The dish is a deep-fried ball or patty-shaped fritter made from broad beans, ground chickpease, or both.

cyprus.name: Stuffed dates
cyprus.description: The dish is a heated dates filled with meat, mint, and parsley with different stuffing including butters and goat cheese.

cyprus.name: Stuffed eggplant
cyprus.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

cyprus.name: Fasolada
cyprus.description: The dish is made by simmering beans with tomatoes and other vegetables such as carrots, onion, parsley, thyme, celery, and bay leaf. Recipes vary considerably, often including meat and olive oil.

israel.name: Fig roll
israel.description: The dish is a biscuit or cookie consisting of a rolled cake or pastry filled with fig paste.

israel.name: Tahini cookie
israel.description: The dish is a cookie made of flour, sugar and butter and usually topped with almonds or pine nuts.

israel.name: Knish
israel.description: The dish is a traditional snack food consisting of a filling covered with dough that is typically baked or sometimes deep fried. In most traditional versions, the filling is made entirely of mashed potato, buckwheat groats, or cheese. Other varieties of fillings include beef, chicken, sweet potatoes, black beans, or spinach.

israel.name: Sufganiyah
israel.description: The dish is a round jelly doughnut. The doughnut is deep-fried, injected with jam or custard, and then topped with powdered sugar.

israel.name: Sfiha
israel.description: A dish consisting of flatbread cooked with a minced meat topping, often lamb flavored with parsley, onion, tomato, pine nuts, and spices.

israel.name: Rye bread
israel.description: A type of bread made with various proportions of flour from rye grain. It can be light or dark in color, depending on the type of flour used and the addition of coloring agents, and is typically denser than bread made from wheat flour. Compared to white bread, it is higher in fiber, darker in color, and stronger in flavor.

israel.name: Matzah
israel.description: The dish is an unleavened flatbread made from flour and water. It is also an integral element of a relogious festival.

israel.name: Ful medames
israel.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

israel.name: Baba ghanoush
israel.description: The dish is an appetizer made of roasted eggplant, olive oil, lemon juice, and various seasonings.

israel.name: Kibbeh
israel.description: The dish is a spiced lean ground meat covered with pounded wheat, then toasted with nuts and spices.

israel.name: Helzel
israel.description: The dish is a sausage made from poultry neck skin stuffed with flour, bread crumbs, and fried onions, sewn up with a thread.
israel.photoCredit: Wizard85 (original file) ; Off-shell (cropped and reprocessed version)

israel.name: Holishkes
israel.description: This dish is prepared from blanched cabbage leaves wrapped in a parcel-like manner around minced meat and then simmered in tomato sauce. Sometimes rice is added to the meat filling.

israel.name: Stuffed eggplant
israel.description: This dish is common in many countries. The main ingredient is eggplant, which is stuffed with various fillings depending on the region. These can include meat (such as lamb), rice, Vegetable, or even mozzarella cheese.

israel.name: Buñuelo
israel.description: The dish is a fried dough fritter. They typically consist of a simple, wheat-based yeast dough, often flavored with anise, that is thinly rolled, cut or shaped into individual pieces, then fried and finished off with a sweet topping. It may be filled with a variety of things, sweet or savory. They can be round in ball shapes or disc-shaped.
israel.photoCredit: Baptiste Pons from Gandia / Burjassot, País Valencià, Spain

israel.name: Tzimmes
israel.description: The dish is typically made from carrots and dried fruits such as prunes or raisins, often combined with other root vegetables (including yam).

israel.name: Sabich
israel.description: The dish consists of flatbread stuffed with fried eggplants, hard-boiled eggs, chopped salad, parsley, mango pickle and sauce.
israel.photoCredit: ClyHell6943.JPG : ClyHell derivative work: Itzuvit ( talk )

israel.name: Bamba
israel.description: The dish are made of peanut-butter-flavored puffed maize

israel.name: Apio
israel.description: The dish is an appetizer which is made from celeriac and carrot and served cold.

israel.name: Israeli couscous
israel.description: The dish is toasted pasta in tiny balls. The pasta is made of hard wheat flour and toasted in an oven. The pasta was factory-made from the outset and, therefore, is rarely seen as home-made from scratch.

israel.name: Krembo
israel.description: The dish is a chocolate-coated marshmallow treat that consists of a round biscuit base, topped with fluffy marshmallow creme-like foam, coated in a thin layer of sweet baking chocolate, and wrapped in colourful, thin aluminum foil.

israel.name: Kubaneh
israel.description: The bread is often served alongside eggs that are baked in their shells along with the bread and grated tomato.

israel.name: Bourekas
israel.description: A baked pastry that are typically made with either puff pastry or filo dough, depending on the origin of the baker. They are often made out of puff pastry filled with various fillings. Among the popular fillings are cheese, minced meat, mashed potato, spinach and cheese, eggplant, and mushrooms.

sweden.name: Finskepinner
sweden.description: The dish is a shortbread cookie characterized by its long shape, crispy texture, and its frequent consumption during Christmas.

sweden.name: Hallongrotta
sweden.description: The dish is similar to shortbread cookies with an added filling. It is an easily baked molded cookie. The cookies are typically made with butter, flour, baking powder, sugar and vanilla. The cookies are usually filled with raspberry jam.

sweden.name: Gustavus Adolphus pastry
sweden.description: The dish is a pastry. Recipes for the pastry vary locally but most versions have a portrait of the king on the top, usually made of chocolate or marzipan.

sweden.name: Joulutorttu
sweden.description: The dish is a pastry. It is traditionally made from puff pastry in the shape of a star or pinwheel and filled with prune jam and often dusted with icing sugar. The pastries can be in other shapes and apple used in place of the prune jam.

sweden.name: Kringlea
sweden.description: The dish is a pastry, a variety of pretzel. It denotes the pretzel-like knotted shape rather than the pretzel pastry type. It may be made from puff pastry (like Danish pastry) or yeast dough, filled with remonce or marzipan and raisins, sprinkled with coarse sugar, nut flakes or icing.

sweden.name: Mandelkubb
sweden.description: The dish is a traditional bitter almond cookie characterized by a bittersweet flavor. Its distinct flavor is derived from bitter almonds. The pastry is made with flour, sugar, eggs, butter, bitter almonds, ammonium carbonate, and leavening agents. They are often garnished with nib sugar.

sweden.name: Punsch-roll
sweden.description: The dish is a small cylindrical pastry covered with green marzipan with the ends dipped in chocolate, with an interior consisting of a mix of crushed biscuits, butter, and cocoa, flavoured with punsch liqueur.

sweden.name: Semla
sweden.description: The dish is a traditional sweet roll made in various forms. It consists of a cardamom-spiced wheat bun which has its top cut off, and is then filled with a mix of milk and almond paste, topped with whipped cream. The cut-off top serves as a lid and is dusted with powdered sugar. Today it is often eaten on its own, with coffee or tea. Some prefer to eat it in a bowl of hot milk.

sweden.name: Tunnbröd
sweden.description: A flatbread that may be soft or crisp, and comes in many variants depending on choice of grain, leavening agent (or lack thereof) and rolling pin. The dough is made from any combination of wheat, barley, oat and rye; the leavening agent can be both yeast and ammonium carbonate.

sweden.name: Teacake
sweden.description: In one region, it is a light yeast-based sweet bun containing dried fruit, typically served toasted and buttered. In other areas can be cookies or small cakes. In another country, they can be soft, round, flat wheat breads made with milk and a little sugar, and used to make buttered ham or cheese sandwiches. In other regions, it is more like a butter cake.

sweden.name: Crispbread
sweden.description: A flat and dry type of bread, containing mostly rye flour. These are lightweight and keep fresh for a very long time due to their lack of water. traditionally consists of wholemeal rye flour, salt, and water. Today, however, many other kinds contain wheat flour, spices and grains, and are often leavened with yeast or sourdough, and milk or sesame seeds can be added.

sweden.name: Jellied veal
sweden.description: This dish is a cold cut dish made from veal, sometimes pork, stock, onion and spices such as allspice, bay leaf and white pepper. It is eaten cold from the fridge, often with potatoes and pickled beetroot or sliced on crisp bread.

sweden.name: Wallenbergare
sweden.description: A dish consisting of a breaded ground veal patty, flavored with cream and egg yolk, pan-fried until golden and traditionally served with potatoes, lingonberries, and peas.

sweden.name: Kalops
sweden.description: This dish is a beef stew that contains beef, onion, allspice, bay leaf, and other spices. It is often served with boiled potatoes and pickled beetroot.

sweden.name: Saffron bun
sweden.description: The dish is a rich, spiced yeast-leavened sweet bun that is flavoured with saffron and contains dried fruit including currants and raisins similar to a teacake. The main ingredients are plain flour, butter, yeast, caster sugar, currants and sultanas.

norway.name: Finskepinner
norway.description: The dish is a shortbread cookie characterized by its long shape, crispy texture, and its frequent consumption during Christmas.

norway.name: Krumkake
norway.description: The dish is a waffle cookie made of flour, butter, eggs, sugar, and cream. While hot, the dish is rolled into small cones around a wooden or plastic cone form. The dish can be eaten plain or filled with whipped cream (often multekrem) or other fillings.

norway.name: Kringlea
norway.description: The dish is a pastry, a variety of pretzel. It denotes the pretzel-like knotted shape rather than the pretzel pastry type. It may be made from puff pastry (like Danish pastry) or yeast dough, filled with remonce or marzipan and raisins, sprinkled with coarse sugar, nut flakes or icing.

norway.name: Semla
norway.description: The dish is a traditional sweet roll made in various forms. It consists of a cardamom-spiced wheat bun which has its top cut off, and is then filled with a mix of milk and almond paste, topped with whipped cream. The cut-off top serves as a lid and is dusted with powdered sugar. Today it is often eaten on its own, with coffee or tea. Some prefer to eat it in a bowl of hot milk.

norway.name: Flatbrød
norway.description: A traditional unleavened bread which is usually eaten with fish, salted meats and soups. It is dry and free from water so it is possible to store it for a long period of time. The basic ingredients are barley flour, salt, and water, though many varieties exist which incorporate other staples.

norway.name: Lefse
norway.description: The dish is made with riced potatoes, can include all purpose (wheat) flour, and includes butter, and milk, cream, or lard.

florence.name: Florentine biscuit
florence.description: The dish is a made of nuts (typically hazelnuts and almonds) and candied cherries mixed with sugar melted together with butter and honey, cooked in an oven. They are often coated on the bottom with chocolate, which is traditionally scored in a wave pattern with the tines of a fork for decoration.

california.name: Fortune cookie
california.description: The dish is a crisp, sugary cookie wafer made from flour, sugar, vanilla, and sesame seed oil with a piece of paper inside.

california.name: Hangtown fry
california.description: The most common version of the dish includes bacon and oysters combined with eggs, and fried together.

california.name: Prawn cocktail
california.description: The dish consists of shelled, cooked prawns in a seafood sauce or cocktail sauce served in a glass.

california.name: Machaca
california.description: This is traditionally dried meat, usually spiced beef or pork, rehydrated and pounded to make it tender.
california.photoCredit: Dale Cruse from San Francisco, CA, USA

aragon.name: Panellets
aragon.description: The dish is a ball-shaped snack made from chestnuts and sweet potatoes covered in pinenuts.

nantes.name: Petit-Beurre
nantes.description: The dish is a type of shortbread surface of the biscuit is smooth and has twenty-four indents (four lines with six columns) intermixed with the inscription of the dish name in three lines.

andalusia.name: Polvorón
andalusia.description: The dish is a type of heavy, soft, and very crumbly shortbread made of flour, sugar, milk, and nuts (especially almonds).
andalusia.photoCredit: This file is a work by El Pantera . Please, credit this: El Pantera I would appreciate being notified (elpanteradejerez@gmail.com) if you use my work outside Wikimedia More of my work can be found in my personal gallery

andalusia.name: Deviled egg
andalusia.description: The dish is a stuffed eggs, curry eggs, or dressed eggs, are hard-boiled, peeled egg mixed with other ingredients such as mayonnaise and mustard, or other toppings.

andalusia.name: Ajoblanco
andalusia.description: This dish is a cold soup made of bread, crushed almonds, garlic, water, olive oil, salt and sometimes vinegar. It is usually served with grapes or slices of melon.

andalusia.name: Porra antequerana
andalusia.description: This dish is a thick soup consists of tomato and dried bread.

andalusia.name: Salmorejo
andalusia.description: This dish is a traditional creamy soup made of pear tomato, bread, extra virgin olive oil and garlic.

andalusia.name: Gazpacho
andalusia.description: The dish is a cold soup made of raw, blended Vegetable. It originated in the southern region of Spain and is widely consumed during hot summers. It is also typically consisted of tomatoes, cucumbers, bell peppers, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, and bread.

andalusia.name: Tortillitas de camarones
andalusia.description: The dish is a type of shrimp fritters made with a batter of wheat flour, chickpea flour, water, onion, parsley, shrimp, salt, and pepper. The batter is fried in olive oil until golden and is typically served with small side dishes.

andalusia.name: Chicharrón
andalusia.description: This is a dish generally consisting of fried pork belly or fried pork rinds. It may also be made from chicken, mutton, or beef.

pernambuco.name: Tareco
pernambuco.description: The dish is a little tough biscuit, made of wheat flour, eggs and sugar; that, when put into the oven, get the disk shape.

pernambuco.name: Bolo de rolo
pernambuco.description: The dish is a cake batter made from flour, eggs, butter, and sugar.

zurich.name: Tirggel
zurich.description: The dish is made from flour and honey, they are thin, hard, and sweet.
zurich.photoCredit: Sandstein . Any incorporated copyrighted artwork is not by me, but is de minimis .

zurich.name: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes
zurich.description: It is a dish made with thin slices of sautéed veal, white wine, cream, onions, and sometimes mushrooms, often served with rösti.

vienna.name: Vanillekipferl
vienna.description: The dish ia a type of small, crescent-shaped biscuits. They were originally made with walnuts, but almonds or hazelnuts can also be used. They get their typical flavour from a heavy dusting of vanilla sugar.

vienna.name: Apple strudel
vienna.description: The dish is a type of layered pastry consists of an oblong layered pastry jacket with an apple filling inside. The filling is made of grated cooking apples (usually of a tart, crisp and aromatic variety) sugar, cinnamon, and bread crumbs. It uses an unleavened dough. The basic dough consists of flour, oil (or butter) and salt although as a household recipe, many variations exist.

vienna.name: Sachertorte
vienna.description: The dish is a chocolate cake, or torte. The cake consists of a dense chocolate cake with a thin layer of apricot jam in between two halves, coated in dark chocolate icing on the top and sides. It is traditionally served with unsweetened whipped cream.

vienna.name: Vienna bread
vienna.description: Bread that used high milling of Hungarian grain, and cereal press-yeast for leavening.
vienna.photoCredit: fir0002 flagstaffotos [at] gmail.com Canon 20D + Tamron 28-75mm f/2.8

vienna.name: Wiener schnitzel
vienna.description: It is a dish made from a thin, breaded, and pan-fried veal cutlet, known for its crispy golden crust and traditionally served with lemon wedges and sides like potatoes or salad.

philadelphia.name: E.L. Fudge
philadelphia.description: The dish is a type of butter-flavored shortbread sandwich cookies with a fudge creme filling.

philadelphia.name: Stromboli
philadelphia.description: This dish is a type of baked turnover filled with various cheeses and usually cold cuts (typically meats) or vegetable, served hot.

county cork.name: Lorna Doone
county cork.description: The dish is a brand of golden, square-shaped shortbread cookie.

west kalimantan.name: Bahulu
west kalimantan.description: The dish is a type of pastry. There are three versions available, the most common being star-shaped and the more elusive shaped like rolls and layered.

cambridgeshire.name: Bedfordshire clanger
cambridgeshire.description: The dish is an elongated suet crust dumpling. It was traditionally boiled in a cloth like other suet puddings, though some modern recipes use a shortcrust or other pastry and suggest baking it like a pasty. The dumpling can be filled with liver and onion, bacon and potatoes, pork and onions, or other meat and Vegetable, and flavoured with the garden herb sage.

uruguay.name: Bizcocho
uruguay.description: The dish is the name given range of pastries, cakes or cookies.

uruguay.name: Empanada
uruguay.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

uruguay.name: Milhojas
uruguay.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

uruguay.name: Pastafrola
uruguay.description: A type of sweet tart, covered, jam-filled shortcrust pastry dish principally made from flour, sugar and egg. Common fillings include quince cheese, sweet potato jam, dulce de leche, guava, or strawberry jam.

uruguay.name: Sopaipilla
uruguay.description: A fried pastry and a type of quick bread, traditionally made from leavened wheat dough (or a mixture of wheat flour and masa harina) to which some shortening such as butter is added. After being allowed to rise, the dough is rolled into a sheet that is then cut into circular, square or triangular shapes, 8–10 cm in size for the longest dimension (if intended for a dessert) or 15–20 cm (if intended to be stuffed for a main course). These pieces are then deep-fried in oil, sometimes after being allowed to rise further before frying: the frying causes them to puff up, ideally forming a hollow pocket in the center.

uruguay.name: Stuffed tomatoes
uruguay.description: This dish is a stuffed tomato filled with various ingredients, usually including rice.

uruguay.name: Puchero
uruguay.description: The dish is made of meat (beef, veal, pork or chicken), bacon, cured bones (such as those of the jamón serrano), and Vegetable (potatoes, celery, chard, leek, carrots, and turnips).

uruguay.name: Longaniza
uruguay.description: This sausage is similar to salchichón, though thinner; both differ from chorizo in that black pepper is used for them instead of paprika and may have different spices in them like nutmeg.
uruguay.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Ardo Beltz assumed (based on copyright claims).

uruguay.name: Elote
uruguay.description: This dish is an ear of corn, on or off the plant. They are splashed with salt water and grilled in the coals until the husks start to burn and the kernels reach a crunchy texture.

ecuador.name: Bizcocho
ecuador.description: The dish is the name given range of pastries, cakes or cookies.

ecuador.name: Empanada
ecuador.description: The dish is a baked or fried pastry with meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients filling.

ecuador.name: Milhojas
ecuador.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

ecuador.name: Llapingacho
ecuador.description: The dish is a fried potato pancake served with peanut sauce, they are stuffed with cheese and cooked until crispy brown.

ecuador.name: Papa rellena
ecuador.description: This dish is a potato-based dough into which a filling made of chopped beef and onions, whole olives, hard-boiled eggs, cumin and other spices is stuffed.

ecuador.name: Guatita
ecuador.description: This dish is a a stew whose main ingredient is pieces of tripe (cow stomach). There are various vegetarian versions of the dish in which wheat gluten is substituted for tripe.

ecuador.name: Seco
ecuador.description: The dish is a stew of beef, kid or another animal, macerated in vinegar, which is served accompanied by rice and a sauce of ají, huacatay and cilantro.

ecuador.name: Cocada
ecuador.description: This dish is a traditional coconut confectionery made with with eggs and shredded coconut.

hague.name: Bossche bol
hague.description: The dish is effectively a large filled choux pastry, about 12 cm in diameter, filled with whipped cream and coated entirely or almost entirely with (usually dark) chocolate fondant icing.

thessaloniki.name: Bougatsa
thessaloniki.description: The dish is a breakfast food (sweet or savoury), or mid-morning snack, or midday snack. It has several versions with their own filling, with the most popular the cream that has semolina custard filling used as a sweet food and dessert.

izmir.name: Boyoz
izmir.description: The dish is a pastry. The most widely preferred is plain, without addition of meat or cheese or spinach stuffings.
izmir.photoCredit: Originally created and uploaded to the Turkish Wikipedia by tr:User:ZorCoCuK

morocco.name: Briouat
morocco.description: The dish is a sweet or savory flaky pastry. It is filled with meat (mostly chicken or lamb) or fish and shrimp, mixed with cheese, lemon and pepper. They are wrapped in a paper-thin dough in a triangular or cylindrical shape. It can also be sweet, filled with almond or peanut paste and fried, then dipped in warm honey flavored with orange blossom water. It is fried or baked and then sprinkled with herbs, spices and sometimes with powdered sugar.

morocco.name: Ka'ak
morocco.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

morocco.name: Msemmen
morocco.description: The dish is a flatbread folded into square pancakes with multiple internal layers and cooked on a griddle, usually served with honey or a cup of aromatic morning mint tea or coffee.

morocco.name: Ahriche
morocco.description: It is a dish of tripe usually consisting of ganglion, caul, lung or heart of an animal wound with intestines on a stick of oak and cooked on hot coals

morocco.name: Bichak
morocco.description: This dish is a stuffed baked or fried pastry that comes in different forms (round, triangle, quadrangle) appetizer.

morocco.name: Tajine
morocco.description: This dish consists of meat, fruit, Vegetable, and spices that are cooked together very slowly.

morocco.name: Chermoula
morocco.description: It is traditionally used to flavor fish or seafood, but it can be used on other meats or Vegetable. Common ingredients include garlic, cumin, coriander, oil, lemon juice, and salt. Regional variations may also include preserved lemons, onion, ground chili peppers, black pepper, saffron, and other herbs.

morocco.name: Ful medames
morocco.description: The dish is a stew of cooked fava beans with olive oil, cumin, with chopped parsley, garlic, onion, lemon juice, and chili pepper.

morocco.name: Shakshouka
morocco.description: The dish is a poached egg in a sauce of tomatoes, olive oils, peppers, onion, and garlic, commonly with other spices also.

morocco.name: Mrouzia
morocco.description: The dish is a sweet and salty meat with blend of spices of honey, cinnamon, and almonds.

morocco.name: Mesfouf
morocco.description: The dish is made of peas and beans with sweet taste accompanied by butter and olive oil.

morocco.name: Merguez
morocco.description: The dish is a lamb or beef based fresh sausage.

morocco.name: Matbucha
morocco.description: The dish is a condiment or cooked salad consisting of cooked tomatoes with roasted bell peppers seasoned with garlic and chili pepper.

morocco.name: Harira
morocco.description: The dish is a soup made with lemon juic and egg to brighten the color and spice up the flavor.

morocco.name: Qrashel
morocco.description: The dish is traditional sweet sesame rolls, made with anise and fennel. They can be served with tea or coffee, and dipped in cheese, olive oil, jam or honey. The rolls are similar to brioche, but the anise seeds give them an extra flavor.

morocco.name: Bissara
morocco.description: The dish contains beans, onions, garlic, fresh aromatic herbs and spices. All ingredients are slowly cooked and then blended together to yield a creamy and fragrant dip or side dish.

bordeaux.name: Canelé
bordeaux.description: The dish is a small pastry flavored with rum and vanilla with a soft and tender custard center and a dark, thick caramelized crust. It takes the shape of a small, striated cylinder up to five centimeters in height with a depression at the top.

bordeaux.name: Jésuite
bordeaux.description: The dish is a triangular, flaky pastry filled with frangipane cream and topped with sliced almonds and powdered sugar. Rectangular in shape, it's made from puff pastry stuffed with ham and cheese, and covered with a sweet crust.

palermo.name: Cannoli
palermo.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a tube-shaped shell of fried pastry dough, filled with a sweet, creamy filling containing ricotta cheese.

mallorca.name: Ensaïmada
mallorca.description: The dish is a pastry product made with flour, water, sugar, eggs, dough, and a reduced pork lard.

hamburg.name: Franzbrötchen
hamburg.description: The dish is a small, sweet pastry baked with butter and cinnamon. Sometimes other ingredients are used as well, such as chocolate or raisins. It is usually served for breakfast, but is also enjoyed along with coffee and cake. The ingredients of the dough include flour, butter, yeast, milk, sugar, and a pinch of salt. The filling is a mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Several times in succession, the dough is folded and rolled out thinly, and coated with butter. As soon as the dough is sufficiently outstretched to a filmy layer, it is moistened with a little water, sprinkled with a melange of sugar and cinnamon and finally rolled up.

gyeongju.name: Hwangnam-ppang
gyeongju.description: The dish is a small pastry with a filling of red bean paste. It is made from a mixture of eggs and wheat flour, with the red bean filling being almost 70% of the pastry. A chrysanthemum would be traditionally imprinted on the top.

frankfurt.name: Haddekuche
frankfurt.description: The dish is a traditional pastry that resembles with a diamond-themed pattern imprinted on the pastry itself.
frankfurt.photoCredit: Selbst fotografiert von Johann H. Addicks

frankfurt.name: Hot dog
frankfurt.description: This dish consists of grilled, steamed, or boiled sausage served in the slit of a partially sliced bun. The names of these sausages commonly refer to their assembled dish.
frankfurt.photoCredit: Czar , original photographed by Renee Comet

finland.name: Joulutorttu
finland.description: The dish is a pastry. It is traditionally made from puff pastry in the shape of a star or pinwheel and filled with prune jam and often dusted with icing sugar. The pastries can be in other shapes and apple used in place of the prune jam.

finland.name: Semla
finland.description: The dish is a traditional sweet roll made in various forms. It consists of a cardamom-spiced wheat bun which has its top cut off, and is then filled with a mix of milk and almond paste, topped with whipped cream. The cut-off top serves as a lid and is dusted with powdered sugar. Today it is often eaten on its own, with coffee or tea. Some prefer to eat it in a bowl of hot milk.

finland.name: Teacake
finland.description: In one region, it is a light yeast-based sweet bun containing dried fruit, typically served toasted and buttered. In other areas can be cookies or small cakes. In another country, they can be soft, round, flat wheat breads made with milk and a little sugar, and used to make buttered ham or cheese sandwiches. In other regions, it is more like a butter cake.

finland.name: Rieska
