finland.description: The dish is an unleavened, usually barley-based, soft flatbread. The simple version contains only flour, salt, and water, but industrial bakeries usually use yeast as well.

finland.name: Kalops
finland.description: This dish is a beef stew that contains beef, onion, allspice, bay leaf, and other spices. It is often served with boiled potatoes and pickled beetroot.

finland.name: Karelian hot pot
finland.description: This dish is a traditional meat stew prepared using a combination of pork and beef, but elk or lamb can also be used.

finland.name: Läskisoosi
finland.description: The dish is made of pork belly fried in butter with onions and flour, stirred in water with salt and pepper. It is often served with mashed potato, pickled cucumber and lingonberry.

finland.name: Egg butter
finland.description: The dish is a mixture of butter and chopped hard boiled eggs.

finland.name: Porkkanalaatikko
finland.description: A dish are mashed carrots, mixed with boiled rice or barley, and liquid.

kerman.name: Kolompeh
kerman.description: The dish is a pastry. It looks like a pie with a mixture of minced dates with cardamom powder and other flavoring inside. Dates, wheat flour, walnuts and cooking oil are the main ingredients. Pistachios or sesame powder are often used for decorating it.

kerman.name: Komaj sehen
kerman.description: The dish is a type of pastry specific. For baking, Wheat sprout flour is mixed with regular flour such as wheat flour to make the dough. Before cooking, dates and walnuts, almonds or pistachio mixed with spices such as clove and fennel seeds are placed in the middle layers of the paste. The sweets are prepared without additive sugar and preservatives, yet the pastry can keep for a long time out of the refrigerator. Due to the very high-calorie ingredients in the pastry, eating a piece of it with a glass of milk provides a feeling of satiety.

hungary.name: Cremeschnitte
hungary.description: The dish is a custard and chantilly cream cream cake dessert. This dish in various variations, all of which include a puff pastry base and custard cream.

hungary.name: Kürtőskalács
hungary.description: The dish is a spit cake. It is made from sweet, yeast dough (raised dough), of which a strip is spun and then wrapped around a truncated cone–shaped baking spit, and rolled in granulated sugar. It is roasted over charcoal while basted with melted butter, until its surface cooks to a golden-brown color. During the baking process the sugar stuck on the caramelises and forms a crisp, shiny crust. The surface of the cake can then be topped with additional ingredients such as ground walnut or powdered cinnamon.

hungary.name: Marillenknödel
hungary.description: The dish is a pastry. It is formed from dough, in which cored apricots or mirabelle plums are placed. The dumplings are then boiled in slightly salted water and covered in crispily fried bread crumbs and powdered sugar. The dough is usually made of potato, though also quark and choux pastry are used.

hungary.name: Pogača
hungary.description: The dish is a type of bread baked in the ashes of the fireplace, and later in modern ovens. It can be leavened or unleavened, though the latter is considered more challenging to make. It is generally made from wheat flour, but barley and sometimes rye may be added. It can be stuffed with potatoes, ground beef, olive, or cheese, and have grains and herbs like sesame, black nigella seed, or dried dill in the dough or sprinkled on top.

hungary.name: Poppy seed roll
hungary.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

hungary.name: Trdelník
hungary.description: The dish is a kind of spit cake. It is made from dough that is wrapped around a stick, then baked and topped with sugar and walnut mix.

hungary.name: Lángos
hungary.description: The dish is a deep fried flatbread, but in the past it was made of the last bits of the bread-dough and baked at the front of a brick or clay oven, to be served hot as the breakfast of the bread-baking day.

hungary.name: Potato bread
hungary.description: The dish is a form of bread in which potato flour or potato replaces a portion of the regular wheat flour.

hungary.name: Salo
hungary.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

hungary.name: Sorrel soup
hungary.description: A soup made from water or broth, sorrel leaves, and salt. Usually includes further ingredients such as egg yolks or whole eggs (hard-boiled or scrambled), potatoes, carrots, parsley root, and rice.

hungary.name: Angel wings
hungary.description: A traditional sweet crisp pastry made out of dough that has been shaped into thin twisted ribbons, deep-fried and sprinkled with powdered sugar.

hungary.name: Smetana
hungary.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

hungary.name: Curd snack
hungary.description: The main part this snack is made from cheese, which is mixed with sugar, sweeteners or other ingredients and milled into a homogenous paste that is pressed into the desired shape and filled with jam or other fillings. The formed bars then pass through the so-called "glaze waterfall" that coats them in chocolate or another type of glaze. Finally, the snacks are cooled in a cooling tunnel and packed.

hungary.name: Helzel
hungary.description: The dish is a sausage made from poultry neck skin stuffed with flour, bread crumbs, and fried onions, sewn up with a thread.
hungary.photoCredit: Wizard85 (original file) ; Off-shell (cropped and reprocessed version)

hungary.name: Nut roll
hungary.description: A sweet yeast dough is rolled flat, and filled with spread usually walnuts spread or poppy seed. The filled dough is rolled up, forming a log or loaf shape, then baked.

hungary.name: Hortobágyi palacsinta
hungary.description: This dish is a savoury crepe filled with meat (usually veal or beef). The crepes are filled with a stew, tucking in the ends.

hungary.name: Főzelék
hungary.description: This dish is a vegetable stew or soup, similar to pottage. It is simply cooked, typically by simmering, not mashing.

hungary.name: Lecsó
hungary.description: The dish is a thick vegetable ragout or stew which contains yellow pointed peppers, tomato, onion, salt, and ground sweet and/or hot paprika as a base recipe.

hungary.name: Pörkölt
hungary.description: This dish is a meat stew with boneless meat, paprika, and some vegetables.

hungary.name: Meringue
hungary.description: The dish is a light, airy dessert or candy made from whipped egg whites and sugar, sometimes with an acidic ingredient like lemon, vinegar, or cream of tartar. A binding agent such as salt, flour, or gelatin may be added. Egg whites are whipped until stiff peaks form by denaturing the protein ovalbumin through mechanical mixing.

dalmatia.name: Kroštule
dalmatia.description: The dish is a traditional pastry. It is made from deep frying dough.

dalmatia.name: Brudet
dalmatia.description: The dish is a fish stew with spices, Vegetable and red or white wine, and vinegar.

dalmatia.name: Frittella
dalmatia.description: The dish is made from dough with raisins, orange peel, and lemon peel on them with fillings.

dalmatia.name: Pašticada
dalmatia.description: The dish is a braised beef cooked in a sweet and sour dark sauce.

lithuania.name: Kūčiukai
lithuania.description: The dish is small, slightly sweet pastries made from leavened dough and poppy seeds. They vary in sweetness and are usually eaten dry but can be served soaked in poppy milk or with cranberry pudding.

lithuania.name: Poppy seed roll
lithuania.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

lithuania.name: Salo
lithuania.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

lithuania.name: Borscht
lithuania.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

lithuania.name: Sorrel soup
lithuania.description: A soup made from water or broth, sorrel leaves, and salt. Usually includes further ingredients such as egg yolks or whole eggs (hard-boiled or scrambled), potatoes, carrots, parsley root, and rice.

lithuania.name: Dressed herring
lithuania.description: A layered salad composed of diced spekesild covered with layers of grated boiled eggs, Vegetable (potatoes, carrots, beetroots), chopped onions, and mayonnaise

lithuania.name: Syrniki
lithuania.description: Pancake made of creamy fermented milk, mixed with flour, eggs and sugar, sometimes adding vanilla extract, mix well and then pan-fried or shallow-fried.
lithuania.photoCredit: Tatyana Morozyuk, color processing by Off-shell

lithuania.name: Varenye
lithuania.description: Whole fruit preservation made by cooking berries, other fruits, or more rarely nuts, Vegetable, or flowers, in sugar syrup (sometimes honey)

lithuania.name: Angel wings
lithuania.description: A traditional sweet crisp pastry made out of dough that has been shaped into thin twisted ribbons, deep-fried and sprinkled with powdered sugar.

lithuania.name: Chrain
lithuania.description: This dish has white and red type. The white consists of grated horseradish and vinegar, and sometimes sugar and salt, while red type includes the addition of beetroot

lithuania.name: Smetana
lithuania.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

lithuania.name: Sushki
lithuania.description: It is a small, crunchy, mildly sweet bread rings eaten for dessert, usually with tea or coffee. Typical ingredients are flour, eggs, water, and salt, which are combined into a firm dough. This is then cut and rolled into thin strips of about half a centimetre thickness which are formed into rings, briefly cooked in boiling sugar water, then baked in an oven.

lithuania.name: Kutia
lithuania.description: This dish is a ceremonial grain dish with sweet gravy traditionally served during the Christmas – Feast of Jordan holiday season or as part of a funeral feast. The main ingredients are wheatberries, poppy seeds, honey or sugar, various nuts and sometimes raisins.

lithuania.name: Kasha
lithuania.description: This dish can be baked but most often is boiled, either in water or milk. The main ingredients are cereal (buckwheat, wheat, barley, oats, millet or rye).

lithuania.name: Pryanik
lithuania.description: These sweets refer to a range of traditional sweet-baked goods and are made from flour and honey.

lithuania.name: Zrazy
lithuania.description: The dish is a meat roulade with a rolled shape and made from thin slices of beef, flavored with salt and pepper and stuffed with Vegetable, mushrooms, eggs, and potatoes.

lithuania.name: Helzel
lithuania.description: The dish is a sausage made from poultry neck skin stuffed with flour, bread crumbs, and fried onions, sewn up with a thread.
lithuania.photoCredit: Wizard85 (original file) ; Off-shell (cropped and reprocessed version)

lithuania.name: Holishkes
lithuania.description: This dish is prepared from blanched cabbage leaves wrapped in a parcel-like manner around minced meat and then simmered in tomato sauce. Sometimes rice is added to the meat filling.

lithuania.name: Kishka
lithuania.description: The dish refers to various types of sausage or stuffed intestine with a filling made from a combination of meat and meal, often grain or potato.

leipzig.name: Leipziger Lerche
leipzig.description: The dish is a pastry. The dish used the actual songbird lark, which was roasted with herbs and eggs and served as a filling in a pastry crust. Today's version consists of a shortcrust filled with a mixture of crushed almonds, nuts and a cherry. The cherry symbolises the heart of the bird. It is topped with a grid of two crossed dough strips.

castilla–la mancha.name: Miguelitos
castilla–la mancha.description: The dish is a type of cream-filled puff pastry, which can also be referred to as a cake. They are a quite simple traditional cake consisting of soft puff pastry with a creamy custard-like filling, with a flaky cake like crust. and covered with sugar powder. They can be filled with milk, dark, and white chocolate along with the original cream. The all around dessert can be served hot or cold.

el salvador.name: Milhojas
el salvador.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

el salvador.name: Pupusa
el salvador.description: This dish is a is a thick griddle cake or flatbread made with cornmeal or rice flour.

el salvador.name: Longaniza
el salvador.description: This sausage is similar to salchichón, though thinner; both differ from chorizo in that black pepper is used for them instead of paprika and may have different spices in them like nutmeg.
el salvador.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Ardo Beltz assumed (based on copyright claims).

el salvador.name: Curtido
el salvador.description: The food is usually made with cabbage, onions, carrots, oregano, and sometimes lime juice.

portugal.name: Milhojas
portugal.description: The dish is a type of dessert. They are made with stacked layers of puff pastry, often filled with whipped egg whites, and other times with creme patissiere; cream; caramelized milk; a creamy mix of condensed milk, sugar, and vanilla; or white chocolate

portugal.name: Broa
portugal.description: A type of maize bread, made from a mixture of cornmeal and rye or wheat flour, and is leavened with yeast rather than baking powder or baking soda.

portugal.name: Portuguese sweet bread
portugal.description: The dish is a bread made by flour, milk, sugar, eggs, yeast, sea salt, butter or olive oil.

portugal.name: Escabeche
portugal.description: The dish is made of marinated fish, meat or Vegetable, cooked or pickled in an acidic sauce (usually with vinegar), and flavored with paprika, citrus, and other spices.

portugal.name: Feijoada
portugal.description: The dish is a beef stew made with white, black, or red beans, accompanied by rice.

portugal.name: Rissole
portugal.description: This dish is a ball or flattened cake of chopped meat, fish, or Vegetable mixed with herbs or spices, then coated in breadcrumbs and fried.

portugal.name: Stuffed squid
portugal.description: This dish is made of made of olive oil, onion, garlic, rice, tomatoes, salt, black pepper, mint leaves, parsley, and tomato juice, with squid as the main ingredient.

portugal.name: Mocotó
portugal.description: The dish is made from cow's feet, stewed with beans and Vegetable.

portugal.name: Fios de ovos
portugal.description: A sweet food made out of egg yolks, drawn into thin strands and boiled in sugar syrup. It is used as a garnish on cakes and puddings, as a filling for cakes, or eaten on its own.

portugal.name: Chicken feet
portugal.description: This dish is a part of chicken which cooked and eaten in many countries. This dish has a distinct gelatinous texture different from the rest of the chicken meat.

portugal.name: Aletria
portugal.description: The dish is a custardy dessert based on thin like pasta.

portugal.name: Eggs and brains
portugal.description: The dish consists of pork brains (or those of another mammal) and scrambled eggs.

portugal.name: Queijada
portugal.description: The dish is a type of small sweet made using cheese, eggs, milk and powdered sugar.

portugal.name: Meringue
portugal.description: The dish is a light, airy dessert or candy made from whipped egg whites and sugar, sometimes with an acidic ingredient like lemon, vinegar, or cream of tartar. A binding agent such as salt, flour, or gelatin may be added. Egg whites are whipped until stiff peaks form by denaturing the protein ovalbumin through mechanical mixing.

portugal.name: Chorizo
portugal.description: This dish is a type of pork sausage with varieties that are quite different from each other depending on the countries and the continent. The most common version is a fermented, cured, smoked sausage which gets its smokiness and deep red color from dried, smoked, red peppers.

portugal.name: Linguiça
portugal.description: This dish is a sausage made from pork and seasoned with onion, garlic, paprika and other spices. It can be used fresh in cooked preparations or undergo a curing and preservation process through smoking.

portugal.name: Migas
portugal.description: This dish is made from stale bread and other ingredients.

portugal.name: Cabrito
portugal.description: This food is roast whole goat over a charcoal fire.

portugal.name: Bacalhau
portugal.description: This is a dried and salted cod, often served with potatoes, sweet potatoes, yams and fresh bread.
portugal.photoCredit: Karl Ragnar Gjertsen Krg This photo was taken by Karl Ragnar Gjertsen . Please credit this photo Karl Ragnar Gjertsen in the immediate vicinity of the image.

portugal.name: Papo-de-anjo
portugal.description: The dish is made of whipped egg yolks, and boiled in sugar syrup to create vibrant colors.

portugal.name: Bacalhau à Gomes de Sá
portugal.description: This dish consists of cod, potatoes, eggs, olives, olive oil, and onion.

portugal.name: Areias
portugal.description: The dish is a biscuit coated with sugar and cinnamon, which resemble sand.

portugal.name: Empadão
portugal.description: The dish is made of red meat between layers of potato, rice, or bread with pasta.

portugal.name: Bife a cavalo
portugal.description: The dish consists of grilled or pan-fried steak with rice, beans, and salad.

portugal.name: Cozido à portuguesa
portugal.description: The dish is a mixed meal consisting of Vegetable, meat, and other toppings.

portugal.name: Cebolada
portugal.description: The dish is a onion stew, sauce, or paste.

portugal.name: Canja de galinha
portugal.description: The dish is a chicken soup with carrot, eggs, olive oil, mint, saffron, clove, and white pepper.
portugal.photoCredit: Sebástian Freire from Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

tatarstan.name: Uchpuchmak
tatarstan.description: The dish is a triangular pastry, filled with chopped meat, onion and potatoes. It is usually eaten with bouillon or with tea. Lamb, and, sometimes, horse meat was used to make a triangular pie. An opening on the top was used to add broth immediately before eating which made it a hot meal. This made cooking in the field fast and easy. Presently, they are often made without an opening, however, it's still served with meat broth in a separate bowl. Beef is the prevalent filling today; other varieties contain goose and duck meat.

tatarstan.name: Qistibi
tatarstan.description: The dish is a roasted flatbread with various fillings inside. The dough should be unleavened. The most popular filling is mashed potato but it may also be ragout or millet.

bashkortostan.name: Uchpuchmak
bashkortostan.description: The dish is a triangular pastry, filled with chopped meat, onion and potatoes. It is usually eaten with bouillon or with tea. Lamb, and, sometimes, horse meat was used to make a triangular pie. An opening on the top was used to add broth immediately before eating which made it a hot meal. This made cooking in the field fast and easy. Presently, they are often made without an opening, however, it's still served with meat broth in a separate bowl. Beef is the prevalent filling today; other varieties contain goose and duck meat.

bashkortostan.name: Qistibi
bashkortostan.description: The dish is a roasted flatbread with various fillings inside. The dough should be unleavened. The most popular filling is mashed potato but it may also be ragout or millet.

bashkortostan.name: Qazı
bashkortostan.description: This is a traditional sausage-like food made from horse meat. It is a common element on a festive meal table. A reviewer described the dish as smoky and earthy. It is often eaten cold, sometimes sliced, and served as an appetiser.

malta.name: Pastizz
malta.description: The dish is a traditional savoury pastry. It is usually have a filling either of cheese or curried peas. They are usually diamond-shaped or round. The pastry is folded in different ways according to the filling, as a means of identification. Traditionally, the cheese one are folded down the middle, whereas pea one are folded down the side.

malta.name: Figolla
malta.description: The dish is a unique shaped stuffed pastry with filling served as sweet. The biscuit base is predominantly made of plain flour, butter/margarine, caster sugar, vanilla essence, eggs, lemon rind and water. The filling is made of ground almonds, caster sugar, egg whites, and almond essence. Some may also add orange rind or more lemon.

malta.name: Bigilla
malta.description: The dish contains mashed beans, olive oil, salt and red pepper. It is usually served as a dip. It could also served as a snack or appetizer and is usually eaten as a spread.

belarus.name: Poppy seed roll
belarus.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

belarus.name: Kholodets
belarus.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients.These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

belarus.name: Salo
belarus.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

belarus.name: Rassolnik
belarus.description: The dish is a kind of soup made from pickled cucumbers, pearl barley, and pork or beef kidneys.

belarus.name: Borscht
belarus.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

belarus.name: Sorrel soup
belarus.description: A soup made from water or broth, sorrel leaves, and salt. Usually includes further ingredients such as egg yolks or whole eggs (hard-boiled or scrambled), potatoes, carrots, parsley root, and rice.

belarus.name: Dressed herring
belarus.description: A layered salad composed of diced spekesild covered with layers of grated boiled eggs, Vegetable (potatoes, carrots, beetroots), chopped onions, and mayonnaise

belarus.name: Syrniki
belarus.description: Pancake made of creamy fermented milk, mixed with flour, eggs and sugar, sometimes adding vanilla extract, mix well and then pan-fried or shallow-fried.
belarus.photoCredit: Tatyana Morozyuk, color processing by Off-shell

belarus.name: Korovai
belarus.description: A large round braided bread, traditionally baked from wheat flour and decorated with symbolic flags and figurines, such as suns, moons, birds, animals, and pine cones

belarus.name: Varenye
belarus.description: Whole fruit preservation made by cooking berries, other fruits, or more rarely nuts, Vegetable, or flowers, in sugar syrup (sometimes honey)

belarus.name: Chrain
belarus.description: This dish has white and red type. The white consists of grated horseradish and vinegar, and sometimes sugar and salt, while red type includes the addition of beetroot

belarus.name: Smetana
belarus.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

belarus.name: Sushki
belarus.description: It is a small, crunchy, mildly sweet bread rings eaten for dessert, usually with tea or coffee. Typical ingredients are flour, eggs, water, and salt, which are combined into a firm dough. This is then cut and rolled into thin strips of about half a centimetre thickness which are formed into rings, briefly cooked in boiling sugar water, then baked in an oven.

belarus.name: Kulich
belarus.description: This bread is round and tall, and dough decorations were made on top of it.

belarus.name: Kutia
belarus.description: This dish is a ceremonial grain dish with sweet gravy traditionally served during the Christmas – Feast of Jordan holiday season or as part of a funeral feast. The main ingredients are wheatberries, poppy seeds, honey or sugar, various nuts and sometimes raisins.

belarus.name: Kasha
belarus.description: This dish can be baked but most often is boiled, either in water or milk. The main ingredients are cereal (buckwheat, wheat, barley, oats, millet or rye).

belarus.name: Pryanik
belarus.description: These sweets refer to a range of traditional sweet-baked goods and are made from flour and honey.

czech republic.name: Poppy seed roll
czech republic.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

czech republic.name: Vánočka
czech republic.description: It is rich in eggs and butter, making it similar to brioche. Lemon rind and rum add colour and flavour; the dough can also contain raisins and almonds and is plaited.

czech republic.name: Salo
czech republic.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

czech republic.name: Helzel

czech republic.name: Nut roll
czech republic.description: A sweet yeast dough is rolled flat, and filled with spread usually walnuts spread or poppy seed. The filled dough is rolled up, forming a log or loaf shape, then baked.

slovenia.name: Poppy seed roll
slovenia.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

slovenia.name: Salo
slovenia.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

slovenia.name: Angel wings
slovenia.description: A traditional sweet crisp pastry made out of dough that has been shaped into thin twisted ribbons, deep-fried and sprinkled with powdered sugar.

slovenia.name: Chrain
slovenia.description: This dish has white and red type. The white consists of grated horseradish and vinegar, and sometimes sugar and salt, while red type includes the addition of beetroot

slovenia.name: Smetana
slovenia.description: A dairy product produced by souring heavy cream

slovenia.name: Kasha

slovenia.name: Tufahije
slovenia.description: The dish is a walnut-stuffed apples poached in sugar water.

slovenia.name: Helzel
slovenia.description: The dish is a sausage made from poultry neck skin stuffed with flour, bread crumbs, and fried onions, sewn up with a thread.
slovenia.photoCredit: Wizard85 (original file) ; Off-shell (cropped and reprocessed version)

slovenia.name: Swiss roll
slovenia.description: This dish is a type of rolled sponge cake filled with whipped cream, jam, icing, or any type of filling.

slovenia.name: Nut roll
slovenia.description: A sweet yeast dough is rolled flat, and filled with spread usually walnuts spread or poppy seed. The filled dough is rolled up, forming a log or loaf shape, then baked.

slovenia.name: Meringue
slovenia.description: The dish is a light, airy dessert or candy made from whipped egg whites and sugar, sometimes with an acidic ingredient like lemon, vinegar, or cream of tartar. A binding agent such as salt, flour, or gelatin may be added. Egg whites are whipped until stiff peaks form by denaturing the protein ovalbumin through mechanical mixing.

slovenia.name: Žganci
slovenia.description: The dish is a traditional "poor man"s food" of hard-working farmhands similar to polenta, although prepared with finer grains. The dish is made from buckwheat flour and cornmeal, cooking oil and salt, which is cooked for fifteen minutes on a low boil.

slovenia.name: Aspic
slovenia.description: The dish is a savory gelatin made with a meat stock or broth, set in a mold to encase other ingredients. These often include pieces of meat, seafood, vegetable, or eggs.

latvia.name: Poppy seed roll
latvia.description: The dish is a pastry consisting of a roll of sweet yeast bread (a sweet roll) with a dense, rich, bittersweet filling of poppy seed. An alternative filling is a paste of minced walnuts, or minced chestnuts.

latvia.name: Speķrauši
latvia.description: Oblong or crescent-shaped baked bread rolls or pastries filled with finely chopped fatty bacon cubes and onions.

latvia.name: Salo
latvia.description: The dish consists of salt-cured slabs of pork subcutaneous fat with or without skin and with or without layers of meat.

latvia.name: Borscht
latvia.description: A sour soup made with meat stock, Vegetable, and seasonings, with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients.

latvia.name: Solyanka
latvia.description: A thick sour soup with cabbage, salted cucumbers, meat, poultry, fish, or mushrooms

latvia.name: Sorrel soup
latvia.description: A soup made from water or broth, sorrel leaves, and salt. Usually includes further ingredients such as egg yolks or whole eggs (hard-boiled or scrambled), potatoes, carrots, parsley root, and rice.

latvia.name: Dressed herring

latvia.name: Holishkes
latvia.description: This dish is prepared from blanched cabbage leaves wrapped in a parcel-like manner around minced meat and then simmered in tomato sauce. Sometimes rice is added to the meat filling.

latvia.name: Grey peas
latvia.description: This dish is usually a snack served on a plate, sprinkled with salt, mixed with cracklings and onions. Soak the peas and cook them gently (it is important not to overcook so that the peas do not come out of their skin). Chopped bacon and onions are fried in a pan.

latvia.name: Kishka
latvia.description: The dish refers to various types of sausage or stuffed intestine with a filling made from a combination of meat and meal, often grain or potato.

paris.name: Puits d'amour
paris.description: The dish is a pastry with a hollow center. The center is usually stuffed with redcurrant jelly or raspberry jam; a later variation replaced the jam with vanilla pastry cream. The surface of the cake is sprinkled with confectioners' sugar or covered with caramel.

paris.name: Ragout
paris.description: The dish is made by slow cooking over a low heat. The main ingredients are many; it may be prepared with or without meat, a wide variety of Vegetable may be incorporated, and they may be more or less heavily spiced and seasoned.

yazd.name: Qottab
yazd.description: The dish is an almond-filled deep-fried Iranian cuisine pastry or cake, prepared with flour, almonds, powdered sugar, vegetable oil, and cardamom.
yazd.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Roozitaa assumed (based on copyright claims).

apulia.name: Rustico
apulia.description: The dish is a snack made with puff pastry and stuffings that vary by style. A common preparation uses puff pastry, tomato, and mozzarella. It is part of the street food tradition and can be found in bar, bakery, and rotisserie.

apulia.name: Pane di Altamura
apulia.description: The dish is a type of naturally leavened bread made from remilled durum wheat semolina.

apulia.name: Parmigiana
apulia.description: This dish is made with fried, sliced eggplant layered with cheese and tomato sauce, then baked.

apulia.name: Scamorza
apulia.description: This is a type of cheese made by cow milk. It is a "stretched curd" cheese, in which the fresh curd matures in its own whey for several hours to allow the acidity to develop through the conversion of lactose to lactic acid.

iceland.name: Semla
iceland.description: The dish is a traditional sweet roll made in various forms. It consists of a cardamom-spiced wheat bun which has its top cut off, and is then filled with a mix of milk and almond paste, topped with whipped cream. The cut-off top serves as a lid and is dusted with powdered sugar. Today it is often eaten on its own, with coffee or tea. Some prefer to eat it in a bowl of hot milk.

iceland.name: Flatkaka
iceland.description: Unleavened rye flatbread that is soft, round, thin and dark with a characteristic pattern from the pan. Traditionally, it was baked on hot stones or straight on the embers of the fire, later on small but heavy cast iron frying pans, and today, when making the dish at home, people sometimes bake them directly on an electric hot plate to get the desired result.

iceland.name: Laufabrauð
iceland.description: The dish is a traditional kind of bread. It consists of round, very thin flat cakes with a diameter of about 15 to 20 cm (6 to 8 inches), decorated with leaf-like, geometric patterns and fried briefly in hot tallow or oil.

trinidad and tobago.name: Aloo pie
trinidad and tobago.description: The dish is a fast food dish. It is a pastry filled with seasoned mashed potatoes and then fried. It is therefore similar to fried dumpling, but at 10-15 cm in length it is significantly larger, and it does not have a triangular basic shape. The dough consists of flour, water, salt, baking powder and if necessary some saffron for the color. Seasonings and ingredients used in the mashed potatoes include salt, pepper, onion, cumin, and garlic, and occasionally green seasoning and long coriander. As a rule, the dumplings are cut open before serving and garnished with a curry based on chickpeas or green peas. It is seasoned with a sauce (usually based on tamarind or mango) and a spicy pepper sauce.

trinidad and tobago.name: Paratha
trinidad and tobago.description: The dish is a kine of unleavened flatbreads made by baking or cooking whole-wheat dough on a tava, and finishing off with shallow-frying.

trinidad and tobago.name: Roti
trinidad and tobago.description: The dish is a round flatbread made from stoneground whole wheat flour

trinidad and tobago.name: Goat curry
trinidad and tobago.description: The dish is a curry dish prepared with goat meat.

north carolina.name: Atlantic Beach pie
north carolina.description: The dish is a type of lemon curd pie which uses a saltine crust and whipped cream topping sprinkled with salt. The pie uses a crust containing saltines, butter, and sugar and a curd containing lemons or limes, condensed milk, and egg yolks. The curd is topped with a sweetened whipped cream and then finishing salt and/or lemon zest. The pie is notable for the speed and ease with which it can be made.

north carolina.name: Moravian chicken pie
north carolina.description: A savory meat pie which is a double crusted pie made with flaky shortcrust pastry filled with only chunks of poached chicken meat and a thick broth-based sauce. Unlike chicken pot pies, Vegetable are never included in the filling. The pie is served in slices with hot chicken gravy on top, and extra gravy on the side.

north carolina.name: Honey bun
north carolina.description: The dish is a fried yeast pastry that contains honey and a swirl of cinnamon in the dough and is glazed with icing.

east sussex.name: Banoffee pie
east sussex.description: The dish is a dessert pie made from bananas, whipped cream, and a thick caramel sauce (made from boiled condensed milk, or milk jam), combined either on a buttery biscuit base or one made from crumbled biscuits and butter. Some versions of the recipe include chocolate, coffee, or both.

new south wales.name: Caramel tart
new south wales.description: A sweet tart, filled with a soft piped caramel filling.

new south wales.name: Chiko Roll
new south wales.description: Deep fried pastry roll filled with cabbage and barley, as well as carrot, green beans, beef, beef tallow, wheat cereal, celery and onion

queensland.name: Caramel tart
queensland.description: A sweet tart, filled with a soft piped caramel filling.

queensland.name: Lamington
queensland.description: The dish is a butter cake or sponge cake coated with outler layer of chocolate sauce and grated coconut.

quebec.name: Pâté chinois
quebec.description: The dish is made with layered ground beef (sometimes mixed with sautéed diced onions) on the bottom, canned corn (either whole-kernel, creamed, or a mixture) for the middle layer, and mashed potatoes on top. Seasonings may be added to the top. Variations may include reversing the layering of ingredients with potatoes at the bottom, then meat, topped with creamed corn; adding diced bell peppers to the ground beef; and serving the dish with pickled eggs or beets. Once served, ketchup can be added.

quebec.name: Tourtière
quebec.description: Meat pie dish usually made with minced pork, veal or beef and potatoes. There is no one correct filling; the meat depends on what is regionally available. In coastal areas, fish such as salmon is commonly used, whereas pork, beef, rabbit and game are often included inland.

quebec.name: Montreal-style bagel
quebec.description: The dish contains malt, egg, and no salt, and is boiled in honey-sweetened water before being baked.

quebec.name: Pets de sœurs
quebec.description: The dish is a dessert that is made from pie dough; often from left over dough, that is layered with butter, brown sugar, then rolled, sliced, placed in a pan, covered with additional brown sugar, and finally baked.

kentucky.name: Derby pie
kentucky.description: A chocolate and walnut open-faced custard pie baked in a (pre-baked) pie shell.

kentucky.name: Goetta
kentucky.description: The dish is made with meat, oats, broth, spices, often onions, and occasionally other vegetables, simmered until thick, poured into loaf pans and chilled or allowed to cool completely so that the loaves become firm enough to slice. It is then cut into slices and fried, often in butter.
kentucky.photoCredit: David Berkowitz from New York, NY, USA

leicestershire.name: Melton Mowbray pork pie
leicestershire.description: The uncured meat of this pie is grey in colour when cooked and the meat is chopped, rather than minced. As the pies are baked free-standing, the sides bow outwards, rather than being vertical as with mould-baked pies.

lisbon.name: Pastel de nata
lisbon.description: Egg custard tart pastry, optionally dusted with cinnamon.

lisbon.name: Bacalhau à Brás
lisbon.description: The dish is a shredded salted cod chopped with fried potatoes, cooked with eggs.

devon.name: Pasty
devon.description: A pastry case traditionally filled with beef skirt, potato, swede and onion.

devon.name: Hog's pudding
devon.description: This is a type of sausage. Popular variants of the recipe consist of pork meat and fat, suet, bread, as well as oatmeal or pearl barley formed into a large sausage whereas other versions of the recipe contain a high percentage of offal such as lung and liver.

prince edward island.name: Rappie pie
prince edward island.description: It is a casserole-like dish formed by grating potatoes, then squeezing them through cheesecloth to remove some of the water from the potato solids. The removed liquid is replaced by adding hot broth made from chicken, pork or seafood along with meat and onions, and layering additional grated potatoes over the top. Common meat fillings include beef, chicken, or bar clams.

new brunswick.name: Rappie pie
new brunswick.description: It is a casserole-like dish formed by grating potatoes, then squeezing them through cheesecloth to remove some of the water from the potato solids. The removed liquid is replaced by adding hot broth made from chicken, pork or seafood along with meat and onions, and layering additional grated potatoes over the top. Common meat fillings include beef, chicken, or bar clams.

saskatchewan.name: Saskatoon berry pie
saskatchewan.description: A pie with Saskatoon berry filling. It is often served with whipped cream, ice cream, or slices of cheddar cheese.

brazil.name: Sfiha
brazil.description: A dish consisting of flatbread cooked with a minced meat topping, often lamb flavored with parsley, onion, tomato, pine nuts, and spices.

brazil.name: Potato bread
brazil.description: The dish is a form of bread in which potato flour or potato replaces a portion of the regular wheat flour.

brazil.name: Galinhada
brazil.description: This dish is a stew of rice with chicken.

brazil.name: Mocotó
brazil.description: The dish is made from cow's feet, stewed with beans and Vegetable.

brazil.name: Moqueca
brazil.description: The dish is typically made with shrimp or fish in a base of tomatoes, onions, garlic, lime, coriander, palm oil and coconut milk.

brazil.name: Cheese bun
brazil.description: The dish refer to a variety of small, baked, cheese-flavored rolls, a popular snack and breakfast food. It may be made with cassava and or corn starch, and cheese. In countries where the snack is popular, it is inexpensive and often sold from street vendors, bakeries, in snack shops, and in grocery stores.

brazil.name: Ham and egg bun
brazil.description: The dish is a bun or bread that contains a sheet of egg and ham.

brazil.name: Quindim
brazil.description: The dish is a baked dessert, made primarily from sugar, egg yolks, and ground coconut. It has a custard-like texture, a glossy surface, and a bright yellow color. Typically served in small, upturned portions, it can also be made in a larger mold and served in slices.

brazil.name: Meringue
brazil.description: The dish is a light, airy dessert or candy made from whipped egg whites and sugar, sometimes with an acidic ingredient like lemon, vinegar, or cream of tartar. A binding agent such as salt, flour, or gelatin may be added. Egg whites are whipped until stiff peaks form by denaturing the protein ovalbumin through mechanical mixing.

brazil.name: Feijão tropeiro
brazil.description: It consists of beans mixed with cassava or maize flour, sausage, eggs, bacon or toucinho, seasoned with garlic, onion, parsley and peppercorn.

brazil.name: Linguiça
brazil.description: This dish is a sausage made from pork and seasoned with onion, garlic, paprika and other spices. It can be used fresh in cooked preparations or undergo a curing and preservation process through smoking.

brazil.name: Cabrito
brazil.description: This food is roast whole goat over a charcoal fire.

brazil.name: Cocada
brazil.description: This dish is a traditional coconut confectionery made with with eggs and shredded coconut.

brazil.name: Beijinho
brazil.description: The dish is prepared with condensed milk, grated coconut, sugar, frequently toped with clove.

brazil.name: Brigadeiro
brazil.description: The dish is made of condensed milk, cocoa powder, butter, and chocolate sprinkle covering outside layer.

brazil.name: Canjica
brazil.description: The dish is a porridge made with white or yellow maize kernels, cooked with milk, sugar, and cinnamon until tender.

brazil.name: Creme de papaya
brazil.description: The dish is a papaya blended with vanilla ice cream.

brazil.name: Maria-mole
brazil.description: The dish is similar shape to marshmallow, made with sugar, gelatine, egg whites.
brazil.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Carioca assumed (based on copyright claims).

brazil.name: Passion fruit mousse
brazil.description: The dish is a passion fruit-flavored variation of dessert, with gelatin, egg, milk, and fruit juice.

brazil.name: Olho de sogra
brazil.description: The dish is a candy made of dried plum with crystal sugar.
brazil.photoCredit: Gilberto Santa Rosa from Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

brazil.name: Pavê
brazil.description: The dish is an alternating layer of biscuits and a cream made with condensed milk.

brazil.name: Pé de moleque
brazil.description: The dish is a candy made of peanuts and molasses.
brazil.photoCredit: No machine-readable author provided. Meksyk~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

brazil.name: Queijadinha
brazil.description: The dish is a custard tart made from coconut and cheese, sweetend condensed milk, sugar, butter, and egg yolks.

brazil.name: Empadão
brazil.description: The dish is made of red meat between layers of potato, rice, or bread with pasta.

brazil.name: Bife a cavalo
brazil.description: The dish consists of grilled or pan-fried steak with rice, beans, and salad.

brazil.name: Canja de galinha
brazil.description: The dish is a chicken soup with carrot, eggs, olive oil, mint, saffron, clove, and white pepper.
brazil.photoCredit: Sebástian Freire from Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

jamaica.name: Bammy
jamaica.description: It is made from bitter cassava. Traditionally, the cassava is grated and placed in a press bag and placed in an outdoor press where heavy stones are loaded on. Once completely drained, but still a bit moist, the cassava is beaten in a mortar then sieved to a fine flour texture. Salt is then added to taste.

jamaica.name: Peg bread
jamaica.description: The dish is a bread that usually served along with tea in the morning.

jamaica.name: Roti
jamaica.description: The dish is a round flatbread made from stoneground whole wheat flour

jamaica.name: Ackee and saltfish
jamaica.description: The dish can be garnished with bacon and tomatoes, and is usually served as breakfast alongside breadfruit, hard dough bread, dumplings, or boiled green bananas.
jamaica.photoCredit: gailf548 from New York State, USA

jamaica.name: Coco bread
jamaica.description: The dish is a bread that contains milk or coconut milk and is starchy and slightly sweet in taste.

jamaica.name: Goat curry
jamaica.description: The dish is a curry dish prepared with goat meat.

jamaica.name: Run down
jamaica.description: The dish consists of a stew made up of reduced coconut milk, with different types of seafood , plantain, yam, tomato, onion, and seasonings.

jamaica.name: Jerk chicken
jamaica.description: The dish is a style of cooking, in which meat is dry-rubbed or wet marinated with a hot spice mixture.

jamaica.name: Gizzada
jamaica.description: The dish is contained in a small, crisp pastry shell with a pinched crust and filled with a sweet and spiced coconut filling.

jamaica.name: Stamp and Go
jamaica.description: The dish is made with salt fish.

jamaica.name: Solomon Gundy
jamaica.description: The dish  is made with smoked red herring and is minced and spiced with Scotch Bonnet peppers and seasonings.

jamaica.name: Bulla cake
jamaica.description: The dish is a rich cake made with molasses and spiced with ginger and nutmeg, sometimes dark-colored and other times light-colored.

jamaica.name: Toto
jamaica.description: The dish is a kind of  small coconut cake prepared with shredded coconut, brown sugar, flour, baking soda and powder, and coconut milk.

jamaica.name: Chicken feet
jamaica.description: This dish is a part of chicken which cooked and eaten in many countries. This dish has a distinct gelatinous texture different from the rest of the chicken meat.

jamaica.name: Fruit bun
jamaica.description: The dish is a type of sweet roll made with fruit, fruit peel, spices and sometimes nuts. They are made with fruit and fruit peel , which are sprinkled and cooked with sugar nibs.

madeira island.name: Bolo do caco
madeira island.description: A circular flatbread, shaped like a cake, traditionally cooked on a flat basalt stone slab. The bread is usually served with garlic butter, or eaten as a sandwich with octopus or a steak.

madeira island.name: Passion fruit mousse
madeira island.description: The dish is a passion fruit-flavored variation of dessert, with gelatin, egg, milk, and fruit juice.

asunción.name: Chipa
asunción.description: This dish is a a type of small, baked, cheese-flavored rolls, often baked in smaller doughnuts or buns made from cassava starch, corn starch, fat, milk, egg, and local cheese.

veneto.name: Ciabatta
veneto.description: This is a white bread that is elongated, broad, and flat, and is baked in many variations, although unique for its alveolar holes. It is made with a strong flour and uses a very high hydration dough.

veneto.name: Casunziei
veneto.description: The dish is a stuffed pasta, consisting of filling sealed between two layers of thin pasta dough, folded in a typical half-moon shape.

veneto.name: Porchetta
veneto.description: This dish is a is a savory, fatty, and moist boneless pork roast. The carcass is deboned and spitted or roasted traditionally over wood for at least eight hours, fat and skin still on.
veneto.photoCredit: Pedro Angelini from São Paulo, Brasil

veneto.name: Pasta e fagioli
veneto.description: It is often called pasta fasul or pasta fazool. pasta soup of which there are several regional variants.

veneto.name: Frittella
veneto.description: The dish is made from dough with raisins, orange peel, and lemon peel on them with fillings.

buenos aires.name: Fugazza
buenos aires.description: A thick pizza crust topped with onions, cheese, and sometimes olives. It is derived from a combination of Neapolitan pizza with Italian focaccia bread.

mauritania.name: Ka'ak
mauritania.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

mauritania.name: Thieboudienne
mauritania.description: This dish is prepared with fish, broken rice and tomato sauce cooked in one pot. Additional ingredients often include onions, carrots, cabbage, cassava, hot pepper, lime and peanut oil, and stock cubes.

mauritania.name: Mesfouf
mauritania.description: The dish is made of peas and beans with sweet taste accompanied by butter and olive oil.

mauritania.name: Merguez
mauritania.description: The dish is a lamb or beef based fresh sausage.

sudan.name: Ka'ak
sudan.description: The dish refer to several different types of baked goods. The bread is similar to a dry and hardened biscuit and mostly ring-shaped.

sudan.name: Kamounia
sudan.description: The dish is a beef and liver stew prepared with cumin.

sudan.name: Shahan ful
sudan.description: The dish is a slow-cooked fava beans in water, cruhed into a coarse paste.

sudan.name: Mulukhiyah
sudan.description: The dish is a soup made of jute leaves resulting in thick liquid or broth, chopped with garlic, cilantro, and dressed with oil.

sudan.name: Matbucha
sudan.description: The dish is a condiment or cooked salad consisting of cooked tomatoes with roasted bell peppers seasoned with garlic and chili pepper.

sudan.name: Freekeh
sudan.description: The dish is a roasted and rubbed macarroni wheat.

sudan.name: Falafel
sudan.description: The dish is a deep-fried ball or patty-shaped fritter made from broad beans, ground chickpease, or both.

sudan.name: Stuffed dates
sudan.description: The dish is a heated dates filled with meat, mint, and parsley with different stuffing including butters and goat cheese.

sudan.name: Bamia
sudan.description: This is a dish made with okra, lamb, and tomatoes as primary ingredients. Additional ingredients used can include tomato sauce or tomato paste, onion, garlic, cilantro (coriander), pomegranate molasses, vegetable oil, cardamom, salt and pepper.

rome.name: Michetta
rome.description: The dish is a bread recognizable by its bulged shape.

rome.name: Deviled egg
rome.description: The dish is a stuffed eggs, curry eggs, or dressed eggs, are hard-boiled, peeled egg mixed with other ingredients such as mayonnaise and mustard, or other toppings.

rome.name: Saltimbocca
rome.description: This dish consists of veal that has been wrapped (lined) with prosciutto and sage and then marinated in wine, oil or salt water, depending on the region or one's own taste.

jalisco.name: Sandwich roll
jalisco.description: The dish is a type of white bread usually made from wheat flour, yeast, water and salt

jalisco.name: Birria
jalisco.description: This dish is a stew mainly made with goat, beef, or lamb. The meat is marinated in a type of sauce made of vinegar, dried chiles, garlic, and herbs and spices (including cumin, bay leaves, and thyme) before being cooked in a broth.

jalisco.name: Bionico
jalisco.description: This dish is a fruit salad consisting of a variety of fruits chopped up into small cubes, drenched with cream and topped off with granola, shredded coconut, raisins and sometimes honey.

fiji.name: Paratha
fiji.description: The dish is a kine of unleavened flatbreads made by baking or cooking whole-wheat dough on a tava, and finishing off with shallow-frying.

guyana.name: Paratha
guyana.description: The dish is a kine of unleavened flatbreads made by baking or cooking whole-wheat dough on a tava, and finishing off with shallow-frying.

guyana.name: Roti
guyana.description: The dish is a round flatbread made from stoneground whole wheat flour

guyana.name: Goat curry
guyana.description: The dish is a curry dish prepared with goat meat.

guyana.name: Guyanese pepperpot
guyana.description: This dish is a stew that is usually reserved for special occasions because it needs to cook for several hours, and mostly eaten on Christmas Day or during the Christmas holiday season, and sometimes on Boxing Day.

kraków.name: Obwarzanek krakowski
kraków.description: The dish is a braided ring-shaped bread that is boiled and sprinkled with salt and sesame or poppy seeds before being baked.

minas gerais.name: Pão de queijo
minas gerais.description: The dish is a small, baked cheese roll or cheese ball.

minas gerais.name: Paçoca
minas gerais.description: The dish is made of ground peanuts, sugar, honey, and salt, usually mold a shape of box or cylinder candy.

naples.name: Pizza
naples.description: The dish consists of a flat base of leavened wheat-based dough topped with tomato, cheese, and other ingredients, baked at a high temperature, traditionally in a wood-fired oven.

westphalia.name: Pumpernickel
westphalia.description: The dish is a typically dense, slightly sweet rye bread traditionally made with sourdough starter and coarsely ground rye.

rhineland.name: Röggelchen
rhineland.description: The dish is a small pastry in the form of a double roll made from two pieces of dough. The rye content must be at least 50% of the flour. The rye dough consists of a bread roll dough to which rye flour or sourdough is added.

moscow.name: Rasstegai
moscow.description: This pastry has a hole in the center, which is stuffed with a wide variety of fillings – from liver with eggs to rice with mushrooms. However, the traditional stuffing is minced fish such as sturgeon or salmon.
moscow.photoCredit: Ekaterina ; processed by Off-shell (removed watermarks, adjusted colours)

moscow.name: Medovik
moscow.description: It is a dessert which is known for its lengthy preparation time. It consists of layers of cake with a cream filling and is often covered with nuts or crumbs made from leftover cake. While the thin layers harden shortly after coming out of the oven, the moisture of the filling softens it again over time.

cameroon.name: Achu
cameroon.description: The dish is a soup made with cocoyam. Spices, water, palm oil, limestone, and fish are other ingredients.

cameroon.name: Alloco
cameroon.description: It is commonly made from cut plantains in slices, fry them until they are yellow, smash them between two plates and fry them again.

cameroon.name: Eru
cameroon.description: This dish is made up of finely shredded leaves of a species of vine. This dish is cooked with waterleaf or spinach, palm oil, crayfish, and either smoked fish, cow skin or beef.

cameroon.name: Egusi
cameroon.description: These protein-rich seeds are from certain cucurbitaceous plants (squash, melon, gourd), which, after being dried and ground.

cameroon.name: Ndolé
cameroon.description: The dish is a stewed nuts, containing beef or fish as the source of protein.

cameroon.name: Moambe chicken
cameroon.description: The dish is a savory chicken with spices and palm butter.

zimbabwe.name: Boerewors
zimbabwe.description: This dish is made from coarsely minced beef, minced pork, lamb and or goat. It also contains spices (usually toasted coriander seed, black pepper, nutmeg, cloves and allspice).

zimbabwe.name: Biltong
zimbabwe.description: This dish is a form of dried, cured meat. Various types of meat are used to produce it, ranging from beef to game meats such as ostrich or kudu. The cut may also vary being either fillets of meat cut into strips following the grain of the muscle, or flat pieces sliced across the grain.

zimbabwe.name: Delele
zimbabwe.description: This dish is prepared with baking soda and well known for its slimy texture. It can be dried before cooking, but more frequently it is cooked fresh.

botswana.name: Boerewors

botswana.name: Seswaa
botswana.description: The dish is made of beef or goat leftover cuts, boiled in a pot.

botswana.name: South Asian pickle
botswana.description: It is a pickled food made from a variety of vegetables, meats and fruits preserved in brine, vinegar, edible oils, and various spices.

senegal.name: Tapalapa
senegal.description: This dish is a traditional bread based on the baguette, though it is slightly smaller, and baked in a large, traditional wood-burning oven made of mud brick. The main ingredients are flour (both wheat and millet are used), salt, water and yeast. The resulting bread is heavier and more filling than a typical baguette.

In addition to fried beans, other variations have added avocado, meat stew, gravy, chicken, or liver. This dish is served in street food stalls and higher-end restaurants.

côte d'ivoire.name: Peanut stew
côte d'ivoire.description: The dish is a stew made from peanut butter sauce.

seychelles.name: Shark chutney
seychelles.description: The dish is a boiled skinned shark, mashed and cooked with juice and lime.

cape town.name: Gatsby
cape town.description: The dish is a bread roll filled with chips, calamaris, seafood, and fillings with sauces.

republic of the congo.description: The dish is a savory chicken with spices and palm butter.

puebla.name: Chiles en nogada
puebla.description: The dish is a pepper chiles stuffed with a mixture of shredded meat, aromatics, fruits and spices, topped with a walnut-based cream.

puebla.name: Chile relleno
puebla.description: The dish is a green chile pepper stuffed with minced meat and coated with eggs.

puebla.name: Memela
puebla.description: These are fried or toasted cakes made of masa topped with different fresh ingredients eaten as streetfood or snacks. The flat cakes are slightly thicker and usually oblong/oval.

puebla.name: Mole poblano
puebla.description: This contains about 20 ingredients, including sugar and cocoa, but for practicality and simplicity, chocolate is also used, which works to counteract the heat of the chili peppers, but its flavor does not dominate.

puebla.name: Al pastor
puebla.description: This food is a preparation of spit-grilled slices of pork.

puebla.name: Tlayuda
puebla.description: This food consists of a large, thin, crunchy, partially fried or toasted tortilla covered with a spread of refried beans, unrefined pork lard, lettuce or cabbage, avocado, meat, cheese, and sauces.
puebla.photoCredit: The original uploader was Bobak at English Wikipedia .

chicago.name: Stuffed pizza
chicago.description: The dish is a pizza which has typical deeper dough and another layering of dough covering the toppings.

chicago.name: Bagel dog
chicago.description: The dish is a hot dog wrapped in bagel-style breading before or after cooking.
chicago.photoCredit: The original uploader was Wl219 at English Wikipedia .

chicago.name: Ham and egg bun
chicago.description: The dish is a bun or bread that contains a sheet of egg and ham.

chicago.name: Hot link sausage
chicago.description: The dish is a type of sausage prepared using pork, beef, or a combination of both. It is sometimes used as an ingredient in other dishes.

são paulo.name: Coxinha
são paulo.description: The dish is a chopped or shredded chicken meat covered in dough and molded into a shape resembling a teardrop before being battered and fried.

nicaragua.name: Nacatamal
nicaragua.description: This dish is made with corn dough which is stuffed with meat like pork, turket, or chicken, then wrapped in plantain leaves and steamed.

veracruz.name: Plátanos rellenos
veracruz.description: This dish consists of plantain stuffed with meat and seasonings and fried.

veracruz.name: Huachinango a la Veracruzana
veracruz.description: This dish consists of a whole red snapper, gutted and de-scaled and marinated in lime juice, salt, pepper, nutmeg and garlic. A sauce is made of onions, garlic, tomato, a type of chili pepper, olives and herbs, and the fish is baked with the sauce until tender.

marche.name: Porchetta
marche.description: This dish is a is a savory, fatty, and moist boneless pork roast. The carcass is deboned and spitted or roasted traditionally over wood for at least eight hours, fat and skin still on.
marche.photoCredit: Pedro Angelini from São Paulo, Brasil

marche.name: Stracciatella
marche.description: The dish is an soup consisting of meat broth and small shreds of an egg-based mixture, prepared by drizzling the mixture into boiling broth and stirring.

nebraska.name: Runza
nebraska.description: This dish is a yeast dough bread pocket with a filling consisting of ground beef, cabbage or sauerkraut, onions, and seasonings.

silesia.name: Šoldra
silesia.description: This dish is a bread with dough stuffed with various sausages, such as smoked meat sausage, white wine sausage, and ham/pork sausage.

southland.name: Cheese roll
southland.description: This dish is created by covering a slice of bread in a prepared filling consisting mainly of grated or sliced cheese, and then rolling it into a tube shape before toasting.

kolkata.name: Kati roll
kolkata.description: This street food dish is a skewer-roasted kebab wrapped in a flatbread.

minneapolis.name: Jucy Lucy
minneapolis.description: This dish is a stuffed cheeseburger with the cheese inside of the meat instead of on top, resulting in a melted core of cheese.

victoria.name: Chiko Roll
victoria.description: Deep fried pastry roll filled with cabbage and barley, as well as carrot, green beans, beef, beef tallow, wheat cereal, celery and onion

seattle.name: Seattle roll
seattle.description: A rice roll dish consists of raw salmon and cream cheese, usually along with cucumber and/or avocado, and sometimes masago or tobiko(fish roe)

washington.name: Seattle roll
washington.description: A rice roll dish consists of raw salmon and cream cheese, usually along with cucumber and/or avocado, and sometimes masago or tobiko(fish roe)

washington.name: Half-smoke
washington.description: This dish is a larger, spicier, and with more coarsely-ground meat than a regular hot dog, with the sausage often to be half-pork and half-beef, smoked, and served with herbs, onion, and chili sauce.

berlin.name: Ragout fin
berlin.description: consists of veal, sweetbread, calf brain, tongue and bone marrow, chicken breast and fish, everything boiled either in a vinegar stock or diced and stewed in butter, and then mixed with stewed button mushrooms and thickened with egg yolk

stockholm.name: Wallenbergare
stockholm.description: A dish consisting of a breaded ground veal patty, flavored with cream and egg yolk, pan-fried until golden and traditionally served with potatoes, lingonberries, and peas.

flanders.name: Waterzooi
flanders.description: This is a stew often made with fish, either freshwater or sea, though chicken is more common today. The stew contains fish or chicken, Vegetable (including carrots, onions, celery, leeks, and potatoes), and herbs (parsley, thyme, bay leaves, and sage).

flanders.name: Hochepot
flanders.description: This dish is a stew made with oxtail, shoulder of mutton, salted bacon, and vegetables. The stewed vegetables are served whole.

granada.name: Andrajos
granada.description: This dish is a stew made of tomato, onion, garlic, red pepper and rabbit, thickened with cake flour. Hare and cod are often used instead of rabbit.

nord-pas-de-calais.name: Hochepot
nord-pas-de-calais.description: This dish is a stew made with oxtail, shoulder of mutton, salted bacon, and vegetables. The stewed vegetables are served whole.

basque country.name: Tuna pot
basque country.description: The dish is a simple dish with tuna, potatoes, onions, peppers, and tomatoes.

basque country.name: Piperade
basque country.description: This dish is a vegetable stew prepared with onion, green peppers, and tomatoes sautéd and flavoured with a type of red pepper.

cantabria.name: Tuna pot
cantabria.description: The dish is a simple dish with tuna, potatoes, onions, peppers, and tomatoes.

cantabria.name: Cocido montañés
cantabria.description: The dish is a traditional stew from the Cantabria region in northern Spain. It is made with large white beans, chorizo, and pork, and is a hearty and filling meal.

cantabria.name: Cocido
cantabria.description: The dish is a warm and heavy dish whose origin is the 17th century and it was cooked to fight against the cold and wet climate in the Cantabrian mountains

cantabria.name: Cocido lebaniego
cantabria.description: The dish is a traditional dish from the region of Liébana in Cantabria, Spain. This stew has some essential ingredients, which include chickpea from the municipality of Potes, potatoes, and collard greens (nowadays cabbage is sometimes substituted for the collard greens)

grenada.name: Oil down
grenada.description: The dish is a stew of breadfruit, salted meat, chicken, dumplings, callaloo, and other Vegetable stewed in coconut milk, herbs, and spices.

malaga.name: Gazpachuelo
malaga.description: The dish is a soup originating in Málaga, Spain, and is a typical fisher's dish, consisting of mayonnaise, garlic, egg yolk, and olive oil

madrid.name: Cocido madrileño
madrid.description: The dish is a traditional chickpea-based stew associated to the Madrid region.[1] It is most popular during the winter

kyoto.name: Yatsuhashi
kyoto.description: The dish is made of glutinous rice flour, sugar, and cinnamon.

kyoto.name: Yudoufu
kyoto.description: This hot pot dish is tofu simmered in a kombu stock and served with ponzu and various condiments.

nagoya.name: Tenmusu
nagoya.description: Rice ball wrapped with nori that is filled with deep-fried tempura shrimp.

karachi.name: Bun kebab
karachi.description: The dish is a sandwich. It is eaten as a regular street food. It is usually eaten as a main course or snack. It consists of a shallow-fried spicy patty, onions, and chutney. The chutney is made up from tamarind, salt, cumin powder, whole red chillies, and/or yogurt in a grilled bun. The patties are typically composed of ground beef or mutton, ground lentils, powdered cumin seeds, and an egg batter. Although they can be vegetarian. The patties are fried in ghee or oil. They can also be served with a fried egg or omelette and topped with tomatoes, cucumbers, or onions.

denver.name: Denver sandwich
denver.description: The dish consists of an omelette (consisting of at least ham, onion, green pepper, and scrambled eggs), sandwiched between two pieces of bread.

porto.name: Francesinha
porto.description: The dish is a sandwich made with layers of toasted bread and assorted hot meats such as roast, steak, wet-cured ham over which sliced cheese is melted by the ladling of a near-boiling tomato-and-beer sauce. It is typically served with french fries.

porto.name: Bacalhau à Zé do Pipo
porto.description: It is an oven baked dish, consisting in layers of cod (previously boiled in milk), onion (or pickles), mashed potatoes with a hint of ground nutmeg, and mayonnaise.

porto.name: Tripas à moda do Porto
porto.description: The dish is a beef stomach with white beans, carrots, and rice.
porto.photoCredit: Jeremy Keith from Brighton & Hove, United Kingdom

durban.name: Bunny chow
durban.description: The dish consisting of a hollowed-out loaf of white bread filled with curry and a serving of salad on the side.

mozambique.name: Matapa
mozambique.description: The dish is prepared with young cassava leaves, which are usually ground in a large wooden mortar and pestle before being cooked with garlic, onion and coconut milk.

zhejiang.name: Tea egg
zhejiang.description: The dish is a savory food commonly sold as a snack, in which a boiled egg is cracked slightly and then boiled again in tea, and sauce or spices. It is also known as marble egg because cracks in the egg shell create darkened lines with marble-like patterns.

lucknow.name: Nargesi kebab
lucknow.description: The dish prepared by wrapping a mixture of minced meat, usually beef, diced onions and various spices, around a boiled egg, which is then fried in ghee or butter and eaten alongside curry or other condiments

south australia.name: Pie floater
south australia.description: This dish commonly consists of a traditional meat pie, usually sitting, but sometimes submerged (traditionally upside down) in a bowl of thick pea soup made from blue boiler peas.

mexico city.name: Chili con carne
mexico city.description: The stew's main ingredients are chilli peppers (sometimes in the form of chilli powder), meat (usually beef), tomatoes, and often pinto beans or kidney beans. Other seasonings may include garlic, onions, and cumin.

mexico city.name: Escamol
mexico city.description: This is food known as insect caviar. They are made are from the edible larvae and pupae of ants

mexico city.name: Huarache
mexico city.description: This dish consists of masa dough with smashed pinto beans placed in the centre before it is given an oblong shape, fried, and topped with green or red salsa, onions, potato, cilantro and any manner of protein such as ground beef or tongue, then finished with white cheese. It also often paired with fried cactus leaves.

hokkaido.name: Jingisukan
hokkaido.description: The dish is a grilled mutton dish prepared on a convex metal skillet or other grill. It is often cooked alongside beansprouts, onions, mushrooms, and bell peppers, and served with a sauce based in either soy sauce or sake.

hokkaido.name: Ishikari-nabe
hokkaido.description: The dish is salmon stewed in a miso-based broth with vegetable. Typical ingredients include daikon, tofu, konjac, Chinese cabbage, potato, Welsh onion, shungiku, shiitake mushroom and butter

oaxaca.name: Chalupa
oaxaca.description: This is made by pressing a thin layer of maize dough around the outside of a small mold, in the process creating a concave container and then deep frying the result to produce crisp, shallow corn cups. These are filled with various ingredients such as shredded chicken, pork, chopped onion, chipotle pepper, red salsa, and/or green salsa

oaxaca.name: Totopo
oaxaca.description: The food is a flat, round, or triangular corn item similar to a tortilla, that has been toasted, fried or baked.

oaxaca.name: Tlayuda
oaxaca.description: This food consists of a large, thin, crunchy, partially fried or toasted tortilla covered with a spread of refried beans, unrefined pork lard, lettuce or cabbage, avocado, meat, cheese, and sauces.
oaxaca.photoCredit: The original uploader was Bobak at English Wikipedia .

oaxaca.name: Arroz negro
oaxaca.description: This dish is made with rice and gets its dark color from black bean broth.

oaxaca.name: Nicuatole
oaxaca.description: This dish is a gelatinous dessert made from ground maize and sugar.

yucatan.name: Cochinita pibil
yucatan.description: This is a slow-roasted pork dish. The high acid content of the marinade and the slow cooking time tenderise the meat, allowing otherwise tough pieces of meat to be used. This dish is marinated in bitter oranges. In areas where bitter oranges are not common, the juice of sweet oranges combined with lemons, limes, or vinegar is employed to approximate the effect of the bitter orange on the meat.

oxford.name: Oxford sausage
oxford.description: The modern version is considered, typically, to consist of a mixture of pork and veal, seasoned with lemon and herbs.
oxford.photoCredit: Sausages_Oxford.jpg : Kaihsu Tai derivative work: Pyrope ( talk )

guadalajara.name: Tlayuda
guadalajara.description: This food consists of a large, thin, crunchy, partially fried or toasted tortilla covered with a spread of refried beans, unrefined pork lard, lettuce or cabbage, avocado, meat, cheese, and sauces.
guadalajara.photoCredit: The original uploader was Bobak at English Wikipedia .

guadalajara.name: Bionico
guadalajara.description: This dish is a fruit salad consisting of a variety of fruits chopped up into small cubes, drenched with cream and topped off with granola, shredded coconut, raisins and sometimes honey.

new orleans.name: New Orleans hot sausage
new orleans.description: This food is made of pork or a blend of beef and pork, and seasoned with cayenne pepper, paprika, onions, garlic, black pepper and salt.

north yorkshire.name: Wensleydale cheese
north yorkshire.description: This is a medium cheese that is supple and crumbly. It has a slight honey aroma.

samegrelo.name: Sulguni
samegrelo.description: This is a type of cheese that has a sour, moderately salty flavor, a dimpled texture, and an elastic consistency.

pará.name: Açaí na tigela
pará.description: The dish is made from frozen and mashed fruit of the acai palm with creamy texture.

rio grande do sul.name: Sagu
rio grande do sul.description: The dish is made of tapioca pearls, sugar, and red wine.

rio grande do sul.name: Churrasco
rio grande do sul.description: The dish is a grilled red meat, sometimes served in skewers or sliced meat.

santa catarina.name: Sagu
santa catarina.description: The dish is made of tapioca pearls, sugar, and red wine.

santa catarina.name: Churrasco
santa catarina.description: The dish is a grilled red meat, sometimes served in skewers or sliced meat.

parana.name: Sagu
parana.description: The dish is made of tapioca pearls, sugar, and red wine.

zagreb.name: Kotlovina
zagreb.description: The dish is a stewed meat dish and sausages stewed in their own juice with onions, potatoes, tomatoes, bell peppers, and paprika.

madagascar.name: Koba
madagascar.description: The food is sweet from ground peanuts, brown sugar, and rice flour. It is made by wrapping a batter of ground peanuts, mashed bananas, honey and corn flour in banana leaves and steaming or boiling the small cakes until the batter has set.

bahia.name: Caruru
bahia.description: The food made from okra, onion, shrimp, palm oil and toasted nuts (peanuts and/or cashews).

dar es salaam.name: Chipsi mayai
dar es salaam.description: The dish is a simple potato-egg omelette.
